summary.en: Research is local, but prompts and related data go to your provider; Cloud contract promises do not cover your API account.
summary.zh: 研究保存在本地，但提示词及相关数据会发送给供应商；Cloud 合同承诺不覆盖你的 API 账户。

description.en: API keys are stored in the operating system credential store and excluded from workspace backups. Deleting local research does not delete provider copies, exported files, operating-system backups or material shared with support; those copies may require separate deletion.
description.zh: API 密钥保存在操作系统凭据存储中，不包含在工作区备份内。删除本地研究不会删除供应商副本、导出文件、操作系统备份或分享给支持团队的材料；这些副本可能需要单独删除。

summary.en: Local deletion does not remove provider copies, exports, OS backups or support-shared material.
summary.zh: 删除本地数据不会移除供应商副本、导出文件、系统备份或分享给支持团队的材料。

description.en: Website audits make ordinary network requests and reveal your connection IP address to the sites checked; optional browser rendering may launch a local browser. Version 0.1.0 sends no research or app-usage analytics to Serpwise, but Microsoft Store, Windows, WebView2 and other operating-system services remain subject to their own privacy terms.
description.zh: 网站审计会发起普通网络请求，并向被检查站点暴露连接 IP；可选浏览器渲染可能启动本地浏览器。0.1.0 版不会向 Serpwise 发送研究或应用使用分析，但 Microsoft Store、Windows、WebView2 及其他操作系统服务仍适用各自隐私条款。

summary.en: Audits expose your IP to checked sites; no Serpwise telemetry in 0.1.0, but Microsoft/OS privacy terms still apply.
summary.zh: 审计会向被检查站点暴露 IP；0.1.0 无 Serpwise 遥测，但 Microsoft/操作系统隐私条款仍适用。

description.en: The MIT license provides the software as is, without warranties, and limits liability of the authors or copyright holders. Provider API access, charges, data handling and response availability remain governed by the connected providers rather than Serpwise.
description.zh: MIT 许可证按原样提供软件，不作保证，并限制作者或版权持有人的责任。供应商 API 访问、费用、数据处理和响应可用性由所连接的供应商决定，而非 Serpwise。

summary.en: Software is provided as is without warranty; provider access, charges and data handling remain external.
summary.zh: 软件按原样提供且无保证；供应商访问、费用与数据处理仍属外部依赖。

description.en: Choose Serpwise Visibility Studio when you want direct brand-mention and citation research without a desktop subscription and already manage provider API accounts. Scope the choice to the free local BYOK desktop app: it is not a consumer-chat or hosted market-share panel, provider budgets and device availability need separate planning, and Serpwise Cloud is a separate paid platform rather than an included second monitoring product.
description.zh: 若希望无需桌面订阅即可开展直接品牌提及与引用研究，且已自行管理供应商 API 账户，可选择 Serpwise Visibility Studio。选择范围仅限免费的本地自带密钥桌面应用：它不是消费端聊天或托管市场份额面板，需另行规划供应商预算与设备可用性；Serpwise Cloud 是独立付费平台，不是随附的第二个监测产品。

summary.en: Free local BYOK tracker; plan provider budgets and device availability; Cloud is separate.
summary.zh: 免费本地自带密钥追踪器；需规划供应商预算与设备可用性；Cloud 为独立产品。

label.en: Serpwise Visibility Studio official product, pricing and download page
label.zh: Serpwise Visibility Studio 官方产品、定价与下载页

label.en: Serpwise Visibility Studio desktop privacy notice
label.zh: Serpwise Visibility Studio 桌面隐私声明

label.en: Microsoft Store listing for Serpwise Visibility Studio
label.zh: Microsoft Store 上的 Serpwise Visibility Studio 列表
Serpwise Visibility Studio MIT 许可证
Serpwise 运营主体与联系方式

description.en: Track brand visibility, share of voice, sentiment, competitors and citations across major AI answer engines, then generate and publish GEO content with agency white-label workflows.
description.zh: 追踪品牌在主要 AI 回答引擎中的曝光、声量占比、情绪、竞品与引用，并生成和发布 GEO 内容，支持代理白标工作流。

en: AI answer monitoring
GEO content workflow
Agency white-label
zh: AI 回答监测
GEO 内容工作流
代理白标

en: Track whether buyer questions name the brand across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode and Claude, with engine availability depending on the plan.
Review share of voice, sentiment, competitors, cited sources, query fan-out, content gaps and prompt search volume, and run a technical GEO audit.
Generate source-backed GEO articles, publish them on request to connected CMS platforms, and track indexing plus AI-referred GA4 traffic.
Manage multiple brands or agency client sites from one account, use white-label reports, localize by country and language, and read Howseen data through a rate-limited REST API or MCP server.
zh: 追踪购买问题是否在 ChatGPT、Gemini、Perplexity、Google AI Overviews、Google AI Mode 与 Claude 中提及品牌，具体引擎依方案而定。
查看声量占比、情绪、竞品、引用来源、查询扩展、内容缺口和提示词搜索量，并运行技术 GEO 审计。
生成有来源支撑的 GEO 文章，按请求发布到已连接的内容管理系统，并追踪收录情况和 GA4 的 AI 引荐流量。
在一个账户中管理多个品牌或代理客户站点，使用白标报告，按国家和语言本地化，并通过限流的 REST API 或 MCP 服务器读取 Howseen 数据。

audience.en: DTC e-commerce brands, B2B SaaS marketing teams and agencies that want AI visibility monitoring combined with content execution and client reporting.
audience.zh: 希望将 AI 曝光监测与内容执行、客户报告结合的 DTC 电商品牌、B2B SaaS 营销团队和代理机构。

description.en: Keep a recurring set of buyer questions and compare brand mentions, share of voice, sentiment, competitors and cited sources across the AI engines included in the selected plan.
description.zh: 维护固定的购买问题集合，比较所选方案包含的 AI 引擎中的品牌提及、声量占比、情绪、竞品与引用来源。

summary.en: Recurring buyer-question monitoring with competitor and citation evidence.
summary.zh: 带竞品与引用证据的购买问题持续监测。

description.en: Turn identified visibility and source gaps into GEO articles, publish them through a connected CMS, and follow indexing, search performance and AI-referred traffic alongside later AI-answer scans.
description.zh: 将已发现的曝光和来源缺口转化为 GEO 文章，通过已连接的内容管理系统发布，并结合后续 AI 回答扫描跟踪收录、搜索表现和 AI 引荐流量。

summary.en: Move from measured visibility gaps to published GEO content and follow-up tracking.
summary.zh: 从已测量的曝光缺口推进到 GEO 内容发布与后续追踪。

description.en: Manage several client brands from one dashboard, deliver white-label reports, and expose selected Howseen observations to internal assistants or workflows through read-only API or MCP access.
description.zh: 在一个仪表板中管理多个客户品牌，交付白标报告，并通过只读 API 或 MCP 将选定的 Howseen 观察结果接入内部助手或工作流。

summary.en: Multi-client agency reporting with optional API and MCP access.
summary.zh: 多客户代理报告，并提供可选 API 与 MCP 接入。

description.en: Starter is EUR €39/month or €31/month equivalent billed €372/year, with 20 prompts every 3 days, 5 GEO articles/month, 1 brand and 3 engines. Pro is €79/month or €63/month equivalent with a quoted €758/year total, 50 prompts every 3 days, 15 articles/month, 1 brand, 5 engines and white-label reports. Business starts at €249/month or €199/month equivalent billed €2,388/year, with 100–300 daily prompts shared across 3 brands, 30–90 articles/month and 6 engines. Enterprise is custom. Team seats are unlimited, and the terms state that VAT is not applicable under the French VAT-exemption scheme.
description.zh: Starter 为每月 39 欧元，或年付月均 31 欧元、账单 372 欧元/年；含 20 个每三天追踪的提示词、每月 5 篇 GEO 文章、1 个品牌和 3 个引擎。Pro 为每月 79 欧元，或年付月均 63 欧元、页面引用总额 758 欧元/年；含 50 个每三天追踪的提示词、每月 15 篇文章、1 个品牌、5 个引擎和白标报告。Business 自每月 249 欧元起，或年付月均 199 欧元、账单 2,388 欧元/年；含 3 个品牌共享的每日 100–300 个提示词、每月 30–90 篇文章和 6 个引擎。Enterprise 定制。团队席位不限；条款称按法国增值税豁免制度不征收 VAT。

summary.en: Paid plans from €39/month; annual equivalents €31/€63/€199 with quoted yearly totals.
summary.zh: 付费方案自 39 欧元/月起；年付月均 31/63/199 欧元，并列出年度总额。

description.en: Agency annual rates are €57/site/month for 2–4 sites with a quoted €683/site/year, €54/site/month for 5–14 sites with a quoted €645/site/year, and €51/site/month for 15+ sites with a quoted €607/site/year. Each site receives the Pro feature set. The page states a 25% discount from 25 sites with a €50/site minimum; Enterprise is custom for 50+ sites.
description.zh: 代理年付价格为：2–4 个站点每站点每月 57 欧元、页面引用 683 欧元/站点/年；5–14 个站点每站点每月 54 欧元、引用 645 欧元/年；15+ 个站点每站点每月 51 欧元、引用 607 欧元/年。每个站点获得 Pro 功能集。页面称从 25 个站点起优惠 25%，最低每站点 50 欧元；50+ 站点为定制 Enterprise。

summary.en: Agency annual pricing is per client site from €51–€57/month equivalent, with volume discounts.
summary.zh: 代理年付按客户站点计费，月均 51–57 欧元起，并享用量折扣。

description.en: The 3-day trial requires a valid payment method and charges nothing if canceled before the end of day 3; otherwise it converts automatically, with at least 24 hours' email notice before the first charge. Monthly payments are non-refundable. Annual payments are non-refundable outside a conditional 90-day guarantee, which requires the subscription to remain active for 90 days and at least six Howseen-prepared articles to stay online, public and indexable, plus the stated visibility and optional traffic conditions. A claim must be emailed within 14 days after day 90 and is limited to once per brand on the first annual subscription.
description.zh: 3 天试用需要有效支付方式；在第 3 天结束前取消则不收费，否则自动转付费，并在首次扣费前至少提前 24 小时邮件通知。月付不可退。年付除有条件的 90 天保障外不可退；保障要求订阅持续有效 90 天、至少 6 篇 Howseen 撰写文章保持在线公开且可收录，并满足规定的曝光及可选流量条件。索赔须在第 90 天后 14 天内邮件提交，且每个品牌首次年订阅仅限一次。

summary.en: Three-day card-required trial; monthly payments non-refundable; annual refund is conditional.
summary.zh: 三天试用需绑卡；月付不可退；年付退款设有条件。

description.en: Published arithmetic and feature copy are inconsistent: €63 × 12 is €756, not the quoted €758; agency totals imply €684, €648 and €612 rather than the quoted €683, €645 and €607. The Pro card says daily tracking while its prompt quantity and comparison table say every 3 days. Pricing includes API/MCP in all plans, About limits it to Pro and Business, and Terms says subscribers including trial users can create keys. Confirm the invoice and entitlement before purchase.
description.zh: 公开算术和功能文案不一致：63 欧元 × 12 为 756 欧元，而非引用的 758 欧元；代理总额按乘法应为 684、648 和 612 欧元，而非引用的 683、645 和 607 欧元。Pro 卡片写每日追踪，但提示词数量和对比表写每三天。定价页称所有方案含 API/MCP，About 只列 Pro 和 Business，条款又称包括试用在内的订阅者可创建密钥。采购前应确认账单金额和权益。

summary.en: Annual arithmetic, Pro cadence and API/MCP eligibility conflict across official pages.
summary.zh: 官方页面在年度算术、Pro 频率和 API/MCP 权益上存在冲突。

description.en: The privacy policy names AI model providers and a specialized AI-answer data provider by category rather than company. Tracked questions, website content and brand information are sent to providers; some processing may occur outside the EEA with safeguards. The current subprocessor list is available on request under the DPA. Data sent from Howseen to Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor through API/MCP is governed by those assistant providers. No saved-login or specific authorization conflict was found, but provider-specific retention and training terms are not public.
description.zh: 隐私政策按类别而非公司名称列出 AI 模型供应商和专门的 AI 回答数据供应商。追踪问题、网站内容和品牌信息会发送给供应商；部分处理可能发生在欧洲经济区之外，并设有保障措施。最新子处理者名单可依 DPA 索取。通过 API/MCP 从 Howseen 发送到 Claude、ChatGPT 或 Cursor 的数据适用对应助手供应商条款。未发现保存登录或具体授权冲突，但各供应商的保留和训练条款未公开。

summary.en: AI providers are unnamed publicly; their retention and training terms need confirmation.
summary.zh: AI 供应商未公开具名；其保留和训练条款需确认。

description.en: AI-generated content can contain errors and requires review before publication. The service does not guarantee visibility, ranking, citations or business results. The trial can have reduced limits and is one per customer; the 90-day refund is conditional rather than an unconditional money-back offer.
description.zh: AI 生成内容可能出错，发布前需要审核。服务不保证曝光、排名、引用或业务结果。试用可能缩减额度且每位客户仅限一次；90 天退款是有条件保障，并非无条件退款承诺。

summary.en: Content needs review; outcomes are not guaranteed and refunds are conditional.
summary.zh: 内容需审核；不保证结果，退款设有条件。

description.en: Choose Howseen when a brand or agency wants AI visibility monitoring combined with GEO content production, CMS publishing and white-label reporting rather than analytics alone. Confirm the Pro tracking cadence, API/MCP eligibility and final annual invoice total before purchase.
description.zh: 若品牌或代理机构希望将 AI 曝光监测与 GEO 内容生产、内容管理系统发布和白标报告结合，而非只购买分析面板，可选择 Howseen。采购前应确认 Pro 追踪频率、API/MCP 权益和最终年度账单金额。

summary.en: Monitoring plus GEO execution and agency reporting; confirm plan inconsistencies first.
summary.zh: 监测结合 GEO 执行与代理报告；需先确认方案不一致项。

label.en: Howseen AI company and product details
label.zh: Howseen AI 公司与产品详情

description.en: A credit-based AI search analytics product that combines direct model APIs with crawling AI search interfaces to track brand mentions, sentiment, competitors, citations and share of voice, with buyer-persona question research and BI exports.
description.zh: 按 credits 计费的 AI 搜索分析产品，结合直接模型 API 与 AI 搜索界面爬取，追踪品牌提及、情绪、竞品、引用和声量占比，并提供购买者画像问题研究与 BI 导出。

en: Branded and unbranded SOV
Buyer-persona questions
Credit-based analytics
zh: 品牌与非品牌声量
购买者画像问题
Credits 分析

en: Track brand presence, sentiment, misinformation and perception trends across Google AI Overviews, Bing Copilot, SearchGPT, ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, DeepSeek and other supported models.
Separate branded and unbranded AI Share of Voice, compare competitors and cited sources, and identify positioning shifts and content gaps.
Build buyer-persona and full-customer-journey question sets, upload custom prompts, and research multilingual long-tail questions.
Schedule recurring tracking and reports, receive alerts and AI commentary, and export CSV, PDF or API data or connect Looker Studio, Power BI and Tableau.
zh: 在 Google AI Overviews、Bing Copilot、SearchGPT、ChatGPT、Gemini、Claude、Perplexity、DeepSeek 及其他支持模型中追踪品牌出现、情绪、错误信息和认知趋势。
区分品牌词与非品牌词 AI 声量占比，比较竞品与引用来源，并识别定位变化和内容缺口。
构建购买者画像和完整客户旅程问题集，上传自定义提示词，并研究多语言长尾问题。
安排持续追踪和报告，接收提醒与 AI 解读，并导出 CSV、PDF 或 API 数据，或连接 Looker Studio、Power BI 和 Tableau。

audience.en: In-house enterprise SEO, e-commerce, brand and PR teams that need multi-model AI answer analytics, structured question research and data warehouse or BI integrations.
audience.zh: 需要多模型 AI 回答分析、结构化问题研究以及数据仓库或 BI 集成的企业内 SEO、电商、品牌和公关团队。

description.en: Monitor how AI answers describe a brand, detect sentiment or misinformation shifts, and compare brand mentions and citations with competitors across supported answer engines.
description.zh: 监测 AI 回答如何描述品牌，发现情绪或错误信息变化，并在支持的回答引擎中比较品牌与竞品的提及和引用。

summary.en: Cross-model brand reputation and competitor monitoring.
summary.zh: 跨模型品牌声誉与竞品监测。

description.en: Create persona-specific questions across the customer journey and compare branded brand-reputation queries with unbranded category queries to produce a clearer view of competitive AI Share of Voice.
description.zh: 围绕客户旅程创建画像专属问题，并比较品牌声誉查询与非品牌分类查询，以更清晰地观察竞争性 AI 声量占比。

summary.en: Persona-led question research with separate branded and unbranded flows.
summary.zh: 画像驱动的问题研究，区分品牌与非品牌流程。

description.en: Plan monitoring volume with the published credit formula, run recurring scans, and move results into internal reporting through scheduled reports, exports, BigQuery or BI connectors.
description.zh: 使用公开的 credits 公式规划监测量，运行持续扫描，并通过计划报告、导出、BigQuery 或 BI 连接器将结果送入内部报告流程。

summary.en: Credit-planned recurring monitoring with exports and BI integration.
summary.zh: 按 credits 规划的持续监测，并提供导出与 BI 集成。

description.en: AI Search Free is GBP £0 with 50 credits. Monthly plans are P1 £89 with 2,000 credits, P2 £229 with 6,000, P3 £379 with 15,000, Enterprise 1 £1,129 with 42,000, Enterprise 2 £1,769 with 75,000 and Enterprise 3 £2,409 with 125,000. Overage CPM rates are respectively £50, £42, £37, £31, £27 and £22. Credits/month = sites × questions × frequency × model unit cost: most models cost 1 credit, flagship API models 2, search-grounded models 2 on Enterprise only, and the premium search-grounded model 5 on Enterprise only. The official example calculates 3 × 25 × 4 × (1 + 2) = 900 credits/week and converts it to 3,600/month using a four-week month.
description.zh: AI Search Free 为 0 英镑，含 50 credits。月付方案为：P1 89 英镑含 2,000 credits；P2 229 英镑含 6,000；P3 379 英镑含 15,000；Enterprise 1 1,129 英镑含 42,000；Enterprise 2 1,769 英镑含 75,000；Enterprise 3 2,409 英镑含 125,000。超额 CPM 费率依次为 50、42、37、31、27 和 22 英镑。每月 credits = 站点数 × 问题数 × 频率 × 模型单价：多数模型 1 credit，旗舰 API 模型 2 credits，带搜索模型仅 Enterprise 可用且 2 credits，高级带搜索模型仅 Enterprise 可用且 5 credits。官方示例按 3 × 25 × 4 × (1 + 2) = 900 credits/周，并以四周一月换算为 3,600 credits/月。

summary.en: Free 50 credits plus GBP £89–£2,409 monthly plans; model cost is 1–5 credits per query.
summary.zh: Free 含 50 credits，另有 89–2,409 英镑月方案；每查询模型成本为 1–5 credits。

description.en: Annual billing is labelled 1 month Free. The quoted yearly totals are P1 £979, P2 £2,519, P3 £4,169, Enterprise 1 £12,419, Enterprise 2 £19,459 and Enterprise 3 £26,499; each equals 11 times the corresponding monthly price. Annual overage CPM rates are £550, £462, £407, £341, £297 and £242 respectively. Fees are exclusive of applicable taxes.
description.zh: 年付标示为免 1 个月。引用的年度总额为：P1 979 英镑、P2 2,519 英镑、P3 4,169 英镑、Enterprise 1 12,419 英镑、Enterprise 2 19,459 英镑、Enterprise 3 26,499 英镑；分别等于对应月付价格的 11 倍。年付超额 CPM 费率依次为 550、462、407、341、297 和 242 英镑。费用不含适用税费。

summary.en: Annual totals equal 11 monthly payments, ranging from £979 to £26,499.
summary.zh: 年度总额等于 11 个月付，从 979 英镑到 26,499 英镑。

description.en: The dedicated pricing page currently lists 50 free credits, while the product FAQ says 100 questions against one provider. Generic Trial Account terms describe a usually 14-day discounted trial that auto-converts unless canceled, but do not establish that as the AI Search trial. Paid payments are non-refundable with no partial-period credits. Rolling monthly cancellation requires written 30-day notice taking effect after the current billing period; quarterly, bi-annual and annual subscriptions require notice 30 days before period end to avoid renewal.
description.zh: 专门定价页当前列出 50 个免费 credits，而产品 FAQ 写可对一个供应商运行 100 个问题。通用 Trial Account 条款描述通常 14 天的折扣试用，不取消则自动转付费，但未明确证明这就是 AI Search 试用。付费不可退，不按部分周期提供抵扣。滚动月订阅取消须提前 30 天书面通知，并在当前账期结束后生效；季度、半年和年度订阅须在周期结束前 30 天通知以避免续费。

summary.en: Free allowance and trial wording conflict; paid cancellation needs 30 days' written notice.
summary.zh: 免费额度与试用文案冲突；付费取消须提前 30 天书面通知。

description.en: The product page advertises hourly, daily, weekly or monthly tracking, while the current pricing calculator offers daily, weekly or monthly frequency. The product FAQ's 100 free questions also conflicts with the dedicated page's 50-credit Free plan. Treat the dedicated pricing page as the current price source and confirm hourly access and the exact free allowance before relying on them.
description.zh: 产品页宣传每小时、每日、每周或每月追踪，而当前定价计算器只提供每日、每周或每月频率。产品 FAQ 的 100 个免费问题也与专门定价页的 50-credit Free 方案冲突。应以专门定价页为当前价格来源，并在依赖每小时访问或确切免费额度前加以确认。

summary.en: Hourly tracking and free-access wording are not aligned across official pages.
summary.zh: 官方页面在每小时追踪和免费访问说明上不一致。

description.en: The product explicitly combines direct API integrations for Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude and DeepSeek with crawling AI search interfaces such as Google AI Overviews, Bing Copilot and Perplexity. The public subprocessor list names VooServers, HubSpot, Intercom and Segment, but not AI model providers. Provider-specific retention, training and authorization arrangements are therefore not public. Terms acknowledge third-party restrictions and do not guarantee source availability; no saved-login or specific authorization conflict was found, but procurement should confirm the provider arrangements.
description.zh: 产品明确结合 Gemini、ChatGPT、Claude 和 DeepSeek 的直接 API 集成，以及 Google AI Overviews、Bing Copilot、Perplexity 等 AI 搜索界面的爬取。公开子处理者名单列有 VooServers、HubSpot、Intercom 和 Segment，但未列 AI 模型供应商。因此各供应商的保留、训练和授权安排未公开。条款承认第三方限制且不保证来源可用性；未发现保存登录或具体授权冲突，但采购前应确认供应商安排。

summary.en: AI-provider identities and provider-specific data terms are not fully public.
summary.zh: AI 供应商身份及其特定数据条款未完全公开。

description.en: The privacy policy was last updated in July 2025 and allows sharing with service providers and partners, retention for legal or legitimate business needs, and transfers outside the EEA with safeguards such as SCCs. The DPA was last updated in May 2018 and still references older Privacy Shield and SCC mechanisms. The DPA does contain processing-instruction, security, 48-hour breach-notice and return/deletion commitments, but its age is a legal-document transparency gap.
description.zh: 隐私政策最后更新于 2025 年 7 月，允许与服务供应商和合作伙伴共享、为法律或合法业务需要保留数据，并在设有 SCCs 等保障措施的情况下向欧洲经济区外传输。DPA 最后更新于 2018 年 5 月，仍引用较旧的 Privacy Shield 和 SCC 机制。DPA 确实包含按指示处理、安全、48 小时数据泄露通知和返还/删除承诺，但其年代构成法律文件透明度缺口。

summary.en: Privacy and DPA documents are dated, and international/provider sharing needs review.
summary.zh: 隐私与 DPA 文件较旧，国际传输和供应商共享需复核。

description.en: Standard terms restrict platform use to the customer and its users for internal business purposes, so agencies planning client-facing redistribution should obtain written confirmation. Direct API outputs and crawled interface answers can differ, and the service does not guarantee third-party data availability or business outcomes.
description.zh: 标准条款将平台使用限定为客户及其用户的内部业务用途，因此计划向客户再分发结果的代理机构应取得书面确认。直接 API 输出与爬取的界面回答可能不同，服务也不保证第三方数据可用性或业务结果。

summary.en: Internal-use terms constrain agency redistribution; API and UI observations can differ.
summary.zh: 内部使用条款限制代理再分发；API 与界面观察结果可能不同。

description.en: Choose Authoritas AI Search Brand Analyser for credit-based multi-model analytics, branded and unbranded Share of Voice, buyer-persona question research and BI exports, especially for in-house enterprise teams. Confirm the free allowance, hourly access, AI-provider terms and any agency redistribution rights before purchase.
description.zh: 若需要按 credits 计费的多模型分析、品牌与非品牌声量占比、购买者画像问题研究和 BI 导出，尤其是企业内团队，可选择 Authoritas AI Search Brand Analyser。采购前应确认免费额度、每小时访问、AI 供应商条款及任何代理再分发权限。

summary.en: Enterprise-oriented AI search analytics with persona research and BI; confirm plan and provider details.
summary.zh: 面向企业的 AI 搜索分析，含画像研究与 BI；需确认方案和供应商细节。

label.en: Authoritas AI Search Brand Analyser official product
label.zh: Authoritas AI Search Brand Analyser 官方产品

label.en: Authoritas AI Search pricing and credit calculator
label.zh: Authoritas AI Search 定价与 credits 计算器
Authoritas 联系方式与注册地址

label.en: Linkdex legacy SEO platform and Authoritas operator disclosure
label.zh: Linkdex 旧版 SEO 平台与 Authoritas 运营主体说明
Authoritas 基础设施供应商与子处理者

description.en: Track brand visibility, position, sentiment, competitors and citations in answers shown by major AI apps, with scheduled scans and answer-level evidence.
description.zh: 持续追踪品牌在主要 AI 应用回答中的曝光、位置、情绪、竞品与引用，并按计划扫描、保留回答级证据。

en: Brand visibility
Sentiment
Answer evidence
zh: 品牌曝光
情绪分析
回答证据

en: Monitor ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode, Perplexity, Microsoft Copilot, DeepSeek, Muse, Claude and Grok.
Review brand mentions, position, sentiment, competitors, recommending sites, raw answers and recommendations.
Schedule daily, three-times-weekly or weekly scans and use Web, MCP, API or CLI access.
Calculate visibility from successfully read answers and mark a run unavailable when no answer can be read.
zh: 监测 ChatGPT、Gemini、Google AI Overviews、Google AI Mode、Perplexity、Microsoft Copilot、DeepSeek、Muse、Claude 与 Grok。
查看品牌提及、位置、情绪、竞品、推荐站点、原始回答与推荐结果。
按每日、每周三次或每周扫描，并通过 Web、MCP、API 或 CLI 使用。
根据成功读取的回答计算曝光；全部无法读取时将结果标为不可用，而不是零曝光。

audience.en: Marketing and agency teams that need recurring, evidence-backed AI answer monitoring.
audience.zh: 需要持续、可追溯地监测 AI 回答的营销与代理团队。

description.en: Keep a stable set of buyer questions and review recurring changes in brand mentions, sentiment, position and cited sources across selected AI apps.
description.zh: 维护固定的购买问题集合，持续复盘品牌在选定 AI 应用中的提及、情绪、位置与引用来源变化。

summary.en: Recurring buyer-question monitoring with answer evidence.
summary.zh: 带回答证据的购买问题持续监测。

description.en: Monthly plans are Starter USD $19 with 1,000 credits and 1 project; Growth USD $99 with 6,000 credits and 6 projects; Pro USD $249 with 16,000 credits and 16 projects; Scale USD $549 with 36,000 credits and 36 projects; Agency USD $1,190 with 85,000 credits and 85 projects; and Enterprise USD $2,490 with 200,000 credits and 200 projects. Custom starts above 200,000 credits. Standard AI-app answers cost 1 credit, Muse 4, and Claude or Grok 6; a weekly brief costs 25 credits per project and a scan has a 10-credit minimum. Extra credits are USD $20 per 1,000 on lower tiers or USD $15 on higher tiers. Annual billing is prepaid at a 20% discount. The seven-day trial requires a card and is not an ongoing free plan.
description.zh: 月付方案为：Starter 19 美元，含 1,000 credits、1 个项目；Growth 99 美元，含 6,000 credits、6 个项目；Pro 249 美元，含 16,000 credits、16 个项目；Scale 549 美元，含 36,000 credits、36 个项目；Agency 1,190 美元，含 85,000 credits、85 个项目；Enterprise 2,490 美元，含 200,000 credits、200 个项目。200,000 credits 以上可定制。标准 AI 应用回答每条约 1 credit，Muse 4 credits，Claude 或 Grok 6 credits；每周简报每项目 25 credits，单次扫描最低 10 credits。低档加购 1,000 credits 为 20 美元，高档为 15 美元。年付预付并优惠 20%。七天试用需绑卡，不属于长期免费方案。

summary.en: Paid monthly credit plans from USD $19; annual prepayment saves 20%.
summary.zh: 付费 credits 月方案自 19 美元起；年付预付优惠 20%。

description.en: Credit cost varies by AI app and scan cadence. Failed or unread answers are excluded from visibility calculations, and a fully unread run is unavailable rather than 0%. The method does not establish that a visibility change was caused by an edit, visit or sale.
description.zh: 费用随 AI 应用和扫描频率变化。失败或无法读取的回答不计入曝光计算；全部无法读取时结果为不可用，而不是 0%。其方法不把曝光变化归因于内容编辑、访问或销售。

summary.en: Engine costs vary; unread answers are not zero visibility.
summary.zh: 引擎费用不同；无法读取不等于零曝光。

description.en: The privacy policy names DataForSEO, Bright Data, Scrapeless and Cloro for asking AI apps questions. Private archives have no routine deletion schedule, account deletion requests are generally handled within 30 days, OpenRouter has a no-training restriction with a Muse Contributor exception, and Meta may use data to improve its products and models.
description.zh: 隐私政策列明 DataForSEO、Bright Data、Scrapeless 与 Cloro 用于向 AI 应用提问。私有归档没有例行删除时间表，账户删除请求通常在 30 天内处理；OpenRouter 有不训练限制但 Muse Contributor 为例外，Meta 可能使用数据改进其产品和模型。

summary.en: Third-party collection and provider-specific data terms apply.
summary.zh: 适用第三方采集及供应商特定数据条款。

description.en: Choose Frontmost when self-service prompt tracking, raw answer evidence and a published credit model are priorities; confirm the engine mix and scan cadence against the monthly allowance.
description.zh: 若重视自助提示词追踪、原始回答证据和公开的 credits 计费模型，可选择 Frontmost；采购前应按月度额度核对引擎组合与扫描频率。

summary.en: Self-service monitoring with published credit costs.
summary.zh: 提供公开 credits 成本的自助监测。

label.zh: Frontmost AI 联系与运营主体

description.en: Run category prompt sets daily across major AI engines and track brand mentions, rank, descriptions, sentiment, citations, competitors and share of voice over time.
description.zh: 每日在多类 AI 引擎运行分类提示词集合，持续追踪品牌提及、排名、描述、情绪、引用、竞品与声量占比。

en: Brand visibility
Daily tracking
Share of voice
zh: 品牌曝光
每日追踪
声量占比

en: Track brand mentions, AI rank, brand descriptions, sentiment, citations, competitors and share of voice.
Run tracked prompts every day across ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, DeepSeek, Grok and Google AI Overviews.
Use category prompt collections, historical trends and public brand reports or an open AI-answer dataset.
Manage multiple projects and custom prompts within plan limits.
zh: 追踪品牌提及、AI 排名、品牌描述、情绪、引用、竞品与声量占比。
每日在 ChatGPT、Gemini、Claude、Perplexity、DeepSeek、Grok 与 Google AI Overviews 运行所追踪的提示词。
使用分类提示词集合、历史趋势、公开品牌报告或开放 AI 回答数据集。
在方案额度内管理多个项目和自定义提示词。

audience.en: In-house SEO, marketing and agency teams comparing brand visibility in AI search.
audience.zh: 希望比较品牌在 AI 搜索中曝光表现的企业 SEO、营销与代理团队。

description.en: Review daily changes in brand mentions and AI rank for a fixed category prompt set, then compare competitors and cited sources in the stored answers.
description.zh: 针对固定分类提示词集合复盘品牌提及和 AI 排名的每日变化，并比较竞品与已存回答中的引用来源。

summary.en: Daily category-level brand visibility review.
summary.zh: 每日分类级品牌曝光复盘。

description.en: Free includes up to 10 projects, 20 custom prompts and 600 answers per month. Paid monthly plans are Basic USD $39 with 100 custom prompts and 3,000 answers per month; Starter USD $169 with 450 custom prompts and 13,500 answers per month; and Pro USD $379 with 1,050 custom prompts and 31,500 answers per month. Paid plans list unlimited projects. Enterprise is custom. The answer allowances follow the published prompts × 30 calculation. An FAQ still says paid plans start at USD $30 per month, which conflicts with the current USD $39 Basic card and is not used as the current price.
description.zh: Free 最多含 10 个项目、20 个自定义提示词和每月 600 条回答。付费月方案为：Basic 39 美元，含 100 个自定义提示词和每月 3,000 条回答；Starter 169 美元，含 450 个提示词和每月 13,500 条回答；Pro 379 美元，含 1,050 个提示词和每月 31,500 条回答。付费方案标示项目不限。Enterprise 定制。回答额度按公开的提示词数量 × 30 计算。FAQ 仍写付费方案自 30 美元/月起，与当前 Basic 39 美元卡片冲突，因此不把 30 美元作为当前价格。

summary.en: Free tier plus USD $39/$169/$379 monthly plans; FAQ price is stale.
summary.zh: 提供 Free 及 39/169/379 美元月方案；FAQ 价格已过时。

description.en: The About page says Trendos's own crawlers collect the prompts it tracks; it does not describe those crawlers as the mechanism that retrieves AI answers. The public pages reviewed do not identify answer-collection suppliers, interface versus API methods or authorization arrangements. No saved-login or specific authorization conflict was found, but this remains a transparency gap rather than a legality certification.
description.zh: About 页面称 Trendos 自有爬虫用于收集其追踪的提示词，并未说明这些爬虫就是获取 AI 回答的机制。已审阅的公开页面未指明回答采集供应商、界面或 API 方法及授权安排。未发现保存登录或具体授权冲突，但这仍是透明度缺口，不构成合法性认证。

summary.en: Answer-collection method and suppliers are not publicly specified.
summary.zh: 未公开说明回答采集方法与供应商。

description.en: The current pricing page and an older FAQ disagree on the entry paid price. Terms also state that specific AI-platform compatibility is not guaranteed, subscriptions renew automatically, taxes are additional and payments are generally non-refundable.
description.zh: 当前定价页与较早 FAQ 的最低付费价格不一致。条款还说明不保证特定 AI 平台兼容性，订阅自动续费、税费另计且付款原则上不可退。

summary.en: Pricing copy conflicts and platform compatibility is not guaranteed.
summary.zh: 价格文案冲突且不保证平台兼容性。

description.en: Choose Trendos for daily category prompt benchmarking, historical brand reports and an open dataset; confirm the current paid tier and answer-collection arrangements before procurement.
description.zh: 若需要每日分类提示词对标、历史品牌报告和开放数据集，可选择 Trendos；采购前应确认当前付费档位及回答采集安排。

summary.en: Daily category benchmarking with public brand data.
summary.zh: 提供公开品牌数据的每日分类对标。

description.en: Monitor buyer questions across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews, with visibility, share of voice, position and citation reporting plus optional Claude API tracking.
description.zh: 监测 ChatGPT、Perplexity、Gemini 与 Google AI Overviews 中的购买问题，提供曝光、声量占比、位置和引用报告，并可选接入 Claude API。

en: Buyer questions
Brand visibility
Citations
zh: 购买问题
品牌曝光
引用分析

en: Track visibility, share of voice, average position and citations for 5–200 buyer questions.
Schedule daily, every two days, three times weekly, weekly or manual runs.
Compare competitors and citation sources, review Reddit mentions and turn findings into recommended tasks.
Use API, MCP, Looker Studio, Search Console, white-label reporting and unlimited seats; Claude tracking uses the customer's Anthropic key.
zh: 针对 5–200 个购买问题追踪曝光、声量占比、平均位置和引用。
支持每日、每两日、每周三次、每周或手动运行。
比较竞品与引用来源、查看 Reddit 提及，并将发现转化为建议任务。
提供 API、MCP、Looker Studio、Search Console、白标报告和不限席位；Claude 追踪使用客户自己的 Anthropic 密钥。

audience.en: Growth and SEO teams tracking how buyer questions influence AI recommendations.
audience.zh: 希望了解购买问题如何影响 AI 推荐的增长与 SEO 团队。

description.en: Track a defined set of buyer questions on a chosen cadence and review changes in visibility, average position, share of voice and cited sources alongside competitor movement.
description.zh: 按选定频率追踪一组购买问题，结合竞品变化复盘曝光、平均位置、声量占比和引用来源。

summary.en: Buyer-question visibility and competitor reporting.
summary.zh: 购买问题曝光与竞品报告。

description.en: The current self-service price is USD $29 per month per brand, comprising a USD $20 platform fee and USD $9 included usage. India pricing is INR 2,499 plus GST per month, including INR 855 usage. Supplier-key mode adds 30%; BYOK pays suppliers directly without that markup. Published usage rates per 1,000 runs are ChatGPT USD $4.68, Perplexity USD $3.90, Gemini USD $3.77, Google AI Overviews USD $3.51 and Claude USD $30.82. The first full scan is free without a card, but ongoing tracking is paid. Done-for-you service starts at USD $1,000 per month and is not the software-only price.
description.zh: 当前自助价格为每品牌每月 29 美元，其中平台费 20 美元、包含用量 9 美元。印度价格为每月 2,499 印度卢比加 GST，包含 855 印度卢比用量。供应商密钥模式加收 30%；BYOK 直接向供应商付费且不加收该费用。公开的每 1,000 次运行用量价格为：ChatGPT 4.68 美元、Perplexity 3.90 美元、Gemini 3.77 美元、Google AI Overviews 3.51 美元、Claude 30.82 美元。首次完整扫描免费且无需绑卡，但持续追踪为付费。代运营服务自每月 1,000 美元起，不属于纯软件价格。

summary.en: USD $29/month per brand plus usage rules; first scan only is free.
summary.zh: 每品牌每月 29 美元并有用量规则；仅首次扫描免费。

description.en: The pricing page and 2026-11-18 pricing article say unused usage rolls over, while the 2026-11-07 terms still say credits do not roll over. The formal terms therefore lag the product copy, and rollover should be confirmed in the order. The public site identifies founder Tarang Agarwal and Bengaluru, India, but does not state the contracting entity's full legal name.
description.zh: 定价页和 2026-11-18 的定价文章称未用用量可滚存，但 2026-11-07 的正式条款仍写 credits 不滚存。正式条款落后于产品文案，滚存应在订单中确认。公开网站标明创始人 Tarang Agarwal 和印度班加罗尔，但未披露签约实体的完整法律名称。

summary.en: Terms lag rollover copy; full contracting entity is not public.
summary.zh: 条款滞后于滚存文案；未公开完整签约实体。

description.en: Claude requires the customer's own Anthropic key and is not presented as the same collection path as the four consumer-facing surfaces. Usage charges vary substantially by engine, so total cost depends on question count, cadence and Claude volume.
description.zh: Claude 需要客户自己的 Anthropic 密钥，并不与四个面向消费者的界面采用同一采集路径。不同引擎的用量费用差异较大，总成本取决于问题数量、频率和 Claude 用量。

summary.en: Claude is BYOK and engine usage costs differ.
summary.zh: Claude 使用 BYOK，且各引擎用量费用不同。

description.en: Choose GetIntel when buyer-question tracking, flexible scan cadence and BYOK are priorities; confirm rollover and the contracting entity in the order before relying on the published terms.
description.zh: 若重视购买问题追踪、灵活扫描频率和 BYOK，可选择 GetIntel；依赖公开条款前，应在订单中确认滚存规则和签约实体。

summary.en: Flexible buyer-question tracking with BYOK.
summary.zh: 提供灵活购买问题追踪和 BYOK。

description.en: Track daily brand presence, position, competitors, sentiment, intent and citations across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot and AI Overview, with an Action Center for visibility gaps.
description.zh: 每日追踪品牌在 ChatGPT、Gemini、Perplexity、Copilot 与 AI Overview 中的出现、位置、竞品、情绪、意图和引用，并通过 Action Center 处理曝光缺口。

en: Brand visibility
Daily tracking
Action Center
zh: 品牌曝光
每日追踪
行动中心

en: Monitor brand presence and absence, position, competitors, sentiment, intent, citations and source intelligence.
Refresh visibility daily, review historical trends and identify gaps through an Action Center.
Cover ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Microsoft Copilot and Google AI Overview.
Include the GoVISIBLE MCP across plans and offer optional extra engines and credit add-ons.
zh: 监测品牌出现与缺失、位置、竞品、情绪、意图、引用和来源情报。
每日刷新曝光，查看历史趋势，并通过 Action Center 识别缺口。
覆盖 ChatGPT、Gemini、Perplexity、Microsoft Copilot 与 Google AI Overview。
所有方案包含 GoVISIBLE MCP，并提供可选加购引擎和 credits。

audience.en: Marketing and SEO teams seeking a self-service AI visibility dashboard.
audience.zh: 希望使用自助 AI 曝光看板的营销与 SEO 团队。

description.en: Review daily brand presence, position and sentiment for a prompt set, compare competitors and citations, and turn identified visibility gaps into actions.
description.zh: 每日复盘一组提示词中的品牌出现、位置和情绪，比较竞品与引用，并将曝光缺口转化为行动。

summary.en: Daily brand dashboard with gap-oriented actions.
summary.zh: 提供每日品牌看板和缺口导向行动。

description.en: Monthly plans are Starter USD $49 for 1 project, 2 engines, 100 prompts and 200 credits; Growth USD $79 for 1 project, 3 engines, 150 prompts and 500 credits; and Professional USD $139 for 1 project, 3 engines, 150 prompts and 2,000 credits with AI assistants and workflows. Enterprise is custom. Annual billing displays a 15% discount. An extra engine costs USD $30 per month and a 500-credit add-on costs USD $50. The free audit is a one-time lead or audit offer, not an ongoing free monitoring tier.
description.zh: 月方案为：Starter 49 美元，含 1 个项目、2 个引擎、100 个提示词和 200 credits；Growth 79 美元，含 1 个项目、3 个引擎、150 个提示词和 500 credits；Professional 139 美元，含 1 个项目、3 个引擎、150 个提示词和 2,000 credits，并提供 AI 助手与工作流。Enterprise 定制。年付显示优惠 15%。加购引擎为每月 30 美元，500 credits 加购为 50 美元。免费审计为一次性获客或审计服务，不属于持续免费监测档位。

summary.en: USD $49/$79/$139 monthly plans; annual billing saves 15%.

description.en: The public pages reviewed do not name the AI-answer collection suppliers or specify interface versus API collection. The privacy policy says primary data is stored on cloud servers in the United States and India and usage data may be retained for up to 90 days after termination. No saved-login or specific authorization conflict was found, but collection transparency remains limited.
description.zh: 已审阅的公开页面未点名 AI 回答采集供应商，也未说明采用界面还是 API 采集。隐私政策称主要数据存储于美国和印度云服务器，终止后使用数据最多保留 90 天。未发现保存登录或具体授权冲突，但采集透明度仍有限。

summary.en: Collection suppliers are undisclosed; retention can reach 90 days.
summary.zh: 未披露采集供应商；数据最多保留 90 天。

description.en: Starter, Growth and Professional have direct subscription access, while Agency Starter, Growth and Advanced are marked Coming soon. Plans include only two or three engines before add-ons, and the one-time free audit should not be treated as recurring Free monitoring.
description.zh: Starter、Growth 和 Professional 可直接订阅，而 Agency Starter、Growth 和 Advanced 标示为即将推出。加购前方案仅含两个或三个引擎，一次性免费审计不应视为持续 Free 监测。

summary.en: Agency tiers are not open; base plans cover only 2–3 engines.
summary.zh: Agency 档位未开放；基础方案仅含 2–3 个引擎。

description.en: Choose GoVISIBLE for a self-service brand dashboard with MCP and optional engine add-ons; verify the live plan and included engine count because agency tiers are not yet open.
description.zh: 若需要带 MCP 和可选引擎加购的自助品牌看板，可选择 GoVISIBLE；由于 Agency 档位尚未开放，应核实可用方案及所含引擎数量。

summary.en: Self-service dashboard with MCP and engine add-ons.
summary.zh: 提供带 MCP 和引擎加购的自助看板。

description.en: Monitor brand mentions, position, share of voice, sentiment, competitors and citations across AI engines, with multi-market analysis, content opportunities and API or MCP access.
description.zh: 监测品牌在 AI 引擎中的提及、位置、声量占比、情绪、竞品与引用，并提供多市场分析、内容机会及 API 或 MCP 访问。

en: Brand visibility
Multi-market
API and MCP
zh: 品牌曝光
多市场
API 与 MCP

en: Track mentions, position, share of voice, citations, source intelligence, prompt analysis, sentiment and competitors across brands, markets and languages.
Cover ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode, DeepSeek, Microsoft Copilot, Grok and Mistral AI.
Distinguish interface collection for ChatGPT, AI Overviews, AI Mode, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot and Grok from API use for Claude, DeepSeek and Mistral AI.
Identify content opportunities and provide MCP on all paid plans, with API access from Growth and exports from Pro.
zh: 跨品牌、市场和语言追踪提及、位置、声量占比、引用、来源情报、提示词分析、情绪和竞品。
覆盖 ChatGPT、Gemini、Perplexity、Claude、Google AI Overviews、Google AI Mode、DeepSeek、Microsoft Copilot、Grok 与 Mistral AI。
区分 ChatGPT、AI Overviews、AI Mode、Perplexity、Gemini、Copilot、Grok 的界面采集与 Claude、DeepSeek、Mistral AI 的 API 使用。
识别内容机会；所有付费方案提供 MCP，Growth 起提供 API，Pro 起提供导出。

audience.en: Marketing and SEO teams managing multiple brands, markets or languages.
audience.zh: 管理多个品牌、市场或语言的营销与 SEO 团队。

description.en: Compare brand visibility and share of voice across selected markets and languages, investigate citation sources and competitors, and prioritize content opportunities from prompt-level analysis.
description.zh: 比较选定市场和语言中的品牌曝光与声量占比，调查引用来源和竞品，并依据提示词级分析确定内容机会优先级。

summary.en: Multi-market brand and citation analysis.
summary.zh: 多市场品牌与引用分析。

description.en: Monthly prices excluding VAT are Starter EUR €79 for 3 engines, 50 prompts, 1 brand, 1 month of history and MCP; Pro EUR €199 for 3 engines, 150 prompts, 3 brands, exports, a monthly site audit, 2 months of history and MCP; and Growth EUR €379 for 3 engines, 300 prompts, 7 brands, API, a weekly site audit, 6 months of history, priority support and MCP. Enterprise is custom for up to 10 engines, 400+ prompts, unlimited brands, all-time history and SSO/SAML. Annual billing shows monthly equivalents of €69, €175 and €333 with a 12% saving and is billed yearly; these are not official annual totals. A seven-day trial is offered. Starter has no exports or API, and Pro has no API.
description.zh: 不含 VAT 的月价为：Starter 79 欧元，含 3 个引擎、50 个提示词、1 个品牌、1 个月历史和 MCP；Pro 199 欧元，含 3 个引擎、150 个提示词、3 个品牌、导出、每月站点审计、2 个月历史和 MCP；Growth 379 欧元，含 3 个引擎、300 个提示词、7 个品牌、API、每周站点审计、6 个月历史、优先支持和 MCP。Enterprise 定制，最多 10 个引擎、400+ 提示词、不限品牌、全部历史和 SSO/SAML。年付显示月均等价价 69、175、333 欧元，优惠 12%，按年账单结算；这些不是官方年度总额。提供七天试用。Starter 无导出或 API，Pro 无 API。

summary.en: EUR €79/€199/€379 monthly ex-VAT; API starts at Growth.
summary.zh: 月付 79/199/379 欧元不含 VAT；Growth 起提供 API。

description.en: Data-collection providers are contracted and subject to data-protection and no-training terms, but their names are not public and are available through the DPA subprocessor list on request. DeepSeek is optional and off by default; enabling it sends prompts to China. Monitoring data is retained during the subscription, then kept for 30 days for export before deletion, with backups on a 30-day rotation.
description.zh: 数据采集供应商受合同、数据保护和不训练条款约束，但名单不公开，可通过 DPA 分包商清单按需获取。DeepSeek 为可选项且默认关闭；启用后提示词会发送至中国。监测数据在订阅期内保留，结束后再保留 30 天供导出，之后删除；备份按 30 天轮转。

summary.en: Provider names are not public; DeepSeek can transfer prompts to China.
summary.zh: 供应商名单不公开；DeepSeek 可向中国传输提示词。

description.en: Interface collection and model API calls are different evidence paths and should not be treated as equivalent consumer-app observations. Feature access is tiered: exports begin at Pro and API at Growth. Output rights and platform-use restrictions are defined in the terms.
description.zh: 界面采集和模型 API 调用属于不同证据路径，不应视为等价的消费者应用观察。功能按档位区分：Pro 起提供导出，Growth 起提供 API。输出权利和平台使用限制以条款为准。

summary.en: Collection paths differ; exports and API are tiered.
summary.zh: 采集路径不同；导出与 API 按档位提供。

description.en: Choose Superlines for multi-brand or multi-market monitoring with MCP and higher-tier API access; account for VAT, engine limits and the DeepSeek transfer setting when configuring the service.
description.zh: 若需要多品牌或多市场监测、MCP 和较高档位 API，可选择 Superlines；配置时应考虑 VAT、引擎限制和 DeepSeek 传输设置。

summary.en: Multi-market SaaS with tiered API access.
summary.zh: 提供分档 API 的多市场 SaaS。

description.en: Self-hosted, evidence-oriented brand visibility monitoring using versioned prompts and OpenAI-compatible model APIs, with mentions, explicit ranks, citations, failures and trends.
description.zh: 使用版本化提示词和 OpenAI 兼容模型 API 的自托管、重证据品牌曝光监测，记录提及、显式排名、引用、失败与趋势。

en: Open source
Self-hosted
API replay
zh: 开源
自托管
API 回放

en: Run versioned prompt sets against multiple OpenAI-compatible models and store evidence for each run.
Track brand mentions, explicit rankings, Chinese and English aliases, citations, failures and historical trends.
Schedule daily, weekly or manual runs and distinguish timeout, rate-limit, parse and API failures from zero visibility.
Provide a bilingual dashboard on Python 3.9+ with no third-party Python runtime dependencies.
zh: 对多个 OpenAI 兼容模型运行版本化提示词集合，并保存每次运行证据。
追踪品牌提及、显式排名、中英文别名、引用、失败和历史趋势。
支持每日、每周或手动运行，并区分超时、限流、解析及 API 失败与零曝光。
基于 Python 3.9+ 提供双语看板，无第三方 Python 运行时依赖。

audience.en: Technical SEO and AI teams that need self-hosted, auditable model-answer monitoring.
audience.zh: 需要自托管、可审计模型回答监测的技术 SEO 与 AI 团队。

description.en: Replay a controlled prompt set against configured OpenAI-compatible endpoints and review brand mentions, explicit ranks and citations while retaining failed runs as separate evidence.
description.zh: 对配置的 OpenAI 兼容端点回放受控提示词集合，复盘品牌提及、显式排名和引用，并将失败运行单独保留为证据。

summary.en: Auditable self-hosted model-answer monitoring.
summary.zh: 可审计的自托管模型回答监测。

description.en: The software is free under Apache-2.0. Users pay their own model and search API providers and any hosting, database or operational costs. The README's CNY 5–10 per month figure is an example estimate, not a vendor bill or guaranteed total cost.
description.zh: 软件依据 Apache-2.0 免费。用户需自行承担模型和搜索 API 供应商费用，以及托管、数据库或运维成本。README 中每月 5–10 元人民币只是示例估算，不是厂商账单或总成本保证。

summary.en: Free Apache-2.0 software; API and infrastructure costs are separate.
summary.zh: Apache-2.0 软件免费；API 与基础设施成本另计。

description.en: This is OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions replay, not observation of the consumer ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude or Perplexity interfaces. The official provider guide states that API success does not reproduce consumer apps' search, memory, system prompts or product orchestration. Direct Anthropic Messages API is unsupported without a compatible gateway or new adapter. No consumer AI Overviews coverage is claimed.
description.zh: 这是 OpenAI 兼容 Chat Completions 回放，不是对消费者 ChatGPT、Gemini、Claude 或 Perplexity 界面的观察。官方供应商指南明确，API 接入成功不代表复刻消费端应用的搜索、记忆、系统提示词或产品编排。没有兼容网关或新适配器时不支持直接 Anthropic Messages API，也不宣称覆盖消费者 AI Overviews。

summary.en: Model API replay does not reproduce consumer AI interfaces.
summary.zh: 模型 API 回放不等同于消费者 AI 界面。

description.en: Model names, availability and prices change and must be checked with each provider. The repository was created in September 2026 and its latest listed release is v0.1.1, so operational maturity should be evaluated before production use. Search-source gaps are recorded as missing evidence rather than brand absence or rank zero.
description.zh: 模型名称、可用性和价格会变化，需以各供应商当前信息为准。仓库创建于 2026 年 9 月，最新列出的版本为 v0.1.1，生产使用前应评估运维成熟度。搜索来源缺口记录为证据缺失，而不是品牌未出现或排名零。

summary.en: Early release; provider and search evidence can be incomplete.
summary.zh: 版本较早；供应商和搜索证据可能不完整。

description.en: Choose GEO Visibility Lab when self-hosted, auditable API replay matters more than consumer-interface fidelity; budget separately for provider calls and operations.
description.zh: 若更重视自托管、可审计的 API 回放而非消费者界面保真度，可选择 GEO Visibility Lab；应为供应商调用和运维单独预算。

summary.en: Self-hosted auditable API replay, not consumer UI tracking.
summary.zh: 自托管可审计 API 回放，而非消费者界面追踪。

label.zh: GEO Visibility Lab 官方仓库
GEO Visibility Lab 供应商指南
GEO Visibility Lab Apache-2.0 许可证
GEO Visibility Lab 安全政策
GEO Visibility Lab 运营主体

description.en: Self-hosted AI answer monitoring for brand mentions, citations, recommendations, competitors and share of voice, using OpenRouter models and optional DataForSEO surface checks.
description.zh: 自托管 AI 回答监测，追踪品牌提及、引用、推荐、竞品和声量占比，使用 OpenRouter 模型及可选 DataForSEO 界面检查。

en: Open source
Self-hosted
Brand visibility
zh: 开源
自托管
品牌曝光

en: Track brand mentions, citations, recommendations, competitors, share of voice and a project-defined GEO score.
Use OpenRouter for Perplexity Sonar and GPT model API checks, with optional DataForSEO checks for ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Mode and Perplexity LLM responses.
Keep consumer-surface DataForSEO results separate from OpenRouter model API answers and record attempted, succeeded, failed and skipped runs.
Deploy with Docker Compose using Next.js, oRPC, Better Auth, BullMQ, PostgreSQL/Drizzle and Redis.
zh: 追踪品牌提及、引用、推荐、竞品、声量占比和项目自定义 GEO 分数。
通过 OpenRouter 进行 Perplexity Sonar 与 GPT 模型 API 检查，并可选通过 DataForSEO 检查 ChatGPT、Gemini、Google AI Mode 和 Perplexity LLM 回答。
将 DataForSEO 消费者界面结果与 OpenRouter 模型 API 回答分开，并记录尝试、成功、失败和跳过的运行。
使用 Docker Compose 部署，技术栈包括 Next.js、oRPC、Better Auth、BullMQ、PostgreSQL/Drizzle 和 Redis。

audience.en: Technical teams able to operate a self-hosted Next.js stack and manage provider credentials.
audience.zh: 能够运维自托管 Next.js 技术栈并管理供应商凭证的技术团队。

description.en: Run recurring prompt checks for a brand, compare mentions, citations, recommendations and competitors, and retain per-model success or failure records without substituting one provider path for another.
description.zh: 为品牌运行周期性提示词检查，比较提及、引用、推荐和竞品，并保留各模型成功或失败记录，不以一种供应商路径替代另一种。

summary.en: Self-hosted multi-provider brand answer checks.
summary.zh: 自托管多供应商品牌回答检查。

description.en: The software is free under AGPL-3.0. OpenRouter credentials are required and DataForSEO credentials are optional for its surface checks. Users pay OpenRouter, DataForSEO, database, hosting and operational costs separately. There is no public hosted subscription price in the reviewed repository.
description.zh: 软件依据 AGPL-3.0 免费。OpenRouter 凭证为必需，DataForSEO 凭证仅在其界面检查中可选。用户需另行承担 OpenRouter、DataForSEO、数据库、托管和运维成本。已审阅仓库没有公开的托管订阅价格。

summary.en: Free AGPL-3.0 software; provider and infrastructure costs are separate.
summary.zh: AGPL-3.0 软件免费；供应商与基础设施成本另计。

description.en: The current code defines DataForSEO engines as ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, Gemini and Perplexity; it does not define a separate Google AI Overviews engine. OpenRouter Perplexity Sonar is a model API, not the consumer Perplexity interface. The DataForSEO Perplexity endpoint returns structured LLM responses and should not be described as consumer-UI observation.
description.zh: 当前代码定义的 DataForSEO 引擎为 ChatGPT、Google AI Mode、Gemini 和 Perplexity，没有独立的 Google AI Overviews 引擎。OpenRouter Perplexity Sonar 是模型 API，不是 Perplexity 消费者界面；DataForSEO Perplexity 端点返回结构化 LLM 回答，也不应称为消费者界面观察。

summary.en: No separate AI Overviews engine; Sonar is a model API.
summary.zh: 无独立 AI Overviews 引擎；Sonar 为模型 API。

description.en: Current source recognizes project-level DataForSEO credentials when filtering runnable models, but the sweep calls the environment-level resolver. As a result, a key entered at project level can appear runnable without being used; the sweep needs server-level DATAFORSEO_LOGIN and DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD. The public repository has one listed initial public commit and no tagged release, so maturity and release hygiene need evaluation.
description.zh: 当前源码在筛选可运行模型时识别项目级 DataForSEO 凭证，但实际扫描调用环境级解析器。因此项目级输入的密钥可能显示可运行却未被使用；扫描需要服务器级 DATAFORSEO_LOGIN 和 DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD。公开仓库仅列出一个初始公开提交且没有 tagged release，应评估其成熟度和发布卫生。

summary.en: Project-level DataForSEO keys are not used by the current sweep.
summary.zh: 当前扫描不使用项目级 DataForSEO 密钥。

description.en: Choose this tracker for a self-hosted stack centered on OpenRouter with optional server-level DataForSEO credentials; validate credential placement before relying on consumer-surface checks.
description.zh: 若需要以 OpenRouter 为核心、可选服务器级 DataForSEO 凭证的自托管技术栈，可选择此追踪器；依赖消费者界面检查前应验证凭证配置位置。

summary.en: Self-hosted OpenRouter tracking with optional DataForSEO.
summary.zh: 自托管 OpenRouter 追踪，可选 DataForSEO。

label.zh: AI Visibility Tracker 官方仓库
AI Visibility Tracker AGPL-3.0 许可证
AI Visibility Tracker GEO 编排源码
DataForSEO Perplexity LLM Responses 文档

description.en: Track AI-answer citations at source level across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and Google AI Mode, with competitor context and answer-change analysis.
description.zh: 在 ChatGPT、Google AI Overviews、Perplexity 和 Google AI Mode 中按来源层级追踪 AI 回答引用，并提供竞品对照与回答变化分析。

en: Citation tracking
Competitor analysis
Answer history
zh: 引用追踪
竞品分析
回答历史

en: Inspect citation sources for an owned brand, competitors, and third parties.
Review prompts, competitor citations, citation velocity, and Answer Diff comparisons.
Use daily scans, CSV export, API access, and client workspaces according to plan.
zh: 查看自有品牌、竞品和第三方内容的引用来源。
结合提示词、竞品引用、引用速度与 Answer Diff 对比回答变化。
按方案使用每日扫描、CSV 导出、API 和客户工作区。

audience.en: SEO and GEO teams, growth marketers, and agencies that need source-level citation and competitor reporting.
audience.zh: 需要来源层级引用与竞品报告的 SEO、GEO、增长营销团队和代理商。

description.en: Maintain a prompt set and review which source categories support the brand, competitors, and third-party publishers in AI answers.
description.zh: 维护一组提示词，复查 AI 回答中支持自有品牌、竞品和第三方出版方的来源类别。

summary.en: Review brand, competitor, and third-party citation sources.
summary.zh: 复盘品牌、竞品与第三方引用来源。

description.en: Compare answers before and after content changes and follow citation velocity to prioritize sources for further investigation.
description.zh: 对比内容变更前后的回答，并结合引用速度确定需进一步调查的来源。

summary.en: Investigate answer changes and citation momentum.
summary.zh: 调查回答变化与引用趋势。

description.en: Separate client data into workspaces and use plan-dependent API, CSV, and white-label reporting for agency delivery.
description.zh: 将客户数据隔离到不同工作区，并按方案使用 API、CSV 和白标报告交付代理项目。

summary.en: Organize multi-brand and agency reporting.
summary.zh: 组织多品牌与代理报告。

description.en: Monthly plans are Starter at USD $49 for 40 prompts, two engines, three competitors, one workspace, and 10 Studio credits; Professional at USD $149 for 150 prompts, four engines, 10 competitors, three workspaces, 30 credits, and full API; Agency at USD $399 for 400 prompts, unlimited competitors, 25 client workspaces, 200 credits, and white label. Enterprise is custom.
description.zh: 月付方案为：Starter 49 美元，含 40 个提示词、2 个引擎、3 个竞品、1 个工作区和 10 个 Studio 积分；Professional 149 美元，含 150 个提示词、4 个引擎、10 个竞品、3 个工作区、30 个积分和完整 API；Agency 399 美元，含 400 个提示词、不限竞品、25 个客户工作区、200 个积分和白标功能。Enterprise 定制报价。

summary.en: Monthly plans: $49, $149, and $399; Enterprise custom.
summary.zh: 月付 49、149、399 美元；企业版定制。

description.en: Annual billing advertises 17% savings and shows Starter at USD $39 per month when billed annually. All plans include unlimited seats. The page says data is preserved after cancellation; its FAQ specifies 30 days.
description.zh: 年付标示节省 17%，Starter 显示为按年结算时每月 39 美元。所有方案均含不限席位；定价页称取消后保留数据，FAQ 明确为 30 天。

summary.en: Starter is $39/month billed annually; unlimited seats.
summary.zh: Starter 年付折合 39 美元/月；席位不限。

description.en: The public terms and privacy pages are dated March 1, 2024. The terms refer to a refund policy whose public link is broken, and the pricing page describes SOC 2 as in progress.
description.zh: 公开条款与隐私页标注日期为 2024 年 3 月 1 日；条款引用的公开退款政策链接已失效，定价页显示 SOC 2 仍在进行中。

summary.en: Legal-page dates and refund-policy availability need review.
summary.zh: 法律页日期与退款政策可用性需复查。

description.en: Engine coverage, API access, and workspaces vary by plan. The terms provide the analytics service as is and allow service modification or discontinuation.
description.zh: 引擎覆盖、API 和工作区因方案而异；条款按现状提供分析服务，并允许修改或停止服务。

summary.en: Plan limits and as-is service terms apply.
summary.zh: 受方案限额与按现状服务条款约束。

description.en: The fit is source-level citation and competitor analysis with agency workspaces. The trade-off is that public refund and security-maturity documentation is less complete than the product evidence.
description.zh: 其优势是来源层级引用、竞品分析和代理工作区；取舍是公开退款与安全成熟度资料不如产品证据完整。

summary.en: Task fit and trade-off based on official evidence.
summary.zh: 基于官方证据的任务适配与取舍。

description.en: Monitor AI-answer citations by domain, save answers, and compare brand and competitor sources across several AI engines.
description.zh: 按域名监测 AI 回答引用、保存回答，并在多个 AI 引擎中对照品牌与竞品来源。

en: Domain citations
Saved answers
Competitor analysis
zh: 域名引用
回答存档
竞品分析

en: Analyze cited domains alongside saved AI answers.
Review brand and competitor references in the collected answers.
Run prompt-based monitoring across plan-supported AI engines.
zh: 结合保存的 AI 回答分析被引域名。
复查收集回答中的品牌与竞品引用。
在方案支持的 AI 引擎中运行提示词监测。

audience.en: Small marketing teams and brands that need recurring domain-level citation monitoring.
audience.zh: 需要持续进行域名层级引用监测的小型营销团队和品牌。

description.en: Track which domains are cited for a saved prompt set and compare the brand with competitors in the same answer collection.
description.zh: 追踪保存提示词集中的被引域名，并在同一回答集合内比较品牌与竞品。

summary.en: Compare cited domains for brands and competitors.
summary.zh: 比较品牌与竞品的被引域名。

description.en: Use saved answers as the review context when a domain gains or loses visibility in monitored prompts.
description.zh: 当某域名在受监测提示词中曝光增减时，以保存的回答作为复查上下文。

summary.en: Review citation changes with answer context.
summary.zh: 结合回答上下文复查引用变化。

description.en: Monthly plans are Starter at USD $29 for 2,000 credits, 50 prompts, two projects, and four engines; Pro at USD $99 for 8,000 credits, 150 prompts, and five projects; Team at USD $299 for 25,000 credits, 500 prompts, and 20 projects.
description.zh: 月付方案为：Starter 29 美元，含 2,000 积分、50 个提示词、2 个项目和 4 个引擎；Pro 99 美元，含 8,000 积分、150 个提示词和 5 个项目；Team 299 美元，含 25,000 积分、500 个提示词和 20 个项目。

summary.en: Monthly plans: $29, $99, and $299.

description.en: Official annual totals are USD $276 for Starter, USD $948 for Pro, and USD $2,868 for Team. Credits are a collection budget, and prompts are shared at account level.
description.zh: 官方年付总额为：Starter 276 美元、Pro 948 美元、Team 2,868 美元。积分属于采集预算，提示词在账户层级共享。

summary.en: Annual totals: $276, $948, and $2,868.

description.en: The verified citation view is domain-level; the reviewed official pages do not establish exact-page citation tracking. Engine and channel availability depends on the plan and service status.
description.zh: 已核验的引用视图为域名层级；所审官方页面未确立精确页面引用追踪。引擎与渠道可用性取决于方案和服务状态。

summary.en: Domain-level evidence, with plan-dependent coverage.
summary.zh: 域名层级证据；覆盖依方案而定。

description.en: Credits do not guarantee a successful answer for every collection attempt. No persistent free monitoring plan was established.
description.zh: 积分不保证每次采集都成功获得回答；未确立持续免费监测方案。

summary.en: Credits are a budget, not guaranteed answers.
summary.zh: 积分是预算，不保证获得回答。

description.en: GeoEcho offers straightforward domain-level monitoring and explicit annual totals. It is a fit when domain analysis is sufficient, rather than when exact cited-page inventory is required.
description.zh: GeoEcho 提供直接的域名层级监测和明确年付总额；适合域名分析足够的场景，而非需要精确被引页面清单的场景。

summary.en: Task fit and trade-off based on official evidence.
summary.zh: 基于官方证据的任务适配与取舍。

description.en: Track cited domains and URLs, identify citation gaps, and compare competitor content across AI search platforms.
description.zh: 追踪被引域名和 URL、识别引用缺口，并跨 AI 搜索平台比较竞品内容。

en: URL citations
Citation gaps
Content analysis
zh: URL 引用
引用缺口
内容分析

en: Inspect cited domains and URLs for tracked prompts.
Identify citation gaps and competitor content opportunities.
Follow citation coverage trends across supported engines.
zh: 查看受监测提示词的被引域名和 URL。
识别引用缺口与竞品内容机会。
跟踪支持引擎中的引用覆盖趋势。

audience.en: Content-led marketing teams that need URL-level citation and competitor-gap analysis.
audience.zh: 需要 URL 层级引用与竞品缺口分析的内容营销团队。

description.en: Review the exact URLs cited for priority prompts and group them by domain to understand source concentration.
description.zh: 查看重点提示词被引的精确 URL，并按域名分组以了解来源集中度。

summary.en: Inspect cited URLs and domain patterns.
summary.zh: 检查被引 URL 与域名分布。

description.en: Compare competitor-cited content with owned coverage to build a research queue for missing topics and pages.
description.zh: 比较竞品被引内容与自有覆盖，建立缺失主题和页面的研究队列。

summary.en: Prioritize content gaps from competitor citations.
summary.zh: 依据竞品引用确定内容缺口优先级。

description.en: Monthly pricing cards list Starter at USD $99 for 5,000 credits, 50 prompts per day, 15 articles, and 50 AI replies; Standard at USD $199 for 12,000 credits, 100 prompts, 30 articles, and 100 replies; Pro at USD $399 for 30,000 credits, 300 prompts, 50 articles, and 200 replies. Enterprise is custom and adds Claude on the pricing card.
description.zh: 月付价格卡列出：Starter 99 美元，含 5,000 积分、每日 50 个提示词、15 篇文章和 50 次 AI 回复；Standard 199 美元，含 12,000 积分、100 个提示词、30 篇文章和 100 次回复；Pro 399 美元，含 30,000 积分、300 个提示词、50 篇文章和 200 次回复。Enterprise 定制，价格卡显示增加 Claude。

summary.en: Monthly plans: $99, $199, and $399; Enterprise custom.
summary.zh: 月付 99、199、399 美元；企业版定制。

description.en: Annual billing is offered at a discount, but the reviewed pricing page does not publish actual annual totals.
description.zh: 提供折扣年付，但所审定价页未公布实际年付总额。

summary.en: Annual discount available; totals not published.
summary.zh: 有年付折扣；未公布总额。

description.en: The FAQ mentions Bing Copilot and varying coverage, while the pricing cards list ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overview, and Gemini. Bing is therefore not recorded as confirmed plan coverage.
description.zh: FAQ 提及 Bing Copilot 且覆盖可能变化，但价格卡列出 ChatGPT、Perplexity、Google AI Overview 和 Gemini；因此未将 Bing 记录为已确认方案覆盖。

summary.en: Platform descriptions are inconsistent across official pages.
summary.zh: 官方页面之间的平台说明不一致。

description.en: Subscriptions renew automatically and are generally non-refundable except where law requires otherwise or a qualifying no-fault termination applies.
description.zh: 订阅自动续费；除法律另有要求或符合无过错终止条件外，通常不退款。

summary.en: Auto-renewal and limited refunds.
summary.zh: 自动续费，退款受限。

description.en: Topify combines URL-level citation analysis with content-workflow quotas. The trade-off is a higher entry price and incomplete public annual totals and platform-consistency evidence.
description.zh: Topify 将 URL 层级引用分析与内容工作流配额结合；取舍是入门价较高，且年付总额与平台一致性证据不完整。

summary.en: Task fit and trade-off based on official evidence.
summary.zh: 基于官方证据的任务适配与取舍。

description.en: Track every cited domain and individual URL for monitored prompts, classify sources, and compare owned and competitor citation gaps.
description.zh: 追踪受监测提示词的全部被引域名和单个 URL，对来源分类，并比较自有与竞品引用缺口。

en: URL citations
Source classification
Competitor gaps
zh: URL 引用
来源分类
竞品缺口

en: Review cited domains and individual URLs in domain and URL views.
Classify source types and separate owned pages from outside sources.
Filter by funnel stage, compare competitor gaps, and export CSV data.
zh: 在域名和 URL 视图中查看被引域名与单个 URL。
对来源类型分类，并区分自有页面和外部来源。
按漏斗阶段筛选、比较竞品缺口并导出 CSV。

audience.en: Growth and content teams that need detailed citation inventories and recurring competitor comparisons.
audience.zh: 需要详细引用清单和持续竞品比较的增长与内容团队。

description.en: Build a URL-level inventory of sources cited for tracked prompts and separate owned pages from third-party coverage.
description.zh: 为受追踪提示词建立 URL 层级来源清单，并区分自有页面与第三方覆盖。

summary.en: Build owned and third-party URL inventories.
summary.zh: 建立自有与第三方 URL 清单。

description.en: Use source-type and funnel-stage filters to identify competitor citations that warrant content research.
description.zh: 使用来源类型和漏斗阶段筛选，确定需进行内容研究的竞品引用。

summary.en: Prioritize competitor citation research.
summary.zh: 确定竞品引用研究优先级。

description.en: Export filtered citation records for recurring client or stakeholder reporting.
description.zh: 导出筛选后的引用记录，用于持续客户或干系人报告。

summary.en: Export citation records for reporting.
summary.zh: 导出引用记录用于报告。

description.en: Weekly-refresh plans are Starter at USD $25 for 50 prompts, one brand, and one market; Growth at USD $45 for 100 prompts, two brands, and three markets; Pro at USD $80 for 200 prompts, three brands, and five markets; Scale at USD $135 for 350 prompts, five brands, and 10 markets.
description.zh: 每周刷新方案为：Starter 25 美元，含 50 个提示词、1 个品牌和 1 个市场；Growth 45 美元，含 100 个提示词、2 个品牌和 3 个市场；Pro 80 美元，含 200 个提示词、3 个品牌和 5 个市场；Scale 135 美元，含 350 个提示词、5 个品牌和 10 个市场。

summary.en: Weekly plans: $25, $45, $80, and $135.

description.en: Daily-refresh plans are USD $85, $155, $289, and $479 with the same respective quotas. A seven-day trial requires no card and allows at most 25 prompts. Annual billing advertises one month free but does not publish an annual total.
description.zh: 每日刷新方案为 85、155、289、479 美元，配额分别与上述方案相同。七天试用无需信用卡，最多 25 个提示词；年付标示赠送一个月，但未公布年付总额。

summary.en: Daily plans: $85–$479; seven-day no-card trial.
summary.zh: 每日方案 85–479 美元；七天免信用卡试用。

description.en: Standard plans allow four engines to be selected from the listed platforms. Additional engines are described as an Enterprise API extension rather than standard-plan coverage.
description.zh: 标准方案可从所列平台中选择 4 个引擎；其他引擎属于企业版 API 扩展，而非标准方案覆盖。

summary.en: Four standard engines; extensions are enterprise API features.
summary.zh: 标准方案 4 个引擎；扩展属于企业 API。

description.en: The terms warn that AI output may be incomplete, delayed, or inconsistent. Subscriptions renew unless cancelled before renewal.
description.zh: 条款提醒 AI 输出可能不完整、延迟或不一致；订阅会在续费前未取消时自动续订。

summary.en: AI-output caveats and automatic renewal.
summary.zh: AI 输出存在不确定性，并会自动续费。

description.en: The low-cost weekly plan supports detailed URL inventories, while daily refresh costs substantially more. Buyers should choose refresh cadence before comparing prompt and brand quotas.
description.zh: 低价周更方案支持详细 URL 清单，日更费用明显更高；采购时应先确定刷新频率，再比较提示词和品牌配额。

summary.en: Task fit and trade-off based on official evidence.
summary.zh: 基于官方证据的任务适配与取舍。

description.en: Track cited domains and exact pages by topic, prompt, engine, and day, with competitor discovery, citation alerts, and AI landing-page analysis.
description.zh: 按主题、提示词、引擎和日期追踪被引域名与精确页面，并提供竞品发现、引用提醒和 AI 落地页分析。

en: Page citations
Citation alerts
AI landing pages
zh: 页面引用
引用提醒
AI 落地页

en: Break down cited domains and exact pages by topic, prompt, engine, and day.
Review cited sources, brands, follow-up questions, and brand descriptions.
Connect owned AI landing pages with GA4 and monitor competitor citation or mention share.
zh: 按主题、提示词、引擎和日期拆分被引域名与精确页面。
查看被引来源、品牌、后续问题和品牌描述。
将自有 AI 落地页连接 GA4，并监测竞品引用或提及份额。

audience.en: Established marketing teams and agencies that need page-level evidence, analytics integration, and documented billing terms.
audience.zh: 需要页面层级证据、分析集成和明确计费条款的成熟营销团队与代理商。

description.en: Identify exact owned pages cited in AI answers and inspect the prompt, topic, engine, and date behind each citation pattern.
description.zh: 识别 AI 回答中被引的自有精确页面，并检查每种引用模式背后的提示词、主题、引擎和日期。

summary.en: Trace exact pages to prompt and engine context.
summary.zh: 将精确页面追溯到提示词与引擎上下文。

description.en: Use GA4-connected AI landing pages and citation history to review what happens after an owned page is cited.
description.zh: 使用连接 GA4 的 AI 落地页和引用历史，复查自有页面被引后的表现。

summary.en: Review post-citation landing-page activity.
summary.zh: 复查被引后的落地页活动。

description.en: Discover competitors and review citation or mention share and lost-citation alerts within the Manager module.
description.zh: 在 Manager 模块中发现竞品，并复查引用或提及份额及丢失引用提醒。

summary.en: Monitor competitor share and lost citations.
summary.zh: 监测竞品份额与丢失引用。

description.en: EUR monthly and annual prices are AEO Start at €149/month or €1,490/year for 50 prompts, 1,000 monthly credits, one project, and one seat; AEO Pro at €399/month or €3,990/year for 100 prompts, 5,000 credits, three projects, and 10 seats; AEO Suite at €899/month or €8,990/year for 200 prompts, 10,000 credits, 10 projects, and 25 seats; Full Stack at €1,990/month or €19,900/year for 400 prompts, 25,000 credits, 30 projects, and 75 seats. VAT is excluded.
description.zh: 欧元月付和年付价格为：AEO Start 149 欧元/月或 1,490 欧元/年，含 50 个提示词、每月 1,000 积分、1 个项目和 1 个席位；AEO Pro 399 欧元/月或 3,990 欧元/年，含 100 个提示词、5,000 积分、3 个项目和 10 个席位；AEO Suite 899 欧元/月或 8,990 欧元/年，含 200 个提示词、10,000 积分、10 个项目和 25 个席位；Full Stack 1,990 欧元/月或 19,900 欧元/年，含 400 个提示词、25,000 积分、30 个项目和 75 个席位。不含增值税。

summary.en: €149–€1,990/month; annual totals published.
summary.zh: 149–1,990 欧元/月；公布年付总额。

description.en: A 14-day trial requires no payment method, is limited to one trial per company, and ends early when quota is exhausted. Organization credits reset monthly, including annual plans, and unused credits expire. Add-ons cover extra prompts, daily runs, engines, Claude, projects, seats, and backlinks.
description.zh: 14 天试用无需支付方式，每家公司限一次，配额耗尽时提前结束。组织积分每月重置，年付方案也不例外，未用积分会过期。附加项包括额外提示词、每日运行、引擎、Claude、项目、席位和反链。

summary.en: 14-day no-card trial; monthly credit reset and add-ons.
summary.zh: 14 天免信用卡试用；积分月重置并有附加项。

description.en: Claude is an add-on, and Google AI Mode is currently English-only. Engine access therefore depends on purchased modules and language support.
description.zh: Claude 属于附加项，Google AI Mode 目前仅支持英语；引擎访问取决于所购模块和语言支持。

summary.en: Claude add-on; AI Mode English-only.
summary.zh: Claude 需附加；AI Mode 仅英语。

description.en: Cancellation takes effect at the end of the paid period. Unused credits and partial periods are non-refundable, subject to applicable statutory rights and erroneous-charge exceptions.
description.zh: 取消在已付费周期结束时生效；除适用法定权利和错误扣款例外外，未用积分和部分周期不退款。

summary.en: No notice period, but unused credits are not refunded.
summary.zh: 无通知期，但未用积分不退款。

description.en: CitationLab has strong exact-page evidence and unusually detailed public billing and data-processing terms. The trade-off is a higher entry price, monthly credit reset on annual plans, and add-on engine costs.
description.zh: CitationLab 的精确页面证据突出，公开计费与数据处理条款也很详细；取舍是入门价较高、年付方案积分仍按月重置，以及引擎附加费用。

summary.en: Task fit and trade-off based on official evidence.
summary.zh: 基于官方证据的任务适配与取舍。

description.en: Map citation URLs and trace answer sources from source type to channel and page, with full-answer and fan-out-query context.
description.zh: 绘制引用 URL，并将回答来源从来源类型追溯到渠道和页面，同时保留完整回答与扇出查询上下文。

en: Citation mapping
Citation URLs
Answer context
zh: 引用映射
引用 URL
回答上下文

en: Use citation mapping and citation URLs to trace sources to channels and pages.
Review a single conversation with its full answer, citations, and fan-out queries.
Run each unique prompt weekly multiple times per model.
zh: 使用引用映射和引用 URL 将来源追溯到渠道与页面。
在单次会话中查看完整回答、引用和扇出查询。
每个唯一提示词按模型每周运行多次。

audience.en: Marketing teams and agencies seeking guided onboarding and conversation-level citation traceability.
audience.zh: 需要引导式上手和会话层级引用追溯的营销团队与代理商。

description.en: Trace a citation from its source type to the channel and exact page, then inspect the full answer that contains it.
description.zh: 将引用从来源类型追溯到渠道和精确页面，再检查包含该引用的完整回答。

summary.en: Trace citations to channels, pages, and answers.
summary.zh: 将引用追溯到渠道、页面和回答。

description.en: Review fan-out queries alongside repeated weekly prompt runs to understand the conversation paths behind citations.
description.zh: 结合每周重复提示词运行查看扇出查询，以理解引用背后的会话路径。

summary.en: Inspect prompt fan-out and repeated weekly runs.
summary.zh: 检查提示词扇出与每周重复运行。

description.en: Growth is USD $249/month for 50 prompts per month on ChatGPT, AI Overviews, and AI Mode, plus five content pieces. Pro is USD $399/month for 100 prompts per month on those engines plus Gemini and Perplexity, plus 25 pieces. Agency is USD $299/month for a multi-brand workspace, 250 prompts, 10 pitching accounts, and five pieces. Enterprise and retainers are custom.
description.zh: Growth 为 249 美元/月，ChatGPT、AI Overviews 和 AI Mode 各每月 50 个提示词，含 5 篇内容；Pro 为 399 美元/月，在上述引擎外加 Gemini 和 Perplexity，各每月 100 个提示词，含 25 篇内容；Agency 为 299 美元/月，含多品牌工作区、250 个提示词、10 个提案账户和 5 篇内容。Enterprise 和顾问服务定制报价。

summary.en: Published plans: $249, $399, and $299/month; custom options.
summary.zh: 公开方案：249、399、299 美元/月；另有定制。

description.en: Claude, Copilot, and DeepSeek are add-ons on relevant plans. No public annual price or free trial was established; the current call to action is Book a Demo.
description.zh: 相关方案中 Claude、Copilot 和 DeepSeek 为附加项；未确立公开年付价格或免费试用，当前行动按钮为预约演示。

summary.en: Model add-ons; demo-led purchase, no public trial.
summary.zh: 模型附加；演示式采购，无公开试用。

description.en: The lowest published plans do not include every listed engine. Additional models increase scope and must be purchased as add-ons or included in a higher plan.
description.zh: 最低公开方案不包含所有列出的引擎；增加模型会扩大范围，需购买附加项或选择更高方案。

summary.en: Engine coverage varies by plan and add-on.
summary.zh: 引擎覆盖依方案和附加项而定。

description.en: The terms limit use to business purposes, provide automatic renewal, and are generally non-refundable. Visible and structured legal-page dates are inconsistent.
description.zh: 条款限定商业用途、规定自动续费且通常不退款；可见法律页日期与结构化数据中的日期不一致。

summary.en: Business-only, auto-renewing, and date inconsistency.
summary.zh: 仅商业用途、自动续费，且日期不一致。

description.en: HeyAmos is a fit for teams that value full-answer citation mapping and guided sales onboarding. The trade-off is a contact-sales purchase path and add-on-based engine coverage rather than transparent self-service annual billing.
description.zh: HeyAmos 适合重视完整回答引用映射和引导式销售上手的团队；取舍是联系销售采购及附加式引擎覆盖，而非透明的自助年付。

summary.en: Task fit and trade-off based on official evidence.
summary.zh: 基于官方证据的任务适配与取舍。

description.en: Track AI-answer citations at page and source level, benchmark competitors, and inspect individual LLM responses across a broad media-intelligence platform.
description.zh: 在广泛的媒体智能平台中按页面和来源追踪 AI 回答引用、进行竞品基准比较，并检查单条大模型回答。

en: Page citations
Source influence
Media intelligence
zh: 页面引用
来源影响力
媒体智能

en: Rank publications and content most cited in AI answers.
Inspect individual LLM responses with exact text, sentiment, key phrases, organizations, and cited sources.
Track prompt-level brand visibility, competitor benchmarks, share of voice, trends, and exports with 24-hour refresh.
zh: 对 AI 回答中最常被引的出版方和内容排序。
查看单条大模型回答的精确文本、情绪、关键短语、组织和被引来源。
以 24 小时刷新跟踪提示词层级品牌曝光、竞品基准、声量份额、趋势和导出。

audience.en: Enterprise communications, media-intelligence, and marketing teams that need citation evidence within a broader monitoring suite.
audience.zh: 需要将引用证据纳入更广泛监测套件的企业传播、媒体智能和营销团队。

description.en: Identify which pages and publications AI systems cite for tracked prompts and compare their prevalence over time.
description.zh: 识别 AI 系统在受追踪提示词中引用的页面和出版方，并比较其出现频率趋势。

summary.en: Track cited pages and source prevalence.
summary.zh: 追踪被引页面与来源出现频率。

description.en: Open an individual LLM response to review its text and cited sources alongside competitor and brand context.
description.zh: 打开单条大模型回答，结合竞品和品牌上下文检查文本与被引来源。

summary.en: Review citations in full response context.
summary.zh: 在完整回答上下文中复查引用。

description.en: Use source and competitor benchmarks in executive reporting while exporting the underlying monitoring data.
description.zh: 在管理层报告中使用来源和竞品基准，并导出底层监测数据。

summary.en: Support executive citation and competitor reporting.
summary.zh: 支持管理层引用与竞品报告。

description.en: Starter, Pro, Enterprise, and Agency pricing is contact sales and tailored to scope. There is no self-serve free trial; access begins with a human-guided demo. Most agreements are annual with a 12-month minimum, and an implementation fee may apply.
description.zh: Starter、Pro、Enterprise 和 Agency 均需联系销售并按范围定制；无自助免费试用，需人工引导演示。多数协议为年度合同，最短 12 个月，并可能收取实施费。

summary.en: Tailored contact-sales pricing; usually a 12-month minimum.
summary.zh: 联系销售定制；通常最短 12 个月。

description.en: The US general terms invoice the full amount in advance and describe non-cancellable, non-refundable fees except where express agreement terms provide otherwise. Renewal is for the same term length at then-current prices, with 60-day written non-renewal notice.
description.zh: 美国通用条款规定全额预付，除协议明确另有规定外，费用不可取消或退款；续约期限相同并按当时价格执行，需提前 60 天书面通知不续约。

summary.en: Advance billing and 60-day non-renewal notice.
summary.zh: 预付费用；提前 60 天通知不续约。

description.en: GenAI Lens is package-dependent within the broader Meltwater platform. Product terms say AI features may be developing, testing, changed, or removed, and AI output may be wrong and requires human review.
description.zh: GenAI Lens 在更广泛的 Meltwater 平台中取决于所选套餐；产品条款称 AI 功能可能处于开发或测试、被更改或移除，AI 输出可能有误并需人工复核。

summary.en: Package-dependent AI features and output caveats.
summary.zh: AI 功能依套餐而定，输出需复核。

description.en: API content rights do not permit training, fine-tuning, grounding, or AI development. Except for specified stylistic outputs, AI outputs and analyses belong to Meltwater or third-party providers.
description.zh: API 内容权利不允许训练、微调、检索增强或 AI 开发；除指定文体输出外，AI 输出和分析归 Meltwater 或第三方提供方所有。

summary.en: API and AI-output rights are restricted.
summary.zh: API 和 AI 输出权利受限。

description.en: Meltwater combines page-level citation evidence with broad source and media context. The trade-off is enterprise sales, likely annual commitment, and more restrictive output and API rights than a standalone tracker may offer.
description.zh: Meltwater 将页面层级引用证据与广泛来源和媒体背景结合；取舍是企业销售、可能年度承诺，以及比独立追踪工具更严格的输出和 API 权利。

summary.en: Task fit and trade-off based on official evidence.
summary.zh: 基于官方证据的任务适配与取舍。

label.zh: Meltwater AI 曝光功能演示

description.en: Record web pages actually used in AI answers, aggregate citations by host, inspect cited pages, and export citation URLs with answer context.
description.zh: 记录 AI 回答实际使用的网页，按主机聚合引用、检查被引页面，并导出带回答上下文的引用 URL。

en: Page citations
Citation exports
Prompt monitoring
zh: 页面引用
引用导出
提示词监测

en: Count only pages used in answers, not search results merely inspected by an engine.
Aggregate citations by host and drill into cited pages, page opens, and brand-mention checks.
Export Citation URLs, full answers, competitors, and fan-out queries as CSV or JSON.
zh: 只统计回答实际使用的页面，不统计引擎仅查看过的搜索结果。
按主机聚合引用，并下钻到被引页面、页面打开和品牌提及检查。
将引用 URL、完整回答、竞品和扇出查询导出为 CSV 或 JSON。

audience.en: Brands and agencies that need documented page-level citation data, exports, and daily prompt monitoring.
audience.zh: 需要明确页面层级引用数据、导出和每日提示词监测的品牌与代理商。

description.en: Review which pages an AI answer actually used and export their citation URLs with the answer and competitor context.
description.zh: 查看 AI 回答实际使用了哪些页面，并导出带回答和竞品上下文的引用 URL。

summary.en: Export answer-used pages with full context.
summary.zh: 导出回答实际使用的页面及完整上下文。

description.en: Use qualifying-source thresholds and topic, tag, date, and platform filters to separate repeatedly cited sources from one-off sources.
description.zh: 使用合格来源阈值及主题、标签、日期和平台筛选，区分重复被引来源与一次性来源。

summary.en: Filter recurring and one-off citation sources.
summary.zh: 筛选持续与一次性引用来源。

description.en: Check whether high-traffic cited pages mention the brand, subject to automatic and manual page-check limits.
description.zh: 在自动和手动页面检查限额内，检查高流量被引页面是否提及品牌。

summary.en: Review brand mentions on cited pages.
summary.zh: 复查被引页面的品牌提及。

description.en: Brand plans are Basic at €69/month or €59/month billed annually (official €708/year), and USD $79/month or $69/month billed annually (official $828/year), with one project and 50 daily prompts; Standard at €209/€179 billed annually (official €2,148/year) and USD $239/$209 billed annually (official $2,508/year), with two projects and 100 daily prompts; Advanced at €419/€359 billed annually (official €4,308/year) and USD $489/$419 billed annually (official $5,028/year), with five projects and 200 daily prompts. Enterprise is custom. Prices exclude VAT.
description.zh: 品牌方案为：Basic 69 欧元/月或年付折合 59 欧元/月（官方 708 欧元/年），以及 79 美元/月或年付折合 69 美元/月（官方 828 美元/年），含 1 个项目和每日 50 个提示词；Standard 209 欧元/月或年付折合 179 欧元/月（官方 2,148 欧元/年），以及 239 美元/月或年付折合 209 美元/月（官方 2,508 美元/年），含 2 个项目和每日 100 个提示词；Advanced 419 欧元/月或年付折合 359 欧元/月（官方 4,308 欧元/年），以及 489 美元/月或年付折合 419 美元/月（官方 5,028 美元/年），含 5 个项目和每日 200 个提示词。Enterprise 定制，价格不含增值税。

summary.en: Brand plans in EUR and USD; official annual totals published.
summary.zh: 品牌方案有欧元和美元；公布官方年付总额。

description.en: Agency plans use shared monthly credits: Basic 14,400, Plus 30,600, and Max 70,200. One credit is one prompt answered by one engine on one day. Separately, the brand Basic plan has a seven-day trial for eligible new accounts, requires a card, and automatically becomes paid Basic on day seven unless cancelled.
description.zh: 代理方案共享每月积分：Basic 14,400、Plus 30,600、Max 70,200。一个积分等于一个提示词在一天内由一个引擎回答。另外，品牌 Basic 方案向符合条件的新账户提供七天试用，需信用卡，并在第七天自动转为付费 Basic，除非取消。

summary.en: Agency credit pools; Basic trial converts automatically.
summary.zh: 代理积分池；Basic 试用自动转付费。

description.en: Documentation calls the fifth engine Copilot, while pricing calls it Bing AI Mode. These are treated as one unresolved naming inconsistency, not two separately verified platforms.
description.zh: 文档称第五个引擎为 Copilot，定价页称其为 Bing AI Mode；本批次将其视为一个未解决的命名不一致，而非两个分别核验的平台。

summary.en: Fifth-engine naming differs across official pages.
summary.zh: 官方页面对第五引擎命名不同。

description.en: Automatic mention checks cover up to five busiest checked pages per qualifying source; manual checks read up to 20 pages per action and are limited to 20 checks per person per day.
description.zh: 每个合格来源的自动提及检查最多覆盖 5 个最常检查页面；手动检查每次最多读取 20 个页面，每人每天限 20 次。

summary.en: Page-check depth and frequency are limited.
summary.zh: 页面检查深度和频率有限。

description.en: The service is operated by a company founded in 2026. Public terms do not state a governing law or detailed refund policy, and the public privacy page does not identify AI providers or a model-training policy.
description.zh: 运营公司成立于 2026 年；公开条款未说明管辖法律或详细退款政策，公开隐私页也未说明 AI 提供方或模型训练政策。

summary.en: New operator and thin public legal detail.
summary.zh: 运营方较新，公开法律细节较少。

description.en: WebGlazer provides explicit answer-used-page definitions, detailed citation documentation, and CSV or JSON exports. The trade-off is an auto-converting trial and unresolved platform naming and legal-detail gaps.
description.zh: WebGlazer 明确区分回答实际使用页面，引用文档详细并支持 CSV 或 JSON 导出；取舍是试用自动转付费，以及平台命名和法律细节缺口。

summary.en: Task fit and trade-off based on official evidence.
summary.zh: 基于官方证据的任务适配与取舍。

description.en: Track links exposed in AI answers to your own site, archive prompt-level answers, and separate answer-text links from visited and consulted pages.
description.zh: 追踪 AI 回答中暴露的自有网站链接，存档提示词层级回答，并区分回答正文链接、已访问页面和已查阅来源。

en: Answer links
URL health
Prompt archive
zh: 回答链接
