URL 健康
提示词存档

en: URL Health checks links to the project and known brand domains that tracked AI answers expose.
Separate Answer text, Visited, and Consulted layers instead of treating every opened page as a visible citation.
Archive successful prompt answers and export sources and pages with filters.
zh: URL Health 检查受追踪 AI 回答暴露的项目域名和已知品牌域名链接。
区分回答正文、已访问和已查阅层级，不把每个打开页面都视为可见引用。
存档成功的提示词回答，并筛选导出来源和页面。

audience.en: Brands and content teams that need own-site answer-link monitoring plus prompt-level source and page research.
audience.zh: 需要自有网站回答链接监测及提示词层级来源和页面研究的品牌与内容团队。

description.en: Use the Shown in answers lens to review links written into tracked answer text, then check their status and normalized page rows.
description.zh: 使用“显示在回答中”视图检查写入受追踪回答正文的链接，再复查其状态和规范化页面记录。

summary.en: Monitor own-site links exposed in answer text.
summary.zh: 监测回答正文暴露的自有网站链接。

description.en: Archive prompt answers and compare consulted sources with visited or opened pages without assuming they were visibly cited.
description.zh: 存档提示词回答，并比较已查阅来源与已访问或打开页面，不假定它们曾被可见引用。

summary.en: Research sources separately from visible answer links.
summary.zh: 将来源研究与可见回答链接分开。

description.en: Export filtered URL Health rows or source and page records for recurring reporting and content review.
description.zh: 导出筛选后的 URL Health 记录或来源和页面记录，用于持续报告与内容复查。

summary.en: Export filtered citation and source records.
summary.zh: 导出筛选后的引用与来源记录。

description.en: Monthly plans are Starter at USD $39 for one project and 20 prompts per project, and Pro at USD $149 for three projects and 40 prompts per project, including URL Health, GA4/GSC, MCP, and white-label reporting. Enterprise starts at USD $6,000/month with custom scope, all engines, API, and SLA support.
description.zh: 月付方案为：Starter 39 美元，含 1 个项目和每项目 20 个提示词；Pro 149 美元，含 3 个项目和每项目 40 个提示词，并包含 URL Health、GA4/GSC、MCP 和白标报告。Enterprise 每月 6,000 美元起，范围定制，包含所有引擎、API 和 SLA 支持。

summary.en: Starter $39/month; Pro $149/month; Enterprise from $6,000.
summary.zh: Starter 39 美元/月；Pro 149 美元/月；企业版 6,000 美元起。

description.en: Official yearly totals include Starter at USD $370/year and Pro at USD $1,430/year. A 14-day Pro trial requires a card and converts to USD $149 on day 15 unless cancelled, or USD $1,430 when started with yearly billing.
description.zh: 官方年付总额包括 Starter 370 美元/年和 Pro 1,430 美元/年。14 天 Pro 试用需信用卡，并在第 15 天转为 149 美元付费，除非取消；按年付开始则为 1,430 美元。

summary.en: Official annual totals: $370 and $1,430; trial converts.
summary.zh: 官方年付 370、1,430 美元；试用自动转付费。

description.en: Ayzeo defines Citation Rate as the percentage of prompts where the AI visited and opened a URL during research. It is not necessarily an answer-visible link rate; consulted and opened pages must be interpreted separately.
description.zh: Ayzeo 将 Citation Rate 定义为 AI 在研究期间访问并打开 URL 的提示词百分比；它不一定是回答可见链接率，已查阅和已打开页面需单独解释。

summary.en: Citation Rate measures opened pages, not only visible links.
summary.zh: Citation Rate 衡量打开页面，而非仅可见链接。

description.en: URL Health is included only in Pro and Enterprise and checks only the project domain, its subdomains, and other known brand domains, not third-party sites. Link checks do not run prompts or consume AI queries.
description.zh: URL Health 仅包含在 Pro 和 Enterprise 中，只检查项目域名、其子域和其他已知品牌域名，不检查第三方网站；链接检查不运行提示词，也不消耗 AI 查询。

summary.en: URL Health is own-site only and plan-limited.
summary.zh: URL Health 仅限自有网站且受方案限制。

description.en: Every plan includes ChatGPT and Google AI Overview; other engines are add-ons, with all add-ons included in Enterprise. Bing AI Mode is unavailable for projects in South Korea, Russia, and China.
description.zh: 所有方案均包含 ChatGPT 和 Google AI Overview；其他引擎为附加项，Enterprise 包含全部附加引擎。Bing AI Mode 不适用于韩国、俄罗斯和中国的项目。

summary.en: Engine add-ons and regional restrictions apply.
summary.zh: 引擎附加和地区限制适用。

description.en: Ayzeo is a strong fit for own-site answer-link health and archived prompt evidence. The key trade-off is semantic: its headline Citation Rate includes research visits, while direct answer-text link tracking is limited to URL Health on higher plans.
description.zh: Ayzeo 适合自有网站回答链接健康和提示词证据存档；关键取舍是语义：其主打 Citation Rate 包含研究访问，而直接回答正文链接追踪仅限更高方案的 URL Health。

summary.en: Task fit and trade-off based on official evidence.
summary.zh: 基于官方证据的任务适配与取舍。

description.en: Track the pages and domains AI answers cite, compare citation gaps against competitors, and drill down from stored answers to exact cited pages.
description.zh: 追踪 AI 回答引用的页面和域名，比较与竞品之间的引用缺口，并从已保存回答下钻到具体被引页面。

en: Citation gaps
Cited pages
Competitor sources
zh: 引用缺口
被引页面
竞品来源

en: Store tracked AI answers with the pages each answer cites and group citations by domain, subdomain, or page.
Find sources cited in answers naming competitors but not the tracked brand, with a 0–100 gap score.
Filter cited pages by engine, site type, page type, competitor, and trend, then export the filtered table as CSV.
zh: 保存受追踪 AI 回答及其引用页面，并按域名、子域或页面汇总引用。
找出在提及竞品但未提及受追踪品牌的回答中被引用的来源，并提供 0–100 分缺口评分。
按引擎、网站类型、页面类型、竞品和趋势筛选被引页面，再将筛选结果导出为 CSV。

audience.en: Brand, content, and growth teams that need cited-page evidence and competitor citation-gap analysis across multiple AI answer engines.
audience.zh: 需要跨多个 AI 回答引擎追踪被引页面证据并分析竞品引用缺口的品牌、内容和增长团队。

description.en: Review the domains, subdomains, and exact pages cited in stored answers to a brand's tracked buyer questions, with page-type and trend labels for content research.
description.zh: 查看品牌受追踪购买问题的已保存回答所引用的域名、子域和具体页面，并借助页面类型与趋势标签开展内容研究。

summary.en: Inspect cited domains and exact pages behind tracked answers.
summary.zh: 查看受追踪回答背后的被引域名与具体页面。

description.en: Compare sources cited in answers that name competitors with answers that name the tracked brand, then prioritize gaps by citation frequency, rival coverage, and brand absence.
description.zh: 比较提及竞品的回答与提及受追踪品牌的回答所引用来源，再按引用频率、竞品覆盖和品牌缺失程度确定缺口优先级。

summary.en: Prioritize sources cited for rivals but not the brand.
summary.zh: 优先处理为竞品而非品牌带来引用的来源。

description.en: Filter citation evidence by engine, site type, competitor, or number of rivals named and export the resulting rows for recurring content and outreach review.
description.zh: 按引擎、网站类型、竞品或同时提及的竞品数量筛选引用证据，并导出结果行用于持续内容与外联复查。

summary.en: Filter and export citation evidence for recurring review.
summary.zh: 筛选并导出引用证据用于持续复查。

description.en: Monthly list prices in Indian rupees, excluding 18% GST, are Starter at INR 1,999, Growth at INR 7,499, Scale at INR 12,499, and Enterprise at INR 25,000. Every plan shows the websites AI cites; citation-gap analysis starts on Growth. Starter includes 16 prompt slots, one project, three competitors, and 2,000 checks/answers per month; higher plans increase pooled prompts, projects, competitors, and monthly checks.
description.zh: 印度卢比月付标价不含 18% GST：Starter 1,999 卢比、Growth 7,499 卢比、Scale 12,499 卢比、Enterprise 25,000 卢比。所有方案均显示 AI 引用的网站，引用缺口分析从 Growth 起提供。Starter 含 16 个提示词位、1 个项目、3 个竞品及每月 2,000 次检查/回答；更高方案增加共享提示词位、项目、竞品和每月检查量。

summary.en: INR 1,999–25,000/month plus GST; gap analysis from Growth.
summary.zh: 1,999–25,000 卢比/月另加 GST；缺口分析从 Growth 起。

description.en: Starter, Growth, and Scale offer one three-day trial per organisation. Signup needs no card, but the trial starts only after a card or UPI AutoPay mandate is set up; Razorpay makes a refundable INR 5 verification charge. The first monthly charge runs on day 4 unless cancelled. The first paid month can be refunded in full on request within seven days; later mid-period subscriptions are not refunded.
description.zh: Starter、Growth 和 Scale 每个组织可试用一次，为期三天。注册无需银行卡，但设置信用卡或 UPI AutoPay 授权后才开始试用；Razorpay 会进行 5 卢比的可退验证扣款。除非取消，否则第 4 天开始收取首个月费。首次付费月可在七天内申请全额退款，之后的周期中订阅不按中期退款。

summary.en: Three-day trial after mandate; first paid month refundable within 7 days.
summary.zh: 设置授权后试用三天；首次付费月七天内可退。

description.en: Depra AI records pages an engine cites in its answer, not pages the engine may have read and omitted. Its terms also describe AI outputs as probabilistic samples rather than a census, so repeated checks can produce different answers.
description.zh: Depra AI 记录引擎在回答中引用的页面，而不记录引擎可能读取但未引用的页面。条款还说明 AI 输出属于概率性抽样而非全量普查，因此重复检查可能产生不同回答。

summary.en: Cited pages only; AI results are probabilistic samples.
summary.zh: 仅记录被引页面；AI 结果属于概率性抽样。

description.en: Each project tracks one country and its country cannot be changed after creation. Prompt slots are shared across projects, additional language versions consume slots, and checks pause when the monthly allowance is exhausted rather than triggering automatic overage charges.
description.zh: 每个项目只追踪一个国家，创建后不能更改项目国家。提示词位在项目间共享，额外语言版本会占用名额，月度额度耗尽后检查暂停，而不是自动收取超额费用。

summary.en: One country per project; shared slots; checks pause at quota.
summary.zh: 每项目一个国家；名额共享；额度耗尽暂停检查。

description.en: ChatGPT with web search, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews run daily on every plan; Claude, Microsoft Copilot, DeepSeek, Google AI Mode, Grok, and other engines are Enterprise additions. CSV export currently returns up to 1,000 of the most recent answers in the selected range, with a complete historical extract requested by email. Self-serve plans have no contractual uptime SLA.
description.zh: 所有方案均每日运行带网页搜索的 ChatGPT、Gemini、Perplexity 和 Google AI Overviews；Claude、Microsoft Copilot、DeepSeek、Google AI Mode、Grok 等引擎仅企业版可添加。CSV 导出目前返回所选时间范围内最近 1,000 条回答，完整历史提取需邮件申请。自助方案没有合同约定的可用性 SLA。

summary.en: Extra engines are Enterprise-only; CSV cap and no self-serve SLA.
summary.zh: 额外引擎仅企业版；CSV 有上限且自助方案无 SLA。

description.en: Prompt text, brand names, and competitor names are sent to AI search providers; captured answers and brand/competitor names may also go to Azure OpenAI or OpenAI for mention and sentiment extraction. Account deletion is manual by email with a stated 30-day target, and some providers process data outside India.
description.zh: 提示词文本、品牌名和竞品名会发送给 AI 搜索提供商；捕获回答及品牌/竞品名也可能发送给 Azure OpenAI 或 OpenAI 用于提及和情绪识别。账户删除需邮件人工办理，官方目标为 30 天，部分提供商会在印度境外处理数据。

summary.en: Prompts and answers reach AI subprocessors; deletion is manual.
summary.zh: 提示词与回答会交由 AI 分包商处理；删除需人工办理。

description.en: Depra AI is a fit for teams that need exact cited-page evidence and competitor citation gaps in one workflow. The main trade-offs are Growth-plan entry for gap analysis, shared prompt quotas, one-country projects, and transmission of prompts and captured answers to third-party AI providers.
description.zh: Depra AI 适合需要在一个工作流中查看具体被引页面证据和竞品引用缺口的团队。主要取舍是缺口分析需 Growth 及以上方案、提示词名额共享、每项目仅一个国家，以及提示词和捕获回答会交由第三方 AI 提供商处理。

summary.en: Cited-page and gap focus, with plan, quota, and privacy trade-offs.
summary.zh: 侧重被引页面与缺口分析，需考虑方案、配额和隐私取舍。

label.zh: Depra AI 引用缺口功能

description.en: Generate, organize and schedule business prompts, then inspect brand visibility across supported AI engines.
description.zh: 生成、整理并计划运行业务提示词，查看品牌在支持平台上的曝光情况。

en: Prompt research
Scheduled sampling
Answer evidence
zh: 提示词研究
计划采样
回答证据

en: Create prompts from a brand, website, description and SEO keywords; edit, delete or add custom prompts.
Group prompts by product, use case, purchase intent, keyword cluster or topic.
Run prompts on demand or on a schedule and retain complete answers with cited sources.
Compare mentions, citations, competitors, sentiment, average position and share of voice.
zh: 根据品牌、网站、描述和 SEO 关键词创建提示词，可编辑、删除或添加自定义提示词。
按产品、用例、购买意图、关键词簇或主题分组提示词。
按需或按计划运行提示词，并保留完整回答及引用来源。
比较提及、引用、竞品、情绪、平均位置和声量份额。

audience.en: Brand, SEO and agency teams maintaining a repeatable set of buyer and category prompts.
audience.zh: 需要持续维护买家及品类提示词的品牌、SEO 和代理团队。

description.en: Build an initial prompt library from brand and SEO inputs, then review and organize it before monitoring.
description.zh: 根据品牌和 SEO 输入建立提示词库，在监测前审核并整理。

summary.en: Create and organize prompts from brand and SEO inputs.
summary.zh: 根据品牌和 SEO 输入创建并整理提示词。

description.en: Schedule selected prompts across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Mode, then inspect full answers and citations.
description.zh: 在 ChatGPT、Perplexity、Gemini 和 Google AI Mode 上计划运行所选提示词，并查看完整回答与引用。

summary.en: Schedule multi-engine runs and inspect answer evidence.
summary.zh: 计划运行多平台采样并检查回答证据。

description.en: Use prompt, topic, cluster, date and provider filters to investigate competitor visibility, sentiment and share-of-voice changes.
description.zh: 使用提示词、主题、关键词簇、日期和平台筛选，调查竞品曝光、情绪及声量份额变化。

summary.en: Investigate competitor and share-of-voice changes by prompt.
summary.zh: 按提示词调查竞品和声量份额变化。

label.zh: 官方产品与提示词监测

description.en: Monthly Ranger, Pathfinder and Nexus plans are USD 39, USD 79 and USD 199, with 35, 75 and 200 prompts respectively. Daily runs are included; brands, seats, audits, reports and consulting differ by tier.
description.zh: Ranger、Pathfinder、Nexus 月付分别为 39、79、199 美元，提示词配额为 35、75、200 个。均含每日运行，品牌数、席位、审计、报告和咨询服务因套餐而异。

summary.en: USD 39/35 prompts; USD 79/75; USD 199/200 per month.
summary.zh: 月付 39 美元/35 个提示词、79 美元/75 个、199 美元/200 个。

description.en: Cognito is custom-priced through contact sales. Annual billing is described as saving approximately 16%, but exact annual totals are not displayed.
description.zh: Cognito 通过联系销售定制报价。年付宣传约省 16%，但页面未显示确切年度总额。

summary.en: Cognito is custom; annual totals are not published.
summary.zh: Cognito 为定制报价；未公布年度总额。

description.en: A seven-day trial allows up to 25 prompts for individuals or 50 for agencies. A card is required, and an uncancelled trial with a bound payment method converts to a paid subscription.
description.zh: 七天试用允许个人最多 25 个提示词、代理最多 50 个。需要绑卡；未取消且已绑定支付方式的试用会转为付费订阅。

summary.en: Seven-day trial; card required; conversion terms apply.
summary.zh: 七天试用，需要绑卡，并适用自动转付费条款。

description.en: Prices exclude taxes. Monthly and annual subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled before the next cycle; unused quota does not roll over and is generally nonrefundable.
description.zh: 价格不含税。月付和年付订阅除非在下一周期前取消，否则自动续订；未使用配额不结转，通常也不退款。

summary.en: Taxes extra; auto-renewal and no-rollover rules apply.
summary.zh: 另计税，适用自动续订及配额不结转规则。

description.en: The former Scout free plan was retired in October 2026, so the current public offer does not establish an ongoing free monitoring tier.
description.zh: 原 Scout 免费方案已于 2026 年 10 月停用，当前公开方案未提供持续免费监测层级。

summary.en: No current ongoing free monitoring tier is listed.
summary.zh: 当前未列出持续免费监测方案。

description.en: The pricing FAQ says a card is required at trial start, while the Terms and Refund Policy describe binding at trial start as dependent on the offer. Confirm the checkout conditions before starting a trial.
description.zh: 定价 FAQ 称试用开始时需要绑卡，而条款和退款政策将试用开始时绑定支付描述为取决于具体优惠。开始试用前需确认结账条件。

summary.en: Trial card and binding wording differs across official pages.
summary.zh: 官方页面对试用绑卡与绑定支付时点的表述不一致。

description.en: Link-building placement fees are invoiced separately and become nonrefundable after placement; they are not part of the prompt-monitoring subscription.
description.zh: 链接建设投放费用单独开票，投放后不退款，不属于提示词监测订阅费用。

summary.en: Link-building placements are separate and nonrefundable after delivery.
summary.zh: 链接投放单独收费，交付后不退款。

description.en: Compare brand count, prompt quota, seats, audits, reports and on-demand runs rather than the headline price. Annual savings are approximate, so confirm the billed total before choosing a longer commitment.
description.zh: 比较品牌数、提示词配额、席位、审计、报告和按需运行次数，而非只看标价。年付优惠为约数，选择长期承诺前需确认实际账单总额。

description.en: Self-hosted buyer-question sampling that stores answers, citations and scoring evidence on infrastructure you control.
description.zh: 自托管买家问题采样，在你控制的基础设施上保存回答、引用和评分证据。

en: Open source
Buyer questions
Local evidence
zh: 开源
买家问题
本地证据

en: Configure buyer questions, assistants and sampling tracks, then repeat collection according to sample settings.
Keep web-search answers, retained searches, URLs and citations, or tool-free recall answers, depending on the track.
Use a separate Claude call to score answers and review ratios, evidence, sources and recommendations.
Run locally, through Docker or Kubernetes, with answers and scores stored in local SQLite.
zh: 配置买家问题、助手和采样轨道，按采样设置重复采集。
根据轨道保存联网搜索回答、保留搜索、URL 和引用，或无工具召回回答。
通过单独的 Claude 调用为回答评分，并查看比例、证据、来源和建议。
可本地、通过 Docker 或 Kubernetes 运行，回答和评分保存在本地 SQLite。

audience.en: Technical SEO teams, developers and researchers who want controllable, auditable answer sampling.
audience.zh: 希望获得可控且可审计回答采样的技术 SEO 团队、开发者和研究人员。

description.en: Define buyer questions and choose search or recall tracks, assistants and sample settings for repeatable collection.
description.zh: 定义买家问题，选择搜索或召回轨道、助手及采样设置，以进行可重复采集。

summary.en: Configure repeatable buyer-question sampling tracks.
summary.zh: 配置可重复的买家问题采样轨道。

description.en: Review raw answers, cited answers, sources and separate Claude scores to understand where a brand appears in sampled responses.
description.zh: 查看原始回答、被引用回答、来源和单独的 Claude 评分，了解品牌在采样回答中的出现情况。

summary.en: Audit mentions and citations against stored answer evidence.
summary.zh: 依据保存的回答证据审核提及和引用。

description.en: Deploy on a Docker host, Kubernetes or an exa.dev VM and share read-only results without sending evidence to an intermediary service.
description.zh: 部署到 Docker 主机、Kubernetes 或 exa.dev 虚拟机，并以只读方式共享结果，无需将证据发送给中间服务。

summary.en: Self-host collection and share read-only evidence.
summary.zh: 自托管采集并以只读方式共享证据。

label.en: Official source repository and MIT license
label.zh: 官方源码仓库及 MIT 许可

description.en: The software is free under the MIT license. Users pay their own hosting and model-provider costs; there is no per-prompt or per-seat fee.
description.zh: 软件采用 MIT 许可，可免费使用。用户需自行承担托管和模型平台成本，没有按提示词或按席位收费。

summary.en: Free MIT software; hosting and model usage are separate costs.
summary.zh: MIT 软件免费，托管和模型用量成本另计。

description.en: A logged-in Claude CLI can consume an existing subscription quota. Docker without the CLI uses paid model APIs, so deployment choice changes the external cost.
description.zh: 登录的 Claude CLI 可消耗已有订阅配额；不带 CLI 的 Docker 运行使用付费模型 API，因此部署方式会改变外部成本。

summary.en: CLI subscription quota and Docker API billing are different cost paths.
summary.zh: CLI 订阅配额与 Docker API 计费是两种成本路径。

description.en: The daily budget is an admission and reservation limit, not a cap on provider billing. Provider charges can still exceed the planned amount if usage or pricing changes.
description.zh: 每日预算是准入和预留限制，不是平台账单上限。若用量或价格变化，平台实际费用仍可能超过计划金额。

summary.en: The daily budget does not cap provider invoices.
summary.zh: 每日预算不会限制平台实际账单。

description.en: Collection covers configured Claude and OpenAI model responses, not consumer ChatGPT or other signed-in assistant apps.
description.zh: 采集覆盖配置的 Claude 和 OpenAI 模型响应，不覆盖消费端 ChatGPT 或其他需登录的助手应用。

summary.en: Model responses are sampled; consumer assistant apps are not covered.
summary.zh: 采样模型响应，不覆盖消费端助手应用。

description.en: Self-hosting requires provider credentials, a supported runtime and secure network configuration. Official docs recommend localhost binding or a TLS proxy.
description.zh: 自托管需要平台凭证、受支持的运行时和安全网络配置。官方文档建议仅绑定本地地址或配置 TLS 代理。

summary.en: Deployment and credential security remain operator responsibilities.
summary.zh: 部署和凭证安全仍由运营者负责。

description.en: Prompt and method edits remain visible. Differences between runs can reflect those edits and model variability, so comparisons alone do not prove causation.
description.zh: 提示词和方法修改会保留可见。运行差异可能来自这些修改和模型波动，因此仅凭比较不能证明因果关系。

summary.en: Comparisons are evidence, not causal proof.
summary.zh: 比较结果可作为证据，但不是因果证明。

description.en: Choose this workflow when local evidence, code control and configurable sampling matter more than a managed dashboard. Budget separately for provider usage and secure hosting.
description.zh: 当本地证据、代码控制和可配置采样比托管仪表盘更重要时，可选择此工作流。平台用量和安全托管需单独预算。

description.en: Monitor a defined buyer-question panel across four AI provider APIs and retain prompt-level answer evidence.
description.zh: 在四个 AI 平台 API 上监测固定的买家问题集，并保留提示词级回答证据。

en: Buyer questions
Weekly monitoring
Provider APIs
zh: 买家问题
每周监测
平台 API

en: Track a consistent set of buyer questions across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and Perplexity provider APIs.
Keep prompt text, provider and model identity, timestamps, raw answers, citations and usage metadata.
Measure mentions, recommendations, share of voice, competitor visibility and prompt history.
Offer a limited free snapshot plus paid recurring monitoring and one-time audits.
zh: 在 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini 和 Perplexity 平台 API 上追踪固定的买家问题集。
保留提示词文本、平台和模型标识、时间戳、原始回答、引用及用量元数据。
衡量提及、推荐、声量份额、竞品曝光和提示词历史。
提供有限的免费快照，以及付费持续监测和一次性审计。

audience.en: Lean brand and marketing teams that want a small, evidence-backed question panel rather than a large enterprise program.
audience.zh: 希望使用小型且有证据支持的问题集，而非大型企业项目的精简品牌和营销团队。

description.en: Select buyer questions and run the same panel weekly across the four supported provider APIs.
description.zh: 选择买家问题，每周在四个受支持的平台 API 上运行同一问题集。

summary.en: Run a fixed weekly four-provider question panel.
summary.zh: 每周运行固定的四平台问题集。

description.en: Trace aggregate metrics back to raw answers, citations, provider/model identity and timestamps, then compare competitors and prompt history.
description.zh: 将汇总指标回溯到原始回答、引用、平台/模型标识和时间戳，再比较竞品和提示词历史。

summary.en: Audit metrics against stored prompt-level evidence.
summary.zh: 依据保存的提示词级证据审核指标。

description.en: Use the free snapshot for an initial read, then add recurring monitoring or one-time competitor scans as needed.
description.zh: 使用免费快照进行初步了解，再按需添加持续监测或一次性竞品扫描。

summary.en: Start with a snapshot and add monitoring only when needed.
summary.zh: 先使用快照，再按需添加监测。

label.zh: 官方 AI 曝光产品
官方 AI 透明度说明

description.en: Free Snapshot is $0 and includes one brand, two lifetime audits, two prompts and four platforms. It does not include recurring monitoring.
description.zh: 免费快照为 0 美元，包含一个品牌、两次终身审计、两个提示词和四个平台，不含持续监测。

summary.en: $0 snapshot: two lifetime audits, no recurring monitoring.
summary.zh: 免费快照：两次终身审计，不含持续监测。

description.en: Starter is $39/month and Monitor is $99/month for one brand, with 5 and 15 prompts respectively. Agency is $999/month for 10 brands and 150 pooled prompts. All three use weekly monitoring; scan and reporting allowances differ.
description.zh: Starter 和 Monitor 月费分别为 39 和 99 美元，均为一个品牌，提示词为 5 和 15 个。Agency 月费 999 美元，含 10 个品牌和 150 个共享提示词。三者均为每周监测，扫描和报告配额不同。

summary.en: Weekly plans: $39/5 prompts, $99/15, $999/150 pooled.
summary.zh: 每周监测：39 美元/5 个提示词、99 美元/15 个、999 美元/150 个共享提示词。

description.en: Founding 100 discounts core Visibility by 20% for the first 12 months, limited to 100 paid activations: $31.20, $79.20 and $799.20 per month for Starter, Monitor and Agency.
description.zh: Founding 100 在前 12 个月为核心 Visibility 方案提供 20% 折扣，限 100 次付费启用：Starter、Monitor、Agency 月费分别为 31.20、79.20、799.20 美元。

summary.en: Founding prices are 20% below standard monthly prices for 12 months.
summary.zh: 创始价格在前 12 个月比标准月价低 20%。

description.en: Extra self-service scans are $19 each. Prompt Expansion adds 10 prompts for $39/month or $468/year. Annual billing advertises two months free, but exact annual totals are not shown.
description.zh: 额外自助扫描每次 19 美元。Prompt Expansion 增加 10 个提示词，月付 39 美元或年付 468 美元。年付宣传免费两个月，但未显示确切年度总额。

summary.en: Add-ons: $19 per scan; +10 prompts $39/month or $468/year.
summary.zh: 附加项：每次扫描 19 美元；增加 10 个提示词月付 39 美元或年付 468 美元。

description.en: The public pricing page uses the $ symbol without an explicit currency code. Confirm the checkout currency and final tax treatment before subscribing.
description.zh: 公开定价页使用 $ 符号，但未明确币种代码。订阅前需确认结账币种和最终税额。

summary.en: Public $ amounts have no explicit currency code.
summary.zh: 公开 $ 金额未明确币种代码。

description.en: Default adapters call provider APIs. The methodology states these answers are not equivalent to signed-in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Perplexity consumer experiences; Google AI Overviews, AI Mode and Copilot are not enabled default surfaces.
description.zh: 默认适配器调用平台 API。方法说明指出，这些回答不等同于登录后的 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 或 Perplexity 消费端体验；Google AI Overviews、AI Mode 和 Copilot 不是默认启用的监测面。

summary.en: API observations are not consumer-interface replicas.
summary.zh: API 观测结果不等同于消费端界面。

description.en: MonitorMyGEO does not promise that every provider never retains or trains on requests. Provider terms, tiers and configuration control treatment, and enterprise assurances require separate procurement review.
description.zh: MonitorMyGEO 不承诺所有平台都不保留或不用请求训练。数据处理取决于平台条款、套餐和配置，企业保障需单独采购审核。

summary.en: Provider training and retention require provider-specific review.
summary.zh: 平台训练和保留政策需按平台单独审核。

description.en: Monthly and annual plans renew unless cancelled. Refunds are generally unavailable after a cycle starts, and add-ons or credits are generally nonrefundable once used or performed.
description.zh: 月付和年付方案除非取消，否则自动续订。周期开始后通常不退款，附加项或额度一旦使用或服务执行后通常不退款。

summary.en: Renewal and no-refund rules apply after a cycle starts.
summary.zh: 周期开始后适用续订和不退款规则。

description.en: Fit this option to a small weekly question panel with inspectable provider-API evidence. Confirm currency and avoid treating API output as an exact replica of consumer assistant screens.
description.zh: 此选项适合小型每周问题集，且可检查平台 API 证据。需确认币种，并避免将 API 输出视为消费端助手界面的完全复制。

description.en: Add-on prompt monitoring across five AI surfaces, with daily or weekly sampling, detailed responses and exports.
description.zh: 覆盖五个 AI 监测面的提示词附加组件，支持每日或每周采样、详细回答和导出。

en: Prompt monitoring
AI credits
Exports
zh: 提示词监测
AI 额度
导出

en: Track up to 2,000 prompts per project across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and Google AI Mode.
Choose daily or weekly tracking and inspect visibility, sentiment, positions, share of voice, competitors and fan-out queries.
Run a one-time analysis of thousands of prompts with actual responses and cited sources.
Export to Looker Studio, Google Sheets and Excel.
zh: 每个项目最多追踪 2,000 个提示词，覆盖 ChatGPT、Gemini、Perplexity、Google AI Overviews 和 Google AI Mode。
选择每日或每周追踪，查看曝光、情绪、位置、声量份额、竞品和扇出查询。
一次性分析数千个提示词，并获取实际回答和引用来源。
导出到 Looker Studio、Google Sheets 和 Excel。

audience.en: Marketing teams already using Marketing Miner or needing prompt-level research with spreadsheet and BI exports.
audience.zh: 已使用 Marketing Miner，或需要提示词级研究及表格、BI 导出的营销团队。

description.en: Create a project prompt set and choose daily or weekly sampling across five AI surfaces.
description.zh: 创建项目提示词集，并选择每日或每周采样，覆盖五个 AI 监测面。

summary.en: Schedule prompt sampling across five AI surfaces.
summary.zh: 在五个 AI 监测面上计划提示词采样。

description.en: Inspect actual answers, cited sources, fan-out queries, sentiment, positions, competitors and share of voice for individual prompts.
description.zh: 查看单个提示词的实际回答、引用来源、扇出查询、情绪、位置、竞品和声量份额。

summary.en: Inspect answer-level evidence and competitive context.
summary.zh: 查看回答级证据和竞品背景。

description.en: Export monitored results to Looker Studio, Google Sheets or Excel for reporting and further analysis.
description.zh: 将监测结果导出到 Looker Studio、Google Sheets 或 Excel，用于报告和进一步分析。

summary.en: Export results to BI, spreadsheet and Excel workflows.
summary.zh: 将结果导出到 BI、表格和 Excel 工作流。

label.zh: 官方 AI 曝光追踪产品

description.en: Four monthly Marketing Miner subscriptions are EUR 19, EUR 34, EUR 69 and EUR 114 per month excluding VAT. No AI credits are included in the base subscription.
description.zh: 四档 Marketing Miner 月订阅分别为 19、34、69、114 欧元每月，不含增值税；基础订阅不包含 AI 额度。

summary.en: Base plans: EUR 19/34/69/114 per month excluding VAT.
summary.zh: 基础方案：每月 19/34/69/114 欧元，不含增值税。

description.en: AI Visibility add-on packages are 1,300 credits for EUR 20/month, 2,800 for EUR 41, 4,400 for EUR 61, 6,300 for EUR 82 and 13,400 for EUR 165. Custom volume starts at EUR 165/month.
description.zh: AI 曝光附加包为 1,300 额度 20 欧元/月、2,800 额度 41 欧元/月、4,400 额度 61 欧元/月、6,300 额度 82 欧元/月、13,400 额度 165 欧元/月；定制量从 165 欧元/月起。

summary.en: Add-ons: EUR 20/41/61/82/165 per month for 1,300–13,400 credits.

description.en: One tracked prompt on one LLM consumes two AI credits. The official example uses 150 prompts on one model for four weeks: 1,200 credits, with 1,300 recommended. Credits expire after 30 days.
description.zh: 一个提示词在一个大模型上消耗两个 AI 额度。官方示例为 150 个提示词在一个模型上运行四周，共 1,200 额度，建议准备 1,300。额度在 30 天后过期。

summary.en: Two credits per prompt-model run; credits expire after 30 days.
summary.zh: 每个提示词与模型组合运行消耗两额度；额度 30 天后过期。

description.en: Annual billing offers 12 months for the price of 11 and is available only by bank transfer. Monthly plans auto-renew on the same calendar date; cancellation in the profile preserves access to the period end. No trial was found on the reviewed official pages.
description.zh: 年付以 11 个月价格获得 12 个月服务，仅支持银行转账。月付在同一日历日自动续订；在个人资料中取消后可使用至周期结束。审核的官方页面未发现试用。

summary.en: Annual: 12 months for 11, bank transfer only; no trial found.
summary.zh: 年付以 11 个月价格获得 12 个月，仅银行转账；未发现试用。

description.en: A paid Marketing Miner subscription is required in addition to the AI Visibility credit add-on.
description.zh: 除 AI 曝光额度附加包外，还需要付费 Marketing Miner 订阅。

summary.en: Total cost includes both a base subscription and AI credits.
summary.zh: 总成本包括基础订阅和 AI 额度两部分。

description.en: The Privacy Policy substantively covers configured marketing prompts and AI data providers, but no visible update or effective date was found.
description.zh: 隐私政策实质性覆盖配置的营销提示词和 AI 数据平台，但未找到可见的更新或生效日期。

summary.en: Privacy content is substantive but visibly undated.
summary.zh: 隐私政策内容完整，但未见日期。

description.en: The DPA contains a broken cross-reference reading “Error! Reference source not found.” in its new-subprocessor clause. Confirm the intended notice mechanism if this clause matters to procurement.
description.zh: 数据处理协议在新子处理商条款中含有损坏的交叉引用“Error! Reference source not found.”。若该条款对采购重要，需确认预期通知机制。

summary.en: A broken DPA cross-reference needs clarification for procurement.
summary.zh: 数据处理协议中的损坏交叉引用需在采购时澄清。

description.en: Evaluate the combined base subscription and AI-credit requirement, not the add-on price alone. The credit model favors predictable prompt counts, while one-time research and recurring monitoring consume the same allowance.
description.zh: 评估时应合并基础订阅和 AI 额度需求，而非只看附加包价格。额度模式适合可预测的提示词数量，一次性研究和持续监测都会消耗同一额度池。

description.en: Prompt monitoring and recurring AI tests with visibility, sentiment, citations, competitor comparisons and action plans.
description.zh: 提示词监测和定期 AI 测试，提供曝光、情绪、引用、竞品比较和行动计划。

en: Prompt monitoring
Recurring tests
Action plans
zh: 提示词监测
定期测试
行动计划

en: Monitor selected prompts and run recurring tests across supported AI models.
Track visibility, position, sentiment, cited sources and competitor share of answer.
Generate action plans and connect an MCP integration for supported workflows.
Offer fixed monthly plans with daily monitoring on Essential and Pro.
zh: 监测所选提示词，并在受支持的 AI 模型上运行定期测试。
追踪曝光、位置、情绪、引用来源和竞品回答份额。
生成行动计划，并为支持的工作流提供 MCP 集成。
提供固定月付方案，Essential 和 Pro 均含每日监测。

audience.en: Companies and agencies that need prompt-level monitoring plus prioritized next actions.
audience.zh: 需要提示词级监测和优先级后续行动的企业及代理团队。

description.en: Configure prompts and recurring tests, then compare visibility and position across the models included in the selected plan.
description.zh: 配置提示词和定期测试，再比较所选方案包含模型上的曝光和位置。

summary.en: Run recurring prompt tests and compare model-level visibility.
summary.zh: 运行定期提示词测试并比较模型级曝光。

description.en: Review cited sources, sentiment and competitor share of answer to investigate why a brand appears or disappears in sampled responses.
description.zh: 查看引用来源、情绪和竞品回答份额，调查品牌在采样回答中出现或消失的原因。

summary.en: Investigate answers with citations, sentiment and competitors.
summary.zh: 结合引用、情绪和竞品调查回答。

description.en: Turn monitoring findings into action plans and use the documented MCP integration where the workflow supports it.
description.zh: 将监测发现转化为行动计划，并在工作流支持时使用文档化的 MCP 集成。

summary.en: Convert findings into action plans and supported MCP workflows.
summary.zh: 将发现转化为计划和支持的 MCP 工作流。

description.en: Essential is USD 135/month with 50 prompts, ChatGPT and Gemini, daily runs and up to five action plans per month. Pro is USD 370/month with 100 prompts, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews, daily runs and up to 12 action plans. USD is confirmed by official structured data.
description.zh: Essential 为 135 美元/月，含 50 个提示词、ChatGPT 和 Gemini、每日运行及每月最多五个行动计划。Pro 为 370 美元/月，含 100 个提示词、ChatGPT、Perplexity、Gemini 和 Google AI Overviews、每日运行及每月最多 12 个行动计划。美元币种由官方结构化数据确认。

summary.en: USD 135/month for 50 prompts; USD 370/month for 100.
summary.zh: 50 个提示词 135 美元/月；100 个提示词 370 美元/月。

description.en: Enterprise is custom-priced and lists up to eight models, real-time monitoring, unlimited action plans and consulting. The public page does not name all eight models.
description.zh: Enterprise 为定制报价，列出最多八个模型、实时监测、无限行动计划和咨询服务。公开页面未列出全部八个模型名称。

summary.en: Enterprise is custom with up to eight models and real-time monitoring.
summary.zh: Enterprise 为定制报价，最多八个模型并支持实时监测。

description.en: Essential and Pro offer seven-day full-access trials with a card required. The pricing page says to cancel during the seven days; Enterprise starts with a demo and has no trial.
description.zh: Essential 和 Pro 提供七天完整功能试用，需要绑卡。定价页面称应在七天内取消；Enterprise 从演示开始，不提供试用。

summary.en: Seven-day card-required trial on Essential and Pro only.
summary.zh: 仅 Essential 和 Pro 提供需绑卡的七天试用。

description.en: The public Terms are substantive but show no visible effective or update date and do not clearly specify billing, auto-renewal, refunds or trial conversion. Confirm these commercial conditions before subscribing.
description.zh: 公开条款内容完整，但未见生效或更新日期，也未明确说明计费、自动续订、退款或试用转付费。订阅前需确认这些商业条件。

summary.en: Public terms omit a visible date and key billing mechanics.
summary.zh: 公开条款未见日期，且缺少关键计费机制。

description.en: The Privacy Policy is updated November 16, 2026 and covers workspaces, prompts, responses, reports and retention. Some processing occurs outside Brazil, mainly in the United States.
description.zh: 隐私政策更新于 2026 年 11 月 16 日，覆盖工作区、提示词、回答、报告和保留期限。部分处理发生在巴西境外，主要在美国。

summary.en: Prompt and response data are covered; cross-border processing applies.
summary.zh: 提示词和回答数据受政策覆盖，并涉及跨境处理。

description.en: Account and workspace data are retained for the contract term plus up to six months; analytics can be retained for 24 months, audit logs for 12 months and billing or tax records for five years.
description.zh: 账户和工作区数据在合同期内及之后最多保留六个月；分析数据最多保留 24 个月，审计日志 12 个月，计费或税务记录五年。

summary.en: Retention varies by data class, up to five years for financial records.
summary.zh: 不同数据类别保留期不同，财务记录最长五年。

description.en: Compare prompt count, included models, daily versus real-time monitoring and the monthly action-plan cap. Confirm renewal and refund mechanics because the public Terms do not state them clearly.
description.zh: 比较提示词数量、包含模型、每日与实时监测以及每月行动计划上限。公开条款未清楚说明续订和退款机制，需另行确认。

description.en: Daily fixed-time prompt tracking with raw answers, citation rows, competitor context and MCP export.
description.zh: 每日定时提示词追踪，提供原始回答、引用行、竞品背景和 MCP 导出。

en: Daily prompts
Raw citations
MCP export
zh: 每日提示词
原始引用
MCP 导出

en: Run tracked prompts daily at fixed times across ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Overviews, with Claude and Perplexity add-ons.
Store full answers and raw citation rows for inspection.
Group goals, publishers, articles, authors and coverage; generate personas from profile and prompt inputs.
Export data through MCP and track inactive prompts without running or charging them.
zh: 每日定时在 ChatGPT、Gemini 和 Google AI Overviews 上运行提示词，Claude 和 Perplexity 为附加项。
保存完整回答和原始引用行，便于检查。
按目标、发布商、文章、作者和覆盖范围分组，并根据资料和提示词输入生成用户画像。
通过 MCP 导出数据，未启用提示词不会运行或计费。

audience.en: Brands and agencies that need inspectable daily prompt evidence and citation-level reporting.
audience.zh: 需要可检查的每日提示词证据和引用级报告的品牌及代理团队。

description.en: Run a fixed prompt set daily and inspect full answers and raw citation rows for each provider.
description.zh: 每日运行固定提示词集，并查看每个平台的完整回答和原始引用行。

summary.en: Inspect daily answers and raw citation rows.
summary.zh: 查看每日回答和原始引用行。

description.en: Compare brand, competitor and publisher coverage by goal, article, author and citation source.
description.zh: 按目标、文章、作者和引用来源比较品牌、竞品及发布商覆盖情况。

summary.en: Compare competitive and publisher coverage from saved answers.
summary.zh: 根据保存的回答比较竞品和发布商覆盖。

description.en: Generate supported personas and run them daily on ChatGPT and Gemini; export monitored data through MCP.
description.zh: 生成受支持的用户画像，并每日在 ChatGPT 和 Gemini 上运行；通过 MCP 导出监测数据。

summary.en: Use persona runs and MCP export in supported workflows.
summary.zh: 在支持的工作流中使用用户画像运行和 MCP 导出。

description.en: Brand is USD 79/month with 50 daily prompts and 60 monthly credits. Agency Core is USD 349/month with 250 daily prompts and 300 credits. Agency Pro is USD 699/month with 600 daily prompts and 720 credits. Enterprise is custom.
description.zh: Brand 为 79 美元/月，含 50 个每日提示词和 60 个每月额度。Agency Core 为 349 美元/月，含 250 个每日提示词和 300 个额度。Agency Pro 为 699 美元/月，含 600 个每日提示词和 720 个额度。Enterprise 为定制报价。

summary.en: USD 79/50 prompts; USD 349/250; USD 699/600 per month.

description.en: Monthly plans can be cancelled anytime. Quarterly billing advertises 10% savings and yearly billing 20%, but exact totals are not displayed. Pay-as-you-go is USD 1 per credit with a USD 15 minimum; a one-time report is USD 15.
description.zh: 月付方案可随时取消。季付宣传省 10%，年付省 20%，但未显示确切总额。按量付费为每额度 1 美元，最低 15 美元；一次性报告为 15 美元。

summary.en: Quarterly -10%, yearly -20%; PAYG $1/credit, $15 minimum.
summary.zh: 季付省 10%，年付省 20%；按量每额度 1 美元，最低 15 美元。

description.en: Perplexity is an add-on: 50 prompts for USD 29/month, 250 for USD 99/month or 600 for USD 249/month. Claude is also described as an add-on, but no separate public Claude price was found.
description.zh: Perplexity 为附加项：50 个提示词 29 美元/月、250 个 99 美元/月、600 个 249 美元/月。Claude 也被描述为附加项，但未找到单独公开的 Claude 价格。

summary.en: Perplexity add-on: USD 29/99/249 per month by prompt tier.
summary.zh: Perplexity 附加项按提示词档位为 29/99/249 美元每月。

description.en: A persona run counts as one tracked prompt. Inactive prompts that are not assigned do not run and do not incur charges.
description.zh: 一次用户画像运行计为一个追踪提示词。未分配的停用提示词不会运行，也不会产生费用。

summary.en: Persona runs consume one prompt; inactive unassigned prompts do not.
summary.zh: 用户画像运行消耗一个提示词；未分配的停用提示词不消耗。

description.en: Public Terms do not clearly state trial terms, auto-renewal, subscription refunds or a postal address, and they do not contain a detailed paid-subscription grant. Confirm the order and billing terms before purchase.
description.zh: 公开条款未清楚说明试用、自动续订、订阅退款或邮政地址，也没有详细的付费订阅授权。购买前需确认订单和计费条款。

summary.en: Public terms leave trial, renewal, refund and subscription-grant details unclear.
summary.zh: 公开条款未清楚说明试用、续订、退款和订阅授权。

description.en: Base plans include ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Overviews. Claude and Perplexity require add-ons, so total cost depends on the selected provider set.
description.zh: 基础方案包含 ChatGPT、Gemini 和 Google AI Overviews。Claude 和 Perplexity 需要附加项，因此总成本取决于所选平台组合。

summary.en: Provider add-ons change the total monthly cost.
summary.zh: 平台附加项会改变每月总成本。

description.en: Quarterly and yearly savings are published only as percentages, not as exact billed totals. Confirm the checkout amount before choosing a longer interval.
description.zh: 季付和年付优惠仅公布百分比，没有确切账单总额。选择较长周期前需确认结账金额。

summary.en: Exact quarterly and yearly totals are not published.
summary.zh: 未公布确切的季付和年付总额。

description.en: Prioritize this workflow when daily fixed-time sampling, raw citation rows and MCP export are central. Budget for provider add-ons and verify the incomplete public subscription terms before committing.
description.zh: 当每日定时采样、原始引用行和 MCP 导出是核心需求时，可优先考虑此工作流。需为平台附加项预算，并在承诺前核实不完整的公开订阅条款。

description.en: Automated biweekly buyer-question sampling with retained answers, competitor context and bundled GEO content services.
description.zh: 自动每两周采样买家问题，保留回答和竞品背景，并捆绑 GEO 内容服务。

en: Biweekly sampling
Buyer questions
GEO services
zh: 每两周采样
买家问题
GEO 服务

en: Run each tracked question three times per selected assistant every two weeks.
Keep every answer and identify named brands, competitors, sentiment, positioning and cited sources.
Support seven assistants, with the Track plan including two of the user’s choice.
Bundle page audits, technical fixes, article drafts, YouTube plans and directory suggestions.
zh: 每两周将每个追踪问题在所选助手上运行三次。
保留每个回答，并识别被提及品牌、竞品、情绪、定位和引用来源。
支持七种助手，Track 方案包含用户选择的两种。
捆绑页面审计、技术修复、文章草稿、YouTube 计划和目录建议。

audience.en: Web agencies and SaaS founders that want recurring sampling together with content and technical GEO execution.
audience.zh: 希望将定期采样与内容及技术 GEO 执行结合的网页代理和 SaaS 创始人。

description.en: Configure tracked buyer questions and select two assistants; Sauror asks each question three times in each biweekly collection.
description.zh: 配置追踪的买家问题并选择两种助手；Sauror 在每次双周采集中将每个问题运行三次。

summary.en: Run each question three times per assistant every two weeks.
summary.zh: 每两周将每个问题在每个助手上运行三次。

description.en: Inspect retained answers for brand mentions, competitors, sentiment, positioning and cited sources.
description.zh: 查看保留的回答，了解品牌提及、竞品、情绪、定位和引用来源。

summary.en: Audit brands and sources against retained answers.
summary.zh: 依据保留的回答审核品牌和来源。

description.en: Use bundled technical fixes, article drafts, YouTube plans and directory suggestions as execution inputs, while reviewing drafts before publication.
description.zh: 将捆绑的技术修复、文章草稿、YouTube 计划和目录建议作为执行输入，并在发布前审核草稿。

summary.en: Pair measurement with bundled GEO execution services.
summary.zh: 将监测与捆绑的 GEO 执行服务结合。

description.en: Monthly Track costs EUR 10 excluding VAT for the first month, then EUR 60/month. It includes two projects, 25 tracked questions, two assistants, three seats and biweekly sampling with three runs per question.
description.zh: Track 月付首月为 10 欧元，不含增值税，之后为 60 欧元/月。包含两个项目、25 个追踪问题、两种助手、三个席位，以及每两周三次运行。

summary.en: EUR 10 first month, then EUR 60/month excluding VAT.
summary.zh: 首月 10 欧元，之后 60 欧元/月，均不含增值税。

description.en: Yearly Track is EUR 42/month excluding VAT, billed as EUR 504 once per year. It includes the same plan scope as monthly billing.
description.zh: Track 年付为 42 欧元/月，不含增值税，每年一次性收取 504 欧元。范围与月付方案相同。

summary.en: Yearly: EUR 42/month equivalent, EUR 504 billed once.
summary.zh: 年付：折合 42 欧元/月，一次性收取 504 欧元。

description.en: Both billing options include page audit and technical fixes, eight articles per month, YouTube plans, directory suggestions and competitor/source analysis. The first month is paid introductory pricing, not a free trial.
description.zh: 两种计费方式均包含页面审计和技术修复、每月八篇文章、YouTube 计划、目录建议及竞品/来源分析。首月为付费引导价，不是免费试用。

summary.en: The bundle includes content and technical services; no free trial is stated.
summary.zh: 套餐包含内容和技术服务；未说明提供免费试用。

description.en: Monthly and yearly plans are billed in advance and renew unless cancelled. Cancellation stops the next renewal and access continues to the paid period end. Started periods are generally nonrefundable unless law requires otherwise or the provider plainly failed.
description.zh: 月付和年付方案预付并自动续订，除非取消。取消会停止下一周期续订，已付周期内仍可使用。已开始周期通常不退款，除非法律要求或平台明显未履行。

summary.en: Advance billing, renewal and limited refund conditions apply.
summary.zh: 适用预付、续订和有限退款条件。

description.en: Track includes only two assistants per project, selected from seven supported assistants. It does not include all seven simultaneously.
description.zh: Track 每个项目仅包含两种助手，可从七种受支持助手中选择，并非同时包含全部七种。

summary.en: Track covers two assistants, not all seven.
summary.zh: Track 仅覆盖两种助手，而非全部七种。

description.en: Visible pricing states two projects, while official structured data still describes one project. This record uses the visible pricing card; confirm the project count at checkout.
description.zh: 可见定价卡写明两个项目，而官方结构化数据仍描述一个项目。本记录采用可见定价卡；结账时需确认项目数量。

summary.en: Visible pricing says two projects; structured metadata says one.
summary.zh: 可见定价为两个项目；结构化元数据为一个。

description.en: The plan bundles content and technical services, so it is not a measurement-only subscription. Mentions and citations are not guaranteed.
description.zh: 该方案捆绑内容和技术服务，因此不是仅用于监测的订阅。提及和引用不作保证。

summary.en: Bundled services extend beyond measurement; outcomes are not guaranteed.
summary.zh: 捆绑服务超出监测范围，且不保证结果。

description.en: Choose this plan when biweekly sampling plus content and technical execution is useful. Measurement-only teams should account for the bundled services and the two-assistant limit before comparing cost.
description.zh: 当每两周采样加上内容和技术执行均有价值时，可选择此方案。仅需监测的团队应先将捆绑服务和两种助手限制纳入成本比较。

description.en: MIT-licensed self-hosted prompt-set monitoring with cron scheduling, provider APIs, local models and a Postgres-backed dashboard.
description.zh: 采用 MIT 许可的自托管提示词集监测，支持 cron 计划任务、平台 API、本地模型和 Postgres 仪表盘。

en: Open source
Cron scheduling
Local models
zh: 开源
cron 计划任务
本地模型

en: Define brand aliases, domain, competitors and prompt sets.
Run prompt sets manually or on cron across OpenAI, Perplexity, Gemini and Anthropic adapters.
Detect brand mentions, cited URLs and competitor share of voice.
Use Ollama or OpenAI-compatible local servers, or start with a mock engine.
zh: 定义品牌别名、域名、竞品和提示词集。
在 OpenAI、Perplexity、Gemini 和 Anthropic 适配器上手动或按 cron 运行提示词集。
检测品牌提及、引用 URL 和竞品声量份额。
使用 Ollama 或兼容 OpenAI 的本地服务，或从模拟引擎开始。

audience.en: Developers and small technical teams that want a simple self-hosted prompt dashboard with flexible model backends.
audience.zh: 希望使用简单自托管提示词仪表盘和灵活模型后端的开发者及小型技术团队。

description.en: Set up brand aliases, domain and competitors, then create prompt sets from the questions buyers ask.
description.zh: 设置品牌别名、域名和竞品，再根据买家问题创建提示词集。

summary.en: Configure brands, competitors and buyer-question prompt sets.
summary.zh: 配置品牌、竞品和买家问题提示词集。

description.en: Run prompt sets manually or on cron and inspect per-prompt, per-engine visibility and competitor share of voice.
description.zh: 手动或按 cron 运行提示词集，查看每个提示词、每个引擎的曝光和竞品声量份额。

summary.en: Schedule prompt sets and inspect per-engine results.
summary.zh: 计划运行提示词集并查看各引擎结果。

description.en: Use hosted provider APIs with your own keys, local Ollama or OpenAI-compatible servers, or the mock engine for workflow exploration.
description.zh: 使用自带密钥的平台 API、本地 Ollama 或兼容 OpenAI 的服务，也可用模拟引擎了解工作流。

summary.en: Choose hosted APIs, local models or a mock engine.
summary.zh: 选择平台 API、本地模型或模拟引擎。

description.en: The software is free under the MIT license. Hosted provider APIs are billed directly to the user at provider cost with no markup.
description.zh: 软件采用 MIT 许可，可免费使用。平台 API 直接按平台成本向用户收费，不加价。

summary.en: Free MIT software; hosted API usage is paid directly.
summary.zh: MIT 软件免费，平台 API 用量直接付费。

description.en: Ollama and compatible local servers can run without API keys, so local sampling can avoid model-usage charges. Hosting, hardware and optional search services remain separate costs.
description.zh: Ollama 和兼容本地服务可无需 API 密钥运行，因此本地采样可避免模型用量费用。托管、硬件和可选搜索服务成本另计。

summary.en: Local models can avoid API fees; infrastructure costs remain.
summary.zh: 本地模型可避免 API 费用，基础设施成本仍存在。

description.en: Docker Compose runs the app and Postgres together. Node.js 22 or newer with a Postgres database is also documented for development.
description.zh: Docker Compose 可同时运行应用和 Postgres。开发环境也文档化支持 Node.js 22 或更高版本加 Postgres。

summary.en: Docker Compose is the one-command deployment path.
summary.zh: Docker Compose 是一条命令的部署方式。

description.en: The project labels itself an MVP and warns that the API and UI may change. No tagged release was found through the official releases endpoint; the repository was last pushed on 2026-10-27.
description.zh: 项目自称 MVP，并提醒 API 和界面可能变化。官方版本接口未找到标签版本；仓库最后推送日期为 2026 年 10 月 27 日。

summary.en: MVP with no tagged release found; verify production readiness.
summary.zh: MVP，未找到标签版本；需核实生产就绪程度。

description.en: Local models provide offline signals but do not have web access. Their answers are not equivalent to hosted consumer search products.
description.zh: 本地模型提供离线信号，但没有联网能力，其回答不等同于托管消费端搜索产品。

summary.en: Local-model answers lack web access.
summary.zh: 本地模型回答没有联网能力。

description.en: The mock engine uses simulated answers for workflow exploration. Its results are not real brand-visibility evidence.
description.zh: 模拟引擎使用模拟回答来展示工作流，其结果不是真实品牌曝光证据。

summary.en: Mock-engine output is not real monitoring evidence.
summary.zh: 模拟引擎输出不是真实监测证据。

description.en: Choose aeoscope for a minimal self-hosted prompt dashboard with cron and local-model options. Treat it as an MVP: validate the API, UI and deployment before relying on it for production monitoring.
description.zh: 需要带 cron 和本地模型选项的简洁自托管提示词仪表盘时，可选择 aeoscope。它仍属 MVP，生产监测前需验证 API、界面和部署。

description.en: Query a continuously updated database of real ChatGPT and Google AI Overview questions, answers, citations and AI search volume through a developer API.
description.zh: 通过开发者 API 查询持续更新的 ChatGPT 与 Google AI Overview 真实问题、回答、引用来源及 AI 搜索量数据库。

en: Question research
Answer database
Citation evidence
zh: 问题研究
回答数据库
引用证据

en: Search more than 280 million real prompts and answers from ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews.
Filter by keyword, domain or URL across questions, answers, cited sources, brand entities and fan-out queries where available.
Return full answers, cited-source metadata, AI search volume, monthly trends and first/last response timestamps.
Access brand comparisons, top sources and historical trends through related metrics endpoints.
zh: 搜索超过 2.8 亿条来自 ChatGPT 与 Google AI Overviews 的真实提示词和回答。
按关键词、域名或 URL 在问题、回答、引用来源、品牌实体和可用的衍生查询中筛选。
返回完整回答、引用来源元数据、AI 搜索量、月度趋势及首次和末次回答时间。
通过相关指标端点进行品牌比较、热门来源和历史趋势分析。

audience.en: SEO, analytics and engineering teams building prompt research, AI visibility products or answer-level citation analysis.
audience.zh: 构建提示词研究、AI 曝光产品或回答级引用分析的 SEO、分析和工程团队。

description.en: Find real buyer and category questions in the LLM Mentions database, inspect the full AI answers and cited sources, and prioritize research using AI search volume rather than inventing a prompt list.
description.zh: 在 LLM Mentions 数据库中发现真实买家和品类问题，查看完整 AI 回答及引用来源，并依据 AI 搜索量确定研究优先级，而非自行编造提示词清单。

summary.en: Discover real AI questions and inspect answers with AI search volume.
summary.zh: 发现真实 AI 问题，并结合 AI 搜索量查看回答。

description.en: Search mentions in questions, answers, sources, brand entities or fan-out queries for a keyword, domain or URL, with location, language, platform and AI-search-volume filters.
description.zh: 按关键词、域名或 URL 搜索问题、回答、来源、品牌实体或衍生查询中的提及，并支持地区、语言、平台和 AI 搜索量筛选。

summary.en: Filter mentions by entity, field, platform, place and language.
summary.zh: 按实体、字段、平台、地区和语言筛选提及。

description.en: Audit citation opportunities from source domains, URLs, snippets, ranks and publication dates, then trace monthly AI-search-volume changes and response freshness.
description.zh: 根据来源域名、URL、摘要、排名和发布日期审计引用机会，并追踪月度 AI 搜索量变化与回答新鲜度。

summary.en: Audit cited sources, ranking, response age and monthly demand.
summary.zh: 审计引用来源、排名、回答时效与月度需求。

label.zh: 官方 LLM Mentions 产品页
官方 LLM Mentions 定价
官方 Search Mentions 端点文档

description.en: LLM Mentions costs USD 0.10 per task plus USD 0.001 per returned row. A 1,000-row request therefore costs USD 1.10; one million rows returned in 1,000 requests costs USD 1,100.
description.zh: LLM Mentions 每任务收费 0.10 美元，每返回行收费 0.001 美元。因此 1,000 行请求收费 1.10 美元；分 1,000 个请求返回 100 万行共收费 1,100 美元。

summary.en: USD 0.10/task + USD 0.001/row; 1M rows across 1,000 tasks costs USD 1,100.
summary.zh: 每任务 0.10 美元＋每行 0.001 美元；100 万行分 1,000 个任务共 1,100 美元。

description.en: The FAQ describes an unlimited trial period and says registration provides Sandbox access and USD 1 in trial credit. The minimum payment commitment is USD 50, and unused balance does not expire.
description.zh: FAQ 描述试用期不限时长，并称注册后提供 Sandbox 访问和 1 美元试用额度。最低付款承诺为 50 美元，未使用余额不过期。

summary.en: Registration trial includes Sandbox and USD 1 credit; minimum commitment USD 50.
summary.zh: 注册试用含 Sandbox 和 1 美元额度；最低付款承诺 50 美元。

description.en: The terms advertise a 30-day no-questions-asked refund for the first purchase of API credits. Database purchases are excluded, and other subscription, downgrade and account-closure charges follow the more specific refund rules.
description.zh: 条款宣传首次购买 API 额度可享 30 天无理由退款，但不适用于数据库购买；其他订阅、降级和关闭账户费用适用更具体的退款规则。

summary.en: 30-day refund applies to first API-credit purchase, not database purchases.
summary.zh: 30 天退款仅限首次 API 额度购买，不含数据库购买。

description.en: LLM Mentions explicitly covers ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews. Other DataForSEO products cover additional AI engines, but their platform coverage and pricing must not be attributed to LLM Mentions.
description.zh: LLM Mentions 明确覆盖 ChatGPT 和 Google AI Overviews。DataForSEO 其他产品覆盖更多 AI 引擎，但其平台范围和定价不能归入 LLM Mentions。

summary.en: Only ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews are confirmed for LLM Mentions.
summary.zh: LLM Mentions 仅确认覆盖 ChatGPT 和 Google AI Overviews。

description.en: This is a continuously updated historical database, not a scheduler that runs a customer's custom prompts against live consumer interfaces. The complete dataset update cycle is 60 days, and individual records carry first and last response timestamps.
description.zh: 这是持续更新的历史数据库，不是按计划将客户自定义提示词运行在实时消费端界面上的工具。完整数据集更新周期为 60 天，单条记录带有首次和末次回答时间。

summary.en: Historical database, not custom-prompt live scheduling; full refresh takes 60 days.
summary.zh: 历史数据库，不支持自定义提示词实时计划采样；完整更新周期 60 天。

description.en: The pricing-page headline saying from USD 1.10 per one million rows is misleading: the body table and FAQ establish USD 0.10 per task plus USD 0.001 per row, making one million rows across 1,000 tasks USD 1,100.
description.zh: 定价页标题称 100 万行起价 1.10 美元，具有误导性：正文表格和 FAQ 明确为每任务 0.10 美元加每行 0.001 美元，100 万行分 1,000 个任务实际为 1,100 美元。

summary.en: Ignore the USD 1.10/1M headline; the published unit pricing totals USD 1,100/1M rows.
summary.zh: 不要按 100 万行 1.10 美元的标题估算；按公布单价计算为 1,100 美元。

description.en: The privacy policy says API task data is retained for 365 days and then permanently deleted. It lists infrastructure, support and payment processors such as Google, AWS, Microsoft Azure and Hetzner, but does not list AI-model providers for this database workflow.
description.zh: 隐私政策称 API 任务数据保存 365 天后永久删除，并列出 Google、AWS、Microsoft Azure、Hetzner 等基础设施、支持和支付处理商，但未列出该数据库工作流的 AI 模型处理商。

summary.en: API task data is kept 365 days; no AI-model processor is listed for this workflow.
summary.zh: API 任务数据保存 365 天；该工作流未列出 AI 模型处理商。

description.en: Terms sections 7.1 and 7.2 restrict using SERP data to harm or compete with the original search providers and impose broad indemnity obligations. Although the product page targets AI-visibility and tracking products, buyers must review redistribution and competitive-use rights before reselling data.
description.zh: 条款第 7.1 和 7.2 节限制将 SERP 数据用于损害或竞争原始搜索服务商，并规定广泛赔偿义务。尽管产品页面向 AI 曝光和追踪产品，购买方在转售数据前仍须审核再分发和竞争性使用权限。

summary.en: SERP-use restrictions and broad indemnities require review before data resale.
summary.zh: SERP 使用限制及广泛赔偿义务要求转售前审查。

description.en: The public terms reviewed do not state a governing-law or dispute-forum clause. The operator is identified in the privacy policy as DataForSEO OU in Estonia, but that address does not by itself establish the contract's governing law.
description.zh: 已审阅的公开条款未规定管辖法律或争议解决地。隐私政策将运营方认定为爱沙尼亚的 DataForSEO OU，但该地址本身不能确定合同管辖法律。

summary.en: No governing-law clause was found; Estonian operator identity does not settle jurisdiction.
summary.zh: 未找到管辖法律条款；爱沙尼亚运营主体不等于合同管辖地。

description.en: Choose this API for evidence-backed question discovery and historical answer/citation research at scale. It is not a substitute for a live custom-prompt tracker, and engineering teams should model per-task plus per-row costs before committing. The operator is DataForSEO OU, company number 14502291, registered in Tallinn, Estonia.
description.zh: 需要大规模、有证据支撑的问题发现以及历史回答和引用研究时，可选择此 API。它不能替代实时自定义提示词追踪器，工程团队应在承诺前按每任务加每行成本建模。运营方为 DataForSEO OU，公司编号 14502291，注册于爱沙尼亚塔林。

name: MentionBird Keyword to AI Prompt Generator

description.en: Free, no-login generator that turns a keyword, URL or brand into brand-neutral AI buyer prompts across research, comparison and decision intent. It uses Perplexity with live web search and returns about ten copyable hypotheses, not real query logs or prompt-volume data.
description.zh: 免费且无需登录，可将关键词、URL 或品牌转化为覆盖研究、比较和决策意图的品牌中立 AI 买家提示词。它使用带实时网页搜索的 Perplexity，通常返回约十条可复制的假设，而非真实查询日志或提示词量数据。

en: Prompt generation
Brand-neutral questions
Buyer intent
zh: 提示词生成
品牌中立问题
买家意图

en: Accept a keyword, URL or brand and send it to Perplexity's API with live web search to infer the category and buying context.
Usually generate about ten natural-language, brand-neutral prompts spanning research, comparison and decision intent; filtering removes prompts with brand names or dates and can shorten the list.
Copy each prompt individually or copy the full list, then test the plain questions on ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity or Claude.
Draft a fresh set on every run, so repeating the same input can widen the pool of prompt hypotheses.
zh: 接受关键词、URL 或品牌，并将其发送至带实时网页搜索的 Perplexity API，以推断品类和购买情境。
通常生成约十条覆盖研究、比较和决策意图的自然语言品牌中立提示词；过滤会移除含品牌名或日期的提示词，并可能缩短结果列表。
可逐条复制或一键复制全部提示词，再在 ChatGPT、Gemini、Perplexity 或 Claude 上测试这些普通问题。
每次运行都会重新起草一组提示词，因此重复输入同一内容可扩大提示词假设池。

audience.en: SEO, GEO, content and ecommerce marketers, plus agency teams, who need a starting set of buyer questions for manual AI-visibility testing.
audience.zh: 需要一组初始买家问题来手动测试 AI 曝光的 SEO、GEO、内容和电商营销人员，以及代理团队。

description.en: Expand a keyword, URL or brand into about ten brand-neutral buyer questions covering research, comparison and decision intent, with brand names and dates filtered out.
description.zh: 将一个关键词、URL 或品牌扩展为约十个覆盖研究、比较和决策意图的品牌中立买家问题，并过滤掉品牌名和日期。

summary.en: Generate brand-neutral research, comparison and decision questions from a seed.
summary.zh: 从种子内容生成品牌中立的研究、比较和决策问题。

description.en: Copy individual prompts or the full list, run them manually on ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity or Claude, and record which brands and sources each answer names as an initial visibility reading.
description.zh: 逐条复制或复制全部提示词，在 ChatGPT、Gemini、Perplexity 或 Claude 上手动运行，并记录每个回答提及的品牌和来源，作为初始曝光观察。

summary.en: Copy prompts and manually record brands and sources across AI assistants.
summary.zh: 复制提示词，并手动记录各 AI 助手提到的品牌和来源。

description.en: Run the same seed again to obtain a different set, then prune the combined hypotheses to three to five prompts weighted toward comparison and decision intent for further testing.
description.zh: 再次运行同一种子内容以获得不同结果，再将合并后的假设筛选为三至五个偏重比较和决策意图的提示词，用于进一步测试。

summary.en: Rerun to widen the pool, then prioritize three to five comparison and decision prompts.
summary.zh: 重复运行扩大候选池，再优先选择三至五个比较和决策提示词。

label.en: Official Keyword to AI Prompt Generator product page and FAQ
label.zh: 官方关键词转 AI 提示词生成器产品页与常见问题

label.en: Official MentionBird about and operator page
label.zh: MentionBird 官方关于与运营方页面

description.en: The generator is labeled Free and No Login Required, and its structured data lists a USD 0 offer. The captured free-tool flow shows no signup, card-entry or trial-countdown step; the terms' billing-information and free-trial provisions concern optional subscriptions rather than this no-login tool.
description.zh: 生成器标注为免费且无需登录，结构化数据列出 0 美元报价。抓取到的免费工具流程没有注册、填卡或试用倒计时步骤；条款中的账单信息和免费试用规定针对可选订阅，而非此无需登录的工具。

summary.en: Free; no login, card or trial clock in the captured generator flow.
summary.zh: 免费；抓取到的生成器流程无需登录、填卡或试用倒计时。

description.en: The page separately promotes the paid MentionBird tracker at USD 19 for the first month with code TRY19, then USD 79 per month, cancel anytime. This subscription is optional and is not required to generate prompts.
description.zh: 页面另行推广付费 MentionBird 追踪器：使用代码 TRY19 首月 19 美元，之后每月 79 美元，可随时取消。该订阅为可选，并非生成提示词的必要条件。

summary.en: Separate optional tracker: USD 19 first month with TRY19, then USD 79/month.
summary.zh: 独立可选追踪器：使用 TRY19 首月 19 美元，之后每月 79 美元。

description.en: Optional subscriptions bill in advance on monthly or annual cycles. The privacy policy identifies Stripe as the payment processor and says MentionBird does not store card details. Subscription refund requests may be considered case by case at ADNABU PTE. LTD.'s sole discretion; that refund process is not applicable to the free generator.
description.zh: 可选订阅按月或按年周期预付。隐私政策指明 Stripe 为支付处理商，并称 MentionBird 不保存银行卡详情。订阅退款申请可由 ADNABU PTE. LTD. 逐案自行决定；该退款流程不适用于免费生成器。

summary.en: Paid subscriptions bill monthly or annually via Stripe; discretionary refunds do not apply to the free tool.
summary.zh: 付费订阅按月或按年通过 Stripe 计费；酌情退款不适用于免费工具。

description.en: The FAQ explicitly says these are not the exact prompts people type: AI platforms do not publish query logs, and there is no verified prompt-volume data. Treat the output as starting hypotheses to test and prune, not a traffic estimate; repeated runs can produce different sets.
description.zh: 常见问题明确说明这些并非用户实际输入的确切提示词：AI 平台不公布查询日志，也没有经核验的提示词量数据。应将结果视为待测试和筛选的初始假设，而非流量估算；重复运行可能产生不同结果。

summary.en: Hypotheses, not real query logs or volume; repeated runs differ.
summary.zh: 仅为假设，不是真实查询日志或提示词量；重复运行结果会不同。

description.en: The generator usually returns up to about ten prompts, but its filters can remove items and return fewer. Prompts containing brand names or dates are excluded by design, so the output is not a source for brand-specific or date-specific questions.
description.zh: 生成器通常返回约十条提示词，但过滤机制可能移除部分项目，使结果更少。含品牌名或日期的提示词会被设计性排除，因此输出不能作为品牌特定或日期特定问题的来源。

summary.en: Usually about ten, possibly fewer; brand names and dates are excluded.
summary.zh: 通常约十条，可能更少；排除品牌名和日期。

description.en: This free tool generates and copies questions; it does not run them across AI assistants, report which brands are named or maintain a daily visibility baseline. The page directs those tracking tasks to the separate paid MentionBird tracker, and notes that a one-off answer is only a reading because sources and answers change.
description.zh: 此免费工具仅生成和复制问题，不会在 AI 助手中运行、报告哪些品牌被提及或维护每日曝光基线。页面将这些追踪任务导向独立的付费 MentionBird 追踪器，并指出一次性回答只是观察，因为来源和回答会变化。

summary.en: Generation and copying only; live testing and daily tracking are separate paid features.
summary.zh: 仅生成和复制；实时测试与每日追踪属于独立付费功能。

description.en: The FAQ says the entered keyword is not logged or stored by MentionBird and submissions are not used to train models. However, the input is sent to Perplexity's API and handled under Perplexity's terms; MentionBird logs the user's IP address and a broad category derived from the input for abuse prevention and rate limiting, deleting those logs after 30 days.
description.zh: 常见问题称 MentionBird 不记录或存储输入的关键词，也不使用提交内容训练模型。但输入会发送至 Perplexity API，并受 Perplexity 条款约束；MentionBird 会为防止滥用和限速记录用户 IP 地址及从输入推导的宽泛类别，并在 30 天后删除这些日志。

summary.en: Input goes to Perplexity; MentionBird keeps no keyword but deletes IP/category abuse logs after 30 days.
summary.zh: 输入会发送至 Perplexity；MentionBird 不保存关键词，但 IP/类别滥用日志在 30 天后删除。

description.en: The site privacy policy discloses Google Analytics, Google Ads remarketing, transfers to the United States, purpose-based retention and GDPR data-protection rights. It names Stripe for payments but does not provide a complete AI subprocessor list; the generator FAQ identifies Perplexity, while Perplexity's own retention and training terms are not included in the preserved captures.
description.zh: 网站隐私政策披露 Google Analytics、Google Ads 再营销、向美国传输数据、按目的保留数据及 GDPR 数据保护权利。它列出用于支付的 Stripe，但没有提供完整的 AI 子处理商名单；生成器常见问题指明 Perplexity，而保存的抓取资料未包含 Perplexity 自身的保留和训练条款。

summary.en: Analytics/ads remarketing and US transfers apply; no complete AI subprocessor list is published.
summary.zh: 适用分析/广告再营销及美国传输；未公布完整 AI 子处理商名单。

description.en: The reviewed captures do not publish an exact free-generation quota or rate limit. The FAQ mentions abuse prevention and rate limiting, but gives no numeric allowance, reset period or over-limit behavior for the generator.
description.zh: 已审阅的抓取资料未公布确切的免费生成额度或速率限制。常见问题提到防止滥用和限速，但没有给出生成器的数值额度、重置周期或超限处理方式。

summary.en: Exact free quota and rate limit are not published in the reviewed captures.
summary.zh: 已审阅资料未公布确切的免费额度与速率限制。

description.en: Choose this free generator to draft brand-neutral buyer questions for manual testing, not as evidence of actual query demand or a replacement for daily visibility tracking. Users retain ownership of submitted brand information, prompts and configurations, while granting ADNABU PTE. LTD. a limited license to process them to provide and improve the service. The operator is ADNABU PTE. LTD. (UEN 202600752W), 160 Robinson Road, #14-04 SBF Center, Singapore 068914. The terms and privacy policy are effective 14-07-2026, and Singapore law governs the terms. No personal-use-only or noncommercial-only restriction was found in the reviewed terms.

description.en: Track brand mentions, citations and competitor presence across AI answer engines, with prompt-level answers and source evidence.
