来源分析

en: Save prompt answers and record brand mentions, site links, named competitors and cited pages.
Compare mention rate, citation rate, average position and share of mentions by prompt.
Classify cited sources as competitor, third-party or video sources.
zh: 保存提示词回答，记录品牌提及、网站链接、出现的竞品和引用页面。
按提示词比较提及率、引用率、平均位置和提及份额。
将引用来源分类为竞品、第三方或视频来源。

audience.en: Brand marketers, publishers and agencies that need answer-level competitor and citation evidence.
audience.zh: 需要回答级竞品与引用证据的品牌营销人员、发布方和代理机构。

description.en: Review prompts where competitors are mentioned but the tracked brand is absent, then inspect the answers and cited pages behind the gap.
description.zh: 复查出现竞品但未出现所跟踪品牌的提示词，并查看该缺口背后的回答和引用页面。

summary.en: Find competitor-only prompts and inspect their cited pages.
summary.zh: 查找仅出现竞品的提示词并检查其引用页面。

description.en: Compare brand performance across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini and Perplexity using the same tracked prompt set.
description.zh: 使用同一组跟踪提示词，比较品牌在 ChatGPT、Google AI Overviews、Gemini 和 Perplexity 上的表现。

summary.en: Compare one prompt set across four answer engines.
summary.zh: 跨四个回答引擎比较同一组提示词。

description.en: Pro is $99 USD/month, or $79 USD/month equivalent when billed yearly. It includes 100 prompts/month, 3 registered sites, 4 engines, daily tracking, 12,000 answers/month, 3 seats and a $5,000 monthly placement cap. Extra prompts cost $49 USD per additional 100 prompts/month.
description.zh: Pro 为 99 美元/月，年付折算 79 美元/月。包含每月 100 个提示词、3 个注册网站、4 个引擎、每日跟踪、每月 12,000 个回答、3 个席位和每月 5,000 美元投放上限。每增加 100 个提示词/月收费 49 美元。

summary.en: Pro: $99 USD/month; $79 USD/month equivalent billed yearly; 100 prompts and 12,000 answers/month; +100 prompts cost $49 USD/month.
summary.zh: Pro 99 美元/月，年付折算 79 美元/月；每月 100 个提示词、12,000 个回答；每加 100 个提示词收费 49 美元/月。

description.en: Agency is $599 USD/month, or $479 USD/month equivalent when billed yearly. It includes 1,000 prompts/month, 50 registered sites, 4 engines, 120,000 answers/month, unlimited seats, a $100,000 monthly placement cap, API and white-label reports. Extra prompts cost $39 USD per additional 100 prompts/month.
description.zh: Agency 为 599 美元/月，年付折算 479 美元/月。包含每月 1,000 个提示词、50 个注册网站、4 个引擎、120,000 个回答、不限席位、每月 100,000 美元投放上限、API 和白标报告。每增加 100 个提示词收费 39 美元。

summary.en: Agency: $599 USD/month; $479 USD/month equivalent billed yearly; 1,000 prompts and 120,000 answers/month; +100 prompts cost $39 USD/month.
summary.zh: Agency 599 美元/月，年付折算 479 美元/月；每月 1,000 个提示词、120,000 个回答；每加 100 个提示词收费 39 美元/月。

description.en: Enterprise is listed from $5,000+ USD/month in publisher spend, with a scoped program rather than a simple platform-only fee. A seven-day trial and free publisher access do not create a permanent free brand-monitoring tier.
description.zh: Enterprise 标示每月 5,000 美元起的发布方支出，并采用定制项目范围，而非单纯的平台费。七天试用和发布方免费使用不构成长期的免费品牌监测套餐。

summary.en: Enterprise starts at $5,000+ USD/month publisher spend; trials are not a permanent free tier.
summary.zh: Enterprise 发布方支出为每月 5,000 美元起；试用不等于长期免费套餐。

description.en: Pro and Agency cover four engines. Claude, Grok, DeepSeek and Meta AI are listed for Enterprise, so lower plans should not be assumed to cover all eight engines.
description.zh: Pro 和 Agency 覆盖四个引擎；Claude、Grok、DeepSeek 和 Meta AI 列在 Enterprise 下，因此不能假定较低套餐覆盖全部八个引擎。

summary.en: Pro and Agency include four engines; the full eight-engine set is Enterprise-scoped.
summary.zh: Pro 和 Agency 含四个引擎；完整八引擎范围属于 Enterprise。

description.en: Publisher placement spend is separate from the platform subscription. Pro renews monthly, while Agency and Enterprise default to 12-month terms unless separately agreed.
description.zh: 发布方投放支出与平台订阅费分开。Pro 按月续订；Agency 和 Enterprise 除非另有约定，默认采用十二个月期限。

summary.en: Placement spend is separate; Agency and Enterprise default to 12-month terms.
summary.zh: 投放支出另计；Agency 和 Enterprise 默认十二个月期限。

description.en: Selected for its independently priced brand-side tracker, prompt-level competitor gaps and source classification, rather than for publisher marketplace access.
description.zh: 因其独立定价的品牌侧跟踪工具、提示词级竞品缺口和来源分类而入选，并非依据发布方市场准入。

summary.en: Independent brand-side tracker with prompt-level competitor and source evidence.
summary.zh: 独立品牌侧跟踪工具，提供提示词级竞品与来源证据。

description.en: Compare every brand named in AI answers, including untracked competitors, and inspect the sources feeding those answers.
description.zh: 比较 AI 回答中出现的所有品牌，包括未跟踪的竞品，并检查这些回答所引用的来源。

en: Competitors
Share of voice
Citation analysis
zh: 竞品对比
声量份额
引用分析

en: Rank brands named for each prompt by mention count, mention rate, average position and platform.
Find answers where a competitor appears and the tracked brand is absent.
Classify cited sources as owned, named-competitor or earned coverage and show source details.
zh: 按提及次数、提及率、平均位置和平台，对每个提示词中出现的品牌排序。
查找出现竞品但未出现所跟踪品牌的回答。
将引用来源分类为自有、指定竞品或第三方报道，并展示来源详情。

audience.en: Brand and agency teams monitoring competitive visibility and the sources behind AI recommendations.
audience.zh: 监测竞品曝光及 AI 推荐背后来源的品牌和代理团队。

description.en: Identify untracked brands that AI names alongside the tracked brand, then compare mention rate and average position for each prompt.
description.zh: 识别 AI 在提及所跟踪品牌时同时列出的未跟踪品牌，再逐提示词比较提及率和平均位置。

summary.en: Discover untracked competitors in prompt-level brand rankings.
summary.zh: 在提示词级品牌排名中发现未跟踪竞品。

description.en: Filter competitor-only answers and inspect all feeding sources, including owned, competitor and earned domains.
description.zh: 筛选仅出现竞品的回答，并检查所有引用来源，包括自有、竞品和第三方报道域名。

summary.en: Trace competitor-only answers to owned, competitor and earned sources.
summary.zh: 将仅出现竞品的回答追溯到自有、竞品和第三方报道来源。

description.en: Standard monthly prices are Starter $79 USD/month, Growth $299 USD/month and Agency $499 USD/month. Starter includes 100 prompts and 100 prompt runs/day, 1 brand, 5 competitors, ChatGPT and Gemini; Growth includes 400 prompts and runs/day, 3 brands, 10 competitors per brand and four engines; Agency includes 800 prompts and runs/day, 10 brands and 10 competitors per brand.
description.zh: 标准月价为 Starter 79 美元/月、Growth 299 美元/月、Agency 499 美元/月。Starter 含每月 100 个提示词、每日 100 次运行、1 个品牌、5 个竞品、ChatGPT 和 Gemini；Growth 含 400 个提示词及每日 400 次运行、3 个品牌、每品牌 10 个竞品和四个引擎；Agency 含 800 个提示词及每日 800 次运行、10 个品牌和每品牌 10 个竞品。

summary.en: Monthly: Starter $79 USD for 100 saved prompts and 100 runs/day; Growth $299 USD for 400/400; Agency $499 USD for 800/800.
summary.zh: 月付：Starter 79 美元含 100 个保存提示词、每日 100 次运行；Growth 299 美元为 400/400；Agency 499 美元为 800/800。

description.en: Standard annual prices are Starter $790 USD/year, Growth $2,990 USD/year and Agency $4,990 USD/year. A temporary offer ending December 1 gives 40% off the first annual year of Starter or Growth: $474 USD and $1,794 USD respectively, renewing at the standard annual prices.
description.zh: 标准年价为 Starter 790 美元/年、Growth 2,990 美元/年、Agency 4,990 美元/年。截至 12 月 1 日的临时优惠为 Starter 或 Growth 首年七折，分别为 474 美元和 1,794 美元，之后按标准年价续订。

summary.en: Annual: $790/$2,990/$4,990 USD; temporary first-year Starter/Growth offers are $474/$1,794 USD.
summary.zh: 年付：790/2,990/4,990 美元；Starter/Growth 临时首年为 474/1,794 美元。

description.en: The first Starter month can be $19 USD with code TRY19, then renews at $79 USD/month. Add-ons are $49 USD/month for 50 extra daily prompt runs and $99 USD/month for 500 extra agent credits. These offers and add-ons are not a permanent free tier.
description.zh: 使用代码 TRY19 时 Starter 首月为 19 美元，之后按 79 美元/月续订。加购为每日增加 50 次提示词运行收费 49 美元/月，增加 500 个 agent credits 收费 99 美元/月。这些优惠和加购不构成长期免费套餐。

summary.en: TRY19 first month: $19 USD, then $79 USD/month; +50 daily runs cost $49 USD/month and +500 credits cost $99 USD/month.
summary.zh: TRY19 首月 19 美元，续订 79 美元/月；每日加 50 次运行 49 美元/月，加 500 credits 99 美元/月。

description.en: One prompt run means one prompt on one AI platform once per day. Daily allowances are shared across selected platforms and unused runs do not roll over.
description.zh: 一次提示词运行指一个提示词在一个 AI 平台每天执行一次。每日额度在所选平台间共享，未使用次数不结转。

summary.en: Daily runs are shared across platforms and do not roll over.
summary.zh: 每日运行额度跨平台共享且不结转。

description.en: Starter covers ChatGPT and Gemini; Growth and Agency cover ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Claude. The 20-platform list belongs to Custom. Agent credits refresh monthly and are consumed separately by ranking advice and media summaries.
description.zh: Starter 覆盖 ChatGPT 和 Gemini；Growth 与 Agency 覆盖 ChatGPT、Gemini、Perplexity 和 Claude。二十平台列表属于 Custom。Agent credits 每月刷新，排名建议和媒体摘要另行消耗。

summary.en: Starter has two engines, Growth/Agency four, and Custom 20; agent credits are separate.
summary.zh: Starter 两个引擎、Growth/Agency 四个、Custom 二十个；agent credits 另计。

description.en: Selected because its rankings include brands the user has not added, and its source labels separate owned, competitor and earned coverage.
description.zh: 因其排名包含用户尚未添加的品牌，且来源标签区分自有、竞品和第三方报道而入选。

summary.en: Includes untracked named brands and classified citation sources.
summary.zh: 包含未跟踪的被提及品牌及分类后的引用来源。

description.en: Track AI-search competitors, share of voice and citation-source gaps, with prompt-level answers behind each comparison.
description.zh: 跟踪 AI 搜索竞品、声量份额和引用来源缺口，并为每项比较保留提示词级回答。

en: Competitors
Share of voice
Source gaps
zh: 竞品对比
声量份额
来源缺口

en: Find recurring competitors from tracked prompts and compare visibility, share of voice, average position and trends.
Inspect competitor wins, shared appearances and prompts where the tracked brand is absent.
Separate own-brand sources, shared sources and competitor-only sources.
zh: 从跟踪提示词中发现反复出现的竞品，比较曝光、声量份额、平均位置和趋势。
查看竞品胜出的问题、共同出现的情况以及未出现所跟踪品牌的提示词。
区分自有品牌来源、共享来源和仅竞品使用的来源。

audience.en: Marketing teams and agencies comparing AI-search visibility and investigating competitor citation gaps.
audience.zh: 比较 AI 搜索曝光并调查竞品引用缺口的营销团队和代理机构。

description.en: Review prompts where a competitor appears without the tracked brand, then compare the source domains supporting each answer.
description.zh: 复查出现竞品但未出现所跟踪品牌的提示词，再比较支持各回答的来源域名。

summary.en: Investigate competitor-only prompts and their source domains.
summary.zh: 调查仅出现竞品的提示词及其来源域名。

description.en: Track share of voice and average position over recurring scans to see which brands gain or lose presence for the same prompt set.
description.zh: 通过重复扫描跟踪声量份额和平均位置，观察各品牌在同一提示词集合中的出现变化。

summary.en: Compare share-of-voice and position trends across recurring scans.
summary.zh: 跨重复扫描比较声量份额与位置趋势。

description.en: The visible yearly-billing view lists Starter at $20/month equivalent, with a regular comparison price of $24/month, Growth at $40/month equivalent, with a regular comparison price of $48/month, and Premium at $100/month equivalent, with a regular comparison price of $120/month. These amounts are billed yearly. The page displays only the $ symbol and does not identify an ISO currency code.
description.zh: 当前可见的年付视图为 Starter 显示 $20/月，常规对比价 $24/月；Growth 显示 $40/月，常规对比价 $48/月；Premium 显示 $100/月，常规对比价 $120/月。这些金额按年计费。页面只显示 $ 符号，未标明 ISO 币种代码，因此保留原符号。

summary.en: Yearly view: $20/$40/$100 per month equivalent, billed yearly; regular comparison prices $24/$48/$120; ISO currency is unstated.
summary.zh: 年付视图：折算 $20/$40/$100 每月，按年计费；常规对比价 $24/$48/$120；未注明 ISO 币种。

description.en: Starter includes 10 prompts, 5 competitors and checks every 3 days. Growth includes 30 prompts, 15 competitors and checks every 2 days. Premium includes 60 prompts, 30 competitors and daily checks. Each plan includes 1 website. A 14-day trial is available without a credit card.
description.zh: Starter 含 10 个提示词、5 个竞品，每 3 天检查；Growth 含 30 个提示词、15 个竞品，每 2 天检查；Premium 含 60 个提示词、30 个竞品，每日检查。每个套餐含 1 个网站，并提供无需信用卡的 14 天试用。

summary.en: Yearly plans: 10/30/60 prompts, 5/15/30 competitors, every 3 days/every 2 days/daily; 1 website; 14-day trial.
summary.zh: 年付套餐：10/30/60 个提示词、5/15/30 个竞品，分别每 3 天、每 2 天、每日；含 1 个网站；14 天试用。

description.en: Each account currently tracks one website. Competitors are selected from businesses actually observed in answers, and a business that has never appeared cannot be added manually.
description.zh: 每个账号目前跟踪一个网站。竞品从回答中实际观察到的企业中选择，从未出现过的企业无法手动添加。

summary.en: One website per account; competitors must first appear in observed answers.
summary.zh: 每账号一个网站；竞品须先在观察到的答案中出现。

description.en: AI answers are variable snapshots. The terms do not guarantee accuracy, completeness or timeliness, and prohibit adding a website solely to monitor a competitor or a site without tracking rights.
description.zh: AI 回答属于可变的时间点快照。条款不保证准确性、完整性或时效性，并禁止仅为监测竞品或对无权跟踪的网站添加监测。

summary.en: AI results are variable and not guaranteed; tracking requires appropriate rights.
summary.zh: AI 结果可变且不作保证；跟踪须具备相应权限。

description.en: Selected for its dedicated competitor-analysis product, source-gap views and published per-account plans.
description.zh: 因其独立的竞品分析产品、来源缺口视图和公开的按账号套餐而入选。

summary.en: Dedicated competitor analysis with source-gap views and public plan limits.
summary.zh: 独立竞品分析，提供来源缺口视图和公开套餐限额。

description.en: Track brand mentions, citations and competitor evidence in saved AI answers, with a permanent free tier and credit-based paid plans.
description.zh: 在保存的 AI 回答中跟踪品牌提及、引用和竞品证据，提供长期免费套餐和按 credits 计费的付费方案。

en: Competitors
Citation analysis
Share of voice
zh: 竞品对比
引用分析
声量份额

en: Save answers and record whether the brand is named, its site is cited, sources are linked and recommendations are explicit.
Use Primey to inspect saved answers and identify where competitors are cited.
Feed citation gaps into content planning and compare results only with aligned questions, tools and markets.
zh: 保存回答，记录品牌是否被提及、网站是否被引用、是否链接来源以及是否明确推荐。
使用 Primey 检查已保存回答，识别竞品被引用的位置。
将引用缺口用于内容规划，并仅在问题、工具和市场等方法一致时比较结果。

audience.en: In-house marketers and agencies that need answer-level citation evidence and a low-volume free option.
audience.zh: 需要回答级引用证据和低用量免费选项的内部营销团队与代理机构。

description.en: Inspect saved answers to see where a competitor is cited while the tracked brand is not, then carry the evidence into content planning.
description.zh: 检查已保存回答，查看竞品在何处被引用而所跟踪品牌未被引用，再将证据用于内容规划。

summary.en: Trace competitor citation gaps into content planning.
summary.zh: 将竞品引用缺口追溯到内容规划。

description.en: Run a small recurring question set on Flash to establish a low-volume baseline before choosing a larger paid credit allowance.
description.zh: 在 Flash 上运行小型重复问题集，建立低用量基线，再选择更大的付费 credits 额度。

summary.en: Use Flash for a low-volume recurring baseline.
summary.zh: 使用 Flash 建立低用量重复监测基线。

description.en: Flash is free with 30 shared monthly credits, one check per calendar month, up to 5 questions, 3 tools, up to 15 saved answers and 1 brand. No card is required.
description.zh: Flash 免费，含每月 30 个共享 credits、每个自然月一次检查、最多 5 个问题、3 个工具、最多保存 15 个回答和 1 个品牌，无需信用卡。

summary.en: Flash: free; 30 shared credits/month; 1 check/month; up to 5 questions and 15 saved answers.
summary.zh: Flash 免费；每月 30 个共享 credits；每月 1 次检查；最多 5 个问题、15 个保存回答。

description.en: Paid plans are Starter $69/month with 200 credits, Growth $179/month with 600 credits, Agency $369/month with 1,300 credits and Enterprise $1,499/month with 5,200 credits. Maximum saved buyer questions per check are 25, 50, 120 and 500 respectively; workspace and seat limits also increase by tier.
description.zh: 付费方案为 Starter 69 美元/月含 200 credits、Growth 179 美元/月含 600 credits、Agency 369 美元/月含 1,300 credits、Enterprise 1,499 美元/月含 5,200 credits。每检查最多保存的买家问题依次为 25、50、120、500 个，工作区和席位上限也随级别增加。

summary.en: Paid: $69/$179/$369/$1,499 USD per month for 200/600/1,300/5,200 monthly credits.

description.en: Paid plans can buy one-time credit packs: 200 credits for $59 USD, 1,000 for $299 USD or 4,000 for $1,149 USD. Per-question costs are ChatGPT 1 credit, Perplexity 2, Claude 3, Gemini 2 and the AI Overview-style preview 2.
description.zh: 付费方案可购买一次性 credits 包：200 个 59 美元、1,000 个 299 美元、4,000 个 1,149 美元。每问题消耗为 ChatGPT 1 credit、Perplexity 2、Claude 3、Gemini 2、AI Overview 风格预览 2。

summary.en: One-time packs: 200/1,000/4,000 credits for $59/$299/$1,149 USD; engine costs vary from 1 to 3 credits/question.
summary.zh: 一次性包：200/1,000/4,000 credits 分别 59/299/1,149 美元；每问题消耗 1–3 credits。

description.en: The AI Overview-style preview uses Google-grounded answers; it is not real-time collection from the Google AI Overview panel. It is therefore not listed as a directly supported Google AI Overviews platform.
description.zh: AI Overview 风格预览使用 Google 依据的回答，并非实时采集 Google AI Overview 面板，因此不列为直接支持的 Google AI Overviews 平台。

summary.en: The Google-grounded preview is not direct Google AI Overviews collection.
summary.zh: Google 依据预览不等于直接采集 Google AI Overviews。

description.en: Credits are shared across checks and tools. Starter's 200 monthly credits do not cover 25 questions across all five tools at the published per-question costs, so question count is not the same as credit capacity.
description.zh: Credits 在检查和工具间共享。按公布的每问题消耗，Starter 的每月 200 credits 不足以覆盖全部五个工具上的 25 个问题，因此问题数量不等于 credits 容量。

summary.en: Shared credits constrain multi-tool checks; Starter cannot run 25 questions across all five tools within 200 credits.
summary.zh: 共享 credits 限制多工具检查；Starter 的 200 credits 不足以在五个工具上运行 25 个问题。

description.en: Selected for its permanent free Flash tier and answer-level competitor and citation evidence, with the Google-grounded preview kept distinct from direct platform collection.
description.zh: 因其长期免费的 Flash 套餐及回答级竞品和引用证据而入选，并将 Google 依据预览与直接平台采集明确区分。

summary.en: Permanent free tier plus answer-level competitor and citation evidence.
summary.zh: 长期免费套餐，并提供回答级竞品与引用证据。

Prime AI Visibility 服务条款
Prime AI Visibility 隐私政策

label.zh: Prime AI Visibility 公司与联系方式

description.en: Measure brand and competitor appearances for a defined set of buyer questions across ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Mode, with source evidence and a published share-of-voice method.
description.zh: 针对一组明确的买家问题，测量品牌和竞品在 ChatGPT、Gemini 与 Google AI Mode 中的出现情况，并提供来源证据和公开的声量份额计算方法。

en: Competitors
Share of voice
Source analysis
zh: 竞品对比
声量份额
来源分析

en: Record brand, competitor, platform and visible source evidence for each buyer question.
Calculate share of voice from observed brand appearances, counting each brand once per eligible answer.
Distinguish owned pages, competitor pages and third-party sources, and compare recurring scans.
zh: 为每个买家问题记录品牌、竞品、平台和可见来源证据。
根据观察到的品牌出现计算声量份额，每个符合条件回答中的每个品牌只计一次。
区分自有页面、竞品页面和第三方来源，并比较重复扫描结果。

audience.en: Founder-led brands and marketing teams that want a documented sampling method for AI-search competitor comparisons.
audience.zh: 希望为 AI 搜索竞品比较采用有文档说明的抽样方法的创始人主导品牌和营销团队。

description.en: Compare the tracked brand with observed competitors on the same buyer questions and inspect which owned, competitor or third-party sources appear around each answer.
description.zh: 在同一组买家问题上比较所跟踪品牌与观察到的竞品，并检查每个回答周围出现的自有、竞品或第三方来源。

summary.en: Compare brands and sources on the same buyer-question set.
summary.zh: 在同一组买家问题上比较品牌和来源。

description.en: Review share-of-voice changes across recurring scans while keeping the question set, platforms and counting rules consistent.
description.zh: 在保持问题集合、平台和计数规则一致的情况下，复查重复扫描间的声量份额变化。

summary.en: Review share-of-voice changes across consistent recurring scans.
summary.zh: 在一致的重复扫描中复查声量份额变化。

description.en: Monthly plans are billed per website: Launch $39 USD/month for 10 pages/month and up to 25 buyer questions; Growth $99 USD/month for 30 pages/month and up to 50 questions; Scale $189 USD/month for 60 pages/month and up to 100 questions. Page allowances reset monthly and do not roll over.
description.zh: 月付方案按网站计费：Launch 39 美元/月，含每月 10 个页面、最多 25 个买家问题；Growth 99 美元/月，含 30 个页面、最多 50 个问题；Scale 189 美元/月，含 60 个页面、最多 100 个问题。页面额度每月重置且不结转。

summary.en: Per website/month: Launch $39 USD for 10 pages/25 questions; Growth $99 for 30/50; Scale $189 for 60/100.
summary.zh: 每网站每月：Launch 39 美元含 10 页/25 问；Growth 99 美元含 30/50；Scale 189 美元含 60/100。

description.en: Annual billing is paid for a full year and is presented as two months free. The retrieved pricing state did not show exact annual totals, so none are recorded here. A one-time AI Visibility preview of up to 5 questions may be available after verified-email signup and Business Profile approval; it is not a recurring free allowance.
description.zh: 年付按全年支付，页面标示免费两个月。本次获取的定价状态未显示确切年度总额，因此不记录该数额。完成邮箱验证和 Business Profile 审核后，可能获得最多 5 个问题的一次性 AI Visibility 预览；它不是重复发放的免费额度。

summary.en: Annual billing is presented as 2 months free; exact annual totals are unrecorded. The free preview is one-time, not recurring.
summary.zh: 年付标示免费两个月；未记录确切年度总额。免费预览为一次性，不是经常性额度。

description.en: Measurements cover a defined sample of buyer questions, not private conversations or all possible queries. AI answers vary, and visibility is not an impression count or permanent ranking.
description.zh: 测量覆盖一组明确的买家问题样本，而非私密对话或所有可能的查询。AI 回答会变化，曝光度不是展示量或永久排名。

summary.en: A sampled question set is not total AI impressions or a permanent ranking.
summary.zh: 抽样问题集不等于全部 AI 展示量或永久排名。

description.en: Subscriptions cover one website each; additional websites need separate subscriptions. Cancellation stops the next renewal, and annual access continues through the paid term.
description.zh: 每个订阅仅覆盖一个网站，增加网站需要单独订阅。取消会停止下次续订，年付访问权持续至已付费期限结束。

summary.en: One website per subscription; annual access runs through the paid term after cancellation.
summary.zh: 每个订阅一个网站；取消后年付访问权持续至付费期结束。

description.en: Selected for its public share-of-voice methodology, per-website pricing and explicit separation of owned, competitor and third-party sources.
description.zh: 因其公开的声量份额方法、按网站定价，以及明确区分自有、竞品和第三方来源而入选。

summary.en: Documented share-of-voice method with per-website plans and source classification.
summary.zh: 有声量份额方法文档，按网站定价并区分来源类型。

label.zh: Rankvia AI 曝光测量方法

description.en: Self-hosted open-source AI visibility tracker with competitor comparisons, share of voice and answer-level citation evidence.
description.zh: 自托管开源 AI 曝光跟踪工具，提供竞品对比、声量份额和回答级引用证据。

en: Open source
Competitors
Citation analysis
zh: 开源
竞品对比
引用分析

en: Run scheduled AI visibility audits and compare visibility, share of voice, competitors and cited sources.
Generate buyer questions from the site, market and competitors and retain the answers behind each result.
Provide a public API and MCP server for self-hosted workflows.
zh: 执行定时 AI 曝光审计，比较曝光、声量份额、竞品和引用来源。
根据网站、市场和竞品生成买家问题，并保留每项结果背后的回答。
为自托管工作流提供公开 API 和 MCP 服务器。

audience.en: Developers and technical marketing teams that can deploy Docker and manage their own model-provider credentials.
audience.zh: 能够部署 Docker 并自行管理模型供应商凭据的开发人员和技术营销团队。

description.en: Compare the tracked brand with configured competitors side by side and inspect the saved answers and cited sources behind each audit result.
description.zh: 并排比较所跟踪品牌与配置的竞品，并检查每项审计结果背后的已保存回答和引用来源。

summary.en: Compare configured competitors with saved answer and citation evidence.
summary.zh: 比较配置的竞品，并保留回答与引用证据。

description.en: Schedule recurring audits and use the API or MCP server to bring competitor and citation results into a self-hosted reporting workflow.
description.zh: 安排重复审计，并通过 API 或 MCP 服务器将竞品和引用结果接入自托管报表流程。

summary.en: Schedule audits and integrate results through API or MCP.
summary.zh: 安排审计并通过 API 或 MCP 接入结果。

description.en: The self-hosted software is licensed under AGPL-3.0 and has no software fee. Users pay their chosen AI model and data providers. CiteLadder Cloud is a separate commercial hosted product and its subscription prices are not applied to this self-hosted record.
description.zh: 自托管软件采用 AGPL-3.0 许可，不收取软件费。用户需支付所选 AI 模型和数据供应商费用。CiteLadder Cloud 是单独的商业托管产品，其订阅价格不适用于本条自托管记录。

summary.en: Self-hosted software: no fee under AGPL-3.0; model/data provider costs apply. Cloud plans are separate.
summary.zh: 自托管软件：AGPL-3.0 下无软件费；模型/数据供应商费用另计。Cloud 方案单独计价。

description.en: The documented Docker deployment uses Compose v2, binds to 127.0.0.1 and requires an authenticating reverse proxy before exposure. The alternative source installation requires Node.js 26+, pnpm 12 and PostgreSQL 16. Users supply their own model keys.
description.zh: 文档中的 Docker 部署使用 Compose v2，绑定 127.0.0.1，对外暴露前需要带身份验证的反向代理。另一种源码安装需要 Node.js 26+、pnpm 12 和 PostgreSQL 16。用户需自行提供模型密钥。

summary.en: Self-hosting requires Docker/Compose or Node.js 26+/pnpm 12/PostgreSQL 16, an auth proxy if exposed, and model keys.
summary.zh: 自托管需 Docker/Compose 或 Node.js 26+/pnpm 12/PostgreSQL 16，对外需认证代理，并提供模型密钥。

description.en: This record covers the self-hosted AGPL product. Cloud terms and privacy identify the hosted operator but do not govern data kept on a user's own infrastructure; cloud-only plan features are not assumed to exist in self-hosted deployments.
description.zh: 本条仅覆盖自托管 AGPL 产品。Cloud 条款和隐私政策用于确认托管运营方，不管辖用户自有基础设施上的数据；不假定 Cloud 专属套餐功能存在于自托管部署。

summary.en: Self-hosted scope only; cloud terms do not govern local data and cloud-only features are not assumed.
summary.zh: 仅限自托管范围；Cloud 条款不管辖本地数据，也不假定具备 Cloud 专属功能。

description.en: Selected specifically as the self-hosted AGPL-3.0 product. The separate CiteLadder Cloud service is outside this record's product and pricing scope.
description.zh: 本条明确选择自托管 AGPL-3.0 产品；单独的 CiteLadder Cloud 服务不在本记录的产品和定价范围内。

summary.en: Self-hosted AGPL product only; the hosted cloud service is out of scope.
summary.zh: 仅收录自托管 AGPL 产品；托管 Cloud 服务不在范围内。

label.zh: CiteLadder README 与自托管文档
CiteLadder 最新官方版本元数据

label.en: CiteLadder Cloud terms and operator identity
label.zh: CiteLadder Cloud 条款与运营方

description.en: Benchmark a brand against named competitors in AI answers using identical prompt sets, fixed competitor lists, and per-engine share-of-voice reports.
description.zh: 使用相同提示词集、固定竞品名单和分引擎声量份额报告，比较品牌与指定竞品在 AI 回答中的表现。

en: Competitors
Share of voice
Citation analysis
zh: 竞品对比
声量份额
引用分析

en: Run the same structured prompts for the brand and named competitors, then compare recommendation frequency, position, and cited sources.
Calculate share of voice against a fixed competitor list separately for each AI engine and market.
Show low-share-of-voice prompts, the competitors named in those answers, competitor-exclusive citations, sentiment, and narrative framing.
Compare brand claims with a governed truth set and export visibility reports to PDF or PPT, with scheduled email delivery.
zh: 为品牌和指定竞品运行相同的结构化提示词，比较推荐频率、位置和引用来源。
按固定竞品名单，分别计算每个 AI 引擎和市场的声量份额。
展示声量份额最低的提示词、回答中出现的竞品、仅竞品引用的来源、情绪和叙事框架。
将品牌表述与受控事实集比对，并将曝光报告导出为 PDF 或 PPT，支持定时邮件发送。

audience.en: Enterprise brand, GEO, and marketing analytics teams that need repeatable named-competitor benchmarks and answer-level evidence.
audience.zh: 需要可重复的指定竞品基准和回答级证据的企业品牌、GEO 与营销分析团队。

description.en: Benchmark the brand and named alternatives on an identical prompt set, comparing how often each is recommended, its position, and the sources cited for it.
description.zh: 在相同提示词集上比较品牌与指定替代方案，对比各自推荐频率、位置和引用来源。

summary.en: Compare named alternatives on identical prompts, recommendation frequency, position, and cited sources.
summary.zh: 在相同提示词上比较指定替代方案的推荐频率、位置和引用来源。

description.en: Keep prompts, competitors, engines, markets, and metric definitions fixed between reporting periods, then inspect the prompts where the brand has the lowest share of voice and the sources competitors use.
description.zh: 在报告周期之间保持提示词、竞品、引擎、市场和指标定义不变，再检查品牌声量份额最低的提示词及竞品使用的来源。

summary.en: Track stable per-engine and per-market share of voice and inspect competitor-winning prompts and sources.
summary.zh: 跟踪稳定的分引擎、分市场声量份额，并检查竞品胜出的提示词和来源。

description.en: Review sentiment, narrative framing, and brand accuracy alongside visibility, opening the supporting answers and citations rather than relying on a single aggregate score.
description.zh: 结合曝光度复查情绪、叙事框架和品牌表述准确性，并打开支持结论的回答和引用，而非只看单一汇总分数。

summary.en: Review sentiment, narrative framing, and accuracy with supporting answers and citations.
summary.zh: 结合支持回答和引用复查情绪、叙事框架和表述准确性。

description.en: Prepare leadership reporting from the Visibility dashboard using PDF or PPT exports and scheduled report emails while retaining the same measurement definitions between periods.
description.zh: 使用曝光看板的 PDF 或 PPT 导出及定时报告邮件准备管理层报告，同时在各周期保持相同测量定义。

summary.en: Export PDF/PPT reports and email saved reports on a schedule using stable metrics.
summary.zh: 使用稳定指标导出 PDF/PPT，并定时邮件发送已保存报告。

description.en: Starter is shown at €90/month equivalent, billed yearly, for one brand and market line: ChatGPT only, 50 prompts tracked daily, and 1 seat. The page advertises two months saved on annual billing but does not separately display the actual annual checkout total. Taxes are additional.
description.zh: Starter 显示为年付折算 90 欧元/月，按一个品牌、一个市场计费：仅 ChatGPT、每日跟踪 50 个提示词、1 个席位。页面标示年付省两个月，但未单独显示实际年度结算总额；税费另计。

summary.en: Starter: €90/month equivalent billed yearly; 1 brand/market line; ChatGPT only; 50 prompts/day; 1 seat; actual annual total not separately shown; taxes extra.
summary.zh: Starter 年付折算 90 欧元/月；1 个品牌/市场计费行；仅 ChatGPT；每日 50 个提示词；1 席位；未单列实际年账单；税费另计。

description.en: Growth is €390/month equivalent, billed yearly, with 6 selectable models from the advertised 14+, 150 prompts tracked daily, 2 seats, and 3 optimisation-agent runs per month. Enterprise is €1,300/month equivalent, billed yearly, with 6 selectable models, 500 prompts daily, unlimited seats, and multi-country/brand views. Both are priced by brand, market, LLM, and prompt; a custom plan is available for all engines or larger volumes. Actual annual checkout totals are not separately displayed.
description.zh: Growth 为年付折算 390 欧元/月，可从标示的 14 多个模型中选择 6 个，每日跟踪 150 个提示词、2 个席位、每月 3 次优化 agent 运行。Enterprise 为年付折算 1,300 欧元/月，可选择 6 个模型、每日 500 个提示词、不限席位并支持多国家/品牌视图。两者按品牌、市场、LLM 和提示词计费；全引擎或更大用量可定制。页面未单独显示实际年度结算总额。

summary.en: Growth: €390/month equivalent billed yearly, 6 models, 150 prompts/day, 2 seats, 3 agent runs/month. Enterprise: €1,300/month equivalent billed yearly, 6 models, 500 prompts/day, unlimited seats; actual annual totals not separately shown.
summary.zh: Growth 年付折算 390 欧元/月，6 模型、每日 150 提示词、2 席位、每月 3 次 agent 运行；Enterprise 年付折算 1,300 欧元/月，6 模型、每日 500 提示词、不限席位；未单列实际年账单。

description.en: Meikai for Shopify is a specialised plan at $190 USD/month equivalent, billed yearly through Shopify, for 1 store representing 1 brand in 1 market, with ChatGPT and Google AI Mode and 50 prompts tracked daily. Shopify may convert to local currency. It is not a separate product entry in this record.
description.zh: Meikai for Shopify 是专门套餐，通过 Shopify 按年结算，折算 190 美元/月，覆盖 1 个店铺、1 个品牌的 1 个市场，支持 ChatGPT 和 Google AI Mode，每日跟踪 50 个提示词；Shopify 可能换算为当地货币。本记录不将其另列为独立产品。

summary.en: Shopify plan: $190 USD/month equivalent billed yearly by Shopify; 1 store/brand/market; ChatGPT + Google AI Mode; 50 prompts/day; local-currency conversion may apply.
summary.zh: Shopify 套餐通过 Shopify 年付折算 190 美元/月；1 店铺/品牌/市场；ChatGPT + Google AI Mode；每日 50 提示词；可能换算当地货币。

description.en: The public site offers a demo and recommends a paid Starter baseline or pilot; it does not define a general free-trial duration or card requirement. Fees are generally non-refundable unless the Terms or an Order Form expressly provide otherwise, VAT and other taxes are additional, and invoices are Net 30 unless the Order Form states otherwise.
description.zh: 公开网站提供演示，并建议以付费 Starter 建立基线或试点；未定义通用免费试用时长或是否需信用卡。除条款或订单表明确规定外，费用通常不退款；VAT 及其他税费另计；除非订单表另有说明，发票为 Net 30。

summary.en: Demo and paid Starter pilot are offered; no general free-trial duration/card rule is published; fees usually non-refundable unless expressly provided; taxes extra; Net 30 unless the Order Form differs.
summary.zh: 提供演示和付费 Starter 试点；未公布通用免费试用时长/信用卡规则；除明确约定外通常不退款；税费另计；除非订单表不同，否则 Net 30。

description.en: Meikai advertises 14+ engines. The visibility FAQ enumerates 14, while organization structured data lists 13 and omits DeepSeek. Starter includes ChatGPT only, Growth and Enterprise include 6 selectable engines, and the custom plan is needed for all engines. The exact plan-specific engine set should be confirmed in the Order Form.
description.zh: Meikai 宣传 14 多个引擎。曝光页面 FAQ 列出 14 个，而组织结构化数据列出 13 个且遗漏 DeepSeek。Starter 仅含 ChatGPT，Growth 和 Enterprise 可选 6 个引擎，全引擎需定制套餐；具体引擎范围应在订单表中确认。

summary.en: Engine counts conflict: FAQ lists 14, structured data 13. Starter has ChatGPT; Growth/Enterprise 6; all engines require custom scope.
summary.zh: 引擎数量不一致：FAQ 为 14、结构化数据为 13；Starter 仅 ChatGPT，Growth/Enterprise 为 6 个，全引擎需定制。

description.en: The visible Starter grid lists Site Scanner, Trend Explorer, Product Tracker, optimisation agents, Recommendation Agent, and a customer success manager, but the pricing FAQ says teams needing Site Scanner, Trend Explorer, Product Tracker, or optimisation agents should start with Growth. Starter entitlements therefore require written confirmation.
description.zh: 可见的 Starter 网格列有 Site Scanner、Trend Explorer、Product Tracker、优化 agent、Recommendation Agent 和客户成功经理，但定价 FAQ 表示需要 Site Scanner、Trend Explorer、Product Tracker 或优化 agent 的团队应从 Growth 开始。因此 Starter 权益需书面确认。

summary.en: Starter feature grid and FAQ conflict on scanners, explorers, trackers, and optimisation agents; confirm entitlements in writing.
summary.zh: Starter 功能网格与 FAQ 在扫描器、探索器、跟踪器和优化 agent 上冲突；需书面确认权益。

description.en: Share of voice is the brand's share of mentions among the competitors counted for a fixed prompt set. Changing the competitor list, prompts, engine, or market changes the denominator and can make trend comparisons misleading. AI answers are probabilistic, and the example audit's 40 prompts repeated five times is an example rather than a universal plan quota.
description.zh: 声量份额是品牌在固定提示词集上所计入竞品的提及中所占份额。更改竞品名单、提示词、引擎或市场会改变分母，可能使趋势比较失真。AI 回答具有概率性；示例审计中的 40 个提示词各运行五次只是示例，并非通用套餐配额。

summary.en: Share of voice depends on the fixed competitor/prompt set; changed inputs break comparability, and the 40×5 audit is only an example.
summary.zh: 声量份额依赖固定竞品/提示词集；更改输入会破坏可比性，40×5 审计仅为示例。

description.en: Core plan prices are described per brand, market, LLM, and prompt; one brand in five markets is five pricing lines. EUR is the visible default, and although currency selectors exist, exact GBP/USD prices and monthly-billing prices were not captured. Annual values are monthly equivalents, not separately quoted annual invoice totals.
description.zh: 核心套餐价格按品牌、市场、LLM 和提示词描述；一个品牌覆盖五个市场即五条计费行。可见默认币种为欧元，虽有币种选择器，但本次未取得确切英镑/美元价格或月付价格。年付显示值为月均折算，并非单独报价的年度发票总额。

summary.en: Pricing multiplies by brand/market/LLM/prompt; exact GBP/USD and monthly totals are unverified; annual figures are monthly equivalents.
summary.zh: 价格按品牌/市场/LLM/提示词叠加；确切英镑/美元和月付总额未核实；年付数字为月均折算。

description.en: Platform personal data is primarily hosted in the EU on Google Cloud. Optional MCP results are sent to the user's chosen AI assistant and may be processed outside the EEA or UK under that provider's terms. Raw CDN logs are kept 30 days, support/sales communications up to 3 years, and GA4 data up to 14 months. Vendor trust and panel-size claims do not independently establish certification or guarantee visibility outcomes.
description.zh: 平台个人数据主要托管在欧盟的 Google Cloud。可选 MCP 结果会发送到用户选择的 AI 助手，并可能由该提供商在其条款下于 EEA 或英国以外处理。原始 CDN 日志保留 30 天，支持/销售通信最长 3 年，GA4 数据最长 14 个月。厂商信任声明和面板规模声明不能独立证明认证或保证曝光结果。

summary.en: EU hosting is primary; optional MCP data may leave the EEA/UK; logs 30 days, support 3 years, GA4 14 months; trust claims are not certification or outcome guarantees.
summary.zh: 主要托管在欧盟；可选 MCP 数据可能离开 EEA/英国；日志 30 天、支持 3 年、GA4 14 个月；信任声明不等于认证或效果保证。

description.en: The public Terms identify MEIKAI LTD, company number 16607357, in England and Wales. Some Order Forms may instead name Meikai SASU in France and apply Order Form-specific law; signed Order Forms and Standard Terms prevail to the extent of conflict. The contracting entity and governing law must therefore be checked per purchase.
description.zh: 公开条款列明运营方为英格兰和威尔士的 MEIKAI LTD，公司编号 16607357。部分订单表可能改为法国 Meikai SASU，并适用订单表特定法律；冲突时以已签署订单表及标准条款为准。因此每次采购都需核对签约主体和管辖法律。

summary.en: Public operator is MEIKAI LTD (England and Wales); some Order Forms may use Meikai SASU (France), so entity and governing law are purchase-specific.
summary.zh: 公开运营方为英格兰和威尔士的 MEIKAI LTD；部分订单表可能使用法国 Meikai SASU，签约主体和管辖法律因采购而异。

description.en: Selected for its explicit identical-prompt competitor methodology, fixed-list share of voice by engine and market, and answer/source drill-down. Acceptance does not rely on panel-size, security, or certification marketing claims; buyers should confirm engine coverage, Starter entitlements, and the contracting entity in the Order Form.
description.zh: 入选依据是明确的相同提示词竞品方法、按引擎和市场划分的固定名单声量份额，以及回答/来源下钻。入选不依赖面板规模、安全性或认证营销声明；采购方应在订单表中确认引擎范围、Starter 权益和签约主体。

summary.en: Documented identical-prompt benchmarking and per-engine/market share of voice; confirm plan conflicts and Order Form scope.
summary.zh: 相同提示词基准及分引擎/市场声量份额证据明确；需确认套餐冲突和订单表范围。

label.en: Meikai AI brand visibility and competitor methodology
label.zh: Meikai AI 品牌曝光与竞品方法

label.en: Meikai pricing, quotas, and billing FAQ
label.zh: Meikai 定价、配额与计费 FAQ
Meikai 子处理商与托管地点

description.en: Run real prompts across AI answer engines and compare brand visibility, sentiment, share of voice, position, citations, and competitor gaps.
description.zh: 在 AI 回答引擎运行真实提示词，比较品牌曝光、情绪、声量份额、位置、引用和竞品缺口。

en: Competitors
Share of voice
Prompt analytics
zh: 竞品对比
声量份额
提示词分析

en: Track prompts, mentions, answer position, visibility trends, and cited sources across ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, Google AI Overviews, Claude, and Perplexity.
Compare brands inside AI answers by visibility, sentiment, share of voice, and position.
Review prompt analytics, answer history, source and citation analysis, and competitor gaps.
Generate PDF reports from recorded prompt results rather than relying only on aggregate visibility scores.
zh: 在 ChatGPT、Google AI Mode、Google AI Overviews、Claude 和 Perplexity 上跟踪提示词、提及、回答位置、曝光趋势和引用来源。
按曝光、情绪、声量份额和位置比较 AI 回答中的品牌。
查看提示词分析、回答历史、来源与引用分析以及竞品缺口。
根据记录的提示词结果生成 PDF 报告，而非只依赖汇总曝光分数。

audience.en: Brand marketers and growth teams that need prompt-level competitor evidence and can avoid submitting sensitive or confidential data.
audience.zh: 需要提示词级竞品证据，且能够避免提交敏感或机密数据的品牌营销和增长团队。

description.en: Run buyer prompts such as product comparisons and alternatives questions, then compare the tracked brand with named competitors by visibility, sentiment, share of voice, and answer position.
description.zh: 运行产品比较和替代方案等买家提示词，再按曝光、情绪、声量份额和回答位置比较所跟踪品牌与指定竞品。

summary.en: Compare the brand with named competitors on real buyer prompts across five answer surfaces.
summary.zh: 在真实买家提示词上跨五个回答界面比较品牌与指定竞品。

description.en: Find prompts where competitors are cited or recommended and the tracked brand is absent, then inspect the recorded answers and feeding sources behind the gap.
description.zh: 查找竞品被引用或推荐而所跟踪品牌缺席的提示词，并检查缺口背后的已记录回答和引用来源。

summary.en: Find competitor-winning prompts and inspect their recorded answers and sources.
summary.zh: 查找竞品胜出的提示词并检查其记录回答和来源。

description.en: Review visibility changes by prompt and model over time, keeping model-specific answers separate rather than assuming that one engine's result represents all AI search.
description.zh: 按提示词和模型复查曝光变化，区分不同模型的回答，而非假定一个引擎的结果代表全部 AI 搜索。

summary.en: Review prompt-level and model-specific visibility trends over time.
summary.zh: 按提示词和模型复查长期曝光趋势。

description.en: Starter is $45 USD/month with 60 credits per day and 1 project. The official page's structured pricing data identifies the currency as USD.
description.zh: Starter 为 45 美元/月，每日 60 credits、1 个项目。官方页面结构化定价数据标明币种为 USD。

summary.en: Starter: $45 USD/month; 60 credits/day; 1 project.
summary.zh: Starter 45 美元/月；每日 60 credits；1 个项目。

description.en: Pro is $195 USD/month with 360 credits per day and 2 projects. Business is $495 USD/month with 960 credits per day and 5 projects. All three plan cards list ChatGPT, Google AI Mode and AI Overviews, Claude, and Perplexity.
description.zh: Pro 为 195 美元/月，每日 360 credits、2 个项目；Business 为 495 美元/月，每日 960 credits、5 个项目。三个套餐卡均列出 ChatGPT、Google AI Mode 和 AI Overviews、Claude 和 Perplexity。

summary.en: Pro: $195 USD/month, 360 credits/day, 2 projects. Business: $495 USD/month, 960 credits/day, 5 projects; both list all five model groups.
summary.zh: Pro 195 美元/月，每日 360 credits、2 项目；Business 495 美元/月，每日 960 credits、5 项目；均列全部五组模型。

description.en: The homepage advertises a free trial with no card required, but does not publish its duration or post-trial conversion rules. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled, and payments are non-refundable unless required by law. Annual pricing, credit consumption per run, overage charges, taxes, and any broader refund eligibility were not verified.
description.zh: 首页宣传无需信用卡的免费试用，但未公布试用时长或试用后转换规则。订阅除非取消否则自动续订；除法律要求外，付款不退款。年度价格、每次运行的 credit 消耗、超额费用、税费及更广泛退款资格未核实。

summary.en: Free trial: no card, duration/conversion unstated; auto-renewal; non-refundable unless law requires; annual pricing, credit cost, overages, and taxes unverified.
summary.zh: 免费试用无需信用卡，时长/转换未说明；自动续订；除法律要求外不退款；年度价格、credit 成本、超额和税费未核实。

description.en: Credits are quoted per day, but the number of credits consumed by a prompt, the number of engines or repetitions included in one run, overage behavior, and unused-credit rollover are not explained on the official pricing page. Daily quotas should not be treated as a fixed monthly prompt count.
description.zh: 官方定价页按天给出 credits，但未说明每个提示词消耗多少 credits、一次运行包含多少引擎或重复次数、超额处理方式及未用 credits 是否结转。每日配额不能视为固定每月提示词数量。

summary.en: Credit consumption, run composition, overages, and rollover are unstated; daily credits are not a fixed monthly prompt count.
summary.zh: 未说明 credit 消耗、运行组成、超额和结转；每日 credits 不等于固定每月提示词数。

description.en: Inputs may be processed by unnamed third-party AI providers, and the company states that it does not fully control provider processing. Inputs, outputs, and logs may be retained for service improvement and security without a specific retention period. The privacy policy explicitly says not to submit sensitive personal data or confidential business information.
description.zh: 输入可能由未具名的第三方 AI 提供商处理，公司表示无法完全控制提供商的处理。输入、输出和日志可能为服务改进与安全而保留，但未给出具体期限。隐私政策明确要求不要提交敏感个人数据或机密商业信息。

summary.en: Unnamed AI providers may process inputs; retention has no fixed period; do not submit sensitive personal or confidential business data.
summary.zh: 未具名 AI 提供商可能处理输入；保留期不固定；不要提交敏感个人或机密商业数据。

description.en: The Terms warn that automated outputs may be inaccurate, incomplete, or misleading and are not verified or guaranteed. They also allow suspension or termination at any time without notice for any reason. No governing-law or dispute-forum clause was identified in the official Terms reviewed.
description.zh: 条款警告自动输出可能不准确、不完整或具有误导性，且未经核验或保证。条款还允许随时在不通知的情况下以任何理由暂停或终止服务。本次审阅的官方条款中未发现管辖法律或争议解决地点条款。

summary.en: Outputs are not guaranteed; access may be terminated without notice; governing law and dispute forum are unstated.
summary.zh: 不保证输出；可在不通知情况下终止访问；未说明管辖法律和争议解决地点。

description.en: Selected for real prompt execution, prompt-level competitor rankings, share-of-voice comparison, and published daily quotas. It is suitable only for non-sensitive brand monitoring: provider transparency, retention, trial details, and termination terms are weaker than the product evidence, and the service should not be treated as a confidentiality-safe enterprise system without further contractual review.
description.zh: 入选依据是真实提示词执行、提示词级竞品排名、声量份额比较和公开每日配额。它仅适合非敏感品牌监测：提供商透明度、数据保留、试用细节和终止条款弱于产品证据；未经进一步合同审阅，不应将其视为适合机密数据的企业系统。

summary.en: Strong prompt-level competitor evidence and clear quotas, but use only for non-sensitive data pending legal and retention review.
summary.zh: 提示词级竞品证据和配额清晰，但在法律及保留审阅前仅用于非敏感数据。

label.en: AI Search Console product, pricing, and trial
label.zh: AI Search Console 产品、定价与试用
AI Search Console 隐私政策

label.en: AI Search Console Terms of Service
label.zh: AI Search Console 服务条款

description.en: A self-hosted MIT-licensed tracker that compares brand mentions, citation rate, position, and competitor share of voice across configurable AI provider APIs.
description.zh: 自托管、MIT 许可的跟踪工具，跨可配置的 AI 提供商 API 比较品牌提及、引用率、位置和竞品声量份额。

en: Open source
Competitors
Share of voice
zh: 开源
竞品对比
声量份额

en: Configure a brand and aliases, named competitors, buyer queries, providers, and model names.
Export raw_results.csv with every query-provider result, mention count, position, and snippet, plus scorecard.csv with provider citation rates.
Use a local Streamlit dashboard for visibility, average first position, provider rates, competitor counts and share of voice, historical trends, raw data, and errors.
Run from the CLI or a cron job, with a mocked smoke test for the query loop, competitor detection, error handling, and scorecard calculations.
zh: 配置品牌及别名、指定竞品、买家提示词、提供商和模型名称。
导出 raw_results.csv，包含每个提示词×提供商结果的提及次数、位置和片段；另导出含各提供商引用率的 scorecard.csv。
使用本地 Streamlit 看板查看曝光、平均首位位置、提供商比率、竞品次数与声量份额、历史趋势、原始数据和错误。
通过 CLI 或 cron 运行，并使用模拟 smoke test 检查查询循环、竞品检测、错误处理和分数计算。

audience.en: Technical SEO and GEO analysts, developers, and teams that can operate Python tooling and manage their own AI API keys and infrastructure.
audience.zh: 能够运营 Python 工具并自行管理 AI API 密钥和基础设施的技术 SEO、GEO 分析师、开发人员及团队。

description.en: Query ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Gemini provider APIs with comparison and best-of prompts, then compare the tracked brand with configured competitors by mention count, position, and snippet.
description.zh: 使用比较类和最佳选择类提示词查询 ChatGPT、Claude、Perplexity 和 Gemini 提供商 API，再按提及次数、位置和片段比较所跟踪品牌与配置竞品。

summary.en: Compare a brand with named competitors in four provider APIs using mention count, position, and snippets.
summary.zh: 在四个提供商 API 中按提及次数、位置和片段比较品牌与指定竞品。

description.en: Review provider-level citation rates and competitor share of voice, then inspect the query breakdown and raw CSV rows to see which prompts and answers produced each result.
description.zh: 查看各提供商引用率和竞品声量份额，再检查提示词明细和原始 CSV 行，了解每个结果由哪些提示词和回答产生。

summary.en: Inspect provider citation rates, competitor share of voice, and the prompt-level rows behind them.
summary.zh: 检查提供商引用率、竞品声量份额及其背后的提示词级数据。

description.en: Schedule weekly local runs to build citation-rate history, export CSV evidence, and isolate failed provider calls without sending monitoring data to a vendor-hosted dashboard.
description.zh: 安排每周本地运行以积累引用率历史、导出 CSV 证据，并隔离失败的提供商调用，无需将监测数据发送到厂商托管看板。

summary.en: Build weekly local history and export CSV evidence without a vendor-hosted dashboard.
summary.zh: 建立每周本地历史并导出 CSV 证据，无需厂商托管看板。

description.en: The software is free and open source under the MIT License. Users need at least one provider API key and pay any external API charges. The README estimates that 5 queries across 4 providers typically cost well under $0.10 on paid providers and may be free with Gemini's free tier; this is an estimate, not a quoted or guaranteed price.
description.zh: 软件依据 MIT 许可免费开源。用户至少需要一个提供商 API 密钥，并承担外部 API 费用。README 估计在付费提供商上运行 4 个提供商的 5 个提示词通常远低于 0.10 美元，使用 Gemini 免费层时可能免费；这是估算，并非报价或保证。

summary.en: MIT software is free; external API fees apply; README's 5 queries × 4 providers well under $0.10 is an estimate, not a guaranteed price.
summary.zh: MIT 软件免费；外部 API 费用另计；README 的 5 提示词×4 提供商远低于 0.10 美元仅为估算，并非保证。

description.en: There is no vendor subscription, hosted trial, or refund policy for this self-hosted repository. Running it requires Python 3.10+, the packages in requirements.txt, provider credentials, and user-managed compute and storage.
description.zh: 该自托管仓库没有厂商订阅、托管试用或退款政策。运行需要 Python 3.10+、requirements.txt 中的软件包、提供商凭据，以及用户自行管理的计算和存储。

summary.en: No vendor subscription, hosted trial, or refund policy; Python 3.10+, dependencies, API keys, compute, and storage are user-managed.
summary.zh: 无厂商订阅、托管试用或退款政策；Python 3.10+、依赖、API 密钥、计算和存储由用户管理。

description.en: The tracker calls provider APIs, not consumer AI-search panels. The README states that Google does not provide a public AI Overviews API and uses Perplexity's live browsing as the closest proxy. Groq and OpenRouter mostly run open models and are described as testing or extra data points rather than equivalent consumer AI-search products.
description.zh: 该工具调用提供商 API，而非消费者 AI 搜索面板。README 说明 Google 未提供公开 AI Overviews API，并将 Perplexity 的实时浏览视为最接近的代理。Groq 和 OpenRouter 主要运行开放模型，被定位为测试或额外数据点，而非等同于消费者 AI 搜索产品。

summary.en: Provider API results are not consumer panels; no direct AI Overviews API; Groq/OpenRouter are mainly testing data points.
summary.zh: 提供商 API 结果不等于消费者面板；无直接 AI Overviews API；Groq/OpenRouter 主要作为测试数据点。

description.en: Citation rate is defined as the percentage of queries where the brand was mentioned at all, so a mention and a linked citation are not rigorously separated. Average first-position is a percentage where lower is better. Results depend on the configured prompts, providers, models, aliases, and competitor list.
description.zh: 引用率定义为品牌至少被提及一次的提示词百分比，因此提及与链接引用未被严格区分。平均首位位置是百分比，越低越好。结果取决于配置的提示词、提供商、模型、别名和竞品名单。

summary.en: Citation rate means any brand mention, not necessarily a linked citation; position and results depend on the configured sample.
summary.zh: 引用率指任何品牌提及，不一定是链接引用；位置和结果取决于配置样本。

description.en: The repository has an MIT License and public maintenance evidence, including 12 commit-feed entries through July 9, 2026, but no published releases or tags were found at verification. Users following main bear the stability risk, and the maintainer's publication contact target is not a software SLA or support commitment.
description.zh: 仓库具有 MIT 许可和公开维护证据，包括截至 2026 年 7 月 9 日的 12 条提交记录，但核验时未发现已发布 releases 或 tags。跟随 main 的用户需自行承担稳定性风险；维护者出版业务的联系回复目标不是软件 SLA 或支持承诺。

summary.en: MIT and commit history are verified, but no releases/tags exist; main-branch stability and software support are not guaranteed.
summary.zh: MIT 和提交历史已核实，但无 releases/tags；不保证 main 分支稳定性或软件支持。

description.en: This record covers only the self-hosted repository. Data and API keys remain on user-managed infrastructure; dashboard keys are kept in memory by default unless the user chooses a local .env file. No separate hosted Indexcraft subscription was verified.
description.zh: 本记录仅覆盖自托管仓库。数据和 API 密钥保留在用户管理的基础设施上；看板密钥默认仅保存在内存中，除非用户选择本地 .env 文件。未核实到独立的 Indexcraft 托管订阅。

summary.en: Self-hosted only; data and keys are user-managed; no separate hosted subscription was verified.
summary.zh: 仅自托管；数据和密钥由用户管理；未核实独立托管订阅。

description.en: Selected for its actual MIT License, maintained public repository, configurable named-competitor comparison, transparent CSV outputs, and local dashboard. It is not a hosted service or a direct Google AI Overviews tracker. IndexCraft identifies Rohit Kunal as its founder and provides a public contact route; no incorporated legal entity is inferred from the brand name.
description.zh: 入选依据是真实 MIT 许可、持续维护的公开仓库、可配置的指定竞品比较、透明 CSV 输出和本地看板。它不是托管服务，也不是直接的 Google AI Overviews 跟踪器。IndexCraft 公布 Rohit Kunal 为创始人并提供公开联系渠道；不根据品牌名称推定其具有法人实体。

summary.en: Verified MIT self-hosted tracker with named-competitor evidence; no hosted service or direct AI Overviews coverage.
summary.zh: 已核实 MIT 自托管跟踪工具及指定竞品证据；无托管服务或直接 AI Overviews 覆盖。

label.en: Indexcraft AI Citation Tracker repository and README
label.zh: Indexcraft AI Citation Tracker 仓库与 README

label.en: Indexcraft AI Citation Tracker MIT License
label.zh: Indexcraft AI Citation Tracker MIT 许可
Indexcraft main 分支提交记录
IndexCraft 关于与创始人身份

description.en: Compare a brand with up to 50 named competitor domains in AI answers using visibility, share of voice, position, sentiment, citation share, and full-answer evidence.
description.zh: 使用曝光度、声量份额、位置、情绪、引用份额和完整回答证据，在 AI 回答中比较品牌与最多 50 个指定竞品域名。

en: Competitors
Share of voice
Citation analysis
zh: 竞品对比
声量份额
引用分析

en: Benchmark a brand against up to 50 competitor domains on visibility, share of voice, average position, sentiment, and citation share, overall or per AI model.
Track buyer prompts by topic, tag, intent, persona, and location on ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Mode, and Google AI Overviews.
Open recorded answers with the brand and competitors highlighted, named brands listed, and cited or merely listed sources visible.
Count displacement prompts where a competitor source is cited but the brand's source is not, and export prompts, answers, citations, and mentions as CSV.
zh: 按曝光度、声量份额、平均位置、情绪和引用份额，比较品牌与最多 50 个竞品域名，并支持总体及分模型视图。
按主题、标签、意图、人群和地点跟踪买家提示词，覆盖 ChatGPT、Perplexity、Gemini、Google AI Mode 和 Google AI Overviews。
打开已记录回答，高亮品牌与竞品、列出被点名品牌，并查看被引用或仅被列出的来源。
统计竞品来源被引用而品牌来源未被引用的替代提示词，并将提示词、回答、引用和提及导出为 CSV。

audience.en: SEO agencies, enterprise search teams, and brand analysts that already need rank tracking and want named-competitor AI benchmarks with answer-level evidence.
audience.zh: 已需要排名跟踪，并希望获得指定竞品 AI 基准和回答级证据的 SEO 机构、企业搜索团队与品牌分析人员。

description.en: Keep one competitor list across traditional rankings and AI search, then compare the brand with named domains on visibility, share of voice, position, sentiment, and citation share by AI model.
description.zh: 在传统排名与 AI 搜索中沿用同一竞品名单，再按 AI 模型比较品牌与指定域名的曝光度、声量份额、位置、情绪和引用份额。

summary.en: Compare up to 50 named competitor domains across five AI metrics, overall or by model.
summary.zh: 按总体或分模型，跨五项 AI 指标比较最多 50 个指定竞品域名。

description.en: Inspect prompts where competitors earn citations and the brand does not, open the recorded answer, and review whether each source belongs to the brand, a competitor, or a third party.
description.zh: 检查竞品获得引用而品牌未获得引用的提示词，打开已记录回答，并复查每个来源属于品牌、竞品还是第三方。

summary.en: Find competitor-winning citation prompts and inspect answer-level source ownership.
summary.zh: 查找竞品胜出的引用提示词，并检查回答级来源归属。

description.en: Repeat the same prompt panel by persona and location, compare changes between reporting periods, and export the underlying prompts, answers, citations, and mentions for agency or leadership reporting.
description.zh: 按人群和地点重复同一提示词面板，比较报告周期之间的变化，并导出底层提示词、回答、引用和提及，用于机构或管理层报告。

summary.en: Retest prompts by persona and location, compare period changes, and export raw evidence.
summary.zh: 按人群和地点复测提示词、比较周期变化并导出原始证据。

description.en: Pro is displayed at $139/month and includes 7,000 keyword units, unlimited projects and users, scheduled or on-demand updates, AI Visibility tracking, AI citations, and mentions. The page does not label an ISO currency code; the Terms say the currency shown at checkout or on the invoice applies, and taxes are additional.
description.zh: Pro 页面显示 139 美元/月，含 7,000 个关键词单位、不限项目和用户、计划或按需更新、AI 曝光跟踪、AI 引用和提及。页面未标明 ISO 币种代码；条款规定适用结账或发票所示币种，税费另计。

summary.en: Pro: $139/month as displayed, ISO currency unstated; 7,000 keyword units; unlimited projects/users; AI Visibility, citations, and mentions included; taxes extra.
summary.zh: Pro 显示 139 美元/月，未注明 ISO 币种；7,000 关键词单位；不限项目/用户；含 AI 曝光、引用和提及；税费另计。

description.en: Agency is displayed at $279/month with 14,500 keyword units, all Pro features, unlimited forecasts, one-hour on-demand updates, custom dashboards and reports, Looker Studio integration, and Developer API access. Enterprise is displayed at $699/month with 35,500 keyword units, all Agency features, cross-project reporting, BigQuery connector, automated CSV exports, and migration support. Annual billing advertises a 10% saving; exact annual invoice totals were not displayed.
description.zh: Agency 显示 279 美元/月，含 14,500 个关键词单位、全部 Pro 功能、不限预测、一小时按需更新、自定义看板与报告、Looker Studio 集成和开发者 API。Enterprise 显示 699 美元/月，含 35,500 个关键词单位、全部 Agency 功能、跨项目报告、BigQuery 连接器、自动 CSV 导出和迁移支持。年付标示省 10%，但未展示实际年度发票总额。

summary.en: Agency: $279/month, 14,500 units, Looker Studio and API. Enterprise: $699/month, 35,500 units, cross-project/BigQuery/CSV; annual saves 10%, invoice totals unshown.
summary.zh: Agency 279 美元/月、14,500 单位、Looker Studio 和 API；Enterprise 699 美元/月、35,500 单位、跨项目/BigQuery/CSV；年付省 10%，未显示年账单。

description.en: AI Visibility is included on every paid plan, starting with Pro, and the official product page offers a seven-day trial without a credit card. The pricing FAQ provides a 30-day money-back guarantee on all plans when the customer contacts AWR within 30 days of purchase.
description.zh: AI 曝光包含在全部付费套餐中，最低从 Pro 开始；官方产品页提供七天免费试用，无需信用卡。定价 FAQ 说明所有套餐均享 30 天退款保证，客户在购买后 30 天内联系 AWR 即可退款。

summary.en: AI Visibility is included from Pro; 7-day trial without a card; 30-day money-back guarantee on all plans.
summary.zh: AI 曝光从 Pro 起包含；7 天免卡试用；所有套餐享 30 天退款保证。

description.en: Online subscriptions are sold by 2Checkout (Verifone) as merchant of record and renew monthly or annually until canceled. Cancellation leaves the account active through the billed period. The pricing page says account access continues for 30 days after the paid period and data is deleted after 90 days; the published Terms describe a 30-day export window followed by six months of archiving, so the applicable deletion schedule should be confirmed.
description.zh: 在线订阅由 2Checkout（Verifone）作为记录商户销售，按月或按年自动续订直至取消。取消后账户仍可使用至当前已付周期结束。定价页称付费期结束后账户访问再保留 30 天、数据 90 天后删除；公开条款则描述 30 天导出窗口后归档六个月，因此应确认适用的删除安排。

summary.en: 2Checkout is merchant of record; monthly/annual auto-renewal; cancellation runs to period end; pricing says 90-day deletion but Terms say 30-day export plus 6-month archive.
summary.zh: 2Checkout 为记录商户；按月/年自动续订；取消至周期末生效；定价页称 90 天删除，条款称 30 天导出后归档 6 个月。

description.en: Each prompt consumes 2 units per AI engine when checked weekly and 14 units when checked daily. AI search draws from the same unit balance as keyword tracking; a check means one prompt on one engine from one location for one persona, so the 7,000-unit Pro allowance is not 7,000 fixed AI prompts.
description.zh: 每个提示词按周检查时，每个 AI 引擎消耗 2 个单位；按日检查时消耗 14 个单位。AI 搜索与关键词跟踪共用单位余额；一次检查指一个提示词在一个引擎、一个地点和一个人群下运行，因此 Pro 的 7,000 单位不等于 7,000 个固定 AI 提示词。

summary.en: Weekly prompt checks cost 2 units per engine; daily checks cost 14; AI and keywords share units, so Pro's 7,000 units are not 7,000 prompts.
summary.zh: 提示词按周检查每引擎耗 2 单位、按日耗 14；AI 与关键词共用单位，Pro 的 7,000 单位不等于 7,000 提示词。

description.en: The platform advertises five AI surfaces and does not list Claude or Microsoft Copilot for this tracking feature. AI Brand Intelligence is a separate discovery feature and should not be assumed to extend the AI Visibility prompt tracker's engine coverage.
description.zh: 该平台宣传五个 AI 界面，未在跟踪功能中列出 Claude 或 Microsoft Copilot。AI Brand Intelligence 是独立的发现功能，不应据此推定 AI 曝光提示词跟踪的引擎覆盖。

summary.en: AI Visibility lists five surfaces, not Claude or Copilot; separate AI Brand Intelligence coverage does not expand tracker scope.
summary.zh: AI 曝光列出五个界面，不含 Claude 或 Copilot；独立 AI Brand Intelligence 覆盖不扩展跟踪范围。

description.en: AWR states that AI responses are probabilistic and vary by location, device, language, account, and time. It does not guarantee that a capture matches what an individual user sees or can be reproduced, and it does not guarantee the accuracy or completeness of third-party data or AI output.
description.zh: AWR 说明 AI 回答具有概率性，并会因地点、设备、语言、账户和时间而变化。它不保证某次抓取与单个用户看到的一致或可复现，也不保证第三方数据或 AI 输出的准确性和完整性。

summary.en: AI captures are probabilistic, person- and context-dependent, not guaranteed reproducible, and not a census or accuracy guarantee.
summary.zh: AI 抓取具有概率性、受人和环境差异影响，不保证可复现，也不是普查或准确性保证。

description.en: For collection, AWR submits tracked prompts without identifying the customer to AI platforms through APIs or publicly available interfaces, directly or through external suppliers. Public-interface prompts are processed under the provider's own terms and may be retained or used for model training; the no-training commitment applies to API inputs, not that public-interface exception. The reviewed materials do not describe customer-account pools or proxy impersonation.
description.zh: 采集时，AWR 不将客户身份与跟踪提示词一起提交给 AI 平台，而是直接或通过外部供应商使用 API 或公开界面。公开界面提示词按提供商自身条款处理，可能被保留或用于模型训练；不训练承诺适用于 API 输入，不涵盖此公开界面例外。本次审阅资料未描述客户账户池或代理冒充。

summary.en: Collection uses APIs or public interfaces without customer identity; public-interface prompts may be retained or trained on, unlike API inputs; no account-pool/proxy impersonation is described.
summary.zh: 通过 API 或公开界面采集且不附客户身份；公开界面提示词可能被保留或训练，API 输入则不同；未描述账户池或代理冒充。

description.en: Developer API access starts with Agency according to the pricing FAQ, while Looker Studio integration is also listed on Agency. CSV export is advertised on the product page, but buyers should confirm whether specific AI fields and historical exports are included on Pro.
description.zh: 定价 FAQ 显示开发者 API 从 Agency 开始，Looker Studio 集成也列在 Agency。产品页宣传 CSV 导出，但采购方应确认 Pro 是否包含具体 AI 字段及历史导出。

summary.en: Developer API and Looker Studio start on Agency; confirm which AI fields and historical CSV exports Pro includes.
summary.zh: 开发者 API 和 Looker Studio 从 Agency 开始；需确认 Pro 包含哪些 AI 字段及历史 CSV 导出。

description.en: The operator is Caphyon S.R.L. in Romania, and the service is intended for business or professional users rather than consumers. The published Terms and Privacy Policy were last updated October 27, 2026 and state an effective date of December 1, 2026; the version governing a purchase before that date should be checked. Personal data may be processed in the EU and US, and provider outages are excluded from availability calculations.
description.zh: 运营方为罗马尼亚的 Caphyon S.R.L.，服务面向企业或专业用户而非消费者。公开条款和隐私政策最后更新于 2026 年 10 月 27 日，并注明 2026 年 12 月 1 日生效；在该日期前采购时应核对适用版本。个人数据可能在欧盟和美国处理，提供商故障不计入可用性计算。

summary.en: Caphyon S.R.L., Romania; business-only service; Oct 27 terms/privacy state Dec 1 effective date; EU/US processing; provider outages excluded from availability.
summary.zh: 运营方为罗马尼亚 Caphyon S.R.L.；仅限企业使用；10 月 27 日条款/隐私注明 12 月 1 日生效；欧盟/美国处理；提供商故障不计可用性。

description.en: Selected for explicit named-domain benchmarking up to 50 competitors, per-model share-of-voice and citation metrics, answer/source drill-down, and published usage rules. The decisive collection evidence is the Terms' API-or-public-interface model without customer identity; it does not describe the customer-account and proxy collection model that remains a core authorization concern for some trackers. Purchase review should still confirm currency, unit budget, export scope, legal version, and retention arrangements.
description.zh: 入选依据是明确支持最多 50 个竞品域名、分模型声量份额与引用指标、回答/来源下钻，以及公开用量规则。关键采集证据是条款中的 API 或公开界面模式，且不附客户身份；资料未披露部分跟踪工具仍存在的客户账户与代理采集模式。采购时仍应确认币种、单位预算、导出范围、适用法律版本和保留 schedule。

summary.en: Documented 50-competitor benchmarks and API/public-interface collection; confirm currency, units, exports, legal version, and retention.
summary.zh: 有明确的 50 竞品基准及 API/公开界面采集证据；需确认币种、单位、导出、法律版本和保留安排。

label.en: Advanced Web Ranking AI Visibility product and FAQ
label.zh: Advanced Web Ranking AI 曝光产品与 FAQ

label.en: Advanced Web Ranking pricing and billing FAQ
label.zh: Advanced Web Ranking 定价与计费 FAQ

label.en: Advanced Web Ranking Terms of Service
label.zh: Advanced Web Ranking 服务条款
Advanced Web Ranking 隐私政策

label.en: Advanced Web Ranking company and operator background
label.zh: Advanced Web Ranking 公司与运营方背景

description.en: A free browser checker that inspects a root llms.txt file, sampled link reachability, robots.txt permissions for 16 AI crawlers, and browser-versus-GPTBot access to reveal possible CDN or firewall blocking.
description.zh: 免费浏览器检查器，检查根目录 llms.txt、抽样链接可达性、16 个 AI 爬虫的 robots.txt 权限，并对比浏览器与 GPTBot 的访问结果以发现可能的 CDN 或防火墙拦截。

en: llms.txt
AI crawler access
CDN blocking
zh: llms.txt
AI 爬虫权限
CDN 拦截

en: Requires a readable Markdown file with a first-line H1 and samples up to 10 links after the format check.
Produces a 100-point file score and reports unavailable files without assigning a low score.
Reviews robots.txt rules for 16 named AI crawlers and compares browser and GPTBot responses.
zh: 要求可读 Markdown 文件以 H1 开头，并在格式检查通过后抽样检查最多 10 个链接。
给出 100 分文件评分；文件不存在或无法获取时不给出低分。
检查 16 个指定 AI 爬虫的 robots.txt 规则，并对比浏览器与 GPTBot 的响应。

audience.en: Website owners, SEO specialists, and developers who need a quick public-file and crawler-access check without creating an account.
audience.zh: 需要快速检查公开文件与爬虫访问权限、且不想注册账户的网站所有者、SEO 人员和开发者。

description.en: Check whether a root llms.txt exists as text, begins with the required H1, and contains working links before publishing or revising the file.
description.zh: 在发布或修订根目录 llms.txt 前，检查文件是否存在、是否以文本提供、是否以规定的 H1 开头，以及链接是否可用。

summary.en: Validate basic llms.txt format and sampled links.
summary.zh: 验证 llms.txt 基础格式和抽样链接。

description.en: Compare browser and GPTBot responses when robots.txt permits crawling but an edge service may still reject the bot.
description.zh: 当 robots.txt 允许抓取，但边缘服务仍可能拒绝机器人时，对比浏览器与 GPTBot 的响应。

summary.en: Spot possible bot-specific edge blocking.
summary.zh: 发现可能的机器人边缘拦截。

description.en: The checker is free without signup and allows up to 15 checks per hour. Separate full-audit subscriptions and one-time reports are not included in this checker listing.
description.zh: 检查器免费且无需注册，每小时最多检查 15 次。独立的全站审计订阅和一次性报告不属于本检查器条目。

summary.en: Free checker; up to 15 checks per hour.
summary.zh: 免费检查器；每小时最多 15 次。

description.en: Only up to 10 links are sampled. Security challenges, nonresponses, and private or local links are skipped or marked could not check and do not lower the score; the browser/GPTBot comparison is not a test of every crawler.
description.zh: 最多只抽样 10 个链接。安全验证、无响应以及私有或本地链接会被跳过或标记为无法检查，且不会降低分数；浏览器与 GPTBot 的对比也不等于测试所有爬虫。

summary.en: Limited link sampling and one bot-response comparison.
summary.zh: 链接抽样有限，只对比一种机器人响应。

description.en: The product says checked URLs are not stored, but the privacy policy says every submitted site is screened using its address, Cloudflare Family DNS, and homepage text sent to an AI provider. Refused sites retain the address, refusal reason, time, and submitting account.
description.zh: 产品页称不保存被检查 URL，但隐私政策称每个提交网站都会使用地址、Cloudflare Family DNS 和发送给 AI 提供商的首页文本进行筛查；被拒绝的网站会保留地址、拒绝原因、时间和提交账户。

summary.en: Screening and refusal records are a stated storage exception.
summary.zh: 筛查与拒绝记录属于已披露的存储例外。

description.en: Useful when a robots.txt-only review leaves doubt about edge blocking; the tradeoff is a narrow focus on the root llms.txt file, sampled links, and one browser-versus-GPTBot comparison rather than a whole-site crawl.
description.zh: 适合仅检查 robots.txt 后仍怀疑边缘拦截的场景；取舍是只聚焦根目录 llms.txt、抽样链接和一次浏览器与 GPTBot 的对比，而非整站抓取。

summary.en: Strong edge-block diagnostic with deliberately narrow crawl scope.
summary.zh: 边缘拦截诊断明确，但抓取范围有意保持狭窄。

description.en: A free no-account browser tool that checks a site's root llms.txt response, content type, H1, and common Markdown conventions, plus whether an optional root llms-full.txt is served as text.
description.zh: 免费免注册浏览器工具，检查网站根目录 llms.txt 的响应、内容类型、H1 和常见 Markdown 约定，并检查可选的根目录 llms-full.txt 是否以文本提供。

en: llms.txt
Markdown validation
Website diagnostics
zh: llms.txt
Markdown 验证
网站诊断

en: Distinguishes a missing file, an HTML fallback, a text response, and a check that could not complete.
Treats H1 as required while reporting summary, H2 sections, link-entry patterns, and Optional as improvement tips.
Checks root llms-full.txt presence without grading its contents.
zh: 区分文件不存在、HTML 回退、文本响应和无法完成检查。
将 H1 视为必需项，同时把摘要、H2 分节、链接条目模式和 Optional 作为改进提示。
检查根目录 llms-full.txt 是否存在，但不评价其内容。

audience.en: Site owners, editors, and developers who want a quick root-file format check with no registration or paid suite.
audience.zh: 希望快速检查根目录文件格式、无需注册或购买付费套件的网站所有者、编辑和开发者。

description.en: Check whether a soft 404 or application fallback is being served at /llms.txt instead of a Markdown text file, then review the required H1 and optional structure tips.
description.zh: 检查 /llms.txt 是否返回软 404 或应用回退而非 Markdown 文本，再查看必需的 H1 和可选结构提示。

summary.en: Separate missing files from HTML fallbacks.
summary.zh: 区分文件缺失与 HTML 回退。

description.en: Confirm that an optional llms-full.txt companion exists as text without treating it as a graded deliverable.
description.zh: 确认可选的 llms-full.txt 伴随文件以文本形式存在，而不将其视为需要评分的交付物。

summary.en: Check optional full-text file presence.
summary.zh: 检查可选全文文件是否存在。

description.en: The checker is listed as a free Web tool with a USD 0 offer in its official structured data. No account is required; the agency's paid services are separate.
description.zh: 检查器在官方结构化数据中列为免费 Web 工具，价格为 0 美元，无需账户；该机构的付费服务是独立业务。

summary.en: Free, no-account Web tool.
summary.zh: 免费、免注册 Web 工具。

description.en: The checker requests only HTTPS root files and discards paths, query strings, typed HTTP schemes, and custom ports. It follows up to five redirects, uses about a nine-second timeout, and displays up to 2,000 characters.
description.zh: 检查器只请求 HTTPS 根目录文件，并丢弃路径、查询字符串、输入的 HTTP 协议和自定义端口。它最多跟随 5 次重定向，超时约 9 秒，最多显示 2,000 个字符。

summary.en: Root-only, HTTPS-only checks with small display and time limits.
summary.zh: 仅检查 HTTPS 根目录，显示和时间均有限制。

description.en: It counts link-entry patterns but does not open linked pages or judge description quality. A blocked request means could not complete, not missing; passing does not prove crawling, indexing, ranking, or citation.
description.zh: 它只统计链接条目模式，不打开链接页面，也不判断描述质量。请求被阻止表示无法完成检查，而非文件缺失；通过检查也不能证明被抓取、索引、获得排名或引用。

summary.en: No link fetching, quality judgement, or AI-provider verification.
summary.zh: 不抓取链接、不判断质量，也不验证 AI 提供商行为。

description.en: The entered domain is sent to Web Aloha's server. The product says file content is not stored, while the privacy policy says ordinary infrastructure logs may record requests and URLs; hosting, analytics, and security providers also process data.
description.zh: 输入的域名会发送到 Web Aloha 服务器。产品称不保存文件内容，但隐私政策称普通基础设施日志可能记录请求和 URL；托管、分析和安全服务商也会处理数据。

summary.en: No file-content storage does not mean no request logging.
summary.zh: 不保存文件内容不等于不记录请求。

description.en: Official pages identify Web Aloha, founder Lucky Oleg, a Lithuania base, and direct contact channels, but do not publish a registered legal-entity type or number or link a separate terms page.
description.zh: 官方页面披露了 Web Aloha、创始人 Lucky Oleg、立陶宛业务地点和直接联系方式，但未公开注册法律实体类型或编号，也未链接独立条款页。

summary.en: Identifiable operator with incomplete entity disclosure.
summary.zh: 运营方可识别，但实体披露不完整。

description.en: A straightforward choice for a no-account root-file check; the tradeoff is that it intentionally does not test links, crawler-specific delivery, scoped files, or actual AI usage.
description.zh: 适合免注册的根目录文件检查；取舍是它有意不测试链接、特定爬虫的交付、路径作用域文件或 AI 的实际使用情况。

summary.en: Simple format check, not a crawler-access or citation audit.
summary.zh: 简单的格式检查，不是爬虫权限或引用审计。

description.en: A free generator that checks homepage crawler permissions, existing llms.txt, noindex signals, and sitemap content, then drafts an editable llms.txt from up to 18 pages.
description.zh: 免费生成器，检查首页爬虫权限、现有 llms.txt、noindex 信号和站点地图内容，然后根据最多 18 个页面生成可编辑的 llms.txt 草稿。

en: llms.txt generator
AI crawler access
Sitemap
zh: llms.txt 生成器
AI 爬虫权限
站点地图

en: Checks homepage robots.txt permissions for 14 AI crawlers, /llms.txt existence, and homepage noindex signals.
Reads listed sitemaps, follows one sitemap-index level, or falls back to homepage links.
Uses Jev by TypeSafe to group up to 18 same-domain pages into Product, Pricing, Docs, Company, Resources, or Legal sections.
zh: 检查 14 个 AI 爬虫的首页 robots.txt 权限、/llms.txt 是否存在，以及首页 noindex 信号。
读取 robots.txt 列出的站点地图，跟随一级站点地图索引，或回退到首页链接。
使用 TypeSafe 的 Jev 将最多 18 个同域页面归入 Product、Pricing、Docs、Company、Resources 或 Legal 分节。

audience.en: Small-site owners and developers who want a structured starting draft rather than hand-writing every llms.txt entry.
audience.zh: 希望获得结构化初始草稿、而非手工编写每条 llms.txt 条目的小型网站所有者和开发者。

description.en: Turn a sitemap or homepage link set into an editable llms.txt draft grouped by page role, then copy or download it for manual review.
description.zh: 将站点地图或首页链接集合转换为按页面角色分组的可编辑 llms.txt 草稿，再复制或下载并人工审阅。

summary.en: Draft a grouped llms.txt from real site pages.
summary.zh: 从真实网站页面生成分组 llms.txt 草稿。

description.en: Review whether a homepage is allowed for named AI crawlers and whether noindex metadata conflicts with the intended discovery setup.
description.zh: 检查指定 AI 爬虫是否允许访问首页，以及 noindex 元数据是否与预期的可发现配置冲突。

summary.en: Check homepage crawler and indexing signals.
summary.zh: 检查首页爬虫与索引信号。

description.en: The generator is free and requires no signup. Gravity's separate AI-agent platform and its weekly checking offers are not prices for this generator.
description.zh: 生成器免费且无需注册。Gravity 独立的 AI 智能体平台及其每周检查服务不是本生成器的价格。

summary.en: Free generator; agent-platform pricing excluded.
summary.zh: 免费生成器；不含智能体平台价格。

description.en: Only the homepage path is checked for crawler access, and the tool does not verify CDN or firewall behavior. Raw HTML is used without JavaScript rendering, so client-built pages may have empty or generic titles.
description.zh: 爬虫权限只检查首页路径，工具也不验证 CDN 或防火墙行为。工具读取原始 HTML，不执行 JavaScript，因此客户端构建的页面可能缺少标题或只有通用标题。

summary.en: Homepage-only permission check and no JavaScript rendering.
summary.zh: 权限仅检查首页，且不渲染 JavaScript。

description.en: The draft reads at most 18 pages and requires editorial review. Page titles and descriptions are sent to Jev for classification; Gravity says it does not save the address or results unless a weekly check is requested.
description.zh: 草稿最多读取 18 个页面，需要人工编辑审阅。页面标题和描述会发送给 Jev 分类；Gravity 称除非用户要求每周检查，否则不保存地址或结果。

summary.en: Small page cap, editorial review required, third-party classification.
summary.zh: 页面数量有限，需要人工审阅，并使用第三方分类。

description.en: Best suited to creating a first draft from a small or medium site's sitemap; the tradeoff is shallow sampling, raw-HTML extraction, and no edge-level crawler verification.
description.zh: 适合从中小型网站的站点地图创建初始草稿；取舍是页面抽样较浅、依赖原始 HTML 提取，且不验证边缘层爬虫访问。

summary.en: Drafting convenience with shallow, raw-HTML sampling.
summary.zh: 草稿生成方便，但抽样较浅且依赖原始 HTML。

description.en: A free no-account checker for root llms.txt existence, plain-text delivery, title and summary structure, grouped links, descriptions, absolute URLs, and optional llms-full.txt presence.
description.zh: 免费免注册检查器，检查根目录 llms.txt 是否存在、是否以纯文本提供、标题和摘要结构、链接分组、链接描述、绝对 URL，以及可选 llms-full.txt 是否存在。

en: llms.txt
SEO diagnostics
Structured links
zh: llms.txt
SEO 诊断
结构化链接

en: Checks file presence and plain-text delivery instead of accepting an HTML response.
Reviews title, summary, H2 grouping, link descriptions, and full URLs.
Returns a 0–100 score with a suggested fix for each point and notes optional llms-full.txt.
zh: 检查文件是否存在以及是否以纯文本提供，而非接受 HTML 响应。
检查标题、摘要、H2 分组、链接描述和完整 URL。
返回 0–100 分，并为每个扣分点给出修复建议，同时提示可选的 llms-full.txt。

audience.en: Marketers, site editors, and developers who want a scored format review with concrete repair suggestions.
audience.zh: 希望获得带具体修复建议的格式评分的营销人员、网站编辑和开发者。

description.en: Review a root llms.txt against common format conventions and turn each deducted point into a specific editing task.
description.zh: 根据常见格式约定检查根目录 llms.txt，并将每个扣分点转化为具体编辑任务。

summary.en: Score format and turn findings into repair tasks.
summary.zh: 为格式评分并转化为修复任务。

description.en: Check whether a short overview and optional full-text companion are both presented as text files rather than HTML pages.
description.zh: 检查简短概览和可选全文伴随文件是否都以文本文件而非 HTML 页面提供。

summary.en: Verify overview and optional companion delivery.
summary.zh: 验证概览与可选伴随文件的交付方式。

description.en: The llms.txt checker is free and needs no account. SEOptimate's paid platform plans are separate, and running a free scan does not create a paid subscription under the official terms.
description.zh: llms.txt 检查器免费且无需账户。SEOptimate 的付费平台套餐是独立产品；根据官方条款，运行免费扫描不会产生付费订阅。

summary.en: Free checker; paid platform plans are separate.
summary.zh: 免费检查器；付费平台套餐另计。

description.en: The score describes file format, not whether an AI engine fetched the file or cited the site. The product explicitly says a tidy file does not guarantee more AI citations.
description.zh: 分数描述文件格式，不代表 AI 引擎已获取文件或引用网站。产品明确表示，整洁的文件不保证获得更多 AI 引用。

summary.en: Format score is not a citation outcome measure.
summary.zh: 格式评分不是引用结果指标。

description.en: The privacy policy covers website URLs, website and SEO data, IP/browser/device data, and analytics or security cookies, but does not specifically state whether an anonymous checker submission is retained. Do not assume that anonymous submissions are never stored.
description.zh: 隐私政策涵盖网站 URL、网站与 SEO 数据、IP/浏览器/设备数据，以及分析或安全 Cookie，但没有具体说明匿名检查提交是否保留；不应假定匿名提交永不保存。

summary.en: Anonymous checker retention is not specifically disclosed.
summary.zh: 未具体披露匿名检查数据的保留规则。

description.en: Useful when a scored checklist and repair suggestions matter more than crawler simulation; the tradeoff is that it remains a file-format review rather than a live crawler-access test.
description.zh: 适合更看重评分清单和修复建议、而非爬虫模拟的场景；取舍是它仍是文件格式审查，不是实时爬虫权限测试。

summary.en: Repair-oriented format review without crawler simulation.
summary.zh: 面向修复的格式审查，不模拟爬虫。

description.en: A free account-based AEO audit that tests customer questions on ChatGPT and Google AI Mode, reviews nine readiness checks across up to 15 public pages, and produces prioritized fixes and PDF reports.
description.zh: 免费账户型 AEO 审计，在 ChatGPT 和 Google AI Mode 上测试客户问题，对最多 15 个公开页面执行九项就绪度检查，并生成优先修复清单和 PDF 报告。

en: AEO audit
AI visibility
Citation readiness
zh: AEO 审计
AI 可见度
引用就绪度

en: Runs eight customer questions on ChatGPT and Google AI Mode and records named businesses and cited sources.
Checks crawler access, schema, answer-ready content, trust signals, and page-level readiness across up to 15 pages.
Provides competitor comparisons, prioritized fixes, a fix checker, prompt-plan preview, report history, and PDF export.
zh: 在 ChatGPT 和 Google AI Mode 上运行八个客户问题，记录被点名的企业和引用来源。
对最多 15 个页面检查爬虫访问、结构化数据、答案就绪内容、信任信号和页面级就绪度。
提供竞品对比、优先修复清单、修复检查器、提示词计划预览、历史报告和 PDF 导出。

audience.en: Local, national, and B2B businesses that want both live AI-answer observations and a technical readiness review in one report.
audience.zh: 希望在同一报告中同时获得实时 AI 答案观察和技术就绪度审查的本地、全国性及 B2B 企业。

description.en: Run a fixed set of customer questions and review which businesses and source pages ChatGPT and Google AI Mode name at the time of the report.
description.zh: 运行固定客户问题集合，查看报告生成时 ChatGPT 和 Google AI Mode 点名了哪些企业及来源页面。

summary.en: Observe live AI answers for a fixed question set.
summary.zh: 观察固定问题集合的实时 AI 答案。

description.en: Combine page-readiness findings with AI-answer observations to create a prioritized remediation list and share a PDF with a web team.
description.zh: 将页面就绪度发现与 AI 答案观察结合，生成优先修复清单，并与网页团队分享 PDF。

summary.en: Turn readiness and answer findings into a fix plan.
summary.zh: 将就绪度与答案发现转化为修复计划。

description.en: AEO Armory is USD 0 with no card and an email account using one-time sign-in codes. It includes three reports per day; additional reports, questions, or locations require contacting the team, with no public higher-tier price confirmed.
description.zh: AEO Armory 价格为 0 美元，无需信用卡，使用邮箱和一次性登录码创建账户。每天包含三份报告；更多报告、问题或地点需联系团队，未确认公开的更高档价格。

summary.en: Free account; three reports per day.
summary.zh: 免费账户；每天三份报告。

description.en: AI answers vary between runs, so a report is a time-specific observation rather than a stable visibility score. Only public pages are read, and the tool does not modify the website.
description.zh: AI 答案会随运行变化，因此报告是特定时间点的观察，而非稳定的可见度分数。工具只读取公开页面，不修改网站。

summary.en: Time-specific AI answers and public-page-only access.
summary.zh: AI 答案具有时效性，且只访问公开页面。

description.en: The service stores account details, entered business information, checked public pages, AI answers, scores, and fix lists. Providers include Vercel, Supabase, DataForSEO, Anthropic, Resend, and GoHighLevel; data is stored on U.S.-based servers and reports remain until account deletion.
description.zh: 服务保存账户资料、输入的业务信息、检查的公开页面、AI 答案、分数和修复清单。服务商包括 Vercel、Supabase、DataForSEO、Anthropic、Resend 和 GoHighLevel；数据存储在美国服务器，报告保留至账户删除。

summary.en: Account and report data are stored with named providers.
summary.zh: 账户和报告数据由具名服务商存储处理。

description.en: Useful when live answer observations and technical readiness should be reviewed together; the tradeoff is an email account, daily report limits, variable AI answers, and stored business and report data.
description.zh: 适合需要同时审查实时答案观察和技术就绪度的场景；取舍是需要邮箱账户、每日报告有限、AI 答案会变化，并且会保存业务和报告数据。

summary.en: Combined live-answer and readiness audit with account and storage tradeoffs.
summary.zh: 结合实时答案与就绪度审计，但有账户和存储取舍。

description.en: An MIT-licensed Node CLI and JavaScript/TypeScript library for validating llms.txt headings, sections, Markdown links, absolute URLs, duplicates, and optional link reachability.
description.zh: MIT 许可的 Node 命令行和 JavaScript/TypeScript 库，用于验证 llms.txt 的标题、分节、Markdown 链接、绝对 URL、重复项，以及可选的链接可达性。
