en: Open source
CLI
llms.txt validation
zh: 开源
命令行
llms.txt 验证

en: Checks first-line H1, duplicate titles, H2 sections, empty sections, and malformed Markdown links.
Flags relative or fragment-only URLs, non-HTTPS links, duplicate URLs, and duplicate link text.
Supports local files, URL input, optional link checks, JSON output, CI usage, and library embedding.
zh: 检查首行 H1、重复标题、H2 分节、空分节和格式错误的 Markdown 链接。
标记相对 URL、仅片段 URL、非 HTTPS 链接、重复 URL 和重复链接文字。
支持本地文件、URL 输入、可选链接检查、JSON 输出、CI 使用和库嵌入。

audience.en: Developers and release engineers who want deterministic llms.txt validation in a terminal, build pipeline, or application.
audience.zh: 希望在终端、构建流水线或应用中执行确定性 llms.txt 验证的开发者和发布工程师。

description.en: Validate a checked-in llms.txt file before release and emit machine-readable findings for a CI job.
description.zh: 在发布前验证仓库中的 llms.txt 文件，并为 CI 作业输出机器可读结果。

summary.en: Gate releases on local llms.txt validation.
summary.zh: 在发布流程中校验本地 llms.txt。

description.en: Enable optional network checks when a workflow needs to know whether linked resources return successful responses.
description.zh: 当工作流需要确认链接资源是否返回成功响应时，启用可选网络检查。

summary.en: Optionally test linked-resource reachability.
summary.zh: 可选测试链接资源可达性。

description.en: The validator is MIT-licensed and available through npm at no charge. BridgeToAgent's separate USD 49 agent-readiness kit is not part of this tool.
description.zh: 验证器采用 MIT 许可，可通过 npm 免费使用。BridgeToAgent 独立的 49 美元智能体就绪套件不属于本工具。

summary.en: Free MIT-licensed npm CLI and library.
summary.zh: 免费 MIT 许可 npm 命令行与库。

description.en: Requires Node 18 or newer and uses native fetch. It validates file structure and optional link responses, but does not generate llms.txt, assess content quality, fetch linked-page content, or audit robots.txt or schema.
description.zh: 需要 Node 18 或更高版本，并使用原生 fetch。它验证文件结构和可选链接响应，但不生成 llms.txt、评价内容质量、抓取链接页面内容，也不审计 robots.txt 或结构化数据。

summary.en: Node 18+; file validation rather than a full GEO audit.
summary.zh: 需要 Node 18+；这是文件验证，而非完整 GEO 审计。

description.en: The repository README mentions a hosted validator, but that hosted page could not be fetched during verification. This record covers only the verified open-source CLI and library, not current hosted availability.
description.zh: 仓库 README 提到托管验证器，但核验时无法获取该托管页面。本条目只覆盖已核验的开源命令行和库，不声称托管服务当前可用。

summary.en: Hosted availability unverified; open-source package verified.
summary.zh: 托管可用性未核验；开源软件包已核验。

description.en: A good fit for automated file linting and CI; the tradeoff is that reachability checking is optional and the package deliberately stops short of broader crawler, schema, or content-quality analysis.
description.zh: 适合自动文件检查和 CI；取舍是可达性检查为可选项，且软件包有意不覆盖更广泛的爬虫、结构化数据或内容质量分析。

summary.en: CI-friendly linting with intentionally narrow scope.
summary.zh: 适合 CI 的文件检查，范围有意保持狭窄。

description.en: An MIT-licensed, dependency-free Node CLI that runs about 30 external readiness checks covering discovery files, sampled pages, structured data, APIs, MCP, agent skills, A2A, and Markdown negotiation.
description.zh: MIT 许可、无依赖的 Node 命令行工具，执行约 30 项外部就绪度检查，涵盖发现文件、页面抽样、结构化数据、API、MCP、智能体技能、A2A 和 Markdown 协商。

en: Open source
CLI
Agent readiness
zh: 开源
命令行
智能体就绪度

en: Checks robots.txt, sitemap, llms.txt, Markdown negotiation, and up to 40 sampled pages for search and page-structure signals.
Reviews structured data, canonical and indexability signals, link previews, OpenAPI, hosted MCP, skills, A2A, and related declarations.
Supports JSON output, comparison runs, multi-site matrices, access-log summaries, and local or preview builds.
zh: 检查 robots.txt、站点地图、llms.txt、Markdown 协商，并抽样最多 40 个页面检查搜索和页面结构信号。
审查结构化数据、规范链接和可索引信号、链接预览、OpenAPI、托管 MCP、技能、A2A 及相关声明。
支持 JSON 输出、运行对比、多站点矩阵、访问日志摘要，以及本地或预览构建。

audience.en: Developers, platform teams, and technical SEOs who want a scriptable audit that can run against production or a pre-deployment build.
audience.zh: 希望针对生产环境或部署前构建运行可脚本化审计的开发者、平台团队和技术 SEO 人员。

description.en: Run a broad external readiness check before launch and compare the resulting JSON with a later run to identify changed findings.
description.zh: 在发布前运行广泛的外部就绪度检查，并将 JSON 结果与后续运行对比，以识别变化。

summary.en: Compare readiness findings before and after changes.
summary.zh: 对比变更前后的就绪度发现。

description.en: Audit a local or preview deployment while keeping production host redirects separate from application-level checks.
description.zh: 审计本地或预览部署，同时将生产主机重定向与应用层检查区分。

summary.en: Check a preview build before deployment.
summary.zh: 在部署前检查预览构建。

description.en: The readiness-audit package is free and MIT-licensed. The current npm release verified for this batch is 2.9.0.
description.zh: readiness-audit 软件包免费并采用 MIT 许可；本批次核验的当前 npm 版本为 2.9.0。

summary.en: Free MIT-licensed CLI, version 2.9.0 verified.
summary.zh: 免费 MIT 许可命令行，已核验版本 2.9.0。

description.en: Requires Node 22.23.4, 24.22.1, 26.12.1, or a later release on the same supported line. The npm engine range is ^22.23.4 || ^24.22.1 || >=26.12.1.

summary.en: Specific supported Node release lines are required.
summary.zh: 要求特定的 Node 支持版本线。

description.en: The scorecard samples pages and only evaluates externally visible signals. It cannot judge next_steps quality, whether an agent can complete a real task, input forgiveness, or test coverage; a high score is not proof of agent usability.
description.zh: 评分卡会抽样页面，且只评估外部可见信号。它不能判断 next_steps 质量、智能体能否完成真实任务、输入容错或测试覆盖率；高分不代表智能体可用性。

summary.en: External checks cannot prove real agent usability.
summary.zh: 外部检查不能证明真实智能体可用性。

description.en: Well suited to technical teams that need broad, repeatable checks in CI; the tradeoff is strict Node-version requirements, sampled rather than exhaustive pages, and the need for separate real-agent usability testing.
description.zh: 适合需要在 CI 中执行广泛且可重复检查的技术团队；取舍是 Node 版本要求严格、页面为抽样而非穷尽，并且需要另行进行真实智能体可用性测试。

summary.en: Broad CI audit with sampled scope and separate usability testing.
summary.zh: 广泛的 CI 审计，但页面抽样且需另测可用性。

description.en: An MIT-licensed Node CLI that checks robots.txt access for 11 AI crawlers, root llms.txt, raw homepage HTML, structured data, and sitemap signals without scores, model calls, accounts, or telemetry.
description.zh: MIT 许可的 Node 命令行工具，检查 11 个 AI 爬虫的 robots.txt 权限、根目录 llms.txt、原始首页 HTML、结构化数据和站点地图信号，不生成分数、不调用模型、不需要账户或遥测。

en: Open source
CLI
AI crawler access
zh: 开源
命令行
AI 爬虫权限

en: Reports crawler access using RFC 9309 group selection, longest-match rules, and Allow tie-breaking.
Validates llms.txt structure and can request up to 20 links when link checking is enabled.
Generates an llms.txt skeleton from up to 30 pages and provides JSON output and CI exit codes.
zh: 按照 RFC 9309 的选择组、最长匹配和 Allow 优先规则报告爬虫权限。
验证 llms.txt 结构，启用链接检查时最多请求 20 个链接。
从最多 30 个页面生成 llms.txt 骨架，并提供 JSON 输出和 CI 退出码。

audience.en: Developers and technical SEOs who want a local, evidence-oriented crawler and discovery-file audit with no vendor account.
audience.zh: 希望进行本地化、以证据为导向的爬虫和发现文件审计、且无需供应商账户的开发者和技术 SEO 人员。

description.en: Inspect which robots.txt rule governs a crawler and path, then review raw public files and homepage signals without sending data to QueryRev.
description.zh: 查看哪条 robots.txt 规则控制特定爬虫和路径，再检查原始公开文件和首页信号，且不向 QueryRev 发送数据。

summary.en: Audit public crawler and discovery signals locally.
summary.zh: 在本地审计公开爬虫和发现信号。

description.en: Use JSON findings and documented exit codes to review changes to robots.txt or llms.txt in a pull request or scheduled check.
description.zh: 使用 JSON 结果和文档化退出码，在拉取请求或定时检查中审查 robots.txt 或 llms.txt 的变化。

summary.en: Bring evidence-based findings into CI workflows.
summary.zh: 将基于证据的发现纳入 CI 工作流。

description.en: The @queryrev/ai-readiness package is free and MIT-licensed; the verified npm version is 1.0.1. Its data directory is separately licensed CC BY 4.0 and requires attribution to QueryRev Research's State of AI Crawler Access, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23424275. QueryRev's separate commercial platform is waitlisted and is not the product recorded here.
description.zh: @queryrev/ai-readiness 免费并采用 MIT 许可；已核验 npm 版本为 1.0.1。其 data 目录另采用 CC BY 4.0 许可，使用数据时需署名 QueryRev Research 的 State of AI Crawler Access，DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23424275。QueryRev 独立的商业平台仍在等待名单，不是本条目记录的产品。

summary.en: Free MIT CLI; CC BY 4.0 data attribution required.
summary.zh: 免费 MIT 命令行；数据需遵守 CC BY 4.0 署名要求。

description.en: Requires Node 22.19 or later and has one runtime dependency, undici. It inspects raw responses without JavaScript rendering and cannot observe crawler-specific CDN behavior, actual crawling, citations, or authenticated content.
description.zh: 需要 Node 22.19 或更高版本，并有一个运行时依赖 undici。它检查原始响应，不渲染 JavaScript，无法观察爬虫特定的 CDN 行为、实际抓取、引用或需认证的内容。

summary.en: Node 22.19+; no JavaScript rendering or real crawler observation.
summary.zh: 需要 Node 22.19+；不渲染 JavaScript，也不观察真实爬虫。

description.en: The crawler list is a defined set of 11, not every AI crawler. Training crawlers are reported but are not treated as failures because blocking them is the site owner's choice.
description.zh: 爬虫列表是定义的 11 个，并非所有 AI 爬虫。训练爬虫会被报告但不视为失败，因为是否阻止训练爬虫由网站所有者决定。

summary.en: Fixed 11-crawler list; training blocks are not failures.
summary.zh: 固定 11 个爬虫；阻止训练爬虫不算失败。

description.en: A strong fit for privacy-conscious local checks and CI evidence; the tradeoff is raw-response analysis, a fixed crawler list, and no simulation of real edge delivery or AI-answer outcomes.
description.zh: 适合注重隐私的本地检查和 CI 证据；取舍是分析原始响应、爬虫列表固定，且不模拟真实边缘交付或 AI 答案结果。

summary.en: Local and telemetry-free, but not an edge or citation simulator.
summary.zh: 本地且无遥测，但不是边缘或引用模拟器。

description.en: An MIT-licensed, zero-dependency Node CLI for first-pass AI-readiness checks covering robots.txt, about 20 crawler tokens, sitemap discovery, llms.txt, Markdown negotiation, crawl headers, metadata, and JSON-LD.
description.zh: MIT 许可、零依赖的 Node 命令行工具，进行 AI 就绪度初检，涵盖 robots.txt、约 20 个爬虫标识、站点地图发现、llms.txt、Markdown 协商、抓取响应头、元数据和 JSON-LD。

en: Open source
CLI
Technical SEO
zh: 开源
命令行
技术 SEO

en: Reports current allow or block state for about 20 known AI crawler tokens without prescribing a crawler policy.
Checks sitemap discovery and structure, llms.txt and llms-full.txt conventions, Markdown negotiation, and crawl-friendly headers.
Inspects title, description, canonical, language, meta robots, Open Graph, feeds, and JSON-LD types.
zh: 报告约 20 个已知 AI 爬虫标识当前的允许或阻止状态，不规定爬虫策略。
检查站点地图发现和结构、llms.txt 与 llms-full.txt 约定、Markdown 协商和有利抓取的响应头。
检查标题、描述、规范链接、语言、meta robots、Open Graph、Feed 和 JSON-LD 类型。

audience.en: Developers and SEO practitioners who want a dependency-free command-line first pass over one public URL.
audience.zh: 希望对单个公开 URL 进行无依赖命令行初检的开发者和 SEO 从业者。

description.en: Run a quick AI-readiness linter on a public URL and review text or JSON findings before deciding whether a deeper crawl is needed.
description.zh: 对公开 URL 运行快速 AI 就绪度检查，查看文本或 JSON 结果，再决定是否需要更深入的抓取。

summary.en: Get a quick first-pass readiness report.
summary.zh: 获得快速的就绪度初检报告。

description.en: Use the fail-on option to turn selected finding levels into a non-zero pipeline exit code.
description.zh: 使用 fail-on 选项将选定级别的问题转换为流水线非零退出码。

summary.en: Gate a pipeline on selected finding levels.
summary.zh: 按选定问题级别设置流水线门槛。

description.en: ReadyScan is free and MIT-licensed. The verified npm release is 0.1.0 and declares zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: ReadyScan 免费并采用 MIT 许可；已核验 npm 版本为 0.1.0，声明零运行时依赖。

summary.en: Free MIT CLI with zero runtime dependencies.
summary.zh: 免费 MIT 命令行，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Requires Node 20 or newer. It checks one URL per run, does not crawl a sitemap or run JavaScript, and parses HTML with regular expressions, so metadata extraction is best-effort.
description.zh: 需要 Node 20 或更高版本。每次只检查一个 URL，不抓取站点地图，也不运行 JavaScript；HTML 使用正则表达式解析，因此元数据提取为尽力而为。

summary.en: Node 20+; single URL, no JavaScript, regex HTML parsing.
summary.zh: 需要 Node 20+；单 URL、不执行 JavaScript、正则解析 HTML。

description.en: robots.txt matching is coarse and answers whether a crawler may fetch the root path, not arbitrary path patterns. The tool reports policy without recommending whether crawlers should be allowed or blocked.
description.zh: robots.txt 匹配较粗略，只回答爬虫是否可获取根路径，不处理任意路径模式。工具报告策略，但不建议应允许还是阻止爬虫。

summary.en: Coarse root-path robots matching and no policy recommendation.
summary.zh: 粗略的根路径权限匹配，不提供策略建议。

description.en: Convenient for a dependency-free first pass in a terminal or pipeline; the tradeoff is one-URL scope, no JavaScript rendering, no sitemap crawl, and coarse robots matching.
description.zh: 适合在终端或流水线中进行无依赖初检；取舍是只检查单个 URL、不渲染 JavaScript、不抓取站点地图，且 robots 匹配较粗略。

summary.en: Lightweight first pass rather than a full crawler audit.
summary.zh: 轻量初检，而非完整爬虫审计。

description.en: An MIT-licensed MCP server that brings Crawl Readiness audits into compatible AI clients, covering 60 AI crawlers, JSON-LD, robots.txt, and browser-versus-bot content parity, with key-based generators and monitoring reads.
description.zh: MIT 许可的 MCP 服务器，将 Crawl Readiness 审计带入兼容 AI 客户端，覆盖 60 个 AI 爬虫、JSON-LD、robots.txt，以及浏览器与机器人的内容一致性，并提供需密钥的生成和监控读取功能。

en: MCP
AI crawler access
Schema validation
zh: MCP
AI 爬虫权限
结构化数据验证

en: Provides anonymous readiness checks for 60 AI crawlers, 20+ JSON-LD types, robots.txt syntax, and content parity.
Compares Chrome, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, and PerplexityBot responses to reveal possible crawler-specific delivery differences.
Adds key-based llms.txt, robots.txt, and schema generators plus a read-only monitoring trend tool.
zh: 匿名检查 60 个 AI 爬虫、20 多种 JSON-LD 类型、robots.txt 语法和内容一致性。
对比 Chrome、GPTBot、ClaudeBot 和 PerplexityBot 的响应，以发现可能的爬虫特定交付差异。
增加需密钥的 llms.txt、robots.txt 和结构化数据生成器，以及只读监控趋势工具。

audience.en: Developers and SEO teams already using an MCP-compatible assistant who want crawler and schema checks inside their existing workflow.
audience.zh: 已在兼容 MCP 的 AI 助手中工作、希望把爬虫和结构化数据检查纳入现有流程的开发者和 SEO 团队。

description.en: Ask an MCP-compatible client to check crawler permissions, validate JSON-LD or robots.txt, and compare browser and bot delivery without leaving the assistant workflow.
description.zh: 让兼容 MCP 的客户端检查爬虫权限、验证 JSON-LD 或 robots.txt，并对比浏览器与机器人交付，而无需离开助手工作流。

summary.en: Run crawler and schema diagnostics inside an MCP client.
summary.zh: 在 MCP 客户端内运行爬虫和结构化数据诊断。

description.en: Use a free API key when a workflow needs generated discovery files or monitoring trends, while retaining anonymous access for the four audit tools and permission check.
description.zh: 当工作流需要生成发现文件或监控趋势时使用免费 API 密钥，同时保留四项审计工具和权限检查的匿名访问。

summary.en: Combine anonymous audits with optional key-based generation.
summary.zh: 将匿名审计与可选密钥生成结合。

description.en: The MCP server is MIT-licensed and the four audit tools plus check_permission work anonymously. A free API key provides 50 checks per month without a card; generators and get_monitor_trend require a key, and the trend read also requires access to Answer Analyses.
description.zh: MCP 服务器采用 MIT 许可，四项审计工具和 check_permission 可匿名使用。免费 API 密钥每月提供 50 次检查且无需信用卡；生成器和 get_monitor_trend 需要密钥，趋势读取还需要 Answer Analyses 访问权限。

summary.en: Anonymous audits; free key gives 50 checks per month.
summary.zh: 审计可匿名；免费密钥每月 50 次检查。

description.en: Optional hosted plans include a USD 99 one-time AI Readiness Audit, Monitor at USD 39/month, Studio at USD 79/month, and Agency at USD 199/month. Yearly billing is offered for ten months' price; no annual total is inferred here.
description.zh: 可选托管方案包括 99 美元一次性 AI Readiness Audit、Monitor 每月 39 美元、Studio 每月 79 美元和 Agency 每月 199 美元。按年支付按十个月价格计；此处不推算年度总额。

summary.en: Optional hosted audit and subscription plans remain separate.
summary.zh: 可选托管审计和订阅方案独立计价。

description.en: The MIT-licensed server calls live hosted endpoints and is not an offline or local-only auditor. Supported clients include Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, Cline, Windsurf, and Continue; MCP setup and, for some tools, an API key are prerequisites.
description.zh: MIT 许可服务器调用实时托管端点，不是离线或纯本地审计器。支持的客户端包括 Claude Desktop、Claude Code、Cursor、Cline、Windsurf 和 Continue；需要配置 MCP，部分工具还需要 API 密钥。

summary.en: Live hosted dependency and MCP-client setup required.
summary.zh: 依赖实时托管服务，并需配置 MCP 客户端。

description.en: Checks cache public signals at an unlisted report URL, and the checked domain may appear on a public list. This applies to signed-in and unsigned checks, including MCP. Reports are noindex and do not identify the checker; domain owners can request removal within five business days.
description.zh: 检查会将公开信号缓存在未公开列出的报告 URL，且被检查域名可能出现在公开列表中。登录和未登录检查均适用，包括 MCP。报告设置为 noindex，不识别检查者；域名所有者可在五个工作日内请求移除。

summary.en: Checks can produce unlisted reports and public-list entries.
summary.zh: 检查可能生成未公开列出的报告和公开列表条目。

description.en: check_permission is limited to 25 calls per day per network without a key. get_monitor_trend requires both a key and a plan or audit access containing Answer Analyses.
description.zh: 无密钥时，check_permission 每个网络每天限制为 25 次调用。get_monitor_trend 同时需要密钥和包含 Answer Analyses 的方案或审计访问权限。

summary.en: Permission and trend tools have additional access limits.
summary.zh: 权限和趋势工具有额外访问限制。

description.en: A practical fit for teams already using MCP clients and wanting both anonymous audits and optional generators; the tradeoff is live-service dependence, key requirements for some tools, and public-signal report caching.
description.zh: 适合已使用 MCP 客户端、同时需要匿名审计和可选生成器的团队；取舍是依赖实时服务、部分工具需要密钥，并且会缓存公开信号报告。

summary.en: MCP-native diagnostics with live-service and report-caching tradeoffs.
summary.zh: MCP 原生诊断，但有实时服务和报告缓存取舍。

description.en: Managed SEO/GEO content production workflow that turns a keyword plan into brand-aligned articles, runs pre-publication checks, and publishes or schedules drafts through connected CMS platforms.
description.zh: 把关键词计划转化为符合品牌语气的 SEO/GEO 文章，执行发布前检查，并通过已连接的 CMS 发布或安排草稿的托管式内容生产工作流。

en: GEO content
Automated publishing
Content briefs
zh: GEO 内容
自动发布
内容简报

en: Builds a personalized keyword plan and produces a monthly package of expert articles of 3,000+ words.
Uses direct answers, authoritative sources, FAQ structure, brand voice, original AI images, and internal links.
Runs SEO/GEO checks before publication and names ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Gemini as target answer surfaces.
Offers Review mode for approving, editing, rescheduling, or deleting drafts, as well as an autopilot option.
Connects with WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Wix, Next.js, Framer, Ghost, Notion, webhooks, and a custom API.
zh: 建立个性化关键词计划，并按月生产 3,000 词以上的专家文章套餐。
采用直接回答、权威来源、FAQ 结构、品牌语气、原创 AI 图片和内链。
发布前执行 SEO/GEO 检查，并明确列出 ChatGPT、Claude、Perplexity 和 Gemini 目标回答界面。
Review 模式可批准、编辑、改期或删除草稿，也提供自动执行选项。
可连接 WordPress、Shopify、Webflow、Wix、Next.js、Framer、Ghost、Notion、webhooks 和自定义 API。

audience.en: Small and midsize content teams that want an ongoing article production and publishing workflow with optional human review.
audience.zh: 希望获得持续文章生产与发布流程、并可选择人工审核的小型和中型内容团队。

description.en: Turn an approved keyword plan into a recurring article package with brand voice, sourced claims, FAQ sections, images, and internal links, then send drafts to a connected CMS.
description.zh: 把已批准的关键词计划转为持续文章套餐，加入品牌语气、有来源的声明、FAQ、图片和内链，再发送到已连接的 CMS。

summary.en: Produce recurring sourced, brand-aligned articles from a keyword plan and hand them to a connected CMS.
summary.zh: 按关键词计划持续生产有来源、符合品牌语气的文章，并交接给已连接的 CMS。

description.en: Use the pre-publication SEO/GEO checks and Review mode to inspect answer structure, sources, and FAQs before approving, editing, rescheduling, or deleting a draft.
description.zh: 利用发布前 SEO/GEO 检查和 Review 模式，在批准、编辑、改期或删除草稿前检查回答结构、来源和 FAQ。

summary.en: Review answer structure, sources, and FAQs before approving or scheduling publication.
summary.zh: 在批准或安排发布前复核回答结构、来源和 FAQ。

description.en: The reviewed annual offer displays USD 19 per month as an introductory equivalent, with an actual first-year charge of USD 228 and a stated renewal of USD 468 per year. The crossed-out USD 99 monthly figure is not used as the current price.
description.zh: 本次核验的年付优惠展示每月 19 美元的首期折算价，首年实际扣款 228 美元，后续续费为每年 468 美元；不采用已被划掉的每月 99 美元作为当前价格。

summary.en: Annual intro: USD 19/month equivalent, USD 228 first year; renewal USD 468/year.
summary.zh: 年付首期：折合 19 美元/月，首年 228 美元；续费 468 美元/年。

description.en: The free audit is not an ongoing free content tier. The current terms explicitly state that Bunzy has no trial; a first-payment refund may be requested within 14 calendar days, while renewals are generally non-refundable.
description.zh: 免费审计不是持续免费内容层。当前条款明确说明 Bunzy 不提供试用；首次扣款后 14 个自然日内可申请退款，续费通常不退。

summary.en: No trial or ongoing free tier; first-payment refund request within 14 calendar days, renewals generally non-refundable.
summary.zh: 无试用或长期免费层；首次扣款后 14 个自然日内可申请退款，续费通常不退。

description.en: Automatic publishing is available and may be the default configuration. The customer remains responsible for published material, so Review mode and approval controls should be configured rather than assumed.
description.zh: 服务支持自动发布，且自动发布可能成为默认配置。客户仍对已发布内容负责，因此应主动配置 Review 模式和审批控制。

summary.en: Auto-publishing may be the default; customers must configure approval controls and remain responsible for published content.
summary.zh: 自动发布可能是默认项；客户须配置审批控制并对发布内容负责。

description.en: CMS publishing and API delivery require access to the relevant platform and credentials. The listed integrations are delivery prerequisites, not additional AI answer engines.
description.zh: CMS 发布和 API 交付需要相应平台访问权与凭据。所列集成属于交付前提，不代表额外的 AI 回答引擎。

summary.en: CMS/API delivery requires platform access and credentials; integrations are not AI engines.
summary.zh: CMS/API 交付需要平台权限和凭据；集成不等同于 AI 引擎。

description.en: Official marketing copy gives inconsistent language counts, using 100+ languages in one section and over 80 global languages in another. No single verified language total is recorded here.
description.zh: 官方营销文案的语言数量表述不一致，一处写 100 多种语言，另一处写超过 80 种全球语言；本记录不采用单一核验后的语言总数。

summary.en: Official pages conflict between 100+ languages and over 80; no single language total is asserted.
summary.zh: 官方页面在 100 多种与超过 80 种之间不一致；不主张单一语言总数。

description.en: Consider this workflow when recurring managed article production matters more than a one-off audit; budget for renewal pricing and configure human approval before enabling unattended publishing.
description.zh: 如果更看重持续托管的文章生产而非一次性审计，可考虑此工作流；应把续费价格纳入预算，并在无人值守发布前配置人工审批。

summary.en: Fits recurring managed article production; plan for renewal cost and configure approval before unattended publishing.
summary.zh: 适合持续托管文章生产；需考虑续费成本，并在无人值守发布前配置审批。

label.en: Bunzy product, workflow, integrations, and displayed pricing
label.zh: Bunzy 产品、工作流、集成与展示价格

label.en: Bunzy privacy and AI processing notice
label.zh: Bunzy 隐私与 AI 处理说明

description.en: AEO content workspace with a free browser-local citation-readiness grader and paid workflows that turn brand context, search opportunities, and research into briefs, outlines, drafts, and publishable content.
description.zh: AEO 内容工作台，提供浏览器本地运行的免费引用就绪检查器，并通过付费流程把品牌上下文、搜索机会和研究转为简报、大纲、草稿和可发布内容。

en: Citation readiness
Content briefs
AEO
zh: 引用就绪
内容简报
AEO

en: Runs the free Citation-Ready Content Grader locally in the browser without uploading pasted content.
Checks answer clarity, evidence, extractable structure, specificity, and nuance, with suggestions for direct answers and sourced details.
Combines brand context, Search Console opportunities, and research into briefs, outlines, drafts, editorial review, export, and publishing.
Offers WordPress, Ghost, and custom-webhook delivery paths.
Supports paid workflows with included provider usage or a one-time bring-your-own-key option.
zh: 免费引用就绪内容检查器在浏览器本地运行，不上传粘贴正文。
检查回答清晰度、证据、可提取结构、具体性和细节层次，并建议直接回答与有来源的细节。
把品牌上下文、Search Console 机会和研究组合为简报、大纲、草稿、编辑审核、导出和发布。
提供 WordPress、Ghost 和自定义 webhook 交付路径。
付费工作流可使用套餐内供应商用量，或选择一次性自带密钥方案。

audience.en: Content editors, SEO teams, and agencies that want to assess citation readiness before drafting and then use a structured AEO writing workflow.
audience.zh: 希望在起草前评估引用就绪度、再使用结构化 AEO 写作流程的内容编辑、SEO 团队和代理商。

description.en: Paste at least 60 words into the browser-local grader to inspect answer clarity, evidence, extractable structure, specificity, and nuance before editing a draft.
description.zh: 将至少 60 词粘贴到浏览器本地检查器，在编辑草稿前检查回答清晰度、证据、可提取结构、具体性和细节层次。

summary.en: Check a 60+ word draft locally for answer clarity, evidence, structure, specificity, and nuance.
summary.zh: 在本地检查 60 词以上草稿的回答清晰度、证据、结构、具体性和细节层次。

description.en: Turn brand context, Search Console opportunities, and research into a content brief, outline, and draft, then use editorial review and CMS or webhook delivery.
description.zh: 把品牌上下文、Search Console 机会和研究转为内容简报、大纲和草稿，再经编辑审核并通过 CMS 或 webhook 交付。

summary.en: Move from brand and search context to briefs, outlines, reviewed drafts, and CMS/webhook delivery.
summary.zh: 从品牌和搜索上下文推进到简报、大纲、已审核草稿及 CMS/webhook 交付。

description.en: The browser-local grader is free. Paid monthly plans are Starter at USD 19 with 10 articles, 200 keyword credits, 50 ideas, and 3 projects; Growth at USD 99 with 30 articles, 600 credits, 150 ideas, and 9 projects; and Agency at USD 240 with 90 articles, 1,800 credits, 450 ideas, and 30 projects.
description.zh: 浏览器本地检查器免费。付费月付套餐为：Starter 19 美元，含 10 篇文章、200 个关键词积分、50 个选题和 3 个项目；Growth 99 美元，含 30 篇、600 积分、150 个选题和 9 个项目；Agency 240 美元，含 90 篇、1,800 积分、450 个选题和 30 个项目。

summary.en: Free local grader; Starter USD 19/month, Growth USD 99/month, Agency USD 240/month with scaled article, credit, idea, and project quotas.
summary.zh: 本地检查器免费；Starter 19 美元/月、Growth 99 美元/月、Agency 240 美元/月，文章、积分、选题和项目配额递增。

description.en: BYOK is a one-time USD 89 option with 250 keyword credits and unlimited articles, ideas, and projects; OpenAI, Anthropic, Exa, DataForSEO, and Keywords Everywhere usage is billed separately. A 3-day trial includes 2 articles, requires a card, converts to Starter at USD 19/month unless canceled, and does not require payment on day one.
description.zh: BYOK 为一次性 89 美元选项，含 250 个关键词积分，文章、选题和项目不限量；OpenAI、Anthropic、Exa、DataForSEO 和 Keywords Everywhere 的用量另计。3 天试用含 2 篇文章，需要信用卡，首日不扣款，未取消则转为每月 19 美元的 Starter。

summary.en: BYOK USD 89 one-time plus provider usage; 3-day, 2-article trial requires a card and converts to USD 19/month unless canceled.
summary.zh: BYOK 一次性 89 美元且供应商用量另计；3 天试用含 2 篇文章，需信用卡，未取消则转为 19 美元/月。

description.en: The free grader requires JavaScript and at least 60 words. It explicitly warns that no checker can guarantee or reliably predict whether an answer engine will cite the content.
description.zh: 免费检查器需要 JavaScript 和至少 60 词。官方明确提示，任何检查器都不能保证或可靠预测回答引擎是否会引用内容。

summary.en: Grader requires JavaScript and 60+ words and cannot guarantee or reliably predict citations.
summary.zh: 检查器需要 JavaScript 和至少 60 词，不能保证或可靠预测引用。

description.en: The paid trial requires a card and automatically converts to the Starter monthly plan unless canceled before the trial ends. The free grader should not be treated as evidence of an ongoing free article-generation tier.
description.zh: 付费试用需要信用卡，试用结束前未取消会自动转为 Starter 月付套餐。免费检查器不应被视为存在持续免费文章生成层的证据。

summary.en: Card-required trial converts to Starter; the free grader is not an ongoing free generation tier.
summary.zh: 试用需信用卡并会转为 Starter；免费检查器不是持续免费生成层。

description.en: The reviewed official pages do not clearly enumerate a fixed set of AI answer engines for the content workflow, so the platforms field remains empty rather than inferring coverage from the AEO label.
description.zh: 本次核验的官方页面未清楚列出内容工作流覆盖的固定 AI 回答引擎集合，因此平台字段留空，而不从 AEO 标签推断覆盖范围。

summary.en: No fixed answer-engine set is clearly published for the workflow; platform coverage is left unknown.
summary.zh: 未清楚公布工作流的固定回答引擎集合；平台覆盖范围保留为未知。

description.en: The privacy notice explains local processing for the free tool but does not clearly name all AI model suppliers or state a customer-content no-training commitment for the paid workflow. This is an information gap, not evidence of a conflicting practice.
description.zh: 隐私说明解释了免费工具的本地处理，但没有清楚列出全部 AI 模型供应商，也未对付费工作流作出客户内容不用于训练的明确承诺。这是信息缺口，不代表已证实存在冲突做法。

summary.en: AI suppliers and a customer-content no-training commitment are not clearly disclosed for the paid workflow.
summary.zh: 付费工作流未清楚披露 AI 供应商及客户内容不用于训练的承诺。

description.en: Use the free local grader as a low-friction editorial check, then evaluate the paid workflow against trial conversion, BYOK provider costs, and the still-unclear engine coverage.
description.zh: 可把免费本地检查器作为低门槛编辑检查，再结合试用自动转价、BYOK 供应商成本和仍不清楚的引擎覆盖范围评估付费工作流。

summary.en: Start with the local grader; assess paid adoption against auto-conversion, BYOK costs, and unclear engine coverage.
summary.zh: 可先用本地检查器；采用付费流程前评估自动转价、BYOK 成本和引擎覆盖缺口。

label.zh: Hypertxt 产品与内容工作流

description.en: Answer-engine optimization workflow that audits a website for missing answers and structured data, publishes improvements on the customer's domain, creates content, and tracks citations and competitor sources.
description.zh: 回答引擎优化工作流，检查网站缺失的回答和结构化数据，在客户域名发布改进，创建内容，并追踪引用和竞品来源。

en: AEO
Content automation
Citation tracking
zh: AEO
内容自动化
引用追踪

en: Audits pages for missing direct answers, schema, FAQs, and machine-readable structure.
Adds JSON-LD, llms.txt, FAQ schema, and server-side rendering support on the customer's domain.
Creates and rewrites pages, then tracks generated answers, citation positions, competitor citation sources, and declines.
Names Google, ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews in official product materials.
Offers a free audit and limited plan, plus paid content, technical-action, and citation-tracking tiers.
zh: 检查页面是否缺失直接回答、schema、FAQ 和机器可读结构。
在客户域名添加 JSON-LD、llms.txt、FAQ schema，并支持服务端渲染。
创建和改写页面，追踪生成的回答、引用位置、竞品引用来源和下降提醒。
官方产品材料列出 Google、ChatGPT、Claude、Perplexity、Gemini 和 Google AI Overviews。
提供免费审计和有限套餐，以及付费内容、技术动作和引用追踪层级。

audience.en: SEO and content teams that want both website-level AEO fixes and an ongoing content and citation-tracking workflow on their own domain.
audience.zh: 希望在自有域名同时完成网站级 AEO 修复、持续内容生产和引用追踪的 SEO 与内容团队。

description.en: Audit existing pages for missing direct answers, schema, FAQs, and parseability, then implement supported technical and content changes on the customer's domain.
description.zh: 检查现有页面是否缺失直接回答、schema、FAQ 和可解析性，再在客户域名实施支持的技术和内容改动。

summary.en: Find and implement missing direct answers, schema, FAQs, and parseability fixes on the customer's domain.
summary.zh: 在客户域名发现并实施缺失的直接回答、schema、FAQ 和可解析性修复。

description.en: Create or rewrite pages and review which answers cite the site, where the citation appears, which competitors are cited instead, and where visibility declines.
description.zh: 创建或改写页面，并查看哪些回答引用该站、引用出现的位置、哪些竞品被引用以及曝光在何处下降。

summary.en: Create or rewrite pages and inspect citation positions, competitor sources, and visibility declines.
summary.zh: 创建或改写页面，并检查引用位置、竞品来源和曝光下降。

description.en: Free is USD 0 with an audit, 5 keywords, a 7-day plan, 2 sample articles, one run of 10 prompts across 3 AI platforms, and a 5-action preview; no card is required.
description.zh: Free 为 0 美元，包含审计、5 个关键词、7 天计划、2 篇示例文章、一次跨 3 个 AI 平台的 10 个问题运行，以及 5 项动作预览；无需信用卡。

summary.en: Free USD 0: audit, 5 keywords, 7-day plan, 2 samples, one 10-prompt run on 3 platforms, 5-action preview; no card.
summary.zh: Free 0 美元：审计、5 个关键词、7 天计划、2 篇示例、3 个平台一次 10 问题运行、5 项动作预览；无需信用卡。

description.en: Starter is USD 199/month with 10 published articles, 50 prompts on 3 platforms every 14 days, all actions, technical fixes, internal links, and unlimited rewrites and users. Growth is USD 499/month with 20 articles, 150 prompts on 3 platforms, competitor and citation tracking, and Slack.
description.zh: Starter 为每月 199 美元，含 10 篇已发布文章、每 14 天在 3 个平台运行 50 个问题、全部动作、技术修复、内链，以及不限次改写和用户。Growth 为每月 499 美元，含 20 篇文章、3 个平台 150 个问题、竞品与引用追踪以及 Slack。

summary.en: Starter USD 199/month: 10 articles and 50 prompts/3 platforms per 14 days; Growth USD 499/month: 20 articles and 150 prompts/3 platforms.
summary.zh: Starter 199 美元/月：10 篇文章、每 14 天 50 问题/3 平台；Growth 499 美元/月：20 篇文章、150 问题/3 平台。

description.en: Expert is custom-priced and adds human advisory support. Its service scope is not treated as the same product configuration as the self-service Starter or Growth plans.
description.zh: Expert 采用自定义价格并增加人工顾问支持。其服务范围不与自助式 Starter 或 Growth 套餐视为同一产品配置。

summary.en: Expert is custom-priced with human advisory support, separate from self-service plan configuration.
summary.zh: Expert 自定义报价并含人工顾问支持，不同于自助套餐配置。

description.en: Product materials name more engines than the plan cards: the FAQ includes Gemini and Google AI Overviews, while Starter and Growth still specify prompt tracking on 3 AI platforms. The included engine set must be confirmed for the selected plan.
description.zh: 产品材料列出的引擎多于套餐卡：FAQ 包含 Gemini 和 Google AI Overviews，而 Starter 与 Growth 仍写明在 3 个 AI 平台追踪问题。所选套餐实际包含的引擎集合需要确认。

summary.en: Product-level engine list is broader than the 3-platform plan cards; confirm the selected plan's engine set.
summary.zh: 产品级引擎清单比套餐卡的 3 平台范围更广；须确认所选套餐的引擎集合。

description.en: The terms and privacy notice show Last Updated Jan 29 without a year. They do not clearly name AI suppliers or provide an explicit customer-content no-training clause, and the terms permit reuse of anonymized data, generalized learnings, and non-client-specific outputs.
description.zh: 条款和隐私说明显示 Last Updated Jan 29，但缺少年份；未清楚列出 AI 供应商，也没有明确的客户内容不用于训练条款。条款允许复用匿名数据、泛化学习成果和不特定于客户的输出。

summary.en: Legal dates lack a year; AI suppliers/no-training are unclear, and anonymized learnings may be reused.
summary.zh: 法律日期缺年份；AI 供应商和不训练条款不清楚，且可能复用匿名学习成果。

description.en: The free tier is a limited audit and preview, not an ongoing full content-production tier. Paid prompt quotas reset on the stated schedule and are shared across the 3 included platforms.
description.zh: Free 是有限的审计和预览，不是持续的完整内容生产层。付费问题配额按所述周期重置，并在包含的 3 个平台之间共享。

summary.en: Free is a limited preview; paid prompt quotas reset on schedule and are shared across 3 platforms.
summary.zh: Free 仅为有限预览；付费问题配额按周期重置并在 3 个平台共享。

description.en: Consider RankAI when the job requires website remediation as well as content and citation tracking, rather than monitoring alone; confirm plan-level engines and the undated legal revision before procurement.
description.zh: 如果任务同时需要网站修复、内容生产和引用追踪，而不只是监测，可考虑 RankAI；采购前须确认套餐级引擎范围和法律文本缺失的年份。

summary.en: Fits combined remediation, content, and citation work; verify plan engines and the missing legal revision year.
summary.zh: 适合修复、内容与引用联动；须核实套餐引擎和法律文本缺失的年份。

label.en: RankAI product overview and named answer surfaces
label.zh: RankAI 产品概览与所列回答界面

description.en: Enterprise content AI workflow that combines first-party demand, market research, approved company knowledge, brand rules, and design-system constraints to refresh existing pages or create missing ones with human approval.
description.zh: 企业内容 AI 工作流，结合一方需求、市场研究、已批准的公司知识、品牌规则和设计系统约束，在人工批准下刷新现有页面或创建缺失页面。

en: Enterprise GEO
Content optimization
Human approval
zh: 企业 GEO
内容优化
人工审批

en: Refreshes blogs, landing pages, and product pages while protecting selected existing elements.
Creates missing pages from demand gaps, competitor coverage, company knowledge, approved claims, and design-system patterns.
Produces page briefs, section plans, keyword and prompt targets, proof plans, metadata, links, FAQ schema, and full drafts.
Keeps sources, decisions, revisions, comments, and workflow handoff records attached to the work.
Requires human acceptance and states that controlled context informs the work only and never trains a foundation model.
zh: 刷新博客、落地页和产品页，同时保护指定的现有元素。
根据需求缺口、竞品覆盖、公司知识、已批准声明和设计系统模式创建缺失页面。
生成页面简报、章节计划、关键词和问题目标、证据计划、元数据、链接、FAQ schema 和完整草稿。
把来源、决策、修订、评论和工作流交接记录附属于具体工作。
要求人工接受，并声明受控上下文仅用于当前工作，不用于训练基础模型。

audience.en: Enterprise marketing and content operations teams with approved claims libraries, design systems, compliance review, and formal publishing controls.
audience.zh: 拥有已批准声明库、设计系统、合规审核和正式发布控制的企业营销与内容运营团队。

description.en: Refresh a decaying page by researching current demand and competitor coverage, protecting approved passages, rewriting only selected sections, and recording sources and decisions for review.
description.zh: 通过研究当前需求和竞品覆盖刷新衰减页面，保护已批准段落，仅改写指定章节，并记录来源和决策供审核。

summary.en: Refresh selected page sections from current demand while preserving protected passages and an audit trail.
summary.zh: 根据当前需求刷新指定页面章节，同时保护既有段落并保留审计记录。

description.en: Create a missing landing page from an approved opportunity, map each section to keywords and prompts, draft in the company's design patterns, and hand off an approved CMS draft.
description.zh: 从已批准机会创建缺失落地页，把每个章节映射到关键词和问题，按公司设计模式起草，并交接已批准的 CMS 草稿。

summary.en: Create a missing page from an approved opportunity and hand off a design-aligned, reviewed CMS draft.
summary.zh: 从已批准机会创建缺失页面，并交接符合设计规范、经审核的 CMS 草稿。

description.en: No public rate is published for Content AI. The official pricing path offers a request-demo flow with no credit card, a 30-minute call, and a free trial included; final scope and price require a tailored quote.
description.zh: Content AI 未公开费率。官方定价入口提供申请演示流程，无需信用卡，包含 30 分钟通话和免费试用；最终范围和价格需要定制报价。

summary.en: No public rate; request a demo for a tailored quote, with no card, a 30-minute call, and a trial included.
summary.zh: 无公开费率；申请演示获取定制报价，无需信用卡，含 30 分钟通话和试用。

description.en: The product demonstration uses illustrative data and labels movement as projected. WordPress appears as a selected example in the demo, not as evidence of a measured result or universal CMS support.
description.zh: 产品演示使用示意数据，并把变化标记为预测。WordPress 在演示中是选定示例，不代表实测结果或通用 CMS 支持。

summary.en: Demo data is illustrative and movement is projected; WordPress is an example, not a measured result or universal support claim.
summary.zh: 演示数据为示意、变化为预测；WordPress 是示例，不代表实测或通用支持。

description.en: The terms limit AI Output to the Subscriber's internal business purposes and require publication to be configured or approved by the Subscriber. Agency delivery or client-owned publication should be checked against the contract.
description.zh: 条款把 AI Output 限定于订阅方的内部商业用途，并要求由订阅方配置或批准发布。代理商交付或客户自有发布场景应核对合同。

summary.en: AI Output is limited to internal business purposes and requires subscriber-configured or approved publication.
summary.zh: AI Output 限内部商业用途，发布须由订阅方配置或批准。

description.en: The terms grant Quattr a broad, perpetual, worldwide license to Subscriber data for service delivery and non-identifiable aggregate trends or statistics, alongside a statement that questions, inputs, and outputs are not used to train AI models.
description.zh: 条款授予 Quattr 广泛、永久、全球的数据许可，用于服务交付和不可识别的聚合趋势或统计；同时声明问题、输入和输出不用于训练 AI 模型。

summary.en: Subscriber data carries a broad perpetual license for service and aggregate uses, while AI training on inputs/outputs is prohibited.
summary.zh: 订阅方数据附带用于服务和聚合用途的广泛永久许可，但禁止用输入/输出训练 AI。

description.en: Plugin and MCP tool-call records and product analytics events are retained for up to 12 months; retention for other platform data, query results, and generated artifacts is governed by the customer agreement.
description.zh: 插件和 MCP 工具调用记录及产品分析事件最多保留 12 个月；其他平台数据、查询结果和生成产物的保留期限由客户协议约定。

summary.en: Plugin/MCP records and analytics events: up to 12 months; other data and artifacts follow the customer agreement.
summary.zh: 插件/MCP 记录和分析事件最多 12 个月；其他数据和产物按客户协议保留。

description.en: Quattr fits controlled enterprise workflows where approved evidence, design-system consistency, protected content, and human sign-off matter; procurement should resolve custom pricing, output-use rights, and data-license scope.
description.zh: Quattr 适合重视已批准证据、设计系统一致性、内容保护和人工签批的受控企业流程；采购时应解决自定义价格、输出使用权和数据许可范围。

summary.en: Fits controlled enterprise content operations; resolve custom pricing, output-use rights, and data-license scope.
summary.zh: 适合受控企业内容运营；须明确自定义价格、输出使用权和数据许可范围。

label.en: Quattr Content AI workflow and demonstration boundaries
label.zh: Quattr Content AI 工作流与演示边界
Quattr 开始使用演示流程

description.en: Semantic content planning and writing platform with Content Designer briefs, entity and competitor analysis, drafts, exports, and an optional AI Visibility add-on for answer-engine mentions and citations.
description.zh: 语义内容规划与写作平台，提供 Content Designer 简报、实体和竞品分析、草稿、导出，以及可选 AI Visibility 附加模块，用于查看回答引擎提及和引用。

en: Semantic SEO
Content design
AI visibility
zh: 语义 SEO
内容设计
AI 曝光

en: Uses semantic NLP and entity analysis to plan content around Google, AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini.
Content Designer produces titles, metadata, H1-H3 structure, factual drafts, brand and people context, and competitor or document facts.
Supports collaboration and DOCX, HTML, and WordPress export or publishing workflows.
AI Visibility reports share of voice, mentions, domain citations, sentiment, competitors, technical readiness, and optimization tasks.
Advanced AI Monitoring names Google, AI Overviews, AI Mode, ChatGPT, and Perplexity; the main site also names Gemini.
zh: 使用语义 NLP 和实体分析，围绕 Google、AI Overviews、ChatGPT、Perplexity 和 Gemini 规划内容。
Content Designer 生成标题、元数据、H1-H3 结构、事实草稿、品牌和人物上下文，并提取竞品或文档事实。
支持协作，以及 DOCX、HTML 和 WordPress 导出或发布流程。
AI Visibility 报告分享声量、提及、域名引用、情绪、竞品、技术就绪度和优化任务。
Advanced AI Monitoring 列出 Google、AI Overviews、AI Mode、ChatGPT 和 Perplexity；主站另列出 Gemini。

audience.en: SEO-led editorial teams that need semantic briefs and entity-driven drafts, with optional monitoring of AI answer visibility.
audience.zh: 需要语义简报和实体驱动草稿、并可选监测 AI 回答曝光情况的 SEO 主导编辑团队。

description.en: Build a content plan from semantic and entity analysis, then use Content Designer to create titles, headings, metadata, factual draft sections, and competitor-informed notes before export or WordPress handoff.
description.zh: 从语义和实体分析建立内容计划，再用 Content Designer 创建标题、小标题、元数据、事实草稿章节和竞品参考笔记，最后导出或交接 WordPress。

summary.en: Turn semantic and entity analysis into structured briefs, factual draft sections, and CMS-ready handoff.
summary.zh: 把语义和实体分析转为结构化简报、事实草稿章节和 CMS 交接。

description.en: Review AI Visibility metrics such as share of voice, mentions, domain citations, sentiment, competitor presence, and technical readiness, then convert findings into optimization tasks.
description.zh: 查看分享声量、提及、域名引用、情绪、竞品出现和技术就绪度等 AI Visibility 指标，再把发现转为优化任务。

summary.en: Review mentions, citations, sentiment, competitors, and readiness, then create optimization tasks.
summary.zh: 查看提及、引用、情绪、竞品和就绪度，再建立优化任务。

description.en: The reviewed Black Friday annual prices are Bronze at USD 11.5/month equivalent, billed USD 138/year, with 2 projects, 25 analyses, 5 standard questions, and 15,000 credits; Gold at USD 34.5/month equivalent, billed USD 414/year, with 10 projects, 75 analyses, 10 questions, 45,000 credits, Content Designer, team features, and 75 plagiarism checks; Yellow Diamond at USD 81.5/month equivalent, billed USD 978/year, with 100 projects, 200 analyses, 30 questions, 105,000 credits, and 200 plagiarism checks.
description.zh: 本次核验的 Black Friday 年付价格为：Bronze 折合每月 11.5 美元、每年扣款 138 美元，含 2 个项目、25 次分析、5 个标准问题和 15,000 积分；Gold 折合每月 34.5 美元、每年扣款 414 美元，含 10 个项目、75 次分析、10 个问题、45,000 积分、Content Designer、团队功能和 75 次查重；Yellow Diamond 折合每月 81.5 美元、每年扣款 978 美元，含 100 个项目、200 次分析、30 个问题、105,000 积分和 200 次查重。

summary.en: Annual promo: Bronze USD 138/year, Gold USD 414/year, Yellow Diamond USD 978/year; Content Designer starts at Gold.
summary.zh: 年付促销：Bronze 138 美元/年、Gold 414 美元/年、Yellow Diamond 978 美元/年；Content Designer 从 Gold 起。

description.en: Advanced AI Monitoring starts at USD 9/month for 10 questions. The current FAQ describes a 7-day Gold trial and a first-purchase refund request window of 30 days; these are promotional or support statements, not a promise of a permanent free plan or a contract-wide renewal price.
description.zh: Advanced AI Monitoring 以每月 9 美元起提供 10 个问题。当前 FAQ 说明 7 天 Gold 试用和首次购买后 30 天退款申请窗口；这些属于促销或支持说明，不代表永久免费套餐，也不是续费价格的合同承诺。

summary.en: AI Monitoring add-on from USD 9/month for 10 questions; 7-day Gold trial and first-purchase 30-day refund request are stated.
summary.zh: AI Monitoring 附加模块 9 美元/月起含 10 个问题；页面说明 7 天 Gold 试用和首次购买 30 天退款申请。

description.en: The reviewed annual prices are promotional and the later renewal price is not disclosed on the cited pricing material. Bronze does not include Content Designer, and Advanced AI Monitoring is an add-on rather than a universal plan entitlement.
description.zh: 本次核验的年付价格属于促销，所引定价材料未披露后续续费价。Bronze 不含 Content Designer，Advanced AI Monitoring 也是附加模块，而非所有套餐通用权益。

summary.en: Post-promo renewal price is undisclosed; Bronze excludes Content Designer and AI Monitoring is an add-on.
summary.zh: 促销后续费价未披露；Bronze 不含 Content Designer，AI Monitoring 为附加模块。

description.en: The pricing-page footer gives Kamienna 20 in Zamosc, while the terms and privacy notice give Łapiguz 10, 22-400 Zamość. The terms are dated February 3, 2023, the privacy notice has no visible update date, and neither clearly lists AI suppliers or a no-training commitment.
description.zh: 定价页页脚给出 Zamosc 的 Kamienna 20，而条款和隐私说明给出 Łapiguz 10, 22-400 Zamość。条款日期为 2023-02-03，隐私说明无可见更新日期，两者也未清楚列出 AI 供应商或不训练承诺。

summary.en: Official addresses conflict; terms are from 2023, privacy is undated, and AI supplier/no-training details are unclear.
summary.zh: 官方地址不一致；条款为 2023 年、隐私无日期，AI 供应商和不训练细节不清楚。

description.en: Content export and publishing depend on the selected format and CMS connection. GSC, WordPress, Shopify, own OpenAI key, Neuron API, MCP, and AI Assistant access are listed for Gold and higher rather than Bronze.
description.zh: 内容导出和发布取决于所选格式和 CMS 连接。GSC、WordPress、Shopify、自有 OpenAI 密钥、Neuron API、MCP 和 AI Assistant 访问权列于 Gold 及以上套餐，而非 Bronze。

summary.en: Export/publishing needs the selected format or CMS; listed GSC, Shopify, API, and MCP access starts at Gold.
summary.zh: 导出/发布需所选格式或 CMS；所列 GSC、Shopify、API 和 MCP 权限从 Gold 起。

description.en: NEURONwriter is a fit for teams whose existing process starts with semantic and entity analysis and needs Content Designer plus optional answer visibility; verify renewal pricing, the address discrepancy, and AI-processing terms before purchase.
description.zh: 如果团队已有流程从语义和实体分析开始，并需要 Content Designer 加可选回答曝光监测，NEURONwriter 较契合；购买前应核实续费价、地址差异和 AI 处理条款。

summary.en: Fits semantic/entity-led briefs with optional AI visibility; verify renewal price, address conflict, and AI terms.
summary.zh: 适合语义/实体驱动的简报和可选 AI 曝光；须核实续费价、地址冲突和 AI 条款。

label.zh: NEURONwriter 当前年付促销价格
NEURONwriter Black Friday 优惠说明

description.en: On-page optimization suite whose POP AI Writer turns existing reports and Content Briefs into full drafts or guided rewrites with live optimization feedback, rich content blocks, and optional own-model keys.
description.zh: 页面优化套件，其 POP AI Writer 把现有报告和 Content Briefs 转为完整草稿或引导式改写，提供实时优化反馈、丰富内容块和可选自有模型密钥。

en: AI Writer
Content briefs
On-page optimization
zh: AI 写作
内容简报
页面优化

en: Starts from POP report terms, targets, structure, Google NLP signals, E-E-A-T signals, schema, and optimization targets.
Offers Fast Draft for a full first pass and Guided Premium for title and outline review before drafting.
Builds tables, FAQs, images, comparison blocks, lists, and key takeaways with live optimization feedback.
Can use existing published content as rewrite inspiration and supports section-level regeneration or refinement.
Names ChatGPT, Google, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity in official AI Writer materials.
zh: 从 POP 报告术语、目标、结构、Google NLP 信号、E-E-A-T 信号、schema 和优化目标开始。
Fast Draft 生成完整初稿，Guided Premium 可在起草前审核标题和大纲。
生成表格、FAQ、图片、对比块、列表和关键要点，并提供实时优化反馈。
可使用已发布内容作为改写参考，并支持章节级重生或细化。
官方 AI Writer 材料列出 ChatGPT、Google、Gemini、Claude 和 Perplexity。

audience.en: SEO specialists, agencies, and content teams already using POP reports who need controlled draft generation or existing-page rewrites.
audience.zh: 已经使用 POP 报告、需要受控草稿生成或现有页面改写的 SEO 专家、代理商和内容团队。

description.en: Create a full page from a POP report and Content Brief, choosing Fast Draft or reviewing the title and outline first with Guided Premium, then applying live SEO and quality feedback.
description.zh: 根据 POP 报告和 Content Brief 创建完整页面，可选择 Fast Draft，或先用 Guided Premium 审核标题和大纲，再应用实时 SEO 与质量反馈。

summary.en: Draft a full page from a POP brief with fast or guided controls and live optimization feedback.
summary.zh: 根据 POP 简报生成完整页面，提供快速或引导式控制及实时优化反馈。

description.en: Rewrite an existing page by using its published URL, headings, and selected sections as inspiration, then adjust revision strength and regenerate individual sections against the report targets.
description.zh: 使用现有页面 URL、标题和指定章节作为灵感改写页面，再按报告目标调整改写强度并重生单个章节。

summary.en: Rewrite existing pages from their URL and selected sections, then refine sections against report targets.
summary.zh: 根据现有 URL 和指定章节改写页面，再按报告目标细化章节。

description.en: Standard monthly prices are Basic at USD 40 with 20 credits, Unlimited at USD 72 with 50 credits, and Teams at USD 143 with 120 credits. Standard annual prices display Unlimited at USD 62/month equivalent with an actual USD 739 annual bill and Teams at USD 119/month equivalent with an actual USD 1,425 annual bill.
description.zh: 标准月付为 Basic 40 美元含 20 积分、Unlimited 72 美元含 50 积分、Teams 143 美元含 120 积分。标准年付中，Unlimited 展示折合每月 62 美元、实际每年 739 美元；Teams 展示折合每月 119 美元、实际每年 1,425 美元。

summary.en: Monthly: Basic USD 40/20 credits, Unlimited USD 72/50, Teams USD 143/120. Annual: Unlimited USD 739/year, Teams USD 1,425/year.
summary.zh: 月付：Basic 40 美元/20 积分、Unlimited 72/50、Teams 143/120；年付：Unlimited 739 美元/年、Teams 1,425 美元/年。

description.en: The 2026-11-24 through 2026-11-30 offer lists Unlimited Monthly at USD 54 for the first month, renewing at the regular USD 72/month, with no annual commitment, monthly cancellation, and a 7-day refund guarantee.
description.zh: 2026-11-24 至 2026-11-30 的优惠将 Unlimited Monthly 首月列为 54 美元，之后按常规每月 72 美元续费，无年度承诺，可按月取消，并提供 7 天退款保证。

summary.en: Unlimited Monthly promo: USD 54 first month, then USD 72/month; monthly cancellation and 7-day refund guarantee.
summary.zh: Unlimited Monthly 促销：首月 54 美元，之后 72 美元/月；可按月取消，7 天退款保证。

description.en: The AI Writer product page and dedicated help page state 3 POP credits per 1,000 words when using POP credits, or a flat 2 POP credits per 500-4,000-word article with an own OpenAI or Claude key plus separate provider charges. Each article includes 5 regeneration credits and 2 SEO and Quality fix runs.
description.zh: AI Writer 产品页和专用帮助页说明，使用 POP 积分时每 1,000 词消耗 3 个 POP 积分；使用自有 OpenAI 或 Claude 密钥时，每篇 500-4,000 词文章固定消耗 2 个 POP 积分，供应商费用另计。每篇文章含 5 个重生积分和 2 次 SEO 与质量修复。

summary.en: POP credits: 3 per 1,000 words; own OpenAI/Claude key: 2 credits per 500-4,000-word article plus provider fees.
summary.zh: POP 积分每 1,000 词 3 个；自有 OpenAI/Claude 密钥每篇 500-4,000 词 2 个积分，供应商费用另计。

description.en: Credits generally do not roll over unless stated otherwise. Unlimited fair use limits a single user to 450 qualifying page runs per rolling 90 days and a team to 900; Watchdog, API, and extra-credit runs are excluded.
description.zh: 除非另有说明，积分通常不结转。Unlimited 的公平使用限制为：单用户每滚动 90 天最多 450 次符合条件的页面运行，团队最多 900 次；Watchdog、API 和额外积分运行不计入。

summary.en: Credits generally do not roll over; Unlimited fair use is 450 single-user or 900 team page runs per rolling 90 days, with exclusions.
summary.zh: 积分通常不结转；Unlimited 公平使用为每滚动 90 天单用户 450 次、团队 900 次页面运行，另有排除项。

description.en: The pricing page retains inconsistent text: one area says 4 POP credits per 1,000 words while the AI Writer page and dedicated help page say 3, and the pricing page says 61 languages while the AI Writer page says 95+. This record relies on the product and dedicated help pages for the writer credit rule and does not assert a single global language total.
description.zh: 定价页保留不一致文字：一处写每 1,000 词 4 个 POP 积分，而 AI Writer 页和专用帮助页写 3 个；定价页写 61 种语言，AI Writer 页写 95 种以上。本记录的写作积分规则采用产品页和专用帮助页，不主张单一全局语言总数。

summary.en: Official pages conflict on 3 vs 4 writer credits and 61 vs 95+ languages; confirm at checkout.
summary.zh: 官方页面在写作积分 3 与 4、语言 61 与 95 种以上上不一致；须在结账时确认。

description.en: The terms select Wyoming law but designate Washington courts. The privacy notice does not provide detailed AI-processing or customer-content no-training language, so that policy remains an explicit information gap.
description.zh: 条款选择 Wyoming 法律，但指定 Washington 法院。隐私说明没有详细的 AI 处理或客户内容不用于训练条款，因此该政策仍为明确的信息缺口。

summary.en: Wyoming law and Washington courts differ; detailed AI processing and no-training language are not published.
summary.zh: 法律适用 Wyoming、法院为 Washington；未公布详细 AI 处理和不训练条款。

description.en: Fast Draft and Guided Premium have the same base generation cost, but word count, research, images, and other optional paid extras can increase credit use. Bulk generation of up to 50 articles is limited to Unlimited and Teams.
description.zh: Fast Draft 和 Guided Premium 的基础生成成本相同，但字数、研究、图片和其他可选付费项目可能增加积分消耗。最多 50 篇的批量生成仅限 Unlimited 和 Teams。

summary.en: Draft modes share base cost; extras can add credits, and 50-article batches require Unlimited or Teams.
summary.zh: 两种起草模式基础成本相同；附加项可能耗积分，50 篇批量生成需 Unlimited 或 Teams。

description.en: Page Optimizer Pro is a fit when the editorial process already starts from a POP report and needs guided drafting or rewriting; account for fair-use limits, credit extras, and the law-versus-court mismatch before purchase.
description.zh: 如果编辑流程已经从 POP 报告开始，并需要引导式起草或改写，Page Optimizer Pro 较契合；购买前应考虑公平使用限制、额外积分成本和法律与法院地不一致。

summary.en: Fits POP-report-led drafting and rewriting; account for fair use, credit extras, and the law/court mismatch.
summary.zh: 适合 POP 报告驱动的起草和改写；须考虑公平使用、额外积分及法律/法院地不一致。

label.zh: Page Optimizer Pro 产品概览

label.zh: POP AI Writer 功能与积分规则
POP AI Writer 积分帮助

label.en: Page Optimizer Pro Black Friday 2026 offer
label.zh: Page Optimizer Pro 2026 Black Friday 优惠
Page Optimizer Pro 隐私政策

description.en: Enterprise GEO platform that connects AI answer monitoring and content-gap analysis to brand-governed agents for briefs, claims, FAQs, schema, and long-form content routed through human review.
description.zh: 企业 GEO 平台，把 AI 回答监测和内容缺口分析连接到受品牌治理的智能体，生成简报、声明、FAQ、schema 和长文，并进入人工审核流程。

en: Enterprise GEO
Brand governance
AI search agents
zh: 企业 GEO
品牌治理
AI 搜索智能体

en: Monitors brand presence, citation rate, sentiment, competitive displacement, and content gaps across major AI answer engines.
Uses brand context and governance rules to produce citation-ready drafts that enter an existing human review process.
Includes agents for AI readiness, fact density, entity mapping, schema, comparison briefs, query planning, citable claims, FAQs, and pillar articles.
Names ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Copilot as AI surfaces.
Connects with workflows and CMS platforms including WordPress, Webflow, Contentful, Asana, Monday, and Notion.
zh: 在主要 AI 回答引擎监测品牌出现、引用率、情绪、竞品替代和内容缺口。
使用品牌上下文和治理规则生成引用就绪草稿，并进入现有人工审核流程。
提供 AI 就绪度、事实密度、实体映射、schema、对比简报、问题规划、可引用声明、FAQ 和支柱文章智能体。
明确列出 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 和 Copilot 作为 AI 界面。
可连接 WordPress、Webflow、Contentful、Asana、Monday 和 Notion 等工作流及 CMS。

audience.en: Enterprise marketing teams that need brand-controlled GEO content production, formal review, and coordination across an existing martech stack.
audience.zh: 需要受品牌控制的 GEO 内容生产、正式审核，并协调现有营销技术栈的企业营销团队。

description.en: Use citation, sentiment, competitor, and content-gap signals to create a prioritized response backlog grounded in brand voice, audience definitions, and governance rules.
description.zh: 利用引用、情绪、竞品和内容缺口信号，建立以品牌语气、受众定义和治理规则为基础的优先响应清单。

summary.en: Turn citation and gap signals into a brand-governed, prioritized content response backlog.
summary.zh: 把引用和缺口信号转为受品牌治理的优先内容响应清单。

description.en: Generate comparison briefs, citable claims, FAQs, schema, and pillar articles with specialized agents, then route drafts through human approval into the existing CMS or workflow stack.
description.zh: 使用专用智能体生成对比简报、可引用声明、FAQ、schema 和支柱文章，再经人工批准路由到现有 CMS 或工作流栈。

summary.en: Generate briefs, claims, FAQs, schema, and pillar articles, then route reviewed drafts to the existing stack.
summary.zh: 生成简报、声明、FAQ、schema 和支柱文章，再把审核后的草稿交接现有系统。

description.en: GEO is available only on Business, which uses custom Contact Sales pricing and requires at least a 12-month commitment. GEO Hub and Agents consume usage credits alongside Business seat pricing, so a seat price alone is not the GEO cost.
description.zh: GEO 仅提供于 Business，采用自定义 Contact Sales 价格，并要求至少 12 个月承诺。GEO Hub 和 Agents 与 Business 席位价格并行消耗用量积分，因此仅看席位价格不等于 GEO 成本。

summary.en: GEO is Business-only: custom price, minimum 12-month commitment, with Hub/Agents credits in addition to seats.
summary.zh: GEO 仅 Business：自定义价格、至少 12 个月承诺，Hub/Agents 积分另与席位并行消耗。

description.en: Pro is listed at USD 69/month or USD 59/month when billed yearly, but it does not include GEO. The 7-day trial is a Pro trial and is not evidence of a free GEO tier.
description.zh: Pro 标价为每月 69 美元，或年付折合每月 59 美元，但不包含 GEO。7 天试用是 Pro 试用，不代表存在免费 GEO 层。

summary.en: Pro USD 69/month or USD 59/month billed yearly excludes GEO; the 7-day Pro trial is not a free GEO tier.
summary.zh: Pro 69 美元/月或年付折合 59 美元/月不含 GEO；7 天 Pro 试用不是免费 GEO 层。

description.en: GEO pricing is custom, requires at least 12 months, and combines seat and usage-credit consumption. Teams should request a quote that identifies both components and the expected agent workload.
description.zh: GEO 价格自定义、至少承诺 12 个月，并同时消耗席位和用量积分。团队应要求报价分别说明两部分及预期智能体工作量。

summary.en: Custom annual commitment plus seat and usage-credit costs; quote both components and expected workload.
summary.zh: 自定义年度承诺，席位与用量积分并行计费；报价须明确两部分和预期工作量。

description.en: Agent drafts inherit brand governance but still require human approval. CMS and workflow connections are delivery prerequisites and are not additional AI answer engines.
description.zh: 智能体草稿继承品牌治理，但仍需人工批准。CMS 和工作流连接属于交付前提，不代表额外的 AI 回答引擎。

summary.en: Human approval remains required; CMS/workflow integrations are delivery prerequisites, not AI engines.
summary.zh: 仍需人工批准；CMS/工作流集成是交付前提，不是 AI 引擎。

description.en: The Data Processing Addendum applies only when signed or incorporated into the agreement. The Business SaaS Agreement prohibits training AI models on Customer Property, but the DPA should not be assumed to apply automatically to every account.
description.zh: 数据处理附录仅在签署或纳入协议时适用。Business SaaS Agreement 禁止用 Customer Property 训练 AI 模型，但不应假定 DPA 自动适用于所有账户。

summary.en: Customer Property is protected from model training; the DPA applies only when signed or incorporated.
summary.zh: Customer Property 受不用于模型训练的保护；DPA 仅在签署或纳入时适用。

description.en: Jasper is a fit for enterprise teams that need governed agents and formal review across an existing stack; procurement should focus on Business-only custom pricing, credit consumption, and DPA incorporation.
description.zh: 如果企业团队需要在现有技术栈中运行受治理智能体并保留正式审核，Jasper 较契合；采购重点应放在 Business 自定义价格、积分消耗和 DPA 纳入方式。

summary.en: Fits governed enterprise agents with formal review; resolve Business pricing, credits, and DPA incorporation.
summary.zh: 适合有正式审核的企业治理智能体；须明确 Business 价格、积分和 DPA 纳入。

label.zh: Jasper GEO 平台与智能体
Jasper 定价与 Business 套餐

description.en: Content strategy module that maps a site's content landscape, prioritizes create, refresh, or optimize work, produces briefs, and drafts sections or full pages with accessibility, technical SEO, and AI-readiness inputs.
description.zh: 内容策略模块，绘制网站内容全景，确定创建、刷新或优化的优先顺序，生成简报，并结合无障碍、技术 SEO 和 AI 就绪度输入起草章节或完整页面。

en: Content strategy
AI readiness
Content briefs
zh: 内容策略
AI 就绪度
内容简报

en: Uses agents to map the content landscape and decide what to create, refresh, or optimize.
Creates prioritized plans and briefs, then drafts sections or full pages from those briefs.
Incorporates accessibility, technical SEO, and AI-readiness checks to support content discovery, understanding, and citation.
Can turn SEO/AEO research and competitor or AI-engine-cited content into actionable briefs.
Lists Optimizely, Sitecore, and WordPress integrations; MarketMuse planning and research capabilities now sit within Siteimprove.
zh: 使用智能体绘制内容全景，并决定创建、刷新或优化哪些内容。
建立优先计划和简报，再根据简报起草章节或完整页面。
结合无障碍、技术 SEO 和 AI 就绪度检查，支持内容被发现、理解和引用。
可把 SEO/AEO 研究以及竞品或 AI 引擎引用内容转为可执行简报。
列出 Optimizely、Sitecore 和 WordPress 集成；MarketMuse 的规划和研究能力现已归入 Siteimprove。

audience.en: Established content operations teams already evaluating Siteimprove or MarketMuse-style planning, briefs, and governed drafting workflows.
audience.zh: 已经评估 Siteimprove 或 MarketMuse 式规划、简报和受治理起草流程的成熟内容运营团队。

description.en: Map the existing content landscape, identify create, refresh, or optimize priorities, and produce briefs that incorporate accessibility, technical SEO, and AI-readiness inputs.
description.zh: 绘制现有内容全景，确定创建、刷新或优化优先级，并生成结合无障碍、技术 SEO 和 AI 就绪度输入的简报。

summary.en: Map content and prioritize create, refresh, or optimize work with accessibility, SEO, and AI-readiness briefs.
summary.zh: 绘制内容全景，结合无障碍、SEO 和 AI 就绪度确定创建、刷新或优化简报优先级。

description.en: Draft sections or complete pages from an approved brief and hand them into supported content workflows, while keeping human judgment in the editorial decision.
description.zh: 根据已批准简报起草章节或完整页面，交接至支持的内容工作流，并在编辑决策中保留人工判断。

summary.en: Draft sections or full pages from approved briefs and hand them into supported content workflows.
summary.zh: 根据已批准简报起草章节或完整页面，并交接支持的内容工作流。

description.en: No public rate is published for Content Strategy. The official path is Request Demo; fees, limits, renewal increases, and payment terms are set in the Service Order rather than a public price card.
description.zh: Content Strategy 未公开费率。官方入口为申请演示；费用、限额、续费涨幅和付款条款由 Service Order 约定，而不是公开价格表。

summary.en: No public rate; request a demo and confirm fees, limits, renewal increases, and payment terms in the Service Order.
summary.zh: 无公开费率；申请演示，并在 Service Order 确认费用、限额、续费涨幅和付款条款。

description.en: Siteimprove Search materials name Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Perplexity, but that Search/AEO coverage is not treated as proof that Content Strategy independently provides the same monitoring. The platforms field is therefore empty for this module.
description.zh: Siteimprove Search 材料列出 Google AI Overviews、ChatGPT 和 Perplexity，但该 Search/AEO 覆盖范围不被视为 Content Strategy 独立提供相同监测的证明。因此本模块的平台字段留空。

summary.en: Search/AEO engine coverage does not prove independent Content Strategy monitoring; module platforms remain unknown.
summary.zh: Search/AEO 引擎覆盖不能证明 Content Strategy 独立监测；本模块平台保留为未知。

description.en: The MSA refers to Siteimprove as Data Controller in one clause, while the privacy notice describes subscription crawling and analytics as processing on the customer's behalf. The data-role wording should be reconciled in the Service Order or DPA.
description.zh: MSA 某一处把 Siteimprove 称为 Data Controller，而隐私说明把订阅爬取和分析描述为代表客户进行处理。数据角色措辞应在 Service Order 或 DPA 中统一。

summary.en: MSA and privacy wording differ on controller versus processor role; reconcile the role in the contract or DPA.
summary.zh: MSA 与隐私说明在控制者/处理者角色上措辞不同；应在合同或 DPA 中统一。

description.en: AI Features may change, be suspended, or stop without terminating the main agreement. Customers must have rights to submitted material, must not provide Personal Data to AI Features, and must review generated output.
description.zh: AI Features 可能变更、暂停或停止，而不终止主协议。客户必须拥有提交材料权利，不得向 AI Features 提供个人数据，并须审核生成输出。

summary.en: AI Features can change or stop; no Personal Data may be submitted, and generated output requires review.
summary.zh: AI Features 可能变更或停止；不得提交个人数据，且生成输出须审核。

description.en: Siteimprove Content Strategy fits teams that want planning, briefs, and drafting inside an existing Siteimprove relationship; do not infer standalone answer-engine monitoring from the separate Search module, and reconcile data roles in contracting.
description.zh: 如果团队希望在现有 Siteimprove 关系中完成规划、简报和起草，Siteimprove Content Strategy 较契合；不要从独立 Search 模块推断本模块具备独立回答引擎监测，并在签约时统一数据角色。

summary.en: Fits Siteimprove-based planning and drafting; separate Search coverage is not proof of module monitoring, and data roles need reconciliation.
summary.zh: 适合基于 Siteimprove 的规划和起草；独立 Search 覆盖不等于本模块监测，数据角色须统一。

label.zh: Siteimprove 与 MarketMuse 产品关系

description.en: Autonomous SEO/GEO article workflow that researches answer-engine subquestions, generates and optimizes daily content, publishes to supported CMS or GitHub targets, and tracks AI citations.
description.zh: 自主 SEO/GEO 文章工作流，研究回答引擎的子问题，生成并优化每日内容，发布到支持的 CMS 或 GitHub 目标，并追踪 AI 引用。

en: GEO articles
Autonomous publishing
AI citations
zh: GEO 文章
自主发布
AI 引用

en: Uses fan-out query research to identify AI subquestions and build a custom content strategy.
Generates daily articles with answer-first openings, self-contained paragraphs, comparison tables, named sources, and authoritative links.
Adds Article, FAQPage, and BreadcrumbList schema, heading hierarchy, machine-readable dates, image alt text, and contextual internal links.
Publishes to WordPress, Webflow, Shopify, webhooks, or direct GitHub repository commits.
Reports Search Console performance and tracks citations on ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Google AI Overviews.
zh: 使用展开式问题研究识别 AI 子问题，并建立自定义内容策略。
生成每日文章，采用答案优先开头、自包含段落、对比表、具名来源和权威链接。
添加 Article、FAQPage 和 BreadcrumbList schema、标题层级、机器可读日期、图片替代文本和上下文内链。
发布到 WordPress、Webflow、Shopify、webhook，或直接提交 GitHub 仓库。
报告 Search Console 表现，并追踪 ChatGPT、Perplexity、Gemini、Claude 和 Google AI Overviews 上的引用。

audience.en: Lean content teams and technical publishers that want high-volume daily article generation with CMS or repository-based delivery and citation tracking.
audience.zh: 希望通过 CMS 或仓库交付实现高频每日文章生成，并追踪引用的精简内容团队和技术出版团队。

description.en: Research a topic through fan-out buyer questions, turn the results into a content strategy, and generate daily articles with answer-first structure, sourced claims, comparisons, and schema.
description.zh: 通过展开式购买者问题研究主题，将结果转为内容策略，并生成采用答案优先结构、有来源声明、对比和 schema 的每日文章。

summary.en: Turn fan-out buyer questions into a strategy and daily answer-first articles with sources, comparisons, and schema.
summary.zh: 把展开式购买者问题转为策略和每日答案优先文章，包含来源、对比和 schema。

description.en: Publish through a supported CMS, webhook, or GitHub repository, add contextual internal links, and review Search Console performance alongside AI citation tracking.
description.zh: 通过支持的 CMS、webhook 或 GitHub 仓库发布，添加上下文内链，并把 Search Console 表现与 AI 引用追踪一起复核。

summary.en: Publish to CMS, webhook, or GitHub and review Search Console performance with AI citation tracking.
summary.zh: 发布到 CMS、webhook 或 GitHub，并结合 AI 引用追踪复核 Search Console 表现。

description.en: PulseRank lists one plan at USD 499/month. A 7-day full-access trial converts to the USD 499 monthly plan unless canceled before the trial ends.
description.zh: PulseRank 列出单一套餐，价格为每月 499 美元。7 天完整访问试用在结束前未取消，会转为每月 499 美元套餐。

summary.en: One plan: USD 499/month; 7-day full-access trial converts to paid unless canceled before expiry.
summary.zh: 单一套餐 499 美元/月；7 天完整试用，到期前未取消则转为付费。

description.en: Marketing emphasizes zero-touch or autonomous publishing, while the terms require review of AI output. Human review should be treated as an operating requirement, not an optional safeguard.
description.zh: 营销强调零接触或自主发布，而条款要求审核 AI 输出。人工审核应被视为运营要求，而不是可选保障。

summary.en: Autonomous publishing claims coexist with a contractual human-review requirement.
summary.zh: 自主发布宣传与合同要求的人工审核并存。

description.en: The operator is disclosed as Hungarian sole proprietor Zoltan Dross, but no public postal address or tax number is shown in the reviewed legal pages. Hungarian law and courts apply.
description.zh: 运营者披露为匈牙利自然人经营者 Zoltan Dross，但本次核验的法律页面未显示公开邮寄地址或税号。适用匈牙利法律和法院。

summary.en: Operator is a disclosed Hungarian sole proprietor; no public postal address or tax number is shown.
summary.zh: 运营者为已披露的匈牙利自然人经营者；未显示公开邮寄地址或税号。

description.en: The single plan has a high fixed monthly price, and started billing periods or unused time are generally non-refundable except where a statutory withdrawal right or discretionary goodwill refund applies.
description.zh: 单一套餐固定月费较高；已开始的计费周期或未使用时间通常不退，法定撤回权或酌情善意退款除外。

summary.en: USD 499 fixed monthly cost; started periods and unused time are generally non-refundable, subject to legal or goodwill exceptions.
summary.zh: 固定每月 499 美元；已开始周期和未使用时间通常不退，法定或善意例外除外。

description.en: PulseRank fits technical publishers that value daily generation and direct CMS or GitHub delivery; assess the single-plan cost, operator disclosures, and the human-review obligation before enabling autonomous publishing.
description.zh: 如果技术出版团队重视每日生成以及直接 CMS 或 GitHub 交付，PulseRank 较契合；启用自主发布前应评估单一套餐成本、运营者披露和人工审核义务。

summary.en: Fits technical daily publishing with CMS/GitHub delivery; assess fixed cost, operator disclosure, and review obligations.
summary.zh: 适合技术团队每日发布至 CMS/GitHub；须评估固定成本、运营者披露和审核义务。

label.en: PulseRank product, pricing, and publishing workflow
label.zh: PulseRank 产品、定价与发布工作流
PulseRank 关于与内容生成细节

description.en: Daily blog publishing workflow that turns site knowledge and buyer questions into an article calendar, creates AI-ready content with contextual internal links, and checks brand mentions and citations across supported answer engines.
description.zh: 每日博客发布工作流，把网站知识和购买者问题转为文章日历，生成带上下文内链的 AI 就绪内容，并在支持的回答引擎检查品牌提及和引用。

en: Daily publishing
AI visibility
Internal linking
zh: 每日发布
AI 曝光
内链

en: Learns the site's sales content and buyer questions to build a monthly article calendar.
Generates and publishes one article per day, using real sources and removing unsupported numbers.
Holds articles that fail quality checks for review, while Growth can publish automatically.
Adds clear headings, direct explanations, comparison tables, FAQs, and contextual internal links.
Checks ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews for brand mentions and citations, with tier-specific access.
zh: 学习网站销售内容和购买者问题，建立月度文章日历。
每日生成并发布一篇文章，使用真实来源并删除无支持的数字。
未通过质量检查的文章等待审核，Growth 可自动发布。
添加清晰标题、直接解释、对比表、FAQ 和上下文内链。
检查 ChatGPT、Perplexity、Claude、Gemini 和 Google AI Overviews 上的品牌提及与引用，访问范围按套餐区分。

audience.en: Founders, in-house SEO teams, and agencies that want a continuous blog-production workflow with tiered AI citation checks and CMS publishing.
audience.zh: 希望获得持续博客生产流程、分级 AI 引用检查和 CMS 发布的创始人、内部 SEO 团队和代理商。

description.en: Turn site knowledge and buyer questions into a monthly article plan, generate daily articles with direct explanations, comparisons, FAQs, sources, and contextual internal links, then publish through a supported integration.
description.zh: 把网站知识和购买者问题转为月度文章计划，生成带直接解释、对比、FAQ、来源和上下文内链的每日文章，再通过支持的集成发布。

summary.en: Build a monthly plan and publish daily sourced articles with direct explanations, comparisons, FAQs, and internal links.
summary.zh: 建立月度计划，每日发布含直接解释、对比、FAQ 和来源的文章，并添加上下文内链。

description.en: Run recurring checks for domain citations, brand mentions, citation positions, and competing sources across the engines included in the selected plan.
description.zh: 在所选套餐包含的引擎上持续检查域名引用、品牌提及、引用位置和竞品来源。

summary.en: Check domain citations, brand mentions, citation positions, and competing sources on plan-included engines.
summary.zh: 在套餐包含的引擎检查域名引用、品牌提及、引用位置和竞品来源。

description.en: Monthly USD pre-tax prices are Starter at USD 59 with 50 articles, 100 credits, 50 questions, Perplexity/ChatGPT/Claude, up to 500 citation checks including 300 on demand, and a weekly report; Growth at USD 129 with 150 articles, 300 credits, 100 questions per site, 5 active engines, 1,200 checks including 800 on demand, and priority support; Scale at USD 399 with 500 articles, 1,000 credits, 100 questions per site, 5 active engines, 4,000 checks including 2,500 on demand, and white-label reports.
description.zh: 未税月付美元价格为：Starter 59 美元，含 50 篇文章、100 积分、50 个问题、Perplexity/ChatGPT/Claude、最多 500 次引用检查（其中 300 次按需）和周报；Growth 129 美元，含 150 篇文章、300 积分、每站 100 个问题、5 个活跃引擎、1,200 次检查（其中 800 次按需）和优先支持；Scale 399 美元，含 500 篇文章、1,000 积分、每站 100 个问题、5 个活跃引擎、4,000 次检查（其中 2,500 次按需）和白标报告。

summary.en: Monthly USD pre-tax: Starter USD 59/50 articles/100 credits; Growth USD 129/150/300; Scale USD 399/500/1,000, with scaled engine and check quotas.
summary.zh: 未税美元月付：Starter 59 美元/50 篇/100 积分；Growth 129/150/300；Scale 399/500/1,000，引擎和检查配额递增。

description.en: Agency is USD 299/month for 3 active client workspaces, with USD 99/month for each additional active client. Each client has 75 articles/month, up to 3 domains, 100 questions per domain, and 1,200 citation checks/month; setup is handled manually rather than through self-serve checkout.
description.zh: Agency 为每月 299 美元，含 3 个活跃客户工作区，每增加一个活跃客户加收每月 99 美元。每个客户含每月 75 篇文章、最多 3 个域名、每域 100 个问题和每月 1,200 次引用检查；需人工设置，不支持自助结账。

summary.en: Agency USD 299/month for 3 clients, plus USD 99 per additional client; 75 articles and 1,200 checks per client, manually configured.
summary.zh: Agency 299 美元/月含 3 个客户，每增加一个加 99 美元；每客户 75 篇文章、1,200 次检查，人工配置。

description.en: The 3-day trial requires a card and converts to a paid plan on day 3 unless canceled, with 5 trial articles and fewer citation checks. A one-time 14-day money-back guarantee applies after the first successful payment, excludes add-on credits, and generally does not apply after 14 days.
description.zh: 3 天试用需要信用卡，第 3 天未取消会转为付费，试用含 5 篇文章和较少引用检查。首次成功付款后享有一次性 14 天退款保证，不含加购积分，14 天后通常不适用。

summary.en: 3-day card-required trial converts on day 3; one-time 14-day refund after first payment excludes add-on credits.
summary.zh: 3 天试用需信用卡并于第 3 天转价；首次付款后一次性 14 天退款，不含加购积分。

description.en: Each article consumes 1 article and 2 credits, whether it comes from an approved brief, Autopilot, refresh, direct app, MCP, or API. Citation checks, Share of Voice refresh, and CMS publishing do not consume article credits, but credits do not roll over.
description.zh: 每篇文章消耗 1 篇文章额度和 2 个积分，无论来自已批准简报、Autopilot、刷新、应用内、MCP 还是 API。引用检查、分享声量刷新和 CMS 发布不消耗文章额度，但积分不结转。

summary.en: Each article costs 1 article plus 2 credits; checks and publishing do not cost article credits, and credits do not roll over.
summary.zh: 每篇文章耗 1 篇文章额度加 2 积分；检查和发布不耗文章额度，积分不结转。

description.en: Engine access is tiered: Perplexity and ChatGPT start with the trial, Claude with Starter, and Gemini and Google AI Overviews with Growth. Google AI Mode is built but switched off, so it is not listed as a current platform.
description.zh: 引擎访问按套餐分级：Perplexity 和 ChatGPT 从试用起，Claude 从 Starter 起，Gemini 和 Google AI Overviews 从 Growth 起。Google AI Mode 已构建但处于关闭状态，因此不列为当前平台。

summary.en: Claude starts at Starter and Gemini/AI Overviews at Growth; Google AI Mode is switched off.
summary.zh: Claude 从 Starter 起，Gemini/AI Overviews 从 Growth 起；Google AI Mode 已关闭。

description.en: Current integrations include Framer, Ghost, Notion, Shopify, Webflow, Wix, self-hosted WordPress, GA4, and GSC. Looker Studio, Make, n8n, WordPress.com, and Zapier are marked coming soon and are not counted as current capabilities. The privacy notice does not clearly state a customer-content no-training commitment.
description.zh: 当前集成包括 Framer、Ghost、Notion、Shopify、Webflow、Wix、自托管 WordPress、GA4 和 GSC。Looker Studio、Make、n8n、WordPress.com 和 Zapier 标记为即将推出，不计为当前能力。隐私说明未清楚作出客户内容不用于训练的承诺。

summary.en: Several integrations are coming soon; current CMS/analytics connections are limited, and no-training language is not explicit.
summary.zh: 部分集成即将推出；当前 CMS/分析连接有限，且未明确不训练条款。

description.en: Rankwise fits teams that want a daily publishing cadence with plan-dependent AI visibility checks; size the plan around article credits and check quotas, and account for trial conversion and unavailable integrations.
description.zh: 如果团队希望每日发布，并按套餐获得 AI 曝光检查，Rankwise 较契合；应按文章积分和检查配额选择套餐，并考虑试用转价及尚不可用的集成。

summary.en: Fits daily publishing with tiered AI checks; size for article/check quotas and account for trial conversion and integration gaps.
summary.zh: 适合每日发布和分级 AI 检查；须按文章/检查配额选套餐，并考虑试用转价和集成缺口。

label.zh: Rankwise 产品与发布工作流
Rankwise 关于与内容生成细节

label.en: Rankwise pricing, credits, trial, and refund
label.zh: Rankwise 定价、积分、试用与退款
Rankwise 当前和即将推出集成
Rankwise AI 曝光引擎覆盖

description.en: Web analytics that treats AI tools as a distinct referral channel, with trends, traffic share, and AI landing-page reporting. It filters bots and distinguishes clicked AI referrals from crawler requests.
description.zh: 将 AI 工具作为独立引荐渠道的网络分析工具，提供趋势、流量占比和 AI 落地页报告。它会过滤机器人，并区分用户点击带来的 AI 引荐与爬虫请求。

en: AI referral analytics
LLM attribution
Traffic analysis
zh: AI 引荐分析
大模型来源归因
流量分析

en: Dedicated AI Tools traffic channel for sources including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Microsoft Copilot.
AI traffic trends, share of total traffic, and landing-page reporting.
Bot filtering keeps crawler requests out of human visit counts.
Prepaid usage-credit model without per-seat, domain, report, or fixed pageview quotas.
zh: 设有人工智能工具流量渠道，覆盖 ChatGPT、Perplexity、Gemini 和 Microsoft Copilot 等来源。
提供 AI 流量趋势、总流量占比和落地页报告。
通过机器人过滤避免把爬虫请求计入真人访问。
采用预付用量额度模式，不按席位、域名、报告或固定页面浏览量配额收费。

audience.en: Growth, SEO, and content teams that need to separate AI referral visits from other acquisition channels.
audience.zh: 需要区分 AI 引荐访问与其他获客渠道的增长、SEO 和内容团队。

description.en: Identify which pages receive AI-referred visitors and compare the mix and trend of individual AI sources over time.
description.zh: 识别哪些页面获得 AI 引荐访客，并比较不同 AI 来源的占比与时间趋势。

summary.en: Find AI landing pages and compare source mix and trends.
summary.zh: 查找 AI 落地页并比较来源占比与趋势。

description.en: Review human acquisition performance without treating bot fetches as visits or claiming that a crawler request produced a citation.
description.zh: 复盘真人获客表现，同时避免把机器人抓取当作访问，或声称爬虫请求已经产生引用。

summary.en: Measure clicked referrals while keeping bot fetches separate.
summary.zh: 衡量点击引荐，并将机器人抓取单独区分。

description.en: Core access is a one-time USD $10 purchase converted into usage credit. Top-ups are USD $10, $25, $50, $100, or a custom amount; unused credit does not expire. There is no platform free trial and no fixed pageview, project, domain, seat, or report quota.
description.zh: 核心使用权为一次性购买 10 美元并折算为用量额度。充值可选 10、25、50、100 美元或自定义金额，未用额度不过期。平台不提供免费试用，也没有固定页面浏览量、项目、域名、席位或报告配额。

summary.en: USD $10 once converts to non-expiring usage credit; top-ups $10–$100 or custom; no free trial or fixed volume quota.
summary.zh: 一次性 10 美元转为不过期用量额度；充值 10–100 美元或自定义；无免费试用或固定用量配额。

description.en: The white-label and email add-on is USD $30/month. Enterprise starts at USD $2,000/month; Managed starts at USD $3,500/month and is available by invitation.
description.zh: 白标与邮件附加服务为每月 30 美元。企业版起价为每月 2,000 美元；托管版起价为每月 3,500 美元，且需邀请开通。

summary.en: White-label/email add-on $30/month; Enterprise from $2,000/month; invite-only Managed from $3,500/month, all USD.
summary.zh: 白标/邮件附加服务每月 30 美元；企业版每月 2,000 美元起；邀请制约管版每月 3,500 美元起，均为美元。

description.en: AI attribution depends on a visitor clicking through with usable source information. The product does not recover direct visits after an earlier AI answer and cannot observe unclicked citations or answer impressions.
description.zh: AI 归因依赖访客点击跳转并保留可用来源信息。该产品无法找回此前看过 AI 回答后直接访问的流量，也无法观察未点击的引用或回答曝光。

summary.en: Requires a click and usable referrer; direct follow-up visits and unclicked citations remain invisible.
summary.zh: 需要点击和可用来源；无法识别随后直接访问或未点击引用。

description.en: Crawler activity is not counted as human traffic and is not evidence that an AI system cited a page. Managed access also requires an invitation rather than ordinary self-service checkout.
description.zh: 爬虫活动不计入真人流量，也不能证明 AI 系统已经引用页面。托管版还需邀请，而不是普通自助购买。

summary.en: Crawler hits do not prove citations; Managed access is invitation-only.
summary.zh: 爬虫命中不能证明引用；托管版仅限邀请。

description.en: Fits teams that prefer prepaid, non-expiring usage credit and explicit AI landing-page analysis; confirm add-on and enterprise requirements before purchase.
description.zh: 适合偏好预付且不过期用量额度、并需要明确 AI 落地页分析的团队；购买前应确认附加服务和企业版需求。

description.en: A free browser-based analyzer for Apache, nginx, and Cloudflare Logpush files. It identifies AI bot requests locally without uploading logs and reports pages, status codes, and verification confidence.
description.zh: 免费浏览器端日志分析器，支持 Apache、nginx 和 Cloudflare Logpush 文件。它在本地识别 AI 机器人请求而不上传日志，并报告页面、状态码与验证可信度。

en: AI crawler logs
Local log analysis
Bot verification
zh: AI 爬虫日志
本地日志分析
机器人验证

en: Analyzes logs locally in the browser without account registration or log upload.
Supports Apache/nginx combined and vhost formats, extra nginx fields, and Cloudflare Logpush CSV or JSONL.
Separates AI and LLM crawler activity and reports hits, top pages, and status codes.
