Distinguishes User-Agent matches from IP-range verification and exports results as CSV.
zh: 在浏览器本地分析日志，无需注册账号或上传日志。
支持 Apache/nginx combined 与 vhost 格式、额外 nginx 字段，以及 Cloudflare Logpush CSV 或 JSONL。
单独分析 AI 与大模型爬虫活动，报告命中、热门页面和状态码。
区分 User-Agent 匹配与 IP 段验证，并支持 CSV 导出。

audience.en: Technical SEO, DevOps, and web teams that already have server or CDN logs and want a no-upload first analysis.
audience.zh: 已有服务器或 CDN 日志、希望先做无需上传分析的技术 SEO、DevOps 和网站团队。

description.en: Inspect which pages AI crawlers requested, which responses they received, and which bot identities can be independently verified.
description.zh: 检查 AI 爬虫请求了哪些页面、收到哪些响应，以及哪些机器人身份可以独立验证。

summary.en: Review crawled pages, response status, and identity verification.
summary.zh: 复盘被抓取页面、响应状态和身份验证情况。

description.en: Run a local preliminary review of Cloudflare or origin-server logs before moving to larger operational monitoring.
description.zh: 在转向更大规模运营监控前，对 Cloudflare 或源站日志做本地初步检查。

summary.en: Triage CDN or origin logs locally before scaling monitoring.
summary.zh: 在扩大监控规模前本地排查 CDN 或源站日志。

description.en: The standalone AI Bot Log Analyzer is free, requires no registration, and has a 50 MB maximum size after decompression. This statement applies to the analyzer, not every other Leadee service.
description.zh: 独立 AI Bot Log Analyzer 免费，无需注册，解压后最大 50 MB。该说明仅适用于此分析器，不代表 Leadee 所有其他服务。

summary.en: Standalone analyzer is free with no registration; decompressed log limit is 50 MB.
summary.zh: 独立分析器免费且无需注册；解压后日志上限为 50 MB。

description.en: Origin logs do not include requests served from CDN cache. Cloudflare CSV imports require headers, and decompressed input is capped at 50 MB.
description.zh: 源站日志不包含由 CDN 缓存直接响应的请求。Cloudflare CSV 导入需要表头，解压后的输入上限为 50 MB。

summary.en: Misses CDN-cached origin requests; CSV needs headers; 50 MB decompressed limit.
summary.zh: 遗漏 CDN 缓存的源站请求；CSV 需表头；解压后上限 50 MB。

description.en: The analyzer matches 174 bots, but only 12 have verifiable official IP ranges. Other matches rely on User-Agent claims and are marked as unverifiable; robots.txt control tokens are not treated as crawler User-Agents.
description.zh: 分析器匹配 174 种机器人，但只有 12 种具有可验证的官方 IP 段。其他匹配依赖 User-Agent 声明并标记为无法验证；robots.txt 控制令牌不会被当作爬虫 User-Agent。

summary.en: Only 12 of 174 bot signatures have official IP-range verification; UA-only matches remain unverifiable.
summary.zh: 174 种机器人特征中仅 12 种有官方 IP 段验证；仅靠 UA 的匹配无法验证。

description.en: A bot hit only shows that a request reached the analyzed log source. It does not establish an AI answer impression, citation, referral click, or human visit.
description.zh: 机器人命中只说明请求到达了所分析的日志来源，不能证明 AI 回答曝光、引用、引荐点击或真人访问。

summary.en: Bot hits are not answer impressions, citations, clicks, or human visits.
summary.zh: 机器人命中不等于回答曝光、引用、点击或真人访问。

description.en: Fits a privacy-conscious first pass where logs must stay in the browser; it is a log analyzer rather than an AI referral-attribution product.
description.zh: 适合要求日志留在浏览器内的隐私优先初步排查；它是日志分析器，而不是 AI 引荐归因产品。

label.zh: AI 机器人日志分析器说明

description.en: Hosted product analytics with AI-agent activity reporting and AI-referred visitor reporting. It separates crawler reads from visitor events and event-based billing.
description.zh: 托管产品分析工具，提供 AI 代理活动报告和 AI 引荐访客报告。它将爬虫读取与访客事件分开，并按事件计费。

en: AI traffic analytics
AI agent monitoring
Event analytics
zh: AI 流量分析
AI 代理监控
事件分析

en: Weekly AI digest covers AI reads, referred visitors, landing pages, and newly read pages.
Tracks AI-requested HTML, markdown, llms.txt, and llms-full.txt formats.
Server-side agent SDK or a Vercel log drain records non-JavaScript crawlers and can distinguish failed requests.
AI crawler activity remains separate from visitor events and billable analytics events.
zh: 每周 AI 摘要涵盖 AI 读取、引荐访客、落地页和新增读取页面。
跟踪 AI 请求的 HTML、markdown、llms.txt 和 llms-full.txt 格式。
服务端代理 SDK 或 Vercel 日志排水可记录不执行 JavaScript 的爬虫，并可区分失败请求。
AI 爬虫活动与访客事件及计费分析事件保持区分。

audience.en: Product, growth, and engineering teams that need event analytics together with visibility into AI readers and AI referrals.
audience.zh: 需要事件分析，同时希望了解 AI 读取者和 AI 引荐情况的产品、增长和工程团队。

description.en: Monitor whether AI agents successfully read important pages and whether AI products send referred visitors to the product.
description.zh: 监控 AI 代理是否成功读取重要页面，以及 AI 产品是否为该产品带来引荐访客。

summary.en: Track successful AI reads alongside referred visitors.
summary.zh: 同时跟踪成功 AI 读取与引荐访客。

description.en: Use recurring AI activity reporting to spot changes in crawler access and human acquisition without merging the two metrics.
description.zh: 通过周期性 AI 活动报告发现爬虫访问与真人获客的变化，同时不合并两类指标。

summary.en: Spot changes in crawler access and human acquisition separately.
summary.zh: 分别发现爬虫访问与真人获客变化。

description.en: Free is USD $0/month with 10,000 events and 10 AI credits. Hobby is USD $9.99/month with 30,000 events and overage from USD $0.035 per 1,000 events. Pro is USD $49.99/month with 1,000,000 events.
description.zh: 免费版为每月 0 美元，含 10,000 个事件和 10 个 AI 额度。Hobby 为每月 9.99 美元，含 30,000 个事件，超额从每 1,000 个事件 0.035 美元起。Pro 为每月 49.99 美元，含 1,000,000 个事件。

summary.en: Free $0/month: 10K events/10 AI credits; Hobby $9.99/month: 30K events, overage from $0.035/1K; Pro $49.99/month: 1M events.
summary.zh: 免费版每月 0 美元：1 万事件/10 AI 额度；Hobby 每月 9.99 美元：3 万事件，超额每千个 0.035 美元起；Pro 每月 49.99 美元：100 万事件。

description.en: Business is USD $299/month with 2,000,000 events, 100 investigations, and 1,500 AI credits. Scale is USD $799/month with 6,000,000 events, 250 investigations, and 3,000 AI credits. AI crawler visits do not consume the event quota.
description.zh: Business 为每月 299 美元，含 2,000,000 个事件、100 次调查和 1,500 个 AI 额度。Scale 为每月 799 美元，含 6,000,000 个事件、250 次调查和 3,000 个 AI 额度。AI 爬虫访问不消耗事件配额。

summary.en: Business $299/month: 2M events/100 investigations/1,500 AI credits; Scale $799/month: 6M/250/3,000; crawler visits excluded, USD.
summary.zh: Business 每月 299 美元：200 万事件/100 次调查/1,500 AI 额度；Scale 每月 799 美元：600 万/250/3,000；爬虫访问不计配额，均为美元。

description.en: Crawler reads are not human visitor events and do not prove citations. A crawler request and an AI-referred visit must be interpreted as separate observations.
description.zh: 爬虫读取不是真人访客事件，也不能证明引用。爬虫请求与 AI 引荐访问必须作为两类独立观察来解释。

summary.en: Crawler reads are separate from visits and do not prove citations.
summary.zh: 爬虫读取不同于访问，也不能证明引用。

description.en: AI features can send prompts and context to configured gateways or model providers. Optional visitor identification can also introduce personal data, so configuration and data-policy review matter.
description.zh: AI 功能可能把提示词和上下文发送给配置的网关或模型提供商。可选访客识别也可能引入个人数据，因此需要检查配置与数据政策。

summary.en: AI prompts/context may reach configured providers; optional identification can add personal data.
summary.zh: AI 提示词/上下文可能发送给配置提供商；可选识别可能增加个人数据。

description.en: Fits teams that want event-based product analytics plus AI-agent diagnostics in one service; the current hosted offering is not a self-hosted deployment.
description.zh: 适合希望在同一服务中获得事件型产品分析和 AI 代理诊断的团队；当前托管服务不提供自托管部署。

description.en: Product analytics with an AI acquisition channel that classifies links from AI assistants using the first landing URL, referring domain, and UTM source. It is referral classification rather than server-log crawler analysis.
description.zh: 产品分析工具，其 AI 获客渠道根据首次落地 URL、来源域名和 UTM 来源对 AI 助手链接分类。它属于引荐分类，而不是服务器日志爬虫分析。

en: AI referral channel
Product analytics
Acquisition attribution
zh: AI 引荐渠道
产品分析
获客归因

en: AI channel recognizes links from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Microsoft Copilot, and other AI tools.
Uses utm_source and referring_domain from the first landing URL.
Paid and custom channel rules take priority over automatic AI classification.
AI-classified traffic can be used within product analytics, segments, and funnels.
zh: AI 渠道识别来自 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Perplexity、Microsoft Copilot 等工具的链接。
根据首次落地 URL 中的 utm_source 和 referring_domain 判断来源。
付费及自定义渠道规则的优先级高于自动 AI 分类。
可在产品分析、分群和漏斗中使用 AI 分类流量。

audience.en: Product analytics and growth teams that already use event-based analysis and want AI referral acquisition as a channel.
audience.zh: 已经使用事件分析、希望把 AI 引荐获客作为渠道管理的产品分析和增长团队。

description.en: Classify acquisition sessions from AI assistants and compare downstream product behavior with other channels.
description.zh: 对来自 AI 助手的获客会话分类，并与其他渠道比较后续产品行为。

summary.en: Classify AI acquisition and compare downstream behavior.
summary.zh: 对 AI 获客分类并比较后续行为。

description.en: Create channel rules or segments for AI referrers while preserving explicit paid or custom attribution rules.
description.zh: 为 AI 来源建立渠道规则或分群，同时保留明确的付费或自定义归因规则。

summary.en: Segment AI referrers without overriding paid or custom rules.
summary.zh: 对 AI 来源分群，同时不覆盖付费或自定义规则。

description.en: The ongoing Free plan costs USD $0/month, resets monthly, requires no credit card, and includes 1,000,000 Analytics events per month, one project, one-year retention, unlimited members, and community support.
description.zh: 持续免费版为每月 0 美元，按月重置，无需信用卡，含每月 1,000,000 个分析事件、1 个项目、一年保留期、无限成员和社区支持。

summary.en: Free $0/month: 1M Analytics events/month, 1 project, 1-year retention, unlimited members; monthly reset and no card.
summary.zh: 免费版每月 0 美元：每月 100 万分析事件、1 个项目、一年保留期、无限成员；按月重置且无需信用卡。

description.en: Pay-as-you-go keeps the same free allowance and charges usage above it, with up to six projects, two-year retention, and email support. Prices are in USD excluding tax, billed monthly, with no minimum or annual commitment. Free allowances for AI Observability, Logs, and PostHog AI are separate product quotas.
description.zh: 按量付费保留相同免费额度并对超出部分收费，支持最多 6 个项目、两年保留期和邮件支持。价格以美元计、不含税、按月结算，无最低消费或年度承诺。AI Observability、Logs 和 PostHog AI 的免费额度属于其他产品配额。

summary.en: Pay-as-you-go adds usage charges above the free allowance, up to 6 projects and 2-year retention; USD, tax excluded, monthly, no annual commitment.
summary.zh: 按量付费对超出免费额度部分收费，最多 6 个项目、两年保留期；美元、不含税、月付、无年度承诺。

description.en: The AI channel classifies human referral traffic from the first landing URL. It does not inspect server logs, identify unclicked citations, or prove that an AI crawler requested a page.
description.zh: AI 渠道根据首次落地 URL 对真人引荐流量分类。它不检查服务器日志，不识别未点击引用，也不能证明 AI 爬虫请求过页面。

summary.en: Referral classification only; no crawler-log or unclicked-citation measurement.
summary.zh: 仅做引荐分类；不衡量爬虫日志或未点击引用。

description.en: Attribution depends on usable UTM or referring-domain data. Paid and custom channel rules can override the default AI channel, so rule configuration must be reviewed before interpreting totals.
description.zh: 归因依赖可用的 UTM 或来源域名数据。付费及自定义渠道规则可能覆盖默认 AI 渠道，因此解释总量前需要检查规则配置。

summary.en: Requires UTM/referrer data; paid and custom rules can override AI classification.
summary.zh: 需要 UTM/来源数据；付费及自定义规则可覆盖 AI 分类。

description.en: Fits organizations that need broad product analytics and configurable acquisition channels rather than a dedicated crawler-log workflow.
description.zh: 适合需要广泛产品分析和可配置获客渠道、而非专门爬虫日志工作流的组织。

description.en: Server-log analysis with dedicated AI and LLM crawler tracking, segmentation, real-time monitoring, migration analysis, REST API, and MCP access. It analyzes logged requests rather than inferring citations from them.
description.zh: 服务器日志分析工具，提供专门 AI 与大模型爬虫跟踪、分群、实时监控、迁移分析、REST API 和 MCP 访问。它分析已记录的请求，而不是由此推断引用。

en: AI crawler logs
Server log analysis
API and MCP
zh: AI 爬虫日志
服务器日志分析
API 与 MCP

en: Dedicated AI and LLM crawler tracking within server-log analysis.
Segmentation, real-time monitoring, migration analysis, and bot activity views.
REST API and MCP server access for operational integrations.
Free and paid plans with project-based log ingestion and history options.
zh: 在服务器日志分析中专门跟踪 AI 与大模型爬虫。
提供分群、实时监控、迁移分析和机器人活动视图。
通过 REST API 和 MCP 服务器支持运营集成。
免费及付费套餐按项目提供日志摄取与历史记录选项。

audience.en: Technical SEO, web operations, and agencies that need structured analysis of large server-log datasets.
audience.zh: 需要结构化分析大型服务器日志数据集的技术 SEO、网站运营团队和代理商。

description.en: Analyze AI crawler activity by project and page, monitor changes over time, and investigate migration-related request patterns.
description.zh: 按项目和页面分析 AI 爬虫活动、持续监控变化，并调查与迁移相关的请求模式。

summary.en: Analyze AI crawler activity by project and page over time.
summary.zh: 按项目和页面持续分析 AI 爬虫活动。

description.en: Connect log-derived bot data to internal workflows through the documented REST API or MCP server.
description.zh: 通过文档化的 REST API 或 MCP 服务器，把日志衍生的机器人数据接入内部工作流。

summary.en: Integrate log-derived bot data through REST API or MCP.
summary.zh: 通过 REST API 或 MCP 集成日志机器人数据。

description.en: Free includes 10,000 log lines per month, a seven-day visible window, one project, and no credit card. Starter includes one project and 250,000 lines per month: EUR €44.10/month excluding VAT for logs only, or EUR €49/month excluding VAT with the optional crawler module. The module costs EUR €4.90/month per project for 250,000 crawl URLs per month with rollover.
description.zh: 免费版含每月 10,000 行日志、7 天可见窗口、1 个项目且无需信用卡。Starter 含 1 个项目和每月 250,000 行日志：仅日志为每月 44.10 欧元、不含 VAT；加可选爬虫模块为每月 49 欧元、不含 VAT。该模块每项目每月 4.90 欧元，含每月 250,000 个爬取 URL，可结转。

summary.en: Free: 10K lines/month, 7-day window, 1 project. Starter: 250K lines/month; €44.10 logs-only or €49 with crawler module; crawler add-on €4.90/project for 250K URLs, VAT excluded.
summary.zh: 免费版：每月 1 万行、7 天窗口、1 个项目。Starter：每月 25 万行；仅日志 44.10 欧元或含爬虫模块 49 欧元；爬虫附加每项目 4.90 欧元/25 万 URL，均不含 VAT。

description.en: Paid plans include 13 months of history. A 90-day history reduces the price by 10%; three-year history adds 10% to volume-based charges, with a EUR €9/month minimum. Monthly billing has no commitment and annual commitment saves 10%. Agency starts at EUR €149/month with unlimited projects and 500,000 aggregated lines per month included; overage is EUR €35 per additional million up to 5 million, then EUR €25 per million up to 20 million. Higher volumes or more than 50 projects require a custom quote.
description.zh: 付费套餐含 13 个月历史记录。90 天历史减价 10%；三年历史按用量加价 10%，最低每月 9 欧元。月付无承诺，年度承诺优惠 10%。Agency 起价为每月 149 欧元，含无限项目和每月合计 500,000 行日志；超额至 500 万行前每增加 100 万行 35 欧元，500 万至 2,000 万行每 100 万行 25 欧元。更高用量或超过 50 个项目需定制报价。

summary.en: Paid history 13 months; annual commitment −10%. Agency from €149/month includes 500K aggregated lines and unlimited projects; overage €35/million to 5M then €25/million to 20M; larger needs custom, VAT excluded.
summary.zh: 付费历史 13 个月；年度承诺优惠 10%。Agency 每月 149 欧元起，含 50 万合计行和无限项目；至 500 万超额每百万行 35 欧元，500 万至 2,000 万每百万行 25 欧元；更大规模定制，均不含 VAT。

description.en: Logs can contain URLs, IP addresses, user agents, referrers, and other personal or confidential data. Customers must filter secrets and personal data and must not submit special-category data. The service may train its own models on de-personalized logs; objections stop new training but do not alter already-trained models.
description.zh: 日志可能包含 URL、IP 地址、User-Agent、来源和其他个人或机密数据。客户必须过滤敏感凭证和个人数据，不得提交特殊类别数据。服务可能在去身份化的日志上训练自有模型；异议会停止新增训练，但不会改变已经训练好的模型。

summary.en: Customers must sanitize logs; de-personalized logs may train vendor models, and objections are prospective only.
summary.zh: 客户须清理日志；去身份化日志可能用于供应商训练模型，异议仅对未来训练生效。

description.en: Crawler requests do not establish citations or clicks. Some official documentation incorrectly presents robots.txt control tokens as crawler signatures; Google-Extended and Applebot-Extended should not be treated as independent crawler User-Agents.
description.zh: 爬虫请求不能证明引用或点击。部分官方文档错误地把 robots.txt 控制令牌当作爬虫特征；Google-Extended 和 Applebot-Extended 不应被视为独立爬虫 User-Agent。

summary.en: Crawler requests do not prove citations; documentation conflates some robots.txt tokens with crawler User-Agents.
summary.zh: 爬虫请求不能证明引用；文档混淆了部分 robots.txt 令牌与爬虫 User-Agent。

description.en: The application is served from app.kelo.gs, while the public product and legal site use crawlgenius.com. The legal materials identify CRAWLGENIUS SASU and Kelo in connection with the service; this host relationship is disclosed rather than treated as evidence of impersonation.
description.zh: 应用从 app.kelo.gs 提供，而公开产品与法律网站使用 crawlgenius.com。法律材料将 CRAWLGENIUS SASU 与相关服务中的 Kelo 名称联系起来；这里披露该域名关系，而不是据此认定为仿冒。

summary.en: Application host is app.kelo.gs; legal operator is CRAWLGENIUS SASU.
summary.zh: 应用域名为 app.kelo.gs；法律运营主体为 CRAWLGENIUS SASU。

description.en: Fits teams that need structured server-log ingestion, project-based limits, and API or MCP integration; very large agency volumes move to custom pricing.
description.zh: 适合需要结构化服务器日志摄取、按项目配额以及 API 或 MCP 集成的团队；大型代理商用量需转为定制价格。

description.en: Open-source web analytics available as a hosted service or self-hosted deployment, with AI referral attribution and bot-event reporting. It separates AI acquisition from crawler reads and documents a server-side forwarding method for crawlers that do not run JavaScript.
description.zh: 开源网络分析工具，可托管或自托管，提供 AI 引荐归因和机器人事件报告。它将 AI 获客与爬虫读取分开，并文档化了不运行 JavaScript 的爬虫所需的服务端转发方法。

en: Open-source analytics
AI referral traffic
Bot monitoring
zh: 开源分析
AI 引荐流量
机器人监控

en: AI acquisition channel using referring domain, utm_source, and utm_medium.
Bot events separated from normal analytics and excluded from billable usage when bot blocking is enabled.
Curated bot identities with operator and purpose fields, plus multi-layer bot detection.
AGPL-3.0 self-hosting with Docker Compose or setup script, alongside a hosted cloud service.
zh: AI 获客渠道使用来源域名、utm_source 和 utm_medium。
启用机器人拦截时，机器人事件与常规分析分开，并不计入计费用量。
精选机器人身份包含运营方和用途字段，并采用多层机器人检测。
AGPL-3.0 自托管支持 Docker Compose 或安装脚本，同时提供托管云服务。

audience.en: Privacy-conscious product and growth teams, developers, and organizations that want self-hosting or managed web analytics.
audience.zh: 注重隐私的产品和增长团队、开发者，以及希望自托管或使用托管网络分析的组织。

description.en: Compare human AI referrals with crawler reads without treating bot requests as visits or citations.
description.zh: 比较真人 AI 引荐与爬虫读取，同时不把机器人请求当作访问或引用。

summary.en: Compare AI referrals and crawler reads as separate metrics.
summary.zh: 将 AI 引荐与爬虫读取作为独立指标比较。

description.en: Self-host the analytics stack or forward real crawler requests from edge middleware, a worker, or a reverse proxy to improve bot visibility.
description.zh: 自托管分析栈，或从边缘中间件、Worker 或反向代理转发真实爬虫请求，以提高机器人可见性。

summary.en: Self-host the stack or forward crawler requests server-side.
summary.zh: 自托管分析栈或通过服务端转发爬虫请求。

description.en: The AGPL-3.0 software can be self-hosted without a software license fee; infrastructure and operations remain the deployer's responsibility. The hosted service has a seven-day trial and paid plans, with no ongoing free cloud tier shown.
description.zh: AGPL-3.0 软件可自托管而无需软件许可费；基础设施和运维由部署方负责。托管服务提供 7 天试用和付费套餐，未显示持续免费云套餐。

summary.en: Free self-hosted AGPL-3.0 software; infrastructure excluded. Cloud has a 7-day trial and paid plans, with no ongoing free tier shown.
summary.zh: AGPL-3.0 自托管软件免费，不含基础设施；云服务有 7 天试用和付费套餐，未显示持续免费档。

description.en: At the displayed 100,000 monthly pageviews, Standard starts at USD $13/month billed annually, with up to five websites, three members, and three-year retention. Pro starts at USD $26/month billed annually, with unlimited websites and members, session replay, a higher API limit, and five-year retention. Enterprise is custom-priced.
description.zh: 按页面显示的每月 100,000 次页面浏览量，Standard 起价为每年结算的每月 13 美元，含最多 5 个网站、3 名成员和三年保留期。Pro 起价为每年结算的每月 26 美元，含无限网站和成员、会话回放、更高 API 限额及五年保留期。企业版为定制价格。

summary.en: Cloud at 100K monthly pageviews: Standard from $13/month billed annually, 5 sites/3 members/3-year retention; Pro from $26/month annually, unlimited sites/members/5-year retention; Enterprise custom, USD.
summary.zh: 云服务每月 10 万页面浏览量时：Standard 每年结算每月 13 美元起，5 网站/3 成员/3 年保留；Pro 每年结算每月 26 美元起，无限网站/成员/5 年保留；企业版定制，均为美元。

description.en: The JavaScript tracker cannot observe crawlers that never execute JavaScript. Full coverage requires forwarding real crawler requests to the tracking endpoint with a server-side API key; that key must never be exposed in browser JavaScript.
description.zh: JavaScript 跟踪器无法观察从不执行 JavaScript 的爬虫。完整覆盖需要把真实爬虫请求转发到跟踪端点，并使用服务端 API 密钥；该密钥绝不能暴露在浏览器 JavaScript 中。

summary.en: JavaScript misses non-executing crawlers; server-side forwarding and a secret API key are required for fuller coverage.
summary.zh: JavaScript 会遗漏不执行的爬虫；更完整覆盖需服务端转发和保密 API 密钥。

description.en: Bot detection is imperfect and may miss sophisticated bots or flag unusual legitimate users. Older bot events created before identity fields existed remain unnamed and are not backfilled.
description.zh: 机器人检测并不完美，可能遗漏复杂机器人，也可能把异常真人用户标记为机器人。身份字段出现之前创建的旧机器人事件仍保持未命名，且不会回填。

summary.en: Detection can miss bots or flag users; older bot events lack backfilled identities.
summary.zh: 检测可能遗漏机器人或误标用户；旧机器人事件不会回填身份。

description.en: The AI Summary endpoint is documented, but its plan entitlement is not explicit. Some bot documentation also misclassifies robots.txt control tokens such as Google-Extended as crawler identities; these tokens are not independent User-Agents.
description.zh: AI Summary 端点已有文档，但文档未明确其套餐权限。部分机器人文档还错误地把 Google-Extended 等 robots.txt 控制令牌归类为爬虫身份；这些令牌不是独立 User-Agent。

summary.en: AI Summary plan access is unclear; documentation mislabels some robots.txt tokens as crawlers.
summary.zh: AI Summary 套餐权限不明确；文档误标部分 robots.txt 令牌为爬虫。

description.en: Fits teams that value open-source self-hosting and can operate the required stack or server-side crawler forwarding; cloud users should confirm AI Summary entitlement separately.
description.zh: 适合重视开源自托管、能够运维所需技术栈或服务端爬虫转发的团队；云服务用户应单独确认 AI Summary 权限。

description.en: Privacy-focused web analytics with an AI traffic-source channel in the Pages panel. It counts human requests with an AI referrer, filters bot traffic, and supports adding missing AI tools.
description.zh: 注重隐私的网络分析工具，在页面面板中提供 AI 流量来源渠道。它统计带有 AI 来源的真人请求、过滤机器人流量，并支持补充缺失的 AI 工具。

en: AI traffic sources
Privacy-first analytics
Referral tracking
zh: AI 流量来源
隐私优先分析
引荐跟踪

en: AI traffic-source channel in the Pages panel.
Recognizes human requests from ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and other AI tools.
Filters bot traffic from the AI referral channel.
Support can add missing AI tools to source recognition.
zh: 在页面面板中提供 AI 流量来源渠道。
识别来自 ChatGPT、Claude、Perplexity 等工具的真人请求。
从 AI 引荐渠道中过滤机器人流量。
支持团队可以补充来源识别中缺失的 AI 工具。

audience.en: Website owners, publishers, and growth teams that want lightweight, cookie-free analytics of human AI referrals.
audience.zh: 希望以轻量、无 Cookie 方式分析真人 AI 引荐的网站所有者、发布者和增长团队。

description.en: See which AI tools send human visitors to individual pages and review AI referrals separately from bot traffic.
description.zh: 查看哪些 AI 工具为单个页面带来真人访客，并将 AI 引荐与机器人流量分开复盘。

summary.en: Review AI referrals by tool and page with bot traffic excluded.
summary.zh: 按工具和页面复盘 AI 引荐，并排除机器人流量。

description.en: Request source recognition updates when an AI product appears in analytics but is not yet classified.
description.zh: 当某个 AI 产品出现在分析数据中但尚未分类时，请求补充来源识别。

summary.en: Request recognition updates for unclassified AI sources.
summary.zh: 为未分类的 AI 来源请求更新识别。

description.en: A 30-day trial is available without a credit card and does not convert automatically. At 10,000 monthly pageviews, Standard is USD $6/month with 50 websites, unlimited members, and unlimited retention; Plus is USD $12/month with unlimited websites and additional features. Prices exclude taxes.
description.zh: 提供无需信用卡的 30 天试用，且不会自动转为付费。按每月 10,000 次页面浏览量，Standard 为每月 6 美元，含 50 个网站、无限成员和无限保留期；Plus 为每月 12 美元，含无限网站及更多功能。价格不含税。

summary.en: 30-day no-card, non-converting trial. At 10K monthly pageviews: Standard $6/month, 50 sites; Plus $12/month, unlimited sites; unlimited members/retention; USD excluding tax.
summary.zh: 30 天无需信用卡且不自动转付费的试用。每月 1 万页面浏览量时：Standard 每月 6 美元、50 网站；Plus 每月 12 美元、无限网站；成员/保留期无限；美元不含税。

description.en: At the same 10,000-pageview tier, annual totals are USD $60/year for Standard and USD $120/year for Plus. Enterprise is custom-priced. Custom events and 10% of session extensions count toward the pageview limit; temporary promotions are not treated as standard pricing.
description.zh: 在同一 10,000 页面浏览量档位，Standard 年账单为 60 美元，Plus 为 120 美元。企业版为定制价格。自定义事件和会话扩展的 10% 计入页面浏览量上限；临时促销不作为标准价格。

summary.en: Annual totals at 10K pageviews: Standard $60/year, Plus $120/year; Enterprise custom. Custom events and 10% of session extensions count toward the limit, USD.
summary.zh: 每月 1 万页面浏览量时年账单：Standard 60 美元、Plus 120 美元；企业版定制。自定义事件和会话扩展的 10% 计入上限，均为美元。

description.en: The AI channel counts human requests with an AI referrer. It does not measure unclicked citations, and filtering bot traffic means it is not a crawler-log visibility tool.
description.zh: AI 渠道统计带有 AI 来源的真人请求。它不衡量未点击引用，并且由于过滤机器人流量，不是爬虫日志可见性工具。

summary.en: Human AI referrers only; no unclicked-citation or crawler-log measurement.
summary.zh: 仅统计真人 AI 来源；不衡量未点击引用或爬虫日志。

description.en: Source recognition is maintained by the vendor, and missing AI tools can be requested through support. A new or altered referrer may therefore remain unclassified until support updates the list.
description.zh: 来源识别由供应商维护，缺失 AI 工具可通过支持请求补充。因此新增或改变的来源在支持更新列表前可能仍未分类。

summary.en: New or changed AI referrers may remain unclassified until vendor support updates recognition.
summary.zh: 新增或改变的 AI 来源在供应商更新前可能仍未分类。

description.en: Fits publishers and website owners seeking a lightweight paid analytics service for human AI referrals rather than server-log crawler analysis.
description.zh: 适合希望以轻量付费分析服务衡量真人 AI 引荐、而非分析服务器爬虫日志的发布者和网站所有者。

label.en: Official release notes for AI traffic sources
label.zh: AI 流量来源官方发布说明
产品、法律主体与联系方式

description.en: Edge-based crawler logging and verification with AI referral exports and rendered-page snapshots. It separates verified bot requests, declared identities, and human AI referrals, and does not establish citations from those signals.
description.zh: 基于边缘的爬虫记录与验证工具，提供 AI 引荐导出和渲染页面快照。它区分已验证机器人请求、声明身份与真人 AI 引荐，并且不通过这些信号认定引用。

en: Crawler verification
AI referral export
Page snapshots
zh: 爬虫验证
AI 引荐导出
页面快照

en: Edge-based request logging through DNS or a Cloudflare Worker.
Per-page and per-bot views with declared, verified, automation, and unknown verification tiers.
AI referral API counts human visitors from AI answer surfaces using the Referer header.
Raw crawl-log export and page snapshots show which HTML version was served.
zh: 通过 DNS 或 Cloudflare Worker 进行基于边缘的请求记录。
提供按页面和机器人视图，以及声明、已验证、自动化和未知验证等级。
AI 引荐 API 根据 Referer 请求头统计来自 AI 回答入口的真人访客。
原始爬虫日志导出和页面快照可展示实际提供的 HTML 版本。

audience.en: Technical SEO and engineering teams that need bot identity verification, referral exports, and evidence of rendered HTML delivery.
audience.zh: 需要机器人身份验证、引荐导出和渲染 HTML 交付证据的技术 SEO 与工程团队。

description.en: Review verified and declared crawler requests by page and operator, then export raw logs for further analysis.
description.zh: 按页面和运营方复盘已验证及声明的爬虫请求，并导出原始日志做进一步分析。

summary.en: Review verified crawler requests by page and operator, then export logs.
summary.zh: 按页面和运营方复盘已验证爬虫请求并导出日志。

description.en: Measure a documented lower bound of human AI referrals and inspect the HTML version served to crawlers on specific pages and days.
description.zh: 衡量有文档依据的真人 AI 引荐下限，并检查特定页面和日期向爬虫提供的 HTML 版本。

summary.en: Measure a referral lower bound and inspect crawler-served HTML.
summary.zh: 衡量引荐下限并检查向爬虫提供的 HTML。

description.en: A seven-day trial is offered. Starter is USD $19/month for one site, 100,000 bot visits, and 10,000 renders. Pro is USD $49/month for three sites, 500,000 bot visits, and 30,000 renders. Growth is USD $89/month for ten sites, 2,000,000 bot visits, and 50,000 renders.
description.zh: 提供 7 天试用。Starter 为每月 19 美元，含 1 个网站、100,000 次机器人访问和 10,000 次渲染。Pro 为每月 49 美元，含 3 个网站、500,000 次机器人访问和 30,000 次渲染。Growth 为每月 89 美元，含 10 个网站、2,000,000 次机器人访问和 50,000 次渲染。

summary.en: 7-day trial. Starter $19/month: 1 site/100K bot visits/10K renders; Pro $49: 3/500K/30K; Growth $89: 10/2M/50K, USD.
summary.zh: 7 天试用。Starter 每月 19 美元：1 网站/10 万机器人访问/1 万渲染；Pro 每月 49 美元：3 网站/50 万机器人访问/3 万渲染；Growth 每月 89 美元：10 网站/200 万机器人访问/5 万渲染，均为美元。

description.en: Agency is USD $149/month for 20 sites, 5,000,000 bot visits, and 100,000 renders. Additional sites cost USD $5/month each; additional renders cost USD $5/month per 2,500 renders. Every plan includes crawl analytics. Annual billing is advertised as two months free, but exact annual invoice totals were not established.
description.zh: Agency 为每月 149 美元，含 20 个网站、5,000,000 次机器人访问和 100,000 次渲染。额外网站每个每月 5 美元；额外渲染每 2,500 次每月 5 美元。所有套餐均含爬虫分析。年度付费宣传为免费两个月，但未确认确切年度账单总额。

summary.en: Agency $149/month: 20 sites/5M bot visits/100K renders; extra site $5/month, extra renders $5/2,500. Annual totals unverified despite “2 months free,” USD.
summary.zh: Agency 每月 149 美元：20 网站/500 万机器人访问/10 万渲染；额外网站每月 5 美元，额外渲染每 2,500 次 5 美元。虽宣传免费两个月，年度总额未核实，均为美元。

description.en: AI referral counts are a lower bound because some answer surfaces strip Referer. Google AI Overviews and Bing Copilot-in-search are intentionally excluded to avoid misattributing bare search hostnames.
description.zh: 由于部分回答入口会移除 Referer，AI 引荐数只是下限。Google AI Overviews 和 Bing Copilot-in-search 被有意排除，以避免把裸搜索域名误归因。

summary.en: Referral counts are a floor; Google AI Overviews and Bing Copilot-in-search are excluded.
summary.zh: 引荐数仅为下限；排除 Google AI Overviews 和 Bing Copilot-in-search。

description.en: Crawler logs and page snapshots show requests and served HTML, not citations. The beta export APIs can change; crawl-log windows are capped at 31 days, archived history is about 13 months, and roughly the most recent three days are provisional while verification settles.
description.zh: 爬虫日志和页面快照展示请求与实际提供的 HTML，而不是引用。测试版导出 API 可能变化；爬虫日志单次窗口上限 31 天，归档历史约 13 个月，最近约三天在验证完成前为临时数据。

summary.en: No citation proof; beta APIs may change; 31-day query windows, about 13-month history, and recent ~3 days provisional.
summary.zh: 不证明引用；测试版 API 可能变化；单次查询 31 天、历史约 13 个月、最近约 3 天为临时数据。

description.en: Marketing funnel stages such as “likely cited” are inferences and must not be read as verified answer citations. Snapshot HTML download links are temporary secrets, and raw client IP addresses are not stored.
description.zh: 营销漏斗中的“可能被引用”等阶段属于推断，不能当作已验证的回答引用。快照 HTML 下载链接是临时秘密链接，且不存储原始客户端 IP 地址。

summary.en: “Likely cited” is not verified citation evidence; snapshot links are temporary secrets and raw IPs are not stored.
summary.zh: “可能被引用”不是已验证引用；快照链接为临时秘密且不存原始 IP。

description.en: Fits technical teams that want crawler verification, referral exports, and served-HTML snapshots together, while accepting beta API behavior and referral undercounting.
description.zh: 适合希望同时获得爬虫验证、引荐导出和实际提供 HTML 快照、并能接受测试版 API 行为及引荐低估的技术团队。

label.en: Product site, legal entity, and contact links
label.zh: 产品网站、法律主体与联系链接

description.en: Privacy-focused web analytics with retrospective AI referral attribution, per-assistant reporting, conversions, and separate AI crawler visibility. Crawler requests are labeled as bot hits rather than visits and are not used to infer citations.
description.zh: 注重隐私的网络分析工具，提供回溯 AI 引荐归因、按助手报告、转化分析和独立 AI 爬虫可见性。爬虫请求被标记为机器人命中而非访问，不用于推断引用。

en: AI referral analytics
AI crawler visibility
Retroactive attribution
zh: AI 引荐分析
AI 爬虫可见性
回溯归因

en: Attributes human click-through sessions to AI assistants including ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Microsoft Copilot.
Applies AI attribution to historical traffic when the report is first opened.
Reports per-assistant trends, revenue, orders, conversion, and AI landing pages.
Shows crawler requests separately, supports AI filters and cohorts, and offers AI-share alerts.
zh: 将真人点击会话归因于 ChatGPT、Claude、Perplexity、Gemini 和 Microsoft Copilot 等 AI 助手。
首次打开报告时，对历史流量应用 AI 归因。
提供按助手趋势、收入、订单、转化和 AI 落地页报告。
单独展示爬虫请求，支持 AI 筛选和群组，并提供 AI 占比提醒。

audience.en: Website owners, marketers, and analysts that want detailed AI-source reporting without cookie-based analytics.
audience.zh: 希望获得详细 AI 来源报告、同时不依赖 Cookie 分析的网站所有者、营销人员和分析师。

description.en: Review historical AI referrals by assistant, compare conversion and revenue where configured, and identify the landing pages receiving AI visitors.
description.zh: 按助手复盘历史 AI 引荐，在已配置时比较转化和收入，并识别获得 AI 访客的落地页。

summary.en: Review historical AI referrals, conversions, revenue, and landing pages.
summary.zh: 复盘历史 AI 引荐、转化、收入和落地页。

description.en: Inspect AI crawler visibility beside referral traffic without creating a crawl-to-click ratio or claiming that a crawl caused a visit.
description.zh: 在引荐流量旁检查 AI 爬虫可见性，同时不计算抓取与点击比率，也不声称抓取导致访问。

summary.en: Inspect crawls beside referrals without implying causation.
summary.zh: 并列检查爬虫与引荐，同时不暗示因果关系。

description.en: Free is GBP £0 forever with 50,000 monthly pageviews, one website, 100 session recordings, one heatmap, one tracked goal, and forever retention. Basic displays GBP £49/month including tax for 250,000 monthly pageviews, three websites, 2,500 recordings, 10 heatmaps, and 10 tracked goals.
description.zh: 免费版永久为 0 英镑，含每月 50,000 次页面浏览量、1 个网站、100 次会话录制、1 个热图、1 个跟踪目标和永久保留。Basic 显示为每月 49 英镑、含税，含每月 250,000 次页面浏览量、3 个网站、2,500 次录制、10 个热图和 10 个跟踪目标。

summary.en: Free £0 forever: 50K pageviews/month, 1 site, 100 recordings, 1 heatmap/goal. Basic £49/month including tax: 250K pageviews, 3 sites, 2,500 recordings, 10 heatmaps/goals.
summary.zh: 免费版永久 0 英镑：每月 5 万页面浏览量、1 网站、100 次录制、1 热图/目标。Basic 每月 49 英镑含税：25 万页面浏览量、3 网站、2,500 次录制、10 热图/目标。

description.en: Advanced displays GBP £129/month including tax for 1,000,000 monthly pageviews, ten websites, 10,000 recordings, 50 heatmaps, and 50 tracked goals. Enterprise is custom-priced. Paid plans have a 30-day free trial without a credit card. The page showed Annual selected while labeling prices per month; exact annual invoice totals were not established.
description.zh: Advanced 显示为每月 129 英镑、含税，含每月 1,000,000 次页面浏览量、10 个网站、10,000 次录制、50 个热图和 50 个跟踪目标。企业版为定制价格。付费套餐提供无需信用卡的 30 天免费试用。页面当时选中 Annual，但价格标注为每月；未确认确切年度账单总额。

summary.en: Advanced £129/month including tax: 1M pageviews, 10 sites, 10K recordings, 50 heatmaps/goals; Enterprise custom. Paid plans: 30-day no-card trial. Annual selected; annual totals unverified, GBP.
summary.zh: Advanced 每月 129 英镑含税：100 万页面浏览量、10 网站、1 万录制、50 热图/目标；企业版定制。付费套餐 30 天无需信用卡试用。页面选中年度付费；年度总额未核实，均为英镑。

description.en: The AI report counts click-through sessions and crawler requests. It cannot see citations shown but never clicked or answer impressions, and crawler requests are never added to visits. The product deliberately avoids a crawl-to-click ratio because one does not prove causation.
description.zh: AI 报告统计点击会话和爬虫请求。它无法看到已展示但未点击的引用或回答曝光，爬虫请求也绝不加入访问量。产品有意不提供抓取与点击比率，因为二者不能证明因果关系。

summary.en: No unclicked-citation or impression measurement; crawler hits are not visits and no causal crawl-to-click ratio is shown.
summary.zh: 不衡量未点击引用或曝光；爬虫命中不是访问，也不显示有因果含义的抓取点击比率。

description.en: Bot detection uses multiple heuristics but remains best effort. Some official documentation incorrectly lists Google-Extended as an AI crawler; it is a robots.txt control token, not an independent crawler User-Agent.
description.zh: 机器人检测采用多种启发式方法，但仍只能尽力而为。部分官方文档错误地把 Google-Extended 列为 AI 爬虫；它是 robots.txt 控制令牌，不是独立爬虫 User-Agent。

summary.en: Bot detection is best effort; documentation misclassifies Google-Extended as a crawler.
summary.zh: 机器人检测只能尽力而为；文档误将 Google-Extended 分类为爬虫。

description.en: Fits teams that want retrospective attribution and granular assistant reporting alongside crawler visibility, while accepting that first-party analytics cannot measure every citation.
description.zh: 适合希望获得回溯归因、细致助手报告和爬虫可见性，同时接受第一方分析无法衡量所有引用的团队。

label.zh: 机器人与 AI 爬虫文档

description.en: Enterprise analytics with a Conversational AI tools referrer type, AI-aware marketing-channel rules, and segments for recognized AI domains. It can recover some missing AI referrals through UTM capture, but public pricing could not be verified.
description.zh: 企业分析工具，提供对话式 AI 工具来源类型、AI 感知营销渠道规则和已识别 AI 域名分群。它可通过 UTM 捕获找回部分缺失的 AI 引荐，但公开价格未能核实。

en: Enterprise analytics
AI referrer reporting
Channel rules
zh: 企业分析
AI 来源报告
渠道规则

en: Referrer type includes Conversational AI tools for recognized domains such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Microsoft Copilot.
Uses referrer or UTM data and supports eVar capture, marketing-channel rules, and segments.
Can classify AI traffic through page URL rules without implementation changes.
Bot detection can analyze pretraining crawler traffic separately from human referral reporting.
zh: 来源类型包含对话式 AI 工具，可识别 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Perplexity 和 Microsoft Copilot 等域名。
使用来源或 UTM 数据，并支持 eVar 捕获、营销渠道规则和分群。
可通过页面 URL 规则识别 AI 流量，无需更改埋点实现。
机器人检测可单独分析预训练爬虫流量，与真人引荐报告分开。

audience.en: Enterprise marketing and analytics teams that need AI referral reporting inside an established analytics implementation.
audience.zh: 需要在既有分析实施中加入 AI 引荐报告的企业营销和分析团队。

description.en: Identify AI-referred visits using the Conversational AI tools referrer type and compare them with other acquisition channels.
description.zh: 使用对话式 AI 工具来源类型识别 AI 引荐访问，并与其他获客渠道比较。

summary.en: Identify AI-referred visits through the Conversational AI referrer type.
summary.zh: 通过对话式 AI 来源类型识别 AI 引荐访问。

description.en: Recover AI attribution when an assistant omits the referrer by capturing utm_source and applying documented channel or segment rules.
description.zh: 当 AI 助手不提供来源时，通过捕获 utm_source 并应用文档化的渠道或分群规则找回 AI 归因。

summary.en: Use UTM capture and channel rules to recover some missing AI attribution.
summary.zh: 通过 UTM 捕获和渠道规则找回部分缺失的 AI 归因。

description.en: A current public price, package amount, currency, and billing period could not be established from accessible official pages on the verification date. Pricing is therefore Unknown. The official product and pricing URLs timed out, and no quote-based model is inferred from that access failure.
description.zh: 在核验日无法从可访问的官方页面确认当前公开价格、套餐金额、币种和账期，因此定价记为 Unknown。官方产品与定价 URL 超时，但不据此推断其采用报价模式。

summary.en: Unknown: official product and pricing pages timed out; no current public amount, currency, billing period, or quote model verified.
summary.zh: 未知：官方产品与定价页面超时；未核实当前公开金额、币种、账期或报价模式。

description.en: Some AI tools, including ChatGPT, may open links without a referrer; those visits can fall into Typed/Bookmarked. If neither referrer nor UTM is available, Adobe documents that the visit cannot be identified as AI traffic.
description.zh: 包括 ChatGPT 在内的部分 AI 工具打开链接时可能不提供来源；这些访问可能归入 Typed/Bookmarked。Adobe 文档说明，如果来源和 UTM 均不可用，就无法识别为 AI 流量。

summary.en: Missing referrer can become Typed/Bookmarked; without referrer or UTM, AI traffic cannot be identified.
summary.zh: 缺失来源可能归为 Typed/Bookmarked；无来源或 UTM 时无法识别 AI 流量。

description.en: Bot detection can reveal pretraining crawler requests, but crawler requests and raw AI search fetches are not human referral visits. Source-link clicks and agentic workflows can generate hits; unclicked links do not establish citations.
description.zh: 机器人检测可以揭示预训练爬虫请求，但爬虫请求和原始 AI 搜索抓取不是真人引荐访问。来源链接点击和代理工作流可能产生命中；未点击链接不能证明引用。

summary.en: Crawler requests and raw AI fetches are not visits; unclicked links do not prove citations.
summary.zh: 爬虫请求和原始 AI 抓取不是访问；未点击链接不能证明引用。

description.en: Adobe Analytics shares the business.adobe.com host with other Adobe products, including the separately listed Adobe Brand Visibility product. The normalized product paths and official documentation establish that this record is Adobe Analytics, not that other product.
description.zh: Adobe Analytics 与其他 Adobe 产品共用 business.adobe.com 域名，其中包括已单独收录的 Adobe Brand Visibility。规范化产品路径和官方文档确认本记录是 Adobe Analytics，而不是该其他产品。

summary.en: Same vendor host as another listed Adobe product; distinct product path and documentation.
summary.zh: 与另一个已收录 Adobe 产品共用域名；产品路径和文档不同。

description.en: Fits enterprises that need AI referrer reporting, UTM recovery, and channel rules within Adobe Analytics; licensing cost and implementation scope require separate confirmation.
description.zh: 适合需要在 Adobe Analytics 内获得 AI 来源报告、UTM 找回和渠道规则的企业；许可成本与实施范围需单独确认。

label.en: Official product page; access timed out during verification
label.zh: 官方产品页；核验时访问超时

label.en: Official pricing page; public price not verified
label.zh: 官方定价页；未核实公开价格

description.en: Local-business platform that tracks daily AI recommendations across ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Google AI Overviews and Google AI Mode, with saved answers, citations, competitors, AI traffic signals and optional Google review automation.
description.zh: 面向本地企业的平台，每日追踪 ChatGPT、Gemini、Claude、Google AI Overviews 和 Google AI Mode 中的 AI 推荐，并提供保存的回答、引用、竞品、AI 流量信号及可选的 Google 评价自动化。

en: AI visibility tracking
Local recommendations
Review automation
zh: AI 可见度追踪
本地推荐
评价自动化

en: Track ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Google AI Overviews and Google AI Mode daily, with all five surfaces included in every plan.
Expand each tracked question into four wordings; the standard panel contains three parent questions per business tracker, subject to account-specific agreements.
Measure visibility, sentiment, mention position and competitor share of voice by prompt, engine and day.
Inspect saved answers, cited URLs, disclosed search and retrieval trails, and keep sponsored placements separate from organic recommendations.
Separate AI crawler activity and pages fetched from detectable referral visits instead of treating bot activity as human traffic.
Connect Google Business Profile through official Google OAuth for a shared review inbox, auto-responses or per-location approval.
zh: 每日追踪 ChatGPT、Gemini、Claude、Google AI Overviews 和 Google AI Mode，所有套餐均包含五个回答界面。
将每个追踪问题扩展为四种表述；标准问题面板每个业务追踪器含三个母问题，具体以账户协议为准。
按问题、引擎和日期衡量可见度、情绪、提及位置及竞品声量份额。
查看保存的回答、引用 URL、已披露的搜索与检索轨迹，并将付费位置与自然推荐分开。
将 AI 爬虫活动和抓取页面与可检测的推荐访问分开，避免把机器人活动当作真人流量。
通过 Google 官方 OAuth 连接 Google 商家资料，使用共享评价收件箱、自动回复或逐门店审批。

audience.en: Local service businesses, multi-location operators, franchises, marketing agencies and reputation teams that need evidence behind AI recommendation visibility and coordinated review operations.
audience.zh: 需要查看 AI 推荐可见度背后证据并协调评价运营的本地服务企业、多门店运营商、连锁品牌、营销代理商及声誉团队。

description.en: Monitor whether local buyer questions produce recommendations, compare the businesses named ahead of the client, and review visibility, sentiment and position changes by prompt and answer surface.
description.zh: 监测本地买家问题是否带来推荐，对比排在客户之前的商家，并按问题和回答界面查看可见度、情绪及位置变化。

summary.en: Track daily local AI recommendations and competitor positions across five answer surfaces.
summary.zh: 跨五个回答界面追踪每日本地 AI 推荐和竞品位置。

description.en: Open the saved answer and inspect cited pages, disclosed fan-out searches and retrieved sources to decide which website, listing or reputation evidence needs improvement.
description.zh: 打开保存的回答，检查引用页面、已披露的扇出搜索和检索来源，以确定需要改进的网站、商家列表或声誉证据。

summary.en: Use answer-level citations and disclosed retrieval evidence to prioritize local content fixes.
summary.zh: 利用回答级引用和已披露的检索证据确定本地内容修复优先级。

description.en: Measure crawler impressions, pages fetched and detectable referral visits as separate signals so teams can distinguish AI answer visibility from actual site visitation.
description.zh: 将爬虫曝光、抓取页面和可检测的推荐访问作为独立信号衡量，使团队能区分 AI 回答可见度与真实网站访问。

summary.en: Separate AI crawler activity from detectable human referral traffic.
summary.zh: 将 AI 爬虫活动与可检测的真人推荐流量分开。

description.en: Manage Google reviews in one inbox and configure automatic responses or approval queues per location, including the option to hold negative and one-to-three-star drafts for review.
description.zh: 在统一收件箱中管理 Google 评价，逐门店配置自动回复或审批队列，并可选择将负面及一至三星草稿暂留待审。

summary.en: Coordinate Google review responses with per-location automation and approval controls.
summary.zh: 通过逐门店自动化和审批控制协调 Google 评价回复。

description.en: Starter is explicitly US$99 per month for one location. It includes AI visibility across all five answer surfaces, source evidence, lead alerts and a Google review inbox with auto-replies.
description.zh: Starter 明确为每月 99 美元，含一个地点，提供五个回答界面的 AI 可见度、来源证据、线索提醒及带自动回复的 Google 评价收件箱。

summary.en: Starter: US$99/month for 1 location, with all five AI answer surfaces and Google review automation.
summary.zh: Starter：99 美元/月，含 1 个地点、全部五个 AI 回答界面及 Google 评价自动化。

description.en: The Growth pricing card shows $449 per month for 5+ locations, adding competitor tracking and per-location reporting to Starter. The visible card does not state a currency code, so the dollar amount is preserved without inferring one.
description.zh: Growth 价格卡显示每月 $449、含 5 个以上地点，并在 Starter 基础上增加竞品追踪和逐门店报告。可见价格卡未注明币种代码，因此保留美元符号金额而不推断币种。

summary.en: Growth: $449/month for 5+ locations; currency code not stated on the visible pricing card.
summary.zh: Growth：$449/月，含 5 个以上地点；可见价格卡未注明币种代码。

description.en: The Agency pricing card shows $799 per month for 10 locations with a multi-client workspace, white-label branding and client-ready reports. The visible card does not state a currency code, so the dollar amount is preserved without inferring one.
description.zh: Agency 价格卡显示每月 $799、含 10 个地点，并提供多客户工作区、白标品牌和客户就绪报告。可见价格卡未注明币种代码，因此保留美元符号金额而不推断币种。

summary.en: Agency: $799/month for 10 locations with multi-client and white-label reporting; currency code unstated.
summary.zh: Agency：$799/月，含 10 个地点、多客户及白标报告；未注明币种代码。

description.en: Every plan advertises a seven-day free trial with no card required. All five AI answer surfaces, daily tracking, source evidence and AI traffic are included, within plan usage limits. Account-specific prompt capacity may differ from the standard panel.
description.zh: 所有套餐均宣传七天免费试用且无需信用卡。五个 AI 回答界面、每日追踪、来源证据和 AI 流量均包含在套餐用量限制内；账户专属问题容量可能与标准面板不同。

summary.en: Seven-day no-card trial on every plan; five surfaces and daily tracking included within plan limits.
summary.zh: 所有套餐均有七天免卡试用；套餐限制内包含五个界面和每日追踪。

description.en: The standard tracker is a focused panel of three parent questions per business tracker, with three generated phrasings per parent rather than unlimited prompt tracking. Generated wordings should be checked for duplicates and intent changes, and account-specific agreements may differ.
description.zh: 标准追踪器是每个业务追踪器三个母问题的聚焦面板，每个母问题生成三种改写，而非无限问题追踪。应检查生成表述是否重复或改变意图，且账户专属协议可能不同。

summary.en: Standard coverage is three parent questions with four wordings each, not unlimited prompts.
summary.zh: 标准覆盖为三个母问题、每个四种表述，并非无限问题。

description.en: Collection methods differ by surface: ChatGPT and Gemini use a web-app collection provider, Google surfaces use a search-results provider, and Claude uses live web search through the Claude Code plan path with no API fallback. Claude is not a recording of a personalized Claude.ai session, and results can differ from an individual user's session.
description.zh: 各界面采集方法不同：ChatGPT 和 Gemini 使用网页应用采集供应商，Google 界面使用搜索结果供应商，Claude 通过 Claude Code 套餐路径运行实时网页搜索且无 API 回退。Claude 并非个性化 Claude.ai 会话录制，结果也可能与个人用户会话不同。

summary.en: Five surfaces use three different collection paths; Claude Code is not personalized Claude.ai recording.
summary.zh: 五个界面使用三条不同采集路径；Claude Code 并非个性化 Claude.ai 录制。

description.en: Perplexity and Copilot are outside the five tracked surfaces. Search and retrieval trails appear only where an engine discloses them, so an absent trail does not prove that no search occurred and should not be treated as a zero.
description.zh: Perplexity 和 Copilot 不在五个追踪界面内。搜索与检索轨迹只在引擎披露时出现，因此缺少轨迹不能证明没有搜索，也不应视为零。

summary.en: No Perplexity or Copilot coverage; undisclosed search trails are not zero activity.
summary.zh: 不覆盖 Perplexity 或 Copilot；未披露的搜索轨迹不等于零活动。

description.en: The privacy policy covers account, connected-business, usage, cookie, diagnostic and communication data, but does not name AI collection or model providers, explain model-training practices, or set a fixed product-data retention period. This is a disclosure gap rather than an identified contradiction.
description.zh: 隐私政策涵盖账户、已连接业务、使用情况、Cookie、诊断和通信数据，但未注明 AI 采集或模型供应商、说明模型训练实践，或设定固定的产品数据保留期。这是披露缺口，并非已发现的矛盾。

summary.en: AI providers, model-training practices and fixed tracker-data retention are not disclosed publicly.
summary.zh: 未公开披露 AI 供应商、模型训练实践及固定的追踪器数据保留期。

description.en: AI drafts and recommendations can be incomplete or inaccurate. The terms require review and approval of public communications, even though the review product can auto-respond or hold drafts according to per-location settings. Google Business Profile access uses official OAuth and can be revoked in Google account settings.
description.zh: AI 草稿和建议可能不完整或不准确。尽管评价产品可按逐门店设置自动回复或暂存草稿，条款仍要求发布前审核并批准公开通信。Google 商家资料访问使用官方 OAuth，并可在 Google 账户设置中撤销。

summary.en: AI output still needs human review; Google OAuth is official and revocable.
summary.zh: AI 输出仍需人工审核；Google OAuth 为官方授权且可撤销。

description.en: A strong fit for local businesses and agencies that need readable saved AI answers plus review operations. The provider explicitly says it does not use fake engagement or review gating, and Google Business Profile access uses official OAuth. Qualify adoption with the documented collection-method differences, limited standard prompt panel and AI-privacy disclosure gaps; no proxy, account-pool or platform-policy conflict was found in the reviewed official materials.
description.zh: 适合需要可读的已保存 AI 回答并同时运营评价的本地企业和代理商。供应商明确表示不使用虚假互动或评价筛选，Google 商家资料采用官方 OAuth。采用时应考虑已记录的采集方法差异、有限的标准问题面板和 AI 隐私披露缺口；在所核验的官方材料中未发现代理、账号池或平台政策冲突。

summary.en: Qualified for direct local AI-answer tracking with no stated review gating; confirm collection methods, prompt capacity and privacy terms.
summary.zh: 具备直接本地 AI 回答追踪能力且声明不做评价筛选；需确认采集方法、问题容量和隐私条款。

label.en: Reputably AI Visibility product and methodology
label.zh: Reputably AI Visibility 产品与方法
Reputably 公司与评价筛选声明
Reputably API 与 MCP 文档

description.en: Hotel-specific AI visibility tracker that repeatedly sends editable booking-intent prompts to ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews, then reports hotel mentions, positions, competitors, cited pages and prioritized recommendations.
description.zh: 面向酒店的 AI 可见度追踪器，反复向 ChatGPT、Gemini、Perplexity 和 Google AI Overviews 发送可编辑的预订意图问题，并报告酒店提及、位置、竞品、引用页面及优先级建议。

en: Hotel AI visibility
Local recommendations
Citation tracking
zh: 酒店 AI 可见度
本地推荐
引用追踪

en: Run the same editable guest-question set on ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews.
Calculate visibility as the percentage of AI chats that mention the hotel, with a default seven-day window and breakdowns by prompt, platform and prompt type.
Inspect full answers, highlighted hotels, mention positions, competitors, cited domains and cited pages in the Prompts & Chats view.
Detect competitors automatically from AI answers and check whether the hotel appears on cited pages.
Turn source and content gaps into hotel-specific actions sorted by impact and effort, with a to-do board and monthly recommendation refreshes.
Choose 20, 30 or 50 tracked questions with weekly or every-second-day refreshes depending on the plan.
zh: 在 ChatGPT、Gemini、Perplexity 和 Google AI Overviews 上运行同一套可编辑的客人问题。
将可见度计算为提及酒店的 AI 对话百分比，默认查看最近七天，并按问题、平台和问题类型拆分。
在 Prompts & Chats 视图查看完整回答、高亮酒店、提及位置、竞品、引用域名和引用页面。
从 AI 回答中自动识别竞品，并检查酒店是否出现在引用页面上。
把来源和内容缺口转化为按影响与工作量排序的酒店专属任务，通过待办看板管理并每月刷新建议。
根据套餐选择 20、30 或 50 个追踪问题，并选择每周或每隔一天刷新。

audience.en: Independent hotels, hotel groups, destination properties and agencies that need repeatable measurement of AI booking recommendations, competitor visibility and source-page gaps.
audience.zh: 需要可重复衡量 AI 预订推荐、竞品可见度和来源页面缺口的独立酒店、酒店集团、目的地物业及代理商。

description.en: Track how often four AI platforms mention a hotel for destination, guest-segment and need-based questions, then compare visibility and average position with automatically detected competitors.
description.zh: 追踪四个 AI 平台在目的地、客群细分和需求型问题中提及酒店的频率，再与自动识别的竞品比较可见度和平均位置。

summary.en: Measure repeated hotel recommendation visibility against same-prompt competitors.
summary.zh: 基于相同问题反复衡量酒店推荐可见度并与竞品对比。

description.en: Open individual chats to verify the full answer, hotel mention position, source domains and pages, and use cited-page presence checks to locate listing or website gaps.
description.zh: 打开单条对话核实完整回答、酒店提及位置、来源域名和页面，并利用引用页面存在性检查定位商家列表或网站缺口。

summary.en: Audit answer-level citations and check whether the hotel appears on cited pages.
summary.zh: 审核回答级引用并检查酒店是否出现在引用页面上。

description.en: Use generated and editable prompts based on the hotel website and Booking.com, Google, Expedia and TripAdvisor listings to cover destination discovery, guest segments and specific guest needs.
description.zh: 使用基于酒店网站及 Booking.com、Google、Expedia、TripAdvisor 列表生成并可编辑的问题，覆盖目的地发现、客群和具体需求。

summary.en: Build hotel-specific prompt coverage from website, listing and AI-derived profile information.
summary.zh: 基于网站、商家列表和 AI 生成的资料信息建立酒店专属问题覆盖。

description.en: Convert AI source and content gaps into a prioritized hotel action plan, manage tasks on a board, and refresh recommendations monthly after subscribing.
description.zh: 将 AI 来源和内容缺口转化为优先级酒店行动计划，通过看板管理任务，并在订阅后每月刷新建议。

summary.en: Turn tracked answer gaps into prioritized website and listing actions.
summary.zh: 把追踪到的回答缺口转化为优先级网站和商家列表行动。

description.en: Monthly AI Visibility Tracker plans are per property: Essential €100, Pro €150 and Max €220 per month. They include 20, 30 and 50 tracked questions respectively, with weekly refresh for Essential and every-second-day refresh for Pro and Max. All prices exclude VAT.
description.zh: AI Visibility Tracker 月付套餐按物业计费：Essential 每月 €100、Pro €150、Max €220，分别包含 20、30、50 个追踪问题；Essential 每周刷新，Pro 和 Max 每隔一天刷新。所有价格均不含增值税。

summary.en: Monthly: €100/€150/€220 per property for 20/30/50 questions; VAT excluded.

description.en: Annual billing displays monthly equivalents of €70 for Essential, €100 for Pro and €150 for Max per property, billed annually. The product page advertises 'Save 33%'; the displayed annual-billed monthly equivalents are not monthly cancellable prices.
description.zh: 年付显示每物业每月等值价：Essential €70、Pro €100、Max €150，按年计费。产品页宣传“Save 33%”；这些年付月均等值价不是可按月取消的月付价格。

summary.en: Annual-billed monthly equivalents: €70/€100/€150 per property; advertised saving 33%.
summary.zh: 年付月均等值价：每物业 €70/€100/€150；宣传节省 33%。

description.en: The tracker advertises a seven-day free trial with no credit card. The trial runs all prompts once at setup and provides one snapshot; results, charts and recommendations do not refresh during the trial. Paid plans continuously rerun prompts according to plan frequency and refresh recommendations monthly.
description.zh: 追踪器宣传七天免费试用且无需信用卡。试用在设置时对所有问题运行一次，只提供一次快照；试用期内结果、图表和建议不会刷新。付费套餐按套餐频率持续重跑问题，并每月刷新建议。

summary.en: Seven-day no-card trial provides one snapshot only; recurring refreshes start with a paid plan.
summary.zh: 七天免卡试用仅提供一次快照；周期刷新从付费套餐开始。

description.en: Unless otherwise agreed, the GTC states no minimum term and termination with 15 days' notice to month-end. Fixed monthly and yearly subscriptions renew unless notice is given 15 days or one month before the term ends respectively; email termination is sufficient. Agency packages are custom-quoted.
description.zh: 除非另有约定，GTC 规定无最短期限，并可提前 15 天通知至月底终止。固定月付和年付订阅分别需在当前期限结束前 15 天或一个月通知方可避免续期；电子邮件终止即可。代理商套餐另行报价。

summary.en: No default minimum term; 15-day month-end notice, with different fixed-term renewal notice; agency pricing is custom.
summary.zh: 默认无最短期限；提前 15 天至月底通知，固定期限续期通知期不同；代理商价格另议。

description.en: The tracked chats are answers to prompts MARA sends, not real guest conversations. AI answers vary with run, location, language and prior context, and there is no universal visibility benchmark; adding, removing or editing prompts also changes the score.
description.zh: 追踪对话是 MARA 发送问题后得到的回答，并非真实客人对话。AI 回答会随运行、地点、语言和先前上下文变化，且没有通用可见度基准；增删或编辑问题也会改变分数。

summary.en: Sampling uses MARA-sent prompts, not real guest chats; scores depend on prompt set and context.
summary.zh: 采样使用 MARA 发送的问题而非真实客人对话；分数取决于问题集和上下文。

description.en: The product is hotel-specific and covers four surfaces only: ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews. Claude is not included, and the tracker does not provide AI prompt search-volume data.
description.zh: 产品专为酒店设计，仅覆盖 ChatGPT、Gemini、Perplexity 和 Google AI Overviews 四个界面，不包含 Claude，也不提供 AI 问题搜索量数据。

summary.en: Hotel-only scope, four AI surfaces, no Claude and no AI prompt search-volume data.
summary.zh: 仅限酒店场景、四个 AI 界面、无 Claude 且无 AI 问题搜索量数据。

description.en: Public product and legal documents identify third-party LLMs and model-hosting subprocessors, but do not fully disclose the technical AI-answer collection provider, search-collection method or platform authorization for each tracked surface. The DPA and subprocessor list provide processor safeguards, but this collection-path disclosure gap should be resolved before rollout.
description.zh: 公开产品和法律文件注明第三方大模型及模型托管分包商，但未完整披露每个追踪界面的技术 AI 回答采集供应商、搜索采集方法或平台授权。DPA 和分包商列表提供了处理者保障，但上线前仍应解决这一采集路径披露缺口。

summary.en: AI-answer collection provider, method and per-surface platform authorization remain incompletely disclosed.
summary.zh: AI 回答采集供应商、方法及逐界面平台授权仍未完整披露。

description.en: MARA Reputation Management is a separate product and its survey flow routes positive responses toward public Google or TripAdvisor reviews while negative feedback stays private. The AI Visibility Tracker can be purchased and used independently, but this provider-level review-gating behavior must be disclosed and must not be conflated with the standalone tracker's measurement function.
description.zh: MARA Reputation Management 是独立产品，其问卷流程将正面评价引导至公开 Google 或 TripAdvisor 评价，负面反馈则保留为私密。AI Visibility Tracker 可独立购买和使用，但必须披露这家供应商的评价筛选行为，且不能与独立追踪器的测量功能混为一谈。

summary.en: Separate MARA survey product uses review gating; the standalone tracker does not require that module.
summary.zh: MARA 独立问卷产品使用评价筛选；独立追踪器无需该模块。

description.en: The GTC describes AI output as probabilistic and potentially inaccurate, incomplete or unsuitable, with no guarantee of accuracy, completeness, timeliness or fitness. Customers must review output and may not publish or enable automatic publication without prior human review.
description.zh: GTC 说明 AI 输出基于概率，可能不准确、不完整或不适用，且不保证准确性、完整性、时效性或适用性。客户必须审核输出，且不得未经人工事先审核就发布或启用自动发布。

summary.en: AI output is not guaranteed and requires human review before publication.
summary.zh: AI 输出无保证，发布前必须经过人工审核。

description.en: Qualified as a standalone hotel-focused tracker with a clearly defined mention-based score, direct answer capture and page-level citation evidence. The legal entity is MARA Solutions GmbH in Mannheim, Germany; the current GTC, DPA and subprocessor list provide contractual and processing safeguards. Evaluate it separately from MARA's gated Reputation Management survey product, confirm the undisclosed collection path and platform authorization for each AI surface, and apply the human-review requirement to AI output.
description.zh: 作为独立酒店追踪器收录：其提及率分数定义清晰，可直接捕获回答并提供页面级引用证据。法律主体为德国曼海姆 MARA Solutions GmbH；现行 GTC、DPA 和分包商列表提供合同与处理保障。应将其与 MARA 使用评价筛选的 Reputation Management 问卷产品分开评估，确认各 AI 界面未披露的采集路径和平台授权，并对 AI 输出执行人工审核要求。

summary.en: Qualified standalone hotel tracker; verify collection authorization and keep the separate gated survey product out of scope.
summary.zh: 合格的独立酒店追踪器；需核实采集授权，并将独立的评价筛选问卷产品排除在本次范围外。

label.en: MARA AI Visibility Tracker product and pricing
label.zh: MARA AI Visibility Tracker 产品与定价

label.en: MARA AI Visibility Tracker overview and standalone product scope
label.zh: MARA AI Visibility Tracker 概览与独立产品范围

label.en: Why AI prompts have no search-volume data
label.zh: AI 问题没有搜索量数据的原因
MARA 如何生成酒店问题
MARA AI Visibility 免费试用

label.en: AI Visibility Tracker and Reputation Management separation
label.zh: AI Visibility Tracker 与 Reputation Management 的区分

label.en: MARA General Terms and Conditions, November 2026
label.zh: MARA 一般条款，2026 年 11 月
MARA 数据处理协议，2026 年 11 月

description.en: AI answer-visibility platform whose local tracking samples city-targeted prompts across supported AI surfaces and preserves local answers, mentioned brands, competitors and cited pages separately from standard brand tracking.
description.zh: AI 回答可见度平台；其本地追踪在支持的 AI 界面上抽样城市定向问题，并将本地回答、被提及品牌、竞品和引用页面与标准品牌追踪分开保存。

en: Local AI visibility
City-level tracking
AI answer citations
zh: 本地 AI 可见度
城市级追踪
AI 回答引用

en: Run local tracking alongside standard tracking for one selected city per prompt, drawing on a catalog of more than 65,000 cities and up to ten local prompts for an eligible brand.
Keep local answers, mentioned brands, competitors and cited pages in separate local result histories rather than folding them into the headline brand score.
Enable supported local surfaces according to plan and rollout; expanded location and model coverage consumes additional prompt slots.
Record UI, API or null as the collection method for every answer run, including disclosed API and no-search fallbacks.
View local dashboard history for up to 90 days and request dedicated local REST/MCP reports for 7, 14, 30 or 90 days, with 14 days as the default.
Use REST API, MCP and Looker Studio access included in valid plans, while ordinary visibility endpoints and standard exports omit local results.
Connect Google Search Console with read-only permission per brand for a nightly sync of the last 90 days of search data.
zh: 在标准追踪之外运行本地追踪，每个问题只选一个城市；城市目录覆盖超过 65,000 个城市，符合条件的品牌最多可有十个本地问题。
将本地回答、被提及品牌、竞品和引用页面保存在独立的本地结果历史中，不并入品牌头条分数。
根据套餐和开放进度启用支持的本地界面；扩展地点和模型覆盖会额外占用问题额度。
每次回答运行记录 UI、API 或空值作为采集方法，并披露 API 回退及无搜索回退。
在仪表盘查看最多 90 天的本地历史，并通过专用本地 REST/MCP 报告请求 7、14、30 或 90 天窗口，默认 14 天。
使用有效套餐包含的 REST API、MCP 和 Looker Studio；普通可见度端点和标准导出不包含本地结果。
以只读权限逐品牌连接 Google Search Console，每晚同步最近 90 天的搜索数据。

audience.en: Local businesses, multi-location brands and agencies that need city-specific evidence of AI recommendations, competitor mentions and cited pages, and can verify whether rollout-gated local tracking is enabled for their account.
audience.zh: 需要城市级 AI 推荐、竞品提及和引用页面证据，并能够确认账户是否已开放本地追踪的本地企业、多门店品牌及代理商。

description.en: Compare how supported AI surfaces mention a brand for a prompt tied to one selected city, then inspect the other mentioned brands, competitors and cited pages preserved in the local answer history.
description.zh: 比较支持的 AI 界面在绑定一个所选城市的问题中如何提及品牌，再查看本地回答历史中保存的其他被提及品牌、竞品和引用页面。

summary.en: Compare city-prompt brand mentions, competitors and cited pages on supported AI surfaces.
summary.zh: 在支持的 AI 界面上比较城市问题的品牌提及、竞品和引用页面。

description.en: Investigate which pages AI answers cite for local prompts and use the separate local history to review changes over the dashboard's up-to-90-day window without treating local results as part of the headline visibility score.
description.zh: 调查 AI 回答为本地问题引用了哪些页面，并利用独立的本地历史在仪表盘最长 90 天窗口内复查变化，同时不把本地结果当作头条可见度分数的一部分。

summary.en: Review local cited pages and up-to-90-day history separately from the headline visibility score.
summary.zh: 独立于头条可见度分数复查本地引用页面及最长 90 天历史。

description.en: Deliver local evidence to clients or internal teams through dedicated local REST/MCP reports, selecting 7, 14, 30 or 90 days; reports default to 14 days and reject requests above 300 checks or requests that mix effective geographies.
description.zh: 通过专用本地 REST/MCP 报告向客户或内部团队交付本地证据，可选择 7、14、30 或 90 天；报告默认 14 天，超过 300 次检查或混合有效地理范围的请求会被拒绝。

summary.en: Share local REST/MCP reports for 7/14/30/90 days; default 14 days, with a 300-check cap.
summary.zh: 分享 7/14/30/90 天本地 REST/MCP 报告；默认 14 天，检查次数上限为 300。

description.en: Connect an already-authorized Search Console property read-only and review the last 90 days of nightly search data alongside AI answer tracking. This is search-performance context, not proof that AI referrals caused visits.
description.zh: 以只读方式连接已有权限的 Search Console 资源，并结合 AI 回答追踪查看最近 90 天的夜间搜索数据。这是搜索表现背景，不能证明访问由 AI 推荐导致。

summary.en: Add read-only Search Console context with nightly 90-day sync; it does not measure AI referral causation.
summary.zh: 加入只读 Search Console 背景并每晚同步 90 天数据；不衡量 AI 推荐访问的因果关系。

description.en: Plans are configurable by brand count, prompts per brand, selected models and analysis cadence; official body and help text say plans start at USD 30/month. The displayed default is one brand, 40 prompts, analysis every two days and three models. Annual billing advertises 15% savings, rounds the monthly equivalent to a whole dollar and bills 12 months at once.
description.zh: 套餐按品牌数、每品牌问题数、所选模型和分析频率配置；官方正文和帮助文本称套餐自每月 30 美元起。展示的默认配置为一个品牌、40 个问题、每两天分析一次和三个模型。年付宣传节省 15%，月均等值价取整为整数美元，并一次收取 12 个月费用。

summary.en: From USD 30/month in body text; configurable by brands, prompts, models and cadence. Annual billing saves 15% and bills 12 months upfront.
summary.zh: 正文价格为每月 30 美元起；按品牌、问题、模型和频率配置。年付节省 15%，一次收取 12 个月。

description.en: A one-time free report requires no card and is not an ongoing free monitoring tier. A 14-day card-backed trial is offered only for configurations below USD 100/month with at least ten prompts per brand, once per workspace/account subscription history; configurations at USD 100/month or more bill at checkout without a trial.
description.zh: 一次性免费报告无需信用卡，但不是持续免费监测套餐。14 天信用卡试用仅适用于每月低于 100 美元且每品牌至少十个问题的配置，每个工作区/账户的订阅历史仅限一次；每月 100 美元及以上的配置在结账时直接收费，不提供试用。

summary.en: One-time no-card report; 14-day card trial only below USD 100/month with 10+ prompts/brand and one trial per subscription history.
summary.zh: 一次性免卡报告；仅每月低于 100 美元且每品牌至少十个问题可享 14 天信用卡试用，每个订阅历史限一次。

description.en: White-label controls and share links are included at a list price of USD 100/month or more, and a custom share-link domain starts at USD 250/month. More than 150 brands requires custom volume pricing; public configurations at USD 600/month or more route to a sales consultation.
description.zh: 标价每月 100 美元及以上包含白标控制和分享链接；自定义分享链接域名自每月 250 美元起。超过 150 个品牌需定制批量价格；公开配置每月 600 美元及以上会转至销售咨询。

summary.en: White-label/share links at USD 100+/month; custom domain from USD 250; 150+ brands custom; USD 600+ routes to sales.
summary.zh: 每月 100 美元及以上含白标/分享链接；自定义域名 250 美元起；150+ 品牌定制；600 美元及以上转销售。

description.en: Fees are billed in advance through Stripe. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the billing cycle, and unused time is not refunded unless law requires it; the provider may issue a discretionary refund or credit for billing errors.
description.zh: 费用通过 Stripe 提前收取。取消在计费周期结束时生效；除非法律要求，未使用时间不予退款；供应商可对账单错误自行决定退款或抵扣。

summary.en: Advance Stripe billing; cancellation at cycle end; no unused-time refunds unless legally required, with discretionary billing-error relief.
summary.zh: 通过 Stripe 提前收费；周期末取消生效；未使用时间除法律要求外不退，账单错误可酌情补救。

description.en: Local tracking is rolling out to paid plans and appears only for brands enabled for it; it is not universally available. An eligible brand has up to ten local prompts, and enabling expanded model coverage consumes one additional prompt slot for each enabled local location. If the Prompts table has no Location column, support must be contacted.
description.zh: 本地追踪正逐步向付费套餐开放，且只对已启用的品牌显示，并非普遍可用。符合条件的品牌最多有十个本地问题；启用扩展模型覆盖时，每个已启用本地地点会额外占用一个问题额度。若 Prompts 表没有 Location 列，须联系支持。

summary.en: Rollout-gated to enabled paid brands; up to 10 local prompts/brand, with extra slots for expanded locations/models.
summary.zh: 仅向已开放的付费品牌逐步推出；每品牌最多十个本地问题，扩展地点/模型会占用额外额度。

description.en: Each prompt supports one city, and the requested city, state or country can differ from the geography actually applied by an AI provider. A saved targeting record describes the request, not proof of a geographically correct answer or of what a particular person would see. Changing city preserves history but does not allow side-by-side comparison within one prompt.
description.zh: 每个问题只支持一个城市，且请求的城市、州或国家可能与 AI 供应商实际应用的地理范围不同。已保存的定向记录仅说明请求，不能证明回答地理上正确，也不能代表某个具体用户会看到的内容。更改城市会保留历史，但不允许在同一问题内并排比较。

summary.en: One city/prompt; requested geography may differ from effective provider geography, and city history cannot be compared side by side within one prompt.
summary.zh: 每个问题一个城市；请求地理范围可能与供应商实际范围不同，且同一问题内不能并排比较不同城市历史。

description.en: Collection is not a single consumer-interface method. ChatGPT usually uses the consumer UI but can fall back to OpenAI API with web search or, as a last resort, without search. Gemini uses API search grounding with some UI collection and can fall back to ungrounded API. Perplexity usually uses UI with an API fallback. Fallback answers still count as model results.
description.zh: 采集并非单一的消费者界面方法。ChatGPT 通常使用消费者 UI，但可回退到带网页搜索的 OpenAI API，最后手段是不带搜索的 API。Gemini 使用带搜索接地的 API，并有部分 UI 采集，还可回退到无接地 API。Perplexity 通常使用 UI，并有 API 回退。回退回答仍计入模型结果。

summary.en: ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity mix UI/API collection and fallbacks; fallback answers still count toward results.
summary.zh: ChatGPT、Gemini 和 Perplexity 混合使用 UI/API 采集与回退；回退回答仍计入结果。

description.en: Google AI Overviews and Google AI Mode use their respective Google interfaces with no fallback. The Copilot add-on uses the consumer web UI without fallback. The Claude add-on uses Anthropic API model claude-sonnet-5 with web search, not the consumer Claude UI, and has no fallback.
description.zh: Google AI Overviews 和 Google AI Mode 使用各自的 Google 界面且无回退。Copilot 加购使用消费者网页 UI 且无回退。Claude 加购使用带网页搜索的 Anthropic API 模型 claude-sonnet-5，并非消费者 Claude UI，且无回退。

summary.en: Google surfaces and Copilot are UI-only; Claude is an Anthropic API/web-search add-on, not consumer Claude UI.
summary.zh: Google 界面和 Copilot 仅用 UI；Claude 是 Anthropic API/网页搜索加购，并非消费者 Claude UI。

description.en: Local results do not change the headline visibility score, prompt table or Overview charts. Ordinary visibility endpoints and standard exports omit local results. Local reports return at most 10 answers, 20 competitors and 30 sources and reject requests over 300 checks or mixing effective geographies.
description.zh: 本地结果不会改变头条可见度分数、问题表或 Overview 图表。普通可见度端点和标准导出不包含本地结果。本地报告最多返回 10 个回答、20 个竞品和 30 个来源，并拒绝超过 300 次检查或混合有效地理范围的请求。

summary.en: Local data is separate from headline metrics and standard exports; report caps are 10 answers, 20 competitors, 30 sources and 300 checks.
summary.zh: 本地数据独立于头条指标和标准导出；报告上限为 10 个回答、20 个竞品、30 个来源和 300 次检查。

description.en: The pricing page's JSON-LD advertises USD lowPrice 29 and highPrice 599, while its visible body and help text say plans start at USD 30 and public configurations at USD 600 or more route to sales. This record uses the body/help starting price and preserves the metadata discrepancy rather than treating USD 29 as a purchasable tier.
description.zh: 定价页 JSON-LD 宣传美元 lowPrice 29、highPrice 599，而可见正文和帮助文本称套餐自 30 美元起、公开配置每月 600 美元及以上转销售咨询。本记录采用正文/帮助文本的起步价并保留元数据差异，不把 29 美元视为可购买档位。

summary.en: JSON-LD says USD 29–599, conflicting with body text from USD 30 and the USD 600 sales boundary; body/help pricing is used.
summary.zh: JSON-LD 为 29–599 美元，与正文 30 美元起及 600 美元转销售冲突；采用正文/帮助文本价格。

description.en: The November 6, 2026 privacy policy names OpenAI, Google Gemini, Perplexity and SimilarWeb, but does not explicitly list Anthropic/Claude even though the methodology documents a Claude API add-on. It does not state an explicit no-general-model-training commitment or a fixed post-termination product-data deletion period; enterprise DPA access is request-only.
description.zh: 2026-11-06 隐私政策列出 OpenAI、Google Gemini、Perplexity 和 SimilarWeb，但未明确列出 Anthropic/Claude，尽管方法文档说明了 Claude API 加购。政策未明确承诺不用于通用模型训练，也未设定固定的终止后产品数据删除期限；企业 DPA 仅可申请。

summary.en: Claude is omitted from the public provider list; no explicit no-training pledge or fixed deletion period; enterprise DPA is request-only.
summary.zh: 公开供应商名单遗漏 Claude；无明确不训练承诺或固定删除期限；企业 DPA 仅可申请。

description.en: Moving a brand to trash allows restoration for 30 days and is not permanent erasure. Deleting the sign-in account neither cancels the subscription nor erases workspace brands/history. Full personal/workspace erasure requires emailing team@aipeekaboo.com, requests are generally answered within about 30 days, and aggregated de-identified statistics may persist.
description.zh: 将品牌移入回收站后可在 30 天内恢复，并非永久删除。删除登录账户既不会取消订阅，也不会清除工作区品牌/历史。完整删除个人/工作区数据须发送电子邮件至 team@aipeekaboo.com，请求通常在约 30 天内答复，聚合去标识统计可能继续保留。

summary.en: Trash is a 30-day restore window; account deletion does not cancel or erase workspace data; full erasure is email-based and de-identified aggregates may persist.
summary.zh: 回收站仅有 30 天恢复期；删除账户不取消订阅或清除工作区数据；完整删除需邮件申请，去标识聚合数据可能保留。

description.en: Search Console access is read-only and per brand, requires an active paid plan or running trial and pre-existing property access, and can be disconnected without changing the Google account. The help article does not state exact OAuth scopes or Google API limited-use obligations, and the reviewed materials do not document a Google Business Profile integration.
description.zh: Search Console 权限为逐品牌只读，需要有效的付费套餐或进行中的试用以及事先拥有的资源权限；断开连接不会更改 Google 账户。帮助文章未说明具体 OAuth 范围或 Google API 有限使用义务，所核验材料也未记录 Google 商家资料集成。

summary.en: Search Console is read-only with pre-existing access; exact OAuth scopes/limited-use terms are unstated and no GBP integration is documented.
summary.zh: Search Console 为只读且需已有权限；未说明具体 OAuth 范围/有限使用条款，也未记录商家资料集成。

description.en: Local tracking is a rollout/beta capability covered by as-is/as-available terms, under which preview and trial features may change or be discontinued. The terms also permit aggregated/de-identified Service Data to be used, published and shared during and after the subscription, including confidential research sharing subject to non-reidentification restrictions.
description.zh: 本地追踪属于逐步开放/测试能力，受按现状/可用性条款约束，预览和试用功能可能变更或停止。条款还允许在订阅期间及之后使用、发布和共享聚合去标识服务数据，包括在保密和不重新识别限制下与研究机构共享。

summary.en: Local tracking is rollout-gated and may change or end; aggregated/de-identified service data may be reused and shared after subscription.
summary.zh: 本地追踪逐步开放且可能变更或停止；聚合去标识服务数据可在订阅后继续使用和共享。

description.en: Qualified as a paid, rollout-gated local AI answer tracker, not as proof of personalized city-level consumer results. The contracting entity is Think Outside The Box Ventures, LLC, a Wyoming LLC, under current October 26, 2026 terms. Official materials disclose collection methods, read-only Search Console access and deletion procedures; no proxy, account-pool, review-gating or platform-policy conflict was found in the reviewed materials. Confirm account-level local availability, effective geography, collection permissions and the undisclosed AI-provider/training/retention details before relying on results for client decisions.

Multi-location
Competitor analysis

多门店
竞品分析

en: Automated daily questions across ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity.
Per-location visibility scores based on mentions, recommendation position, business-information accuracy, sentiment, and citation depth.
Multi-city prompt targeting, competitor benchmarking and movement alerts, citation-source tracking, and citation-gap analysis.
An AI Search Website Audit covering technical and content checks related to AI citations.

逐门店计算曝光评分，纳入提及、推荐位置、商家信息准确性、情绪和引用深度。
支持多城市问题定位、竞品对标与变动提醒、引用来源追踪及引用缺口分析。
提供 AI Search Website Audit，检查与 AI 引用相关的技术和内容项目。

audience.en: Multi-location brands, franchises, agencies, and local service businesses that need city-level AI recommendation and competitor monitoring.
audience.zh: 需要按城市监测 AI 推荐和竞品的多门店品牌、连锁企业、代理商及本地服务企业。

description.en: Run local buyer questions by city and compare per-location mentions, recommendation positions, and visibility trends across the three supported engines.
description.zh: 按城市运行本地购买者问题，对比各门店在三个受支持引擎中的提及、推荐位置和曝光趋势。

summary.en: Compare city-level questions and per-location AI mentions, recommendation positions, and trends.
summary.zh: 按城市对比问题，以及逐门店的 AI 提及、推荐位置和趋势。

description.en: Investigate questions where competitors are named, compare citation sources and sentiment, and turn the gaps into a local content, profile, or website-audit worklist.
description.zh: 调查 AI 回答提及竞品的问题，对比引用来源和情绪，并把缺口整理为本地内容、商家资料或网站审计工作清单。

summary.en: Find competitor-led answers, citation gaps, and sentiment differences for local optimization work.
summary.zh: 找出竞品占优的回答、引用缺口和情绪差异，用于本地优化工作。

description.zh: 在印度，AI Visibility Solo 为每月 999 印度卢比，按月计费，包含 10 个 AI 问题。该金额仅适用于独立 AI Visibility 产品，不适用于另列的 Google Business Profile 套餐。

summary.en: India AI Visibility Solo: INR 999/month, monthly billing, 10 AI prompts.
summary.zh: 印度 AI Visibility Solo：999 印度卢比/月，月付，含 10 个 AI 问题。

description.en: Quarterly and annual billing have lower per-month prices, but the reviewed source does not preserve exact discounted amounts. Enterprise has custom pricing and unlimited prompts; outside India, the standalone AI Visibility plan is quoted by the team.
description.zh: 季付和年付的月均价格更低，但本次核验的来源未保留确切折后金额。企业版自定义报价且问题不限量；印度以外的独立 AI Visibility 套餐由团队报价。

summary.en: Quarterly/annual discounts exist; exact discounted amounts were not captured. Enterprise is custom with unlimited prompts; non-India pricing is quoted.
summary.zh: 有季付/年付折扣但未记录折后金额；企业版自定义、问题不限量；印度以外需报价。

description.en: Self-serve plans start with a 7-day free trial. Enterprise is configured with the team instead, so the trial is not an ongoing free tier or an Enterprise entitlement.
description.zh: 自助套餐提供 7 天免费试用；企业版由团队配置，因此试用既不构成长期免费层，也不是企业版权益。

summary.en: 7-day trial for self-serve plans only; no ongoing free tier and no Enterprise trial entitlement.
summary.zh: 仅自助套餐有 7 天试用；无长期免费层，企业版无试用权益。

description.en: The self-serve AI Visibility plan includes 10 prompts. The official page does not publish a fixed standalone AI Visibility price outside India, where a team quote is required.
description.zh: 自助 AI Visibility 套餐包含 10 个问题。官方页面未公布印度以外的独立 AI Visibility 固定价格，需要团队报价。

summary.en: 10-prompt self-serve cap; fixed non-India AI Visibility pricing is not published.
summary.zh: 自助套餐限 10 个问题；未公布印度以外的固定 AI Visibility 价格。

description.en: The product FAQ says initial discovery and diagnosis results are available within 48 hours, while location scores are updated daily. Daily updating should not be read as an immediate first report.
description.zh: 产品 FAQ 表示初次发现和诊断结果在 48 小时内提供，而门店评分每日更新。每日更新不等于首次报告即时完成。

summary.en: Initial discovery and diagnosis can take up to 48 hours despite daily score updates.
summary.zh: 尽管评分每日更新，初次发现和诊断仍可能需 48 小时。

description.en: A fit for teams that need city-specific prompt monitoring and competitor/citation diagnostics inside a local-SEO platform; confirm prompt capacity and the regional quote before adoption.

summary.en: City-level monitoring plus local-SEO diagnostics; verify prompt capacity and regional pricing.
summary.zh: 城市级监测结合本地 SEO 诊断；需确认问题容量与地区价格。

description.en: Monthly service-area AI recommendation monitoring that measures answer share, first-choice mentions, missing locations, and named competitors across five AI engines, with human-reviewed reports.
description.zh: 按月监测服务区域的 AI 推荐，衡量回答占比、首选提及、缺失门店和具名竞品，覆盖五类 AI 引擎，并提供人工复核报告。

en: Service-area monitoring
AI Answer Share
Reviewed reports
zh: 服务区域监测
AI 回答占比
人工复核报告

en: Asks questions from the business's customer area across major AI engines every month.
Reports ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews separately.
Shows first-choice, mentioned, and missing areas, plus the competitors recommended instead and their frequency.
Provides an AI Answer Share timeline and a report reviewed by a Cloute analyst.
zh: 每月从企业客户所在区域提出问题，并交给主要 AI 引擎。
分别报告 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Perplexity 和 Google AI Overviews。
展示首选、仅被提及和缺失区域，以及 AI 转而推荐的竞品和出现频次。
提供 AI Answer Share 时间线和经 Cloute 分析师复核的报告。

audience.en: Local businesses and service brands that want recurring, analyst-reviewed monitoring of the market they draw customers from, with follow-on optimization agents available.
audience.zh: 希望持续、由分析师复核其客源市场 AI 表现，并可继续使用优化代理的本地企业与服务品牌。

description.zh: 每月按引擎对服务区域进行对标，查看企业在何处成为首选、何处仅被提及以及何处缺失。

summary.en: Monthly service-area benchmarking for first-choice, mentioned, and missing locations.
summary.zh: 按月对服务区域的首选、提及和缺失情况进行对标。

description.en: Identify the named competitors recommended when the business is absent and use the AI Answer Share timeline to review reported changes alongside completed work.
description.zh: 找出企业缺失时被推荐的具名竞品，并结合已完成工作，通过 AI Answer Share 时间线复盘报告中的变化。

summary.en: Identify substitute competitors and review AI Answer Share changes over time.
summary.zh: 识别替代竞品，并复盘 AI 回答占比的长期变化。
