description.en: Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled. Cancellation is available in the dashboard or by email and takes effect at the end of the paid period; partial periods are not refunded or prorated.
description.zh: 订阅自动续期直至取消。可在控制台或通过邮件取消，取消在当前付费期结束时生效；不满期不退款也不按比例折算。

summary.en: Auto-renewal; cancel for period-end effect, with no partial-period refund or proration.
summary.zh: 自动续期；取消后期末生效，不满期不退款或按比例折算。

description.en: The public product page states a monthly measurement cycle but does not publish question counts, per-location limits, or answer-sampling quotas.
description.zh: 公开产品页说明按月测量，但未公布问题数量、逐门店上限或回答采样配额。

summary.en: Monthly cadence is public; question counts and per-location sampling quotas are not.
summary.zh: 公开按月监测；未公开问题数量及逐门店采样配额。

description.en: The terms provide no default service-level agreement or downtime credits unless the Order Form states otherwise, and they do not guarantee rankings, recommendations, or business outcomes.
description.zh: 除非 Order Form 另有约定，条款不提供默认服务水平协议或停机补偿，也不保证排名、推荐或商业结果。

summary.en: No default SLA or downtime credits; no ranking, recommendation, or business-outcome guarantee.
summary.zh: 无默认 SLA 或停机补偿；不保证排名、推荐或商业结果。

description.en: Choose for recurring service-area market reports with human review and access to follow-on agents; confirm question volume and location scope in the Order Form before relying on the service as a self-serve tracker.
description.zh: 适合需要持续服务区域报告、人工复核和后续代理服务的团队；若希望作为自助追踪工具使用，应先在 Order Form 中确认问题数量和门店范围。

summary.en: Reviewed market reports plus follow-on agents; confirm scope before treating it as self-serve tracking.
summary.zh: 人工复核市场报告结合后续代理；作为自助追踪前需确认范围。

Home services
Local visibility

家庭服务
本地曝光

Connects AI visibility reporting with review, profile, citation, local-page, and website work.

展示采样回答中的竞品和来源，并对应到公开证据缺口。
Visibility 套餐包含每日 AI 搜索、每周 Google Maps 关键词追踪、商家资料检查及带 AI 回复的评价收件箱。
将 AI 曝光报告与评价、商家资料、引用、本地页面和网站工作衔接。

audience.en: Established home-service companies, local brands, and multi-location portfolios that need market-level AI answer monitoring alongside local visibility operations.
audience.zh: 需要市场级 AI 回答监测并结合本地曝光运营的成熟家庭服务公司、本地品牌和多门店组合。

description.en: Track high-intent local buyer prompts by market and compare recommendation, citation, mention, and omission patterns, including the competitors and sources in each answer.

summary.zh: 对比市场级本地回答中的推荐、引用、竞品和遗漏情况。

description.zh: 检查评价、商家资料、引用和本地页面的证据缺口，并在约定工作完成后重新测量相同的优先问题。

summary.en: Turn answer evidence gaps into local visibility tasks and remeasure the same questions.
summary.zh: 把回答中的证据缺口转为本地曝光任务，并重测相同问题。

description.en: Visibility is USD 750 per month before tax, discounts, and promotions. It covers one brand and website with up to three Google Business Profiles, 10 AI searches daily, 10 Google Maps keywords weekly, and the listed software features. No setup fee is published.

summary.en: Visibility: USD 750/month before tax, discounts, and promotions; one brand, up to 3 Business Profiles, 10 daily AI searches, and 10 weekly Maps keywords.
summary.zh: Visibility：750 美元/月，未含税/折扣/促销；一个品牌、最多 3 个商家资料、每日 10 次 AI 搜索、每周 10 个 Maps 关键词。

summary.en: Managed: from USD 3,000/month before tax, discounts, and promotions; scope and team work are agreed before start.
summary.zh: Managed：3,000 美元/月起，未含税/折扣/促销；开始前约定范围和团队工作。

description.en: Physical NFC and QR badges cost USD 10 each for the first three and USD 3 each thereafter; digital employee badges are included. Standard plans are month-to-month with 30 days' written cancellation notice. Contracted annual plans require 30 days' notice before renewal and are non-refundable after the first 30 days.

summary.en: Physical badges: USD 10 each for the first 3, then USD 3 each. Standard plans are monthly; annual contracts have renewal and refund conditions.
summary.zh: 实体徽章前 3 个每个 10 美元，之后每个 3 美元；标准套餐按月，年付合同有续期和退款条件。

summary.zh: Visibility 限一个品牌、最多 3 个商家资料且不含博客；更大范围需签约。

summary.zh: 报告限内部使用；再分发或白标需许可，在线率为目标而非保证。

summary.en: Free grader: 3 scans/email and 5 scans/IP per rolling 24 hours; no automated or bulk access and no ongoing free tier.
summary.zh: 免费扫描：每邮箱 3 次、每 IP 5 次/滚动 24 小时；禁自动或批量访问，无持续免费层。

description.zh: 隐私政策表示不出售个人信息，但部分广告活动可能构成 CCPA 下的共享；可向 info@cheers.tech 提出退出请求。

summary.en: No sale of personal information; some advertising may count as CCPA sharing, with opt-out by email.
summary.zh: 不出售个人信息；部分广告可能属于 CCPA 共享，可通过邮件退出。

description.en: A fit for established home-service teams that want AI-answer monitoring paired with local-profile and review operations; the published entry plan is limited to one brand and three Business Profiles.
description.zh: 适合希望把 AI 回答监测与本地商家资料和评价运营结合的成熟家庭服务团队；公开入门套餐限一个品牌和三个商家资料。

summary.en: Combines AI-answer monitoring with local operations; entry scope is one brand and up to 3 Business Profiles.

对比企业所在区域的竞品 AI 曝光，识别推荐差异。

audience.zh: 需要在更完整的本地营销套件中进行 AI 竞品和引用诊断的本地企业、代理商、连锁品牌和多门店企业。

description.en: Compare AI visibility against local competitors for relevant queries and identify which engines recommend competitors more often or place the business in lower rank bands.
description.zh: 针对相关问题对比本地竞品的 AI 曝光，找出哪些引擎更常推荐竞品，或把企业放在较低排名区间。

summary.en: Compare local competitors by engine, recommendation frequency, and rank band.
summary.zh: 按引擎、推荐频次和排名区间对比本地竞品。

description.en: Inspect citation coverage and sentiment phrases to identify missing sources and content areas for follow-up, while keeping AI-answer reporting separate from traditional local-pack reporting.
description.zh: 检查引用覆盖和情绪短语，识别缺失来源和待处理内容领域，同时把 AI 回答报告与传统本地排名报告分开。

summary.en: Find missing citation sources and sentiment issues without mixing AI answers into local-pack reporting.
summary.zh: 找出缺失引用来源和情绪问题，并区分 AI 回答与本地排名报告。

description.en: With monthly billing, Solo is $49 per month for one location with 20,000 monthly credits, one parallel Agent chat, and a shared environment. Premium is $299 per month for up to 10 locations with 200,000 credits, three chats, a shared environment, and white labeling. The page shows only the $ symbol and does not publish a currency code, so USD is not assumed.
description.zh: 月付时，Solo 为每月 $49，含一个门店、每月 20,000 积分、一个并行 Agent 对话和共享环境。Premium 为每月 $299，最多 10 个门店、200,000 积分、三个对话、共享环境和白标。页面仅显示 $ 符号而未公布币种代码，因此不推定为美元。

summary.en: Monthly: Solo $49 for 1 location and 20,000 credits; Premium $299 for up to 10 locations and 200,000 credits. Currency code is not published.
summary.zh: 月付：Solo $49/1 门店/20,000 积分；Premium $299/最多 10 门店/200,000 积分；未公布币种代码。

description.en: Pro is $499 per month for up to 25 locations, 600,000 monthly credits, five parallel chats, a dedicated environment, and white labeling. Scale is $899 per month for up to 50 locations, 1,200,000 credits, 10 chats, and a dedicated environment. Enterprise for 50+ locations uses custom contract pricing. The currency code is not published.
description.zh: Pro 为每月 $499，最多 25 个门店、每月 600,000 积分、五个并行对话、专属环境和白标。Scale 为每月 $899，最多 50 个门店、1,200,000 积分、10 个对话和专属环境。50+ 门店的企业版采用自定义合同价格；未公布币种代码。

summary.en: Monthly: Pro $499 for up to 25 locations and 600,000 credits; Scale $899 for up to 50 locations and 1,200,000 credits; Enterprise is custom. Currency code is not published.
summary.zh: 月付：Pro $499/最多 25 门店/600,000 积分；Scale $899/最多 50 门店/1,200,000 积分；企业版自定义；未公布币种代码。

description.en: Annual billing is advertised as saving 20%, and monthly plans can be cancelled before the next renewal. Card or invoice billing is monthly in advance. Exact discounted annual dollar amounts were not captured from the visible pricing content.
description.zh: 年付宣传节省 20%，月付套餐可在下次续期前取消。支持银行卡或发票，按月提前计费；本次未从可见价格内容记录确切年付折后金额。

summary.en: Annual billing advertises 20% savings; exact discounted annual amounts were not captured. Monthly plans are billed in advance and cancellable before renewal.
summary.zh: 年付宣传节省 20%，未记录确切折后金额；月付提前计费，可在续期前取消。

description.en: AEO is labeled New Beta. The FAQ says coverage for newer conversational platforms is rolled out progressively and shown with a status badge in the report.
description.zh: AEO 标注为 New Beta。FAQ 表示较新的对话平台会逐步开放覆盖，并在报告中用状态标记显示。

summary.en: AEO is in beta, and newer platform coverage is rolled out progressively.
summary.zh: AEO 处于测试阶段，较新平台的覆盖逐步推出。

description.en: The pricing page advertises a 14-day free trial for every plan, but its FAQ says starting a paid Premium subscription triggers an immediate charge and the free trial does not apply. Trial eligibility should be confirmed; no ongoing free tier is established.
description.zh: 价格页宣传所有套餐均有 14 天免费试用，但 FAQ 表示开始付费 Premium 订阅会立即扣费且不适用免费试用。应确认试用资格；不存在长期免费层。

summary.en: Trial messaging conflicts: a 14-day trial is advertised, but an immediately started paid Premium subscription is charged without it. Confirm eligibility.
summary.zh: 试用说明冲突：宣传 14 天试用，但立即开始付费 Premium 会收费且无试用；需确认资格。

description.en: The displayed credit allowances are labeled as quadrupled for launch. Accounts created on or before September 30 keep those allowances for as long as the account remains open.
description.zh: 显示的积分额度标注为上线期间四倍。9 月 30 日或之前创建的账户，只要账户保持开放即可继续保留这些额度。

summary.en: Displayed credits are launch-quadrupled; accounts created on or before September 30 retain them while open.
summary.zh: 显示积分为上线期间四倍；9 月 30 日及之前创建的账户在存续期间保留。

description.en: The official pricing page uses the $ symbol without stating a currency code. The amounts are preserved as displayed rather than converted or labeled USD.
description.zh: 官方价格页使用 $ 符号但未说明币种代码。金额按页面原样保留，不换算也不标注为美元。

summary.en: Pricing currency code is unpublished; displayed $ amounts are not assumed to be USD.
summary.zh: 未公布价格币种代码；不将显示的 $ 金额推定为美元。

description.en: A fit for location portfolios that need AI competitor and citation diagnostics inside a broader local-marketing suite; confirm beta scope, trial eligibility, billing currency, and promotional credit terms.
description.zh: 适合需要在更完整的本地营销套件内进行 AI 竞品和引用诊断的门店组合；应确认测试范围、试用资格、计费币种和积分优惠条款。

summary.en: Local suite with AI competitor and citation diagnostics; verify beta, trial, currency, and credit terms.
summary.zh: 本地套件包含 AI 竞品与引用诊断；需核实测试、试用、币种和积分条款。

label.zh: Synup AEO 产品与覆盖范围

label.en: Synup current contact and legal identity
label.zh: Synup 当前联系信息与法律主体

description.en: Agentic local-search software for multi-location brands that monitors location signals and visibility across local search, maps, and AI-driven discovery, analyzes search patterns, and publishes approved listing and local-page optimizations.
description.zh: 面向多门店品牌的代理式本地搜索软件，监测逐门店信号及本地搜索、地图和 AI 发现中的曝光，分析搜索模式，并发布经批准的商家资料和本地页面优化。

en: Multi-location
Local search monitoring
Agentic publishing
zh: 多门店
本地搜索监测
代理式发布

en: Monitors search rankings, listing accuracy, keyword trends, and engagement across locations.
Tracks visibility across local search, maps, and AI-driven discovery with location-by-location benchmarking.
Analyzes traditional and AI search patterns and local demand to identify changes for each location.
Publishes automatically, routes changes for approval, or combines both under brand guardrails.
Supports local SEO and AEO work intended to help locations appear in ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity.
zh: 监测各门店的搜索排名、商家资料准确性、关键词趋势和互动。
追踪本地搜索、地图和 AI 发现中的曝光，并逐门店对标。
分析传统与 AI 搜索模式及本地需求，为各门店识别待处理变化。
可自动发布、转交审批或两者结合，并受品牌规则约束。
支持旨在帮助门店出现在 ChatGPT、Gemini 和 Perplexity 中的本地 SEO 与 AEO 工作。

audience.en: Enterprise multi-location brands and franchises that need centralized governance, location-level search visibility monitoring, and automated or approval-based local SEO execution.
audience.zh: 需要集中治理、逐门店搜索曝光监测，以及自动或审批式本地 SEO 执行的大型多门店品牌和连锁企业。

description.en: Benchmark locations across local search, maps, and AI-driven discovery, then use listing, keyword, engagement, and visibility signals to prioritize location-level investigations.
description.zh: 对本地搜索、地图和 AI 发现中的各门店进行对标，再结合商家资料、关键词、互动和曝光信号确定逐门店调查优先级。

summary.en: Benchmark location-level local and AI discovery visibility to prioritize investigations.
summary.zh: 对逐门店本地与 AI 发现曝光进行对标，以确定调查优先级。

description.en: Analyze traditional and AI search patterns, draft listing or local-page changes, and publish them automatically or through an approval workflow set by the brand.
description.zh: 分析传统与 AI 搜索模式，起草商家资料或本地页面变更，并按品牌设置自动发布或通过审批流程发布。

summary.en: Turn search-pattern analysis into listing and local-page changes under automated or approval-based publishing.
summary.zh: 将搜索模式分析转为商家资料和本地页面变更，并自动或审批发布。

description.en: SOCi uses custom quotes based on location count and the Genius Agents and skills deployed. It does not charge per user or per business listing, page, or social profile.
description.zh: SOCi 根据门店数量和部署的 Genius Agents 与技能自定义报价；不按用户或商家资料、页面、社交档案数量收费。

summary.en: Custom quote by locations and deployed agents/skills; no per-user or per-profile/listing fees.
summary.zh: 按门店和部署的代理/技能自定义报价；无按用户或资料/listing 收费。

description.en: Some skills have package-specific usage limits that can be increased as the brand grows. Multiple agents can be bundled. There is no free trial; deployments are scoped through a custom quote and demo.
description.zh: 部分技能有随套餐变化的用量上限，可随品牌发展提高；多个代理可以组合。没有免费试用，部署通过自定义报价和演示确定范围。

summary.en: Some skills have adjustable package limits; bundling is available. No free trial, only a custom-quoted deployment.
summary.zh: 部分技能有可调整套餐上限，可组合代理；无免费试用，仅自定义报价部署。

description.en: Public product and pricing pages establish location-level monitoring of local search and AI-driven discovery, but do not state AI-answer sampling cadence, question quotas, or exact per-location AI-answer limits.
description.zh: 公开产品和价格页确认逐门店监测本地搜索和 AI 发现，但未说明 AI 回答采样频率、问题配额或确切的逐门店 AI 回答上限。

summary.en: AI-answer sampling cadence, question quotas, and per-location AI-answer limits are not publicly specified.
summary.zh: 未公开 AI 回答采样频率、问题配额及逐门店 AI 回答上限。

description.en: The free AI Visibility Snapshot is a separate acquisition tool, and the AI Visibility Hub is primarily educational. Their engine lists and metrics should not be treated as the paid agent's contracted monitoring quotas.
description.zh: 免费 AI Visibility Snapshot 是独立获客工具，AI Visibility Hub 主要提供教育内容；其中的引擎清单和指标不能视为付费代理的约定监测配额。

summary.en: Free Snapshot and educational Hub coverage does not establish paid-agent monitoring quotas.
summary.zh: 免费 Snapshot 和教育 Hub 的覆盖不能确定付费代理监测配额。

description.en: A fit for enterprise portfolios that need location-level monitoring plus automated local SEO execution and approval controls; buyers focused only on answer sampling should confirm engine-level quotas before contracting.
description.zh: 适合需要逐门店监测、自动本地 SEO 执行和审批控制的大型门店组合；只关注回答采量的买家应在签约前确认引擎级配额。

summary.en: Location monitoring plus automated local SEO execution; confirm engine-level answer quotas if sampling is the main requirement.
summary.zh: 逐门店监测结合自动本地 SEO 执行；若以回答采样为主，需确认引擎级配额。

label.en: SOCi Genius Local Search Agent product
label.zh: SOCi Genius Local Search Agent 产品页

label.en: SOCi location-level AI visibility measurement framework
label.zh: SOCi 逐门店 AI 曝光测量框架
SOCi 免费 AI Visibility Snapshot

description.en: An Apify Actor for checking how AI engines recommend a business in a city, matching results to public Google Maps listings, and returning competitors, citations, review gaps, an HTML report, and comparable run history.
description.zh: 一个 Apify Actor，用于检查 AI 引擎如何推荐某城市的企业，将结果匹配到公开 Google Maps 商家资料，并返回竞品、引用、评价缺口、HTML 报告和可比的运行历史。

en: City-level monitoring
Maps matching
Pay per answer
zh: 城市级监测
地图匹配
按回答计费

en: Accepts a business name and city or a precise Google Maps URL, then runs local service questions across selected engines.
Extracts recommended businesses, supporting quotes, recommendation positions, Maps matches, and identity-confidence reasons.
Reports competitors, citation sources, review gaps, share of voice, recommendation rates, and question-level winners.
Provides SUMMARY, REPORT.html, dataset exports, and named history for comparable sequential runs.
Can run through Apify's interface, API, schedules, integrations, or MCP.
zh: 接受企业名称和城市或精确 Google Maps 链接，再在选定引擎上运行本地服务问题。
提取被推荐企业、支持引文、推荐位置、地图匹配及身份置信度理由。
报告竞品、引用来源、评价缺口、声量占比、推荐率和逐问题胜出者。
提供 SUMMARY、REPORT.html、数据集导出和用于连续可比运行的具名历史。
可通过 Apify 界面、API、定时任务、集成或 MCP 运行。

audience.en: Analysts, agencies, local businesses, and technical teams comfortable with Apify, API-based sampling, and separately budgeted model usage.
audience.zh: 熟悉 Apify、API 采样并愿意单独预算模型用量的分析师、代理商、本地企业和技术团队。

description.en: Run local service questions for a city across selected engines and inspect the recommended businesses, supporting quotes, citations, and Maps evidence for the target and its competitors.
description.zh: 在城市中跨选定引擎运行本地服务问题，检查目标企业及竞品的被推荐情况、支持引文、引用和地图证据。

summary.en: Inspect city-level AI recommendations, supporting quotes, citations, and Maps evidence.
summary.zh: 检查城市级 AI 推荐、支持引文、引用和地图证据。

description.en: Schedule identical configurations sequentially and use named history to compare changes while keeping questions, settings, and model versions stable.
description.zh: 按相同配置连续安排定时运行，并使用具名历史比较变化，同时保持问题、设置和模型版本稳定。

summary.en: Use sequential, identical configurations for comparable history and change analysis.
summary.zh: 使用连续且相同的配置进行可比历史与变化分析。

description.en: The Actor costs USD 0.10 per analysed answer, equivalent to USD 80 per 1,000 answers, at the same event price on every Apify plan. Maps lookups, competitor discovery, SUMMARY, the HTML report, and history are included in the answer-event price.
description.zh: 该 Actor 每个已分析回答收费 0.10 美元，即 1,000 个回答 80 美元，所有 Apify 套餐的事件单价相同。地图查询、竞品发现、SUMMARY、HTML 报告和历史包含在回答事件价格中。

summary.en: USD 0.10 per analysed answer, or USD 80 per 1,000; Maps lookups, reports, and history are included.
summary.zh: 每个已分析回答 0.10 美元，1,000 个 80 美元；含地图查询、报告和历史。

description.en: A USD 0.00005 Actor start charge applies and counts toward the maximum cost per run. Answering-model usage and the separate Gemini Flash entity-extraction step are billed through Apify's OpenRouter gateway at its applicable rates.
description.zh: Actor 启动费为 0.00005 美元，计入每次运行的最高成本。回答模型和单独的 Gemini Flash 实体提取步骤通过 Apify 的 OpenRouter 网关按适用费率另行计费。

summary.en: USD 0.00005 start charge counts toward the run cap; answer and Gemini Flash extraction model usage is billed separately.
summary.zh: 启动费 0.00005 美元计入运行上限；回答与 Gemini Flash 提取模型用量另行计费。

description.en: Failed, refused, or unreadable answers have no answer-event charge, but the start charge and any completed model usage can still apply. The maximum-cost setting excludes separately billed gateway model usage.
description.zh: 失败、拒绝或不可读回答不收回答事件费，但启动费和已完成的模型用量仍可能收费。最高成本设置不包含另行计费的网关模型用量。

summary.en: Failed or unreadable answers have no answer-event fee, but start and completed model charges may remain; the run cap excludes gateway model usage.
summary.zh: 失败或不可读回答无事件费，但可能仍有启动和模型费；运行上限不含网关模型用量。

description.en: The Actor samples web-enabled API models, not signed-in consumer chat sessions. Country is approximate search context rather than GPS, and Maps reads public signed-out results.
description.zh: 该 Actor 采样启用网页的 API 模型，而非登录状态的消费者聊天会话。国家只是近似搜索上下文而非 GPS，地图读取的是公开未登录结果。

summary.en: API-model sampling, not signed-in consumer sessions; country is not GPS and Maps is public signed-out data.
summary.zh: 采样 API 模型而非登录消费者会话；国家非 GPS，地图为公开未登录数据。

description.en: Google AI Overview requires a readable answer in the SERP page. Google AI Mode often loads asynchronously through an unsupported route, and the Actor does not solve browser challenges or use an alternative paid data supplier.
description.zh: Google AI Overview 需要 SERP 页面中存在可读回答。Google AI Mode 常通过不支持的异步路由加载，Actor 不解决浏览器挑战，也不使用替代付费数据供应商。

summary.en: Google AI Overview needs readable SERP answers; AI Mode is often unavailable, with no browser-challenge bypass or alternate supplier.
summary.zh: AI Overview 需 SERP 可读回答；AI Mode 常不可用，不绕过浏览器挑战或改用其他供应商。

description.en: A run supports up to 10 services, 10 neighbourhoods, 100 explicit prompts, 100 answer attempts, 25 extracted businesses per answer, and 150 Maps requests. Generated intent templates are English, so other languages need explicit prompts. History comparisons require unchanged questions, settings, and model versions.
description.zh: 每次运行最多支持 10 个服务、10 个社区、100 个显式问题、100 次回答尝试、每个回答提取 25 家企业及 150 次地图请求。生成的意图模板为英文，其他语言需显式提问；历史比较要求问题、设置和模型版本不变。

summary.en: Caps include 10 services, 10 neighbourhoods, 100 prompts/answers, 25 businesses per answer, and 150 Maps requests; templates are English and history needs stable settings.
summary.zh: 上限含 10 服务、10 社区、100 问题/回答、每回答 25 企业、150 地图请求；模板英文，历史比较需稳定设置。

description.en: This is a Community Actor. Apify does not vet, endorse, or guarantee Community Actors, and users must perform their own due diligence, grant appropriate permissions, and independently verify outputs. The Standard Actor Contract limits use to internal business purposes, prohibits redistribution or resale, and caps creator liability at USD 100.
description.zh: 这是社区 Actor。Apify 不审核、背书或保证社区 Actor，用户必须自行尽调、授予适当权限并独立核实输出。Standard Actor Contract 仅限内部商业使用，禁止再分发或转售，并将创作者责任上限设为 100 美元。

summary.en: Community Actor without Apify vetting; user due diligence and output verification are required. Internal use only, no redistribution, and creator liability is capped at USD 100.
summary.zh: 社区 Actor 未经 Apify 审核；需用户尽调和核实输出。限内部使用、禁再分发，创作者责任上限 100 美元。

description.en: Zaiq's privacy policy covers personal information collected through zaiq.ai and does not separately describe all Actor-input processing. Apify's Actor terms also require users to review the creator's data-handling practices for Community Actors.
description.zh: Zaiq 的隐私政策覆盖通过 zaiq.ai 收集的个人信息，未单独说明全部 Actor 输入处理。Apify 的 Actor 条款还要求用户审查社区 Actor 创作者的数据处理方式。

summary.en: Zaiq's site privacy policy does not fully describe Actor-input processing; review creator data handling before use.
summary.zh: Zaiq 网站隐私政策未完整说明 Actor 输入处理；使用前需审查创作者数据处理方式。

description.en: A fit for technical teams that want per-answer pricing, raw answer evidence, and Maps matching; budget separate model charges and perform code, data, and permission due diligence before production use.
description.zh: 适合需要按回答计费、原始回答证据和地图匹配的技术团队；应预算单独模型费用，并在生产使用前对代码、数据和权限进行尽调。

summary.en: Per-answer pricing with raw evidence and Maps matching; budget model fees and complete Community Actor due diligence.
summary.zh: 按回答计费并提供原始证据和地图匹配；需预算模型费并完成社区 Actor 尽调。

label.zh: Zaiq 在 Apify 的创作者资料

label.en: Zaiq Privacy Policy and POPIA statement
label.zh: Zaiq 隐私政策与 POPIA 声明

label.en: Apify Create Actor API schema for USD event prices
label.zh: Apify Create Actor API 的美元事件价格架构

description.en: Enterprise multi-location reputation platform combining business listings, AI-ready location pages with schema and llms.txt, reviews, surveys, and AI-powered internal insight, with GEO Readiness diagnostics and structured-data remediation rather than consumer AI-answer monitoring.
description.zh: 面向企业的多门店声誉平台，集商家列表、带结构化数据和 llms.txt 的 AI 就绪门店页面、评价、问卷及 AI 驱动的内部洞察于一体，提供 GEO Readiness 诊断和结构化数据修复，而非消费者 AI 回答监测。

en: Multi-location
Listings & AI-ready pages
Reputation intelligence
zh: 多门店
列表与 AI 就绪页面
声誉智能

en: Structure and sync business data across 100+ listing platforms, with bulk controls, duplicate suppression, local benchmarking, and role-based access.
Publish listings-native location pages with LocalBusiness, Review, and FAQPage schema, JSON-LD, llms.txt, live review widgets, automatic updates, and IndexNow.
Score each location's GEO Readiness across discovery, schema, content, technical setup, and server-side rendering, then prioritize remediation.
Centralize review requests and reviews from Google, Facebook, Yelp, and industry sites, with AI-assisted replies, sentiment workflows, and multi-location reporting.
Ask natural-language questions of review and survey data in Reputation IQ, with role-aware insights, root-cause summaries, benchmarks, and action routing.
zh: 构建并同步商家数据至 100 多个列表平台，提供批量控制、重复抑制、本地对标和角色权限。
发布以商家列表为数据源的门店页面，包含 LocalBusiness、Review、FAQPage 结构化数据、JSON-LD、llms.txt、实时评价组件、自动更新和 IndexNow。
从发现、结构化数据、内容、技术配置和服务端渲染五个维度为每个门店的 GEO Readiness 评分，并确定修复优先级。
集中管理评价邀请以及来自 Google、Facebook、Yelp 和行业站点的评价，提供 AI 辅助回复、情绪工作流和多门店报告。
在 Reputation IQ 中用自然语言查询评价和问卷数据，获得角色感知洞察、根因摘要、对标和行动路由。

audience.en: Enterprise and multi-location brands, franchise groups, healthcare networks, automotive groups, and hospitality or retail operators that need coordinated local presence and reputation operations.
audience.zh: 需要协调本地形象和声誉运营的企业及多门店品牌、连锁集团、医疗网络、汽车集团，以及酒店或零售运营商。

description.en: Use GEO Readiness to identify weak location signals, then publish Pages from verified Business Listings data with schema, llms.txt, current hours and reviews, server-side rendering, and automatic re-publication.
description.zh: 使用 GEO Readiness 找出薄弱门店信号，再基于已验证的商家列表数据发布 Pages，内置结构化数据、llms.txt、最新营业时间和评价、服务端渲染及自动重新发布。

summary.en: Diagnose per-location GEO gaps and remediate them with listings-native, AI-ready pages.
summary.zh: 诊断逐门店 GEO 缺口，并以商家列表为数据源的 AI 就绪页面修复。

description.en: Keep hours, addresses, categories, and other location data consistent across major directories, find duplicate listings, compare local performance with competitors, and delegate changes by brand, region, or location.
description.zh: 保持营业时间、地址、分类等门店数据在主要目录中一致，查找重复列表，对比本地表现与竞品，并按品牌、区域或门店委派变更。

summary.en: Maintain accurate multi-platform listings, suppress duplicates, benchmark locally, and control access by organizational scope.
summary.zh: 维护多平台准确列表、抑制重复、进行本地对标，并按组织范围控制权限。

description.en: Run SMS and email review requests, manage a unified inbox, draft brand-aligned replies, classify sentiment, route issues, and compare review volume, ratings, and response times across locations and competitors.
description.zh: 运行短信和邮件评价邀请、管理统一收件箱、起草符合品牌的回复、分类情绪、路由问题，并跨门店和竞品对比评价数量、评分及响应时间。

summary.en: Coordinate review generation, response, sentiment, escalation, and benchmarking across a location estate.
summary.zh: 在门店组合中协调评价获取、回复、情绪、升级和对标。

description.en: Ask Reputation IQ plain-language questions over unified review and survey data, respect hierarchy and role permissions, identify root causes in open-text feedback, benchmark competitors, and route insights into tickets or alerts.
description.zh: 在 Reputation IQ 中用自然语言查询统一的评价和问卷数据，遵循组织层级和角色权限，从开放文本中识别根因，对比竞品，并把洞察路由到工单或提醒。

summary.en: Turn internal review and survey data into permissioned, role-aware answers and operational actions.
summary.zh: 将内部评价和问卷数据转化为受权限控制、角色感知的答案和运营行动。

description.en: Rep Core is USD 80 per location per month. It includes Reviews Management—collection, requesting, and AI responding—and Business Listings & SEO. The USD currency and per-location/month unit are explicit in the official structured pricing data.
description.zh: Rep Core 为每个门店每月 80 美元，包含 Reviews Management（评价收集、邀请和 AI 回复）以及 Business Listings & SEO。官方结构化价格数据明确标注美元币种和每门店每月单位。

summary.en: Rep Core: USD 80/location/month, including reviews management with AI responding and Business Listings & SEO.
summary.zh: Rep Core：80 美元/门店/月，包含带 AI 回复的评价管理和 Business Listings & SEO。

description.en: Rep Core + Pulse is USD 115 per location per month. It adds Reputation Insights, AI Reputation Manager, Pulse Analytics, and one basic survey template with star rating and text.
description.zh: Rep Core + Pulse 为每个门店每月 115 美元，增加 Reputation Insights、AI Reputation Manager、Pulse Analytics，以及一个含星级和文本的基础问卷模板。

summary.en: Rep Core + Pulse: USD 115/location/month; adds insights, AI Reputation Manager, Pulse Analytics, and one basic survey template.
summary.zh: Rep Core + Pulse：115 美元/门店/月；增加洞察、AI Reputation Manager、Pulse Analytics 和一个基础问卷模板。

description.en: Rep Core + Surveys is USD 150 per location per month. It includes six custom survey templates, email survey requesting, targeted outreach campaigns, and Deep Experience Insights.
description.zh: Rep Core + Surveys 为每个门店每月 150 美元，包含六个自定义问卷模板、邮件问卷邀请、定向触达活动和 Deep Experience Insights。

summary.en: Rep Core + Surveys: USD 150/location/month; six custom templates, email requests, targeted campaigns, and Deep Experience Insights.
summary.zh: Rep Core + Surveys：150 美元/门店/月；六个自定义模板、邮件邀请、定向活动和 Deep Experience Insights。

description.en: Enterprise pricing is custom for 125+ locations. Competitive Insights, Actions & Ticketing, Social Suite, Premium Sources, Premium Integrations, Managed Services, and Expert & Professional Services are listed as upgrades or services without public prices.
description.zh: 125 个以上门店的企业版采用自定义价格。Competitive Insights、Actions & Ticketing、Social Suite、Premium Sources、Premium Integrations、Managed Services 和 Expert & Professional Services 列为升级或服务，但未公布价格。

summary.en: Enterprise is custom for 125+ locations; listed upgrades and services have no public add-on prices.
summary.zh: 125+ 门店企业版自定义报价；所列升级和服务未公布附加价格。

description.en: The public pricing page does not advertise a current trial, refund, annual commitment, or minimum below the enterprise threshold. The Service Agreement says a 30-day trial applies only if Reputation permits one, subscriptions auto-renew for equal-length terms unless either party gives at least 30 days' written notice before term end, and there is no general money-back guarantee. The free GEO Readiness report is separate from the paid platform.
description.zh: 公开价格页未宣传当前试用、退款、年度承诺或企业阈值以下的最低消费。服务协议称只有 Reputation 允许时才适用 30 天试用；除非任一方在期末前至少提前 30 天书面通知，订阅按等长期限自动续费；没有普遍退款保证。免费 GEO Readiness 报告独立于付费平台。

summary.en: No public general trial/refund promise; trial only if permitted, equal-term auto-renewal with 30-day notice, and the free readiness report is not a platform free tier.
summary.zh: 无公开普遍试用/退款承诺；试用须获许可，等期自动续费并需提前 30 天通知，免费就绪报告不构成平台免费层。

description.en: Reputation's GEO evidence concerns structured data, AI-ready pages, GEO Readiness scoring, and remediation for AI Overviews and voice discovery. The reviewed sources do not establish direct sampling of ChatGPT, Gemini, or other consumer AI answers, so it should not be selected as an AI-answer visibility tracker.
description.zh: Reputation 的 GEO 证据涉及结构化数据、AI 就绪页面、GEO Readiness 评分，以及针对 AI Overviews 和语音发现的修复。本次核验来源未证明其直接采样 ChatGPT、Gemini 或其他消费者 AI 回答，因此不应将其作为 AI 回答曝光追踪器选择。

summary.en: GEO readiness and remediation are verified; direct consumer AI-answer sampling is not.
summary.zh: 已证实 GEO 就绪和修复能力；未证实直接采样消费者 AI 回答。

description.en: The current privacy notice covers online reviews, social media, and AI-generated responses, names OpenAI as an opt-in Reviews provider, and says customer personal data is not used to train general-purpose AI models unless otherwise agreed. However, it does not provide an explicit Google API limited-use statement, GBP-specific OAuth scopes, or a fixed review/AI retention schedule; retention is described only as as long as needed. The DPA separately requires deletion or return within 90 days after services cease, unless law requires otherwise.
description.zh: 当前隐私声明覆盖在线评价、社交媒体和 AI 生成回复，明确 OpenAI 是 Reviews 的可选启用供应商，并称除非另有约定，客户个人数据不用于训练通用 AI 模型。但它没有明确的 Google API 有限使用声明、商家资料专属 OAuth 权限或固定评价/AI 保留期限；保留仅表述为按需保留。DPA 另要求服务停止后 90 天内删除或返还数据，法律另有要求的除外。

summary.en: Current review/AI disclosures are substantial, but Google limited-use, GBP scopes, and fixed review/AI retention remain unclear; DPA cessation deletion is 90 days.
summary.zh: 当前评价/AI 披露较完整，但 Google 有限使用、商家资料权限和固定评价/AI 保留期仍不清楚；DPA 服务停止后删除期为 90 天。

description.en: AI Auto-Response is described as analyzing sentiment and drafting brand-aligned replies; mandatory human approval is not established. Product material also describes private surveys followed by prompting happy respondents to leave public reviews, creating a review-gating and third-party platform-policy risk. Genuine negative reviews are not represented as removable.
description.zh: AI Auto-Response 被描述为分析情绪并起草符合品牌的回复；未证实必须人工批准。产品材料还描述先进行私有问卷，再引导满意受访者留下公开评价，形成评价筛选和第三方平台政策风险。材料未声称可删除真实负面评价。

summary.en: Human approval is not guaranteed for AI replies, and the survey-to-public-review flow creates review-gating/platform-policy risk.
summary.zh: AI 回复不保证必须人工批准，问卷到公开评价的流程存在评价筛选/平台政策风险。

description.en: Commercial details are controlled by the Order Form. Fees are due within 30 days of invoice unless otherwise specified, subscriptions renew automatically, and refunds are limited to specified circumstances such as an uncured material breach, qualifying warranty remedy, immediate material modification, or unresolved subprocessor objection. Reputation may permanently delete Customer Content after termination, and third-party listing/review coverage can change.
description.zh: 商务细节由 Order Form 控制。除非另有规定，发票后 30 天内付款；订阅自动续费；退款仅限于未纠正的重大违约、符合条件的保证救济、即时重大修改或未解决的子处理方异议等特定情形。服务终止后 Reputation 可永久删除客户内容，第三方列表/评价覆盖也可能变化。

summary.en: Order Form controls commercials; renewal and limited-refund rules apply, post-termination content may be deleted, and third-party coverage may change.
summary.zh: 商务条款由 Order Form 控制；适用续费和有限退款规则，终止后内容可能删除，第三方覆盖可能变化。

description.en: The DPA and subprocessor page contain official security and compliance statements, including SOC2 Type II/HIPAA claims and named cloud, messaging, analytics, and AI processors. These were not independently audited for this directory entry and must not be read as a legal certification or a guarantee of a particular customer's compliance scope. Some EU-platform processing remains in the US.
description.zh: DPA 和子处理方页面包含官方安全与合规声明，包括 SOC2 Type II/HIPAA 声明以及具名云、消息、分析和 AI 处理方。本次目录收录未对其进行独立审计，不能解读为法律认证或保证特定客户的合规范围。部分欧盟平台处理仍在美国进行。

summary.en: Security/compliance statements are official claims, not independently verified certification; some EU-platform subprocessors process in the US.
summary.zh: 安全/合规声明属于官方主张，不是独立验证的认证；部分欧盟平台子处理方在美国处理数据。

description.en: A fit for multi-location organizations that need listings, reviews, surveys, AI-ready pages, and reputation analytics under one operational platform. Confirm Google data-use terms, AI approval controls, review-request policy, and Order Form commercials before rollout; pair it with a dedicated tracker if consumer AI-answer measurement is required.
description.zh: 适合需要在同一运营平台中管理商家列表、评价、问卷、AI 就绪页面和声誉分析的多门店组织。上线前应确认 Google 数据使用条款、AI 审批控制、评价邀请政策和 Order Form 商务条款；如需测量消费者 AI 回答，应另配专用追踪器。

summary.en: Strong integrated local-presence and reputation suite; validate Google/AI/review controls and add separate AI-answer tracking if needed.
summary.zh: 本地形象与声誉整合能力强；需验证 Google/AI/评价控制，必要时另加 AI 回答追踪。
